text: Gin-postpone ang world super-bantamweight title fight sang Japanese superstar nga si Naoya ‘Monster’ Inoue batok kay American World Boxing Council kag World Boxing Organization champion Stephen Fulton matapos na-injure ang kamot sang Japanese boxer sa training.
english: Japanese superstar Naoya ‘Monster’ Inoue’s world super-bantamweight title fight against American World Boxing Council and World Boxing Organization champion Stephen Fulton has been postponed after the Japanese boxer injured his hand in training.

text: Natalana kuntani nga magsabak si Inoue sa iya super-bantamweight debut batok kay Fulton sa Yokohama sa Mayo 7.
english: Inoue was scheduled to make his super-bantamweight debut against Fulton in Yokohama on May 7.

text: Apang bangud sa injury, gin-isol ang away sa bulan sang Hulyo.
english: However, due to injury, the fight was postponed to July.

text: Nagpangayo man sang pasaylo ang unbeaten Japanese star sa kampo ni Fulton bangud sa problema nga natuga sini.
english: The unbeaten Japanese star also apologized to Fulton's camp for the trouble it caused.

text: Nakadaog si Inoue sang world titles sa tatlo ka magkatuhay nga weight divisions, kag sang Disyembre, gintumba sini si Paul Butler sang England kag nangin una nga undisputed bantamweight world champion halin sa nahimo nga rekord ni Enrique Pinder sang Panama sang 1972.
english: Inoue has won world titles in three different weight divisions, and in December, he knocked out Paul Butler of England to become the first undisputed bantamweight world champion since the record set by Enrique Pinder of Panama in 1972.

text: Sang Enero, ginpangbakante ini nga mga titulo matapos nag-desisyon si Inoue nga magsaka sa super-bantamweight division.
english: In January, these titles were vacated after Inoue decided to move up to the super-bantamweight division.

text: Ang 28-anyos naman nga si Fulton ang wala man sang kalutusan sa 21 fights nga may walo ka knock-outs.
english: The 28-year-old Fulton is also undefeated in 21 fights with eight knock-outs.

text: Ginpaathag ni Mayor Raisa Treñas ang iya suporta sa Catch, Neuter, Vaccinate, and Release (CNVR) program sang City Veterinary Office sa Iloilo City, apang ginpabutyag man niya nga kinahanglan ini nga i-review kag tan-awon sa case-to-case basis, ilabi na sa mga lugar nga may dalagku nga populasyon kag problema sa basura.
english: Mayor Raisa Treñas explained her support for the Catch, Neuter, Vaccinate, and Release (CNVR) program of the City Veterinary Office in Iloilo City, but she also expressed that it needs to be reviewed and looked at on a case-to-case basis, especially in areas with large populations and garbage problems.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga samtang isa ka maayo kag makatawhan nga inisyatibo ang CNVR program, kinahanglan nga husto ang pagpatuman sini agud malikawan ang mas madamo pa nga isyu sa kahilwayan sang mga sapat sa mga barangay.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Treñas said that while the CNVR program is a good and humane initiative, it must be implemented properly to avoid more issues on the freedom of animals in the barangays.

text: Suno sa alkalde, isa sa mga ginapanguna nga pagpanghangkat amo ang mga ido ukon kuring nga nagalapta sang basura, ilabi na gid ang mga plastic kag diaper.
english: According to the mayor, one of the main challenges is dogs or cats that spread garbage, especially plastics and diapers.

text: Ginklaro niya nga suportado niya ang programa, apang dapat hatagan man sang lugar kun diin ibalik ang mga sapat matapos nga ma-neuter kag mabakunahan.
english: He clarified that he supports the program, but it should also be given a place where the animals can be returned after being neutered and vaccinated.

text: Ang CNVR strategy ginadumalahan sang City Veterinary Office kag kabahin sini ang humane catching sang mga layaw nga ido kag kuring, sterilization, rabies vaccination.
english: The CNVR strategy is managed by the City Veterinary Office and includes humane catching of stray dogs and cats, sterilization, rabies vaccination.

text: Bisan pa man nga kilala ini nga ethical solution sa sobra nga populasyon sang layaw nga sapat, ginpabutyag sang alkalde nga ang kahilwayan sang mga sapat sa wala sang monitoring posible nga magresulta sa dugang nga problema sa mga lugar nga may mataas nga populasyon.
english: Although it is known to be an ethical solution to the overpopulation of stray animals, the mayor expressed that the freedom of animals in the absence of monitoring is likely to result in more problems in areas with high populations.

text: Base sa datos sang syudad, 6,130 na ka sapat ang nabakunahan samtang 185 na ang na-neuter.
english: Based on city data, 6,130 animals have been vaccinated while 185 have been neutered.

text: Ginaplano man ni Mayor Treñas nga makigsapol siya sa mga animal welfare advocates agud mapabaskug pa ang koordinasyon kag mapadasig ang maayo nga implementasyon sang programa.
english: Mayor Treñas also plans to meet with animal welfare advocates to strengthen coordination and accelerate the proper implementation of the program.

text: Apisar wala ang main man nga si June Mar Fajardo bangud sa naangkon nga injury, nagapalangkaak sa gihapon ang abilidad sang San Miguel Beermen sa Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) Governors’ Cup sa pagpanguna ni CJ Perez nga amo ang ginhingadlan nga Press Corps Player of the Week.
english: Despite the absence of main man June Mar Fajardo due to injury, the San Miguel Beermen are still performing well in the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) Governors' Cup under the leadership of CJ Perez who was named Press Corps Player of the Week.

text: Nakuha ni Perez ini nga award sa extended period halin Marso 8-19.
english: Perez won this award in the extended period from March 8-19.

text: Gingiyahan sini ang second-seeded Beermen tubtub nga nakalab-ot na ang team sa semifinals.
english: He guided the second-seeded Beermen until the team reached the semifinals.

text: Contender man si Perez sa Best Player of the Conference race nga may average nga 23 points, 10.3 rebounds, 5 assists, kag 3.3 steals sa tatlo ka sunod-sunod nga kadalag-an lakip na ang 121-105 nga resulta sang hampang batok sa Converge nga amo ang nagpalab-ot sa San Miguel sa final four.
english: Perez is also a contender in the Best Player of the Conference race averaging 23 points, 10.3 rebounds, 5 assists, and 3.3 steals in three straight wins including a 121-105 game result over Converge that advanced San Miguel to the final four.

text: Gindayaw ang performance sang Pangasinan native apisar nga kapoy ini sa sunod-sunod nga mga hampang sang nagligad nga tatlo ka semana lakip na ang hampang kaupod sa Gilas Pilipinas sa FIBA World Cup Asian Qualifiers, ang East Asian Super League Champions Week sa Japan, kag ang PBA All-Star sa Passi City, Iloilo.
english: The Pangasinan native's performance was praised despite being tired in consecutive games in the past three weeks including the game with Gilas Pilipinas in the FIBA ​​World Cup Asian Qualifiers, the East Asian Super League Champions Week in Japan, and the PBA All-Star in Passi City, Iloilo.

text: Ang Press Corps Player of the Week amo ang weekly honor nga ginahatag sang grupo sang print kag online media nga may PBA beat.
english: Press Corps Player of the Week is the weekly honor given by the group of print and online media with a PBA beat.

text: Nangibabaw si Perez sa iban pa nga ginpilian nga sanday Vic Manuel nga iya teammate, Roger Pogoy sang TNT, kag Christian Standhardinger sang Ginebra.
english: Perez topped other selections of teammate Vic Manuel, TNT’s Roger Pogoy, and Ginebra’s Christian Standhardinger.

text: Ginbulgar ni Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David nga nakapalapit sa iya kag nagpangayo sang “moral and spiritual advice” ang pila sa mga Katoliko nga senador kag kongresista nga involved sa kurapsyon sa flood control projects.
english: Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David revealed that some of the Catholic senators and congressmen involved in corruption in flood control projects approached him and asked for “moral and spiritual advice”.

text: Wala ginhingadlan ni Cardinal David kun sanday sin-o kag pila ka legislators ang nagkadto sa iya, apang ginkumpirma sini nga pareho nga may halin sa Senado kag sa Kamara.
english: Cardinal David did not name who and how many legislators came to him, but he confirmed that there were both from the Senate and the House.

text: Wala man sini ginhinambit kun san-o nagkadto sa iya ang amo nga mga indibidwal.
english: He also did not mention when the individuals came to him.

text: Nagapati si Cardinal David nga patimaan ini nga buhi pa ang konsensya sang mga involved kag apektado man sila sa kun ano na ang nagakatabo subong.
english: Cardinal David believes that this is a sign that the conscience of those involved is still alive and they are also affected by what is happening now.

text: “Well, now many of them are waking up.
english: “Well, now many of them are waking up.

text: And that’s good.
english: And that’s good.

text: Nasasaktan na sila.
english: They are already hurting.

text: That means buhay ‘yung conscience nila.
english: That means their conscience is alive.

text: Hindi pa ‘yan patay.
english: It’s not dead yet.

text: Buhay pa ‘yan.
english: It’s still alive.

text: Pwede pa ‘yang magbago.
english: It can still change.

text: Kasi affected sila,” pahayag sang Filipino cardinal nga amo man ang presidente sang Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP).
english: Because they are affected,” said the Filipino cardinal who is also president of the Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP).

text: Matandaan nga sa ginpatigayon nga mga hearing sa Kongreso, na-implicate ang pila ka mga kongresista kag senador paagi sa pagbaton sang kickback.
english: It can be recalled that in the hearings conducted in Congress, some congressmen and senators were implicated by receiving kickbacks.

text: Tanan ini nga mga opisyal ang nagpanginwala nga may kahilabtanan sa kurapsyon.
english: All these officials have denied involvement in corruption.

text: Sa bahin sang Simbahan, ginklaro sang Cardinal nga wala sang balibaran ilabi na kun nagapangayo sila sang giya sa espiritual kag moral nga aspeto.
english: On the part of the Church, the Cardinal clarified that there is no refusal especially when they ask for guidance in spiritual and moral aspects.

text: “We will not turn down people who, in all honesty, are really seeking our spiritual and moral advice, despite their reputation,” pahayag ni David.
english: “We will not turn down people who, in all honesty, are really seeking our spiritual and moral advice, despite their reputation,” stated David.

text: Dugang pa sini, sang nagpalapit sa iya ang mga opisyal, wala sang may nagklaro kun handa sila nga magkadto sa awtoridad kag mag-ako sa ila nga mga sala.
english: He added that when the officers approached him, none of them clarified whether they were ready to go to the authorities and confess to their crimes.

text: “Nung sabihin ko lang… ‘What are you willing to admit?
english: “If I just said… ‘What are you willing to admit?

text: Hanggang saan?’ Siyempre tahimik sila, and then merong tipo na, ‘I know the legal implications of that,'” suno kay David.
english: How far?’ Of course they were quiet, and then there was like, ‘I know the legal implications of that,'” David said.

text:
“‘Am I ready to face those legal implications?’ Parang gano’n. It’s an offer, at least they know they are aware of it.”

Nagpahanumdom man ini nga indi lang tubtub sa pagpangumpisar ang dapat nga himuon.
english:
“‘Am I ready to face those legal implications?’ Parang gano’n. It’s an offer, at least they know they are aware of it.”

He also reminded that it is not enough to confess.

text: Dapat suno sa iya nga may paghinulsol kag pagasundan sang “act of reparation” ukon pag-uli sa kun ano man ang kinawatan.#
english: He said there should be repentance followed by an act of reparation.

text: Hugot nga ginapatuman sang Police Regional Office 6 (PRO6) ang non-partisan policy sa mga katapo nga kapulisan subong nga 2025 midterm elections.
english: The Police Regional Office 6 (PRO6) is strictly implementing the non-partisan policy to police officers during the 2025 midterm elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson sang Police Regional Office 6, iya ginpahayag nga ang talatapan ang dapat magpabilin nga neutral ilabi na nga nagatrabaho sa gobyerno ang kapulisan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office 6, said the office should remain neutral especially as the police work for the government.

text: Suno kay Solis, may mga pagsulundan ukon rekisitos nga dapat sundon agud nga mapabilin ang loyalty para sa pungsod kag indi sa kandidato.
english: According to Solis, there are rules or requirements that must be followed in order to maintain loyalty to the country and not to the candidate.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga gina-abi-abi sang PRO6 kon may pulis gidman nga magpakita sang iya suporta apang nagakinahanglan sa gihapon nga sundon ang layi kag indi dapat maglapaw sa limitasyon.
english: He also said that PRO6 welcomes any policeman to show his support but still needs to follow the law and should not exceed the limit.

text: Nakadependi na man sa nakomiter nga bayolasyon sang isa ka pulis ang magapangatubang sini nga silot.
english: It also depends on the violation committed by a police officer who will face this punishment.

text: Gin-athag sang aktor nga si Diego Loyzaga nga wala sila nagbalikanay sang iya ex-girlfriend nga si Barbie Imperial.
english: Actor Diego Loyzaga clarified that he and his ex-girlfriend Barbie Imperial did not get back together.

text: Una diri may mga espekulasyon nga nag-reconcile ang duha matapos nakit-an nga magkaupod nga nagakaon sa Pasig City.
english: Earlier, there were speculations that the two reconciled after they were seen eating together in Pasig City.

text: Suno naman sa aktor, ‘friends in talking terms’ sila ni Barbie.
english: According to the actor, they are 'friends in talking terms' with Barbie.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga wala sila sang bad breakup — baliskad sa naglapta nga istorya sang bulan sang Pebrero.
english: He also said that they did not have a bad breakup — contrary to the story that circulated in February.

text: Sa pamangkot kun posible ayhan ang reconciliation sa aktres, ginpahayag ni Diego nga depende pa ini sa ila nga mabatyagan.
english: When asked if reconciliation with the actress is possible, Diego said it depends on their feelings.

text: Dead on arrival ang isa ka college student matapos nadisgrasya sa Brgy.
english: A college student is dead on arrival after being involved in an accident in Brgy.

text: Lico-an, Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo.
english: Lico-an, Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Novie John Esmolina Samuel, 20, residente sang Brgy.
english: The victim was identified as Novie John Esmolina Samuel, 20, resident of Brgy.

text: Merced, Banate, Iloilo.
english: Merced, Banate, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Police Captain Cedrick Cruz, hepe sang Barotac Nuevo Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga padulong ang biktima sa iya eskwelahan sang natabo ang aksidente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Police Captain Cedrick Cruz, chief of the Barotac Nuevo Municipal Police Station, said the victim was on his way to his school when the accident occurred.

text: Suno kay Cruz, tuyo kuntani sang biktima nga mag overtake sa elf truck kaso nadulaan sang control rason nga ini siyanga natumba.
english: According to Cruz, the victim tried to overtake the elf truck but lost control and fell.

text: Base sa imbistigasyon, wala sang sala ang elf truck, tungod natumba na ang biktima bag-o ini nakabunggo ang ginamaneho nga motorsiklo nalikod nga bahin sini.
english: According to the investigation, the elf truck was not at fault, because the victim fell before he hit the motorcycle in the back.

text: Sa subong, temporaryo naman nga gin-costudy ang truck kag mismo ang driver sini sa Barotac Nuevo MPS.
english: The truck and its driver are now temporarily detained at Barotac Nuevo MPS.

text: Sa pagtalakay ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: In a discussion with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sa sektor sang enerhiya sa iya ika-apat nga State of the Nation Address (SONA), ginpabutyag sang MORE Electric and Power Corporation (MORE Power) ang suporta sini sa paglapad sang Lifeline Rate coverage para sa mga konsumidor ilabi na sa marginalized sector.
english: on the energy sector in its fourth State of the Nation Address (SONA), MORE Electric and Power Corporation (MORE Power) expressed its support for the expansion of Lifeline Rate coverage for consumers especially in the marginalized sector.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Angel Tan, Strategic Communication Officer kag tagpamaba sang MORE Power, ginpahayag niya nga ang expansion sang Lifeline Rate magahatag sang daku nga oportunidad sa mga pumuluyo nga naga-obra sang minimum wage ukon may manubo nga konsumo sang kuryente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Angel Tan, Strategic Communication Officer and spokesperson of MORE Power, said the expansion of the Lifeline Rate will provide great opportunities to residents who work on minimum wage or have low electricity consumption.

text: Suno kay Tan, ini nga inisyatibo nagahatag kabakod sa prinsipyo nga ang access sa kuryente isa ka kinamatarong, indi lang serbisyo.
english: Tan said this initiative reinforces the principle that access to electricity is a right, not just a service.

text: Sa subong, may 5,610 ka lifeline beneficiaries na ang MORE Power, kag ginapaabot nga ini nga numero magataas pa kasunod sang pahayag sang presidente nga palapadon ang coverage sang programa.
english: Currently, MORE Power has 5,610 lifeline beneficiaries, and this number is expected to increase following the president's announcement to expand the coverage of the program.

text: Diri na kalakip indi lang ang 4Ps members kundi pati na ang iban nga kwalipikado base sa income kag konsumo.
english: This includes not only 4Ps members but also others who qualify based on income and consumption.

text: Ginpasangkad man sang Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) ang serbisyo sini paagi sa satellite office sa Iloilo City sang 2023, suno sa tripartite agreement upod ang Iloilo City Government kag MORE Power, agud mapadasig ang proseso sang Net Metering applications.
english: The Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) also expanded its services through a satellite office in Iloilo City in 2023, pursuant to a tripartite agreement with the Iloilo City Government and MORE Power, to expedite the process of Net Metering applications.

text: Ginpabutyag ni MORE Power President kag CEO Roel Castro nga ang kompanya padayon nga naga-invest sa moderno nga teknolohiya kag mga inobasyon nga nagapabaskug sang operational efficiency, kag ginaprayoridad ang mga programa nga nagahatag benepisyo sa marginalized sector.
english: MORE Power President and CEO Roel Castro stressed that the company continues to invest in modern technology and innovations that boost operational efficiency, and prioritizes programs that benefit the marginalized sector.

text: Nagapanguna si Christian Standhardinger sang Barangay Ginebra sa contenders para sa Best Player of the Conference (BPC) sa Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) Governors Cup.
english: Christian Standhardinger of Barangay Ginebra leads the contenders for Best Player of the Conference (BPC) in the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) Governors Cup.

text: Sa statistics tally nga gin-release sang liga sa katapusan sang eliminations, nakatipon si Standhardinger sang 42.8 statistical points pagkatapos sang solid numbers nga 22.9 points, 10.2 rebounds, kag 6.0 assists sa siyam ka mga hampang.
english: In the statistics tally released by the league at the end of the eliminations, Standhardinger accumulated 42.8 statistical points after solid numbers of 22.9 points, 10.2 rebounds, and 6.0 assists in nine games.

text: Ang 30-anyos nga Filipino-German star amo ang nangin main option sang Kings matapos ang injury nga naangkon ni Japeth Aguilar.
english: The 30-year-old Filipino-German star became the main option for the Kings after the injury suffered by Japeth Aguilar.

text: Nagasunod sa iya sa BPC race amo si CJ Perez nga may 39.3 statistical points kag June Mar Fajardo nga may 37.6 statistical points.
english: Following him in the BPC race are CJ Perez with 39.3 statistical points and June Mar Fajardo with 37.6 statistical points.

text: Nagtabog naman sa ika-11 nga pwesto si Scottie Thompson nga amo ang reigning Most Valuable Player kag Best Player of the Conference winner sang Commissioner’s Cup.
english: Scottie Thompson, the reigning Most Valuable Player and Best Player of the Conference winner of the Commissioner's Cup, finished 11th.

text: Samtang, sa Best Import race naman, leading candidate si Rondae Hollis Jefferson sang Talk ‘N Text nga may 59.0 statistical points.
english: Meanwhile, in the Best Import race, Rondae Hollis Jefferson of Talk ‘N Text is the leading candidate with 59.0 statistical points.

text: Ginbuyagyag subong nga adlaw ni Senadora Risa Hontiveros ang kopya sang iya Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN) para sa tuig 2024, bilang kabahin sang iya padayon nga panawagan para sa transparency kag accountability sa serbisyo publiko.
english: Senator Risa Hontiveros today unveiled a copy of her Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN) for the year 2024, as part of her continued call for transparency and accountability in the public service.

text: Sa iya ginpagguwa nga SALN, nagapakita nga may yara si Hontiveros sang total assets nga nagalab-ot sa P20 million, may liabilities nga malapit sa P900,000, kag net worth nga halos P19 million, base sa data tubtob Disyembre 31, 2024.
english: In his SALN, Hontiveros has total assets of P20 million, liabilities of nearly P900,000, and a net worth of nearly P19 million, based on data as of December 31, 2024.

text: Lakip sa iya mga ginpanag-iyahan amo ang tatlo ka residential properties nga iya naangkon sang 1991, 1999, kag 2003.
english: Among his holdings are three residential properties that he acquired in 1991, 1999, and 2003.

text: May yara man siya sang mga personal nga kagamitan kaangay sang cash deposits, duha ka salakyan, furnitures, alahas, kag equity sa mga installment purchases.
english: He also has personal assets like cash deposits, two cars, furniture, jewelry, and equity in installment purchases.

text: Gindeklarar man sang Senadora ang isa ka car loan nga nagabalor sang halos P900,000 sa idalom sang iya mga utang.
english: The Senator also declared a car loan worth nearly P900,000 under her debts.

text: Sa dugang nga impormasyon, ginbuyagyag ni Hontiveros nga isa siya ka stockholder sang dive resort nga Planet Dive Inc.
english: In addition, Hontiveros revealed that he is a stockholder of the dive resort Planet Dive Inc.

text: halin pa sang 1999, myembro sang New Rural Bank of San Leonardo Inc.
english: since 1999, member of New Rural Bank of San Leonardo Inc.

text: nga naka-base sa Nueva Ecija sang 2010, kag director sang La Luna Corp.
english: based in Nueva Ecija in 2010, and director of La Luna Corp.

text: halin pa sang 2002.
english: since 2002.

text: Una siya nga napili bilang Senador sang 2016 kag napilian liwat para sa ikaduha nga termino sang 2022.
english: He was first elected as a Senator in 2016 and was re-elected for a second term in 2022.

text: Base sa mga petsa sang acquisition sang iya mga propedad kag assets, makit-an nga ang kadam-an sang iya manggad naangkon antes pa siya nagsulod sa posisyon sa gobyerno.
english: Based on the dates of acquisition of his properties and assets, it can be seen that most of his wealth was acquired before he entered government position.

text: Ginatutukan sang Provincial Government sang Iloilo ang pagpasangkad sang teen centers bilang prayoridad nga programa para sa kabataan kag edukasyon, paagi sa isa ka panibag-o nga Executive Order nga ginpanugyan ni Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: The Provincial Government of Iloilo is focusing on the expansion of teen centers as a priority program for children and education, through a new Executive Order proposed by Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Governor Arthur Defensor Jr., ginpabutyag sini nga ang teen centers ang ginakabig nga puluy-an sang youth development programs sa probinsya kag diri magasulod ang programa para sa mental health, guidance counseling, adolescent health, education, career guidance, kag voter education.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Governor Arthur Defensor Jr. said the teen centers are considered the home of youth development programs in the province and will include programs for mental health, guidance counseling, adolescent health, education, career guidance, and voter education.

text: Suno pa sa gobernador nga dapat mapalapad pa ang mga programa sang probinsya agud masiguro nga ang kabataan may akses sa mga serbisyo nga nagapabakod sang ila psychosocial well-being.
english: The governor said the province's programs should be expanded to ensure that children have access to services that strengthen their psychosocial well-being.

text: Ginsiling man niya nga ang pagpabakod sang teen centers padayon nga kabahin sang kabug-usan nga estratehiya sa edukasyon sang Iloilo.
english: He also said that the strengthening of teen centers continues to be part of Iloilo's overall education strategy.

text: Ang school-based teen center project nagsugod sang 2011, kun sa diin ang probinsya ang nagahatag sang kagamitan samtang ang eskwelahan ang nagapahulam sang kwarto.
english: The school-based teen center project began in 2011, with the province providing the equipment while the school loans the room.

text: Sa 2023, gin-upgrade ini sang Provincial Population Office sa Teen Center 2.0, nga may mga stand-alone buildings nga ginatukod para gid sa sini nga programa.
english: In 2023, the Provincial Population Office upgraded it to Teen Center 2.0, with stand-alone buildings being constructed specifically for this program.

text: Subong nga tuig 2025, may kabug-usan nga 102 ka teen centers na ang naestablisar sa probinsya, lakip ang 11 ka stand-alone buildings nga nahamtang sa 10 ka banwa kag sa Iloilo National High School.
english: By 2025, a total of 102 teen centers will have been established in the province, including 11 stand-alone buildings located in 10 towns and Iloilo National High School.

text: Ang mga banwa nga una nakabenepisyo amo ang Balasan, San Dionisio, San Enrique, Dueñas, Pototan, Maasin, Alimodian, Santa Barbara, Oton, kag Miagao.
english: The first towns to benefit are Balasan, San Dionisio, San Enrique, Dueñas, Pototan, Maasin, Alimodian, Santa Barbara, Oton, and Miagao.

text: Ang teen center project kabahin sang MoRProGRes Iloilo development mantra ni Gov.
english: The teen center project is part of the MoRProGRes Iloilo development mantra of Gov.

text: Defensor nga nagatinguha sang mabakod, progresibo, globally-competitive kag resilient nga probinsya.
english: Defensor who seeks a strong, progressive, globally-competitive and resilient province.

text: Ginahingadlan ini nga isa ka epektibo kag transformative nga paagi sa pagpauswag sang edukasyon kag kabataan sa Iloilo.
english: It is called an effective and transformative way to improve education and children in Iloilo.

text: Naghatag sang tribute ang Asian Hospital and Medical Center kay Baby Aniela nga amo ang ginakilala subong nga “youngest organ donor” sa Pilipinas.
english: The Asian Hospital and Medical Center paid tribute to Baby Aniela who is now recognized as the “youngest organ donor” in the Philippines.

text: Ginakabig nga baganihan si Baby Aniela bangud nakabulig siya nga makakita ang isa ka nueve-anyos nga bata nga babaye.
english: Baby Aniela is considered a hero because she helped a nine-year-old girl see.

text: Suno sa ospital, nabun-ag si Aniela nga may anencephaly, isa ka indi-kinaandan nga kondisyon kun sa diin wala naga-develop sang maayo ang utok kag skull sang bata.
english: According to the hospital, Aniela was born with anencephaly, a rare condition in which the baby's brain and skull do not develop properly.

text: “Her mother, Karina, knew from the start that her daughter’s time would be heartbreakingly short lived.
english: “Her mother, Karina, knew from the start that her daughter’s time would be heartbreakingly short lived.

text: Yet, in the midst of unimaginable pain, Karina chose to turn loss into life — by donating Aniela’s eyes to give others the chance to see,” kabahin sang post sang ospital.
english: Yet, in the midst of unimaginable pain, Karina chose to turn loss into life — by donating Aniela’s eyes to give others the chance to see,” part of the hospital’s post.

text: Ginhatag ang mata ni Baby Aniela kay Nikki nga nabun-ag naman nga may congenital glaucoma.
english: Baby Aniela's eye was donated to Nikki who was born with congenital glaucoma.

text: Paagi sa mga mata ni Baby Aniela, nahatagan sang oportunidad si Nikki nga makit-an ang katahum sang kalibutan.
english: Through Baby Aniela's eyes, Nikki was given the opportunity to see the beauty of the world.

text: “Aniela’s short but meaningful life continues to inspire.
english: “Aniela’s short but meaningful life continues to inspire.

text: She is remembered as the country’s youngest organ donor, a symbol of hope, generosity, and love,” pahayag pa sa post sang ospital.#
english: She is remembered as the country’s youngest organ donor, a symbol of hope, generosity, and love,” the hospital said in a post.

text: ILOILO – Wala na sang plano nga magpasaka sang kaso ang pamilya sang pahinante nga napatay matapos makabunggo ang iya ginasakyan nga delivery sa naga-park nga dump truck sa Brgy.
english: ILOILO CITY – The family of a driver who died after his delivery collided with a parked dump truck in Brgy.

text: Pili, Ajuy, Iloilo.
english: Pili, Ajuy, Iloilo.

text: AIng biktima amo si June Selubrico, residente sang Brgy.
english: The victim was identified as June Selubrico, resident of Brgy.

text: Monpoc, Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo.
english: Monpoc, Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo.

text: Samtang, ang isa pa gid ka sakay amo si Ronilo Juliado Muyong, 34, kasado, kag residente sang Brgy.
english: Meanwhile, another passenger was identified as Ronilo Juliado Muyong, 34, married, and resident of Brgy.

text: Trapiche, Oton, Iloilo.
english: Trapiche, Oton, Iloilo.

text: Ang driver naman amo si Jason Puga Patanao, 24, kag residente sang Brgy.
english: The driver was identified as Jason Puga Patanao, 24, resident of Brgy.

text: Tolarucan, Mina, Iloilo.
english: Tolarucan, Mina, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Police Captain John Michael Dalipe, Hepe sang Ajuy Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga ginahulat nalang sang tag-iya sang delivery van ang tag-iya sang dump truck nga magpauli sa banwa sang Ajuy agud nga ma-settle ang natabo nga insidente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Police Captain John Michael Dalipe, chief of the Ajuy Municipal Police Station, said the owner of the delivery van is waiting for the owner of the dump truck to return to Ajuy town to settle the incident.

text: Dugang pa ni Dalipe, ginsabat na sang tag-iya sang delivery van ang pagpalubong kay Selubrico kag ang pagpabulong sa ospital sang driver kag sang isa pagid ka pahinante.
english: Dalipe said the owner of the delivery van has already taken care of the burial of Selubrico and the hospital treatment of the driver and another passenger.

text: Sa subong, padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang mga kapulisan sa insidente.
english: Police are still investigating the incident.

text: -With a report from Bombo Hanna Andasa
english: -With a report from Bombo Hanna Andasa

text: Ginbulgar sang Commission on Elections (Comelec) nga may apat ka senatorial candidates sa May 2025 elections ang nakabaton sang campaign donations nagikan sa mga kontraktor.
english: The Commission on Elections (Comelec) revealed that four senatorial candidates in the May 2025 elections received campaign donations from contractors.

text: Suno kay Comelec chairperson George Erwin Garcia, magluwas sa pito ka senatorial candidates, may yara pa sang duha ka partylist organizations.
english: According to Comelec chairperson George Erwin Garcia, besides the seven senatorial candidates, there are also two partylist organizations.

text: 21 tanan ka mga kontraktor ang gin-flag sang Comelec suno kay Garcia bangud sang amo nga rason.
english: Garcia said a total of 21 contractors were flagged by the Comelec for the same reason.

text: “Sa 21, nasa anim o pito ang involved na mga kandidato.
english: “Of the 21, there are six or seven involved candidates.

text: National at mayroong party-lists,” pahayag sini.
english: National and mayroong party-lists,” he said.

text: Nauna na nga ginpahayag sang poll body nga nag-umpisa na ini sang imbestigasyon sa Statement of Contributions and Expenditures (SOCEs) sang mga kandidato sang nagligad nga piniliay.
english: The poll body earlier said it has started an investigation into the Statement of Contributions and Expenditures (SOCEs) of candidates in the last election.

text: Nagahulat man ang Comelec sang certification nagikan sa Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) agud matumod kun government contractors ang 55 ka mga kontraktor nga ginaalegar nga nagdonar sa mga kandidato.#
english: The Comelec is also waiting for certification from the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) to determine whether the 55 contractors who allegedly donated to the candidates are government contractors.

text: Nagtukod ang Department of Agriculture sang bag-o nga opisina agud matapna ang lapnagon nga kaso sang smuggling sang agricultural products sa pungsod.
english: The Department of Agriculture has set up a new office to curb the widespread cases of smuggling of agricultural products in the country.

text: Ini amo ang Office of the Assistant Secretary for Inspectorate and Enforcement sa idalom sang National Food Safety and Food Security Agency.
english: This is the Office of the Assistant Secretary for Inspectorate and Enforcement under the National Food Safety and Food Security Agency.

text: Magapamuno ini nga opisina sa pagtapna sa agricultural smuggling in compliance sa Anti-Agricultural Smuggling Act of 2016 kag sa Food Safety Act of 2013.
english: This office will lead the fight against agricultural smuggling in compliance with the Anti-Agricultural Smuggling Act of 2016 and the Food Safety Act of 2013.

text: Magaimbestigar man ini sa regulatory and policy violations kag maga-assist sa law enforcement kag prosecution sang mga kaso.
english: It will also investigate regulatory and policy violations and assist in law enforcement and prosecution of cases.

text: Magaconduct man ini sang intelligence operations sa iligal nga mga aktibidad nga may impact sa national economy.
english: It will also conduct intelligence operations on illegal activities that have an impact on the national economy.

text: Ini man ang maga-handle sa tracking, commodity monitoring kag field inspection agud malikawan ang pagginansya, price manipulation kag hoarding.
english: It will also handle tracking, commodity monitoring and field inspection to prevent profiteering, price manipulation and hoarding.

text: Nagmando na ang Office of the Ombudsman sa anay regional director sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) 6 kag mga district engineers sa Western Visayas nga magpasa sang counter-affidavit kaangot sa graft cases nga ginpasaka sang corruption watchdog batok sa ila.
english: The Office of the Ombudsman has ordered the former regional director of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) 6 and district engineers in Western Visayas to submit counter-affidavits regarding the graft cases filed against them by the corruption watchdog.

text: Sa mga dokumento nga ginpakigbahin ni Crimes and Corruption Watch International, Inc.
english: In documents shared by Crimes and Corruption Watch International, Inc.

text: (CCWI) president Carlomagno Batalla, nakaplastar nga naghatag ang Ombudsman sang 10 ka adlaw agud nga makasabat ang respondents.
english: (CCWI) president Carlomagno Batalla, it is set that the Ombudsman gave 10 days for the respondents to respond.

text: Lakip sa nalista nga mga pangalan amo sanday former DPWH 6 Regional Director Sanny Boy Oropel; mga district engineers nga sanday Gener Abergas, Robert Palmera, Randolfo Melosantos, Allan Rey Pajimna, Roy Pacanan, Ethel Morales, kag Bernadette Betsy Uy; kag mga opisyal sang DPWH Western Visayas Bids and Awards Committee nga sanday Mary Grace Bulaquina-Hachuela, Marilou Zamora, Ormel Santo, Gladwyn Ledesma, Roland Rainier Victorino, kag Ricardo Gutierrez.
english: Among the names listed are former DPWH 6 Regional Director Sanny Boy Oropel; district engineers Gener Abergas, Robert Palmera, Randolfo Melosantos, Allan Rey Pajimna, Roy Pacanan, Ethel Morales, and Bernadette Betsy Uy; and DPWH Western Visayas Bids and Awards Committee officials Mary Grace Bulaquina-Hachuela, Marilou Zamora, Ormel Santo, Gladwyn Ledesma, Roland Rainier Victorino, and Ricardo Gutierrez.

text: Yara man sa respondents si Helen Edith Lee Tan, ang presidente sang construction firm nga International Builders Corporation (IBC).
english: Also among the respondents was Helen Edith Lee Tan, the president of the construction firm International Builders Corporation (IBC).

text: Nag-ugat ini sa gina-alegar sang watchdog nga iregularidad sa multibillion-peso projects sang 2024.
english: It stemmed from what the watchdog alleged were irregularities in multibillion-peso projects by 2024.

text: Base sa complaint sang CCWI, gin-akusaran ang DPWH nga nagahatag sang pabor sa IBC matapos nag-award sang mga proyekto sa amo nga kontraktor apisar sang mga kontrobersiya sa duha ka proyekto nga amo ang Ungka kag Aganan flyovers.
english: Based on the complaint of the CCWI, the DPWH was accused of giving favors to the IBC after awarding projects to the contractor despite the controversies in the two projects, the Ungka and Aganan flyovers.

text: Partikular nga gin-akusaran sang CCWI ang DPWH officials nga nagalapas sa layi kaangot sa government procurement, graft, kag sa Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees.
english: The CCWI specifically accused DPWH officials of violating the law on government procurement, graft, and the Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees.

text: Base pa sa ginreklamo ni Batalla, halin sang 2016-2024, nakadaog ang IBC sang ginabanta nga P40 billion nga balor sang DPWH VI projects.
english: Based on Batalla's complaint, from 2016-2024, the IBC won an estimated P40 billion worth of DPWH VI projects.

text: Ginsiling man sa ila press conference sang Mayo 22, 2025 nga nasakop sa complaint ang 26 infrastructure projects nga gin-award sang 2024 sa amo nga kontraktor nga amo man ang sa likod sang kontrobersyal nga Aganan kag Ungka flyovers sa Jaro, Iloilo City kag sa banwa sang Pavia.
english: It was also said in their press conference on May 22, 2025 that the complaint covers 26 infrastructure projects awarded in 2024 to the contractor who is also behind the controversial Aganan and Ungka flyovers in Jaro, Iloilo City and Pavia town.

text: Una naman nga nagpaathag si Oropel nga klaro ang ila nga bidding process kag nakabase sa lehitimo nga mga guidelines.
english: Earlier, Oropel explained that their bidding process is clear and based on legitimate guidelines.

text: Ginlaragway man sini anay ang kaso nga “harassment” kag nagpahayag man nga kumpyansa siya nga ibasura sang Ombudsman ang kaso kaangay sa nagligad nga charges bangud sa kakulang sang basehan.#
english: He also described the case as “harassment” and said he was confident that the Ombudsman would dismiss the case like the previous charges due to lack of basis.

text: Wala tuo nga wildfire ang nagaapekto sa subong sa madamo nga mga pamalay sa Pacific Palisades sa California, USA.
english: Wildfires are currently affecting many homes in the Pacific Palisades in California, USA.

text: Suno kay Bombo Nilo Juaneza, International Correspondent sa California, iya ginpahayag nga ginpang-evacuate na ang masobra 180,000 ka mga residente sa Los Angeles bangud sa padayon nga paglapta sang dako nga sunog nga naglamon sang linibo ka mga ektarya sang kagulangan kag mga pamalay.
english: According to Bombo Nilo Juaneza, International Correspondent in California, he said that more than 180,000 residents in Los Angeles have been evacuated due to the continuous spread of the massive fire that has devoured thousands of hectares of forest and homes.

text: Nagdangat naman sa masobra lima ang narekord nga napatay sa wildfire.
english: More than five people were recorded killed in the wildfire.

text: Ginalauman naman nga mas magalapta pa ang mga sunog bangud sa windstorm nga man sa nasambit nga lugar.
english: The fires are expected to spread further due to the windstorm in the area.

text: Ginapahalong naman sang mga otoridad ang mga residente nga naga-istar sa mga apektado nga lugar.
english: Authorities are warning residents living in the affected areas.

text: Magapadala ang Pilipinas sang 1,233 ka delegates sa 32ndSoutheast Asian Games (SEAGames) sa Cambodia sa Mayo 5-17.
english: The Philippines will send 1,233 delegates to the 32ndSoutheast Asian Games (SEAGames) in Cambodia on May 5-17.

text: Suno kay Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) President Bambol Tolentino, 905 diri ang athletes kag 257 ang officials.
english: According to Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) President Bambol Tolentino, 905 of them are athletes and 257 are officials.

text: May 608 ka sports event sa Cambodia kun sa diin 38 ang first time nga himuon sa amo nga biennial event.
english: There are 608 sports events in Cambodia of which 38 will be held for the first time in the biennial event.

text: Kumpirmado man nga maga-compete ang Pilipinas sa tanan nga sports sa amo nga pungsod.
english: It is also confirmed that the Philippines will compete in all sports in the country.

text: Mas daku ang delegasyon sang pungsod subong nga tuig ipaanggid sa 656 ka atleta nga ginpadala sa Hanoi, Vietnam sang nagligad nga tuig kun sa diin nagpang-apat ang Pilipinas matapos naghakot sang 52 ka gold medals, 70 ka silver, kag 104 ka bronze medals.
english: The country's delegation this year is larger compared to the 656 athletes sent to Hanoi, Vietnam last year where the Philippines came fourth after winning 52 gold medals, 70 silver, and 104 bronze medals.

text: Natalana sa Abril 15 ang pormal nga sendoff ceremony sang Team Philippines sa Philippine International Convention Center.
english: The formal sendoff ceremony of Team Philippines is scheduled for April 15 at the Philippine International Convention Center.

text: Patay ang 33-anyos nga Ukrainian actor nga nagsulod sa Territorial Defence Force sang iya pungsod kasunod sang Russian invasion.
english: A 33-year-old Ukrainian actor who joined his country's Territorial Defense Force following the Russian invasion has died.

text: Si Pasha Lee, ukon kilala man nga si Pavlo Li kag Pasha Li, ang nabun-ag sa Crimea kag ginapahayag nga nagtaliwan sang Marso 6.
english: Pasha Lee, also known as Pavlo Li and Pasha Li, was born in Crimea and reportedly passed away on March 6.

text: Ginapahayag nga lakip ini sa nabombahan sa Irpin, isa ka lugar sa northwest sang capital nga Kyiv kag isa man ka lugar kun sa diin masami nagaluntad ang inaway batok sa pwersa sang Russia.
english: It is reportedly among those bombed in Irpin, an area northwest of the capital Kyiv and also an area where fighting against Russian forces often takes place.

text: Ang iya kamatayon ang ginkumpirma man sang National Union of Journalists sa Ukraine kag sang Odessa International Film Festival.
english: His death was also confirmed by the National Union of Journalists in Ukraine and the Odessa International Film Festival.

text: Lakip si Lee sa 2016 action-comedy nga Selfie Party, 2017 nga sports action-drama nga The Fight Rules kag 2019 comedy nga Meeting of Classmates.
english: Lee was included in the 2016 action-comedy Selfie Party, 2017 sports action-drama The Fight Rules and 2019 comedy Meeting of Classmates.

text: Yara man ang iya tingog sa dubbed Ukrainian versions sang films nga The Lion King kag The Hobbit, kag nangin host man sang local DOM TV channel.
english: He also appeared in the dubbed Ukrainian versions of the films The Lion King and The Hobbit, and hosted the local DOM TV channel.

text: ILOILO – Ginsulod sang kawatan ang isa ka classroom sa Dumangas National High School sa Barangay Población, Dumangas, Iloilo.
english: ILOILO – A thief broke into a classroom at Dumangas National High School in Barangay Población, Dumangas, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Senior Master Sergeant Ronald Domines, imbestigador sang Dumangas Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga isa ka maestro ang nakadiskubre nga bukas na ang iya classroom.
english: Police Senior Master Sergeant Ronald Domines, investigator of the Dumangas Municipal Police Station, said a teacher discovered that his classroom was open.

text: Suno kay Domines, sang gin-check ini sang maestro, wala na ang mga gamit sini kaangay sang laptop.
english: According to Domines, when the teacher checked it, his belongings such as the laptop were gone.

text: Ginpahayag sang imbestigador nga ginalantaw nga posibilidad amo nga nalipatan nga siraduhan ang classroom ukon may access sa liyabe ang kawatan.
english: The investigator said the possibility is that the thief forgot to close the classroom or had access to the key.

text: Ginsiling naman sang maestro nga masami nga ginabilin nila sa security guard ang liyabe kun sa diin apat sila ang nagabulos-bulos nga naga-duty sa eskwelahan apang nagapauli sila kung magtapos na ang ila shift.
english: The teacher said they often leave the key with the security guard where four of them take turns on duty at the school but they go home when their shift is over.

text: Natukiban man nga ang iban nga mga classroom kag stockrooms ang gintuyo man nga buksan ang kandado, amo man ang ila nga canteen bangud may nakit-an nga buho sa pwertahan sini.
english: It was also discovered that other classrooms and stockrooms were also attempted to open the lock, as well as their canteen because a hole was found in its door.

via Bombo Mae Joy Amora

-With a report from Bombo Hanna Andasa
english:
via Bombo Mae Joy Amora

-With a report from Bombo Hanna Andasa

text: ILOILO CITY – Posible nga mag-expand pa ang ekonomiya sang pungsod tubtob sa 7.2 percent subong nga tuig antes ini magnubo sa masunod nga tuig.
english: ILOILO CITY – The country's economy is likely to expand by up to 7.2 percent this year before declining next year.

text: Ini ang suno sa Philippines Economic Update nga ginpagwa sang World Bank.
english: This is according to the Philippines Economic Update released by the World Bank.

text: Ang mabaskog nga performance sang ekonomiya sa una nga tatlo ka quarters subong nga tuig ang bangud sang paghagan-hagan na sang mobility restrictions nga nagresulta sang mas madamo nga negosyo.
english: The strong performance of the economy in the first three quarters of this year is due to the easing of mobility restrictions which resulted in more business.

text: Samtang, ang paghina sang ekonomiya sa 2023 ang bangud sang reduced consumer demand, mataas nga inflation kag mas mataas nga interest rates nga magapanubo sang household spending kag investment.
english: Meanwhile, the economic slowdown in 2023 is due to reduced consumer demand, high inflation and higher interest rates that will reduce household spending and investment.

text: Ang inflation rate sang Nobyembre ang nagdangat sa 8 percent nga amo ang pinakamataas humalin sang November 2008.
english: The inflation rate in November reached 8 percent, the highest since November 2008.

text: Tumandok sang Calinog, Iloilo ang bag-o nga commanding general sang Philippine Army nga si Lt.
english: The new commanding general of the Philippine Army, Lt.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Antonio Nafarrete.
english: Antonio Nafarrete.

text: Ginpatigayon ang pormal nga change of command ceremony sa Taguig City kag ginpangunahan ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: The formal change of command ceremony was held in Taguig City and was presided over by President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: Ginbuslan ni Nafarrete si Lt.
english: Nafarrete replaced Lt. Col.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Roy Galido.
english: Roy Galido.

text: Nagserbe ini sadto bilang pinuno sang Western Mindanao Command (WESMINCOM) sang Armed Forces of the Philippines sang 2024.
english: He previously served as the head of the Western Mindanao Command (WESMINCOM) of the Armed Forces of the Philippines in 2024.

text: Si Nafarrete ang myembro sang PMA “Bigkis-Lahi” Class of 1990.
english: Nafarrete is a member of the PMA “Bigkis-Lahi” Class of 1990.

text: Naggradwar ini sang elementary sa Calinog Elementary School sang 1982 kag nakatapos sa Calinog Agricultural Industrial College-High School Department sang 1986.
english: He graduated from Calinog Elementary School in 1982 and graduated from Calinog Agricultural Industrial College-High School Department in 1986.

text: Liwat na nga magabalik sa big screen pinaagi sa isa ka proyekto ang aktor nga si John Lloyd Cruz.
english: Actor John Lloyd Cruz is returning to the big screen with a project.

text: Ini matapos ang masobra sa lima ka tuig nga hiatus ukon pag-untat sa showbusiness ni John Lloyd.
english: This comes after a more than five-year hiatus from John Lloyd's showbusiness.

text: Kaupod sini sa bag-o nga proyekto ang aktres nga si Jasmine Curtis-Smith nga amu ang personal nga ginpili ni John Lloyd bilang iya nga leading lady.
english: She is joined in the new project by actress Jasmine Curtis-Smith, who was personally chosen by John Lloyd as his leading lady.

text: Nagpasalamat man ang aktres bangud nakita ni Lloydi ang iya talento bilang isa ka aktres.
english: The actress also thanked Lloydi for seeing her talent as an actress.

text: Ginsuspinde ang Memphis Grizzlies guard nga si Ja Morant sa walo ka hampang sa National Basketball Association (NBA) nga wala sang bayad.
english: Memphis Grizzlies guard Ja Morant has been suspended for eight games in the National Basketball Association (NBA) without pay.

text: Ini matapos nakit-an ini nga nag-stream sang video sang iya kaugalingon nga nagauyat sang pusil samtang hubog sa isa ka nightclub.
english: This was after he was seen streaming a video of himself holding a gun while drunk in a nightclub.

text:
Gin-ban si Morant bangud sa “conduct detrimental to the league.”

“Ja’s conduct was irresponsible, reckless and potentially very dangerous.
english:
Morant was banned for “conduct detrimental to the league.”

“Ja’s conduct was irresponsible, reckless and potentially very dangerous.

text: It also has serious consequences given his enormous following and influence, particularly among young fans who look up to him.
english: It also has serious consequences given his enormous following and influence, particularly among young fans who look up to him.

text: He has expressed sincere contrition and remorse for his behavior.
english: He has expressed sincere contrition and remorse for his behavior.

text: Ja has also made it clear to me that he has learned from this incident and that he understands his obligations and responsibility to the Memphis Grizzlies and the broader NBA community extend well beyond his play on the court,” suno kay NBA Commissioner Adam Silver.
english: Ja has also made it clear to me that he has learned from this incident and that he understands his obligations and responsibility to the Memphis Grizzlies and the broader NBA community extend well beyond his play on the court,” according to NBA Commissioner Adam Silver.

text: Antes sini, wala na nga daan siya nakahampang sang lima ka games para sa iya nga team, apang eligible na kuntani nga makabalik sa game sang Memphis batok sa Dallas sa Lunes.
english: He had previously missed five games for his team, but would have been eligible to return for Memphis' game against Dallas on Monday.

text: Nagabalay ang Sandiganbayan sang bag-o nga mga pagsulundan agud nga mapadasig ang pagpasaka sang kaso-kriminal.
english: The Sandiganbayan is drafting new guidelines to expedite the filing of criminal cases.

text: Ini ang kabahin sang preparasyon sa pag-file sang Ombudsman sang impormasyon batok sa mga opisyal kag personalidad nga involved sa mga anomaliya sa flood control projects.
english: This is part of the preparation for the Ombudsman to file information against officials and personalities involved in anomalies in flood control projects.

text: “In anticipation of the cases to be filed by the Ombudsman, the Sandiganbayan is currently in the process of drafting new rules on expedited procedure, which will be pilot tested upon the approval of the Supreme Court,” suno kay Sandiganbayan Presiding Justice Geraldine Econg.
english: “In anticipation of the cases to be filed by the Ombudsman, the Sandiganbayan is currently in the process of drafting new rules on expedited procedure, which will be pilot tested upon the approval of the Supreme Court,” said Sandiganbayan Presiding Justice Geraldine Econg.

text: Matandaan nga una na nagpahayag si Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla nga sa masunod nga bulan maga-file ang iya opisina sang una nga information kaangot sa mga iregularidad sa flood control projects.
english: It can be recalled that Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla earlier said that next month his office will file the first information regarding irregularities in flood control projects.

text: May nabaton naman ang Ombudsman nga reklamo halin sa Department of Public Works and Highways sang Septyembre 11 batok sa pila ka personalidad.
english: The Ombudsman received a complaint from the Department of Public Works and Highways on September 11 against several personalities.

text: Lakip diri sanday anay DPWH Bulacan 1st District Rep.
english: These include former DPWH Bulacan 1st District Rep.

text: Enginner Henry Alcantara, anay Assistant District Engineer Engr.
english: Enginner Henry Alcantara, former Assistant District Engineer Engr.

text: Brice Ericson Hernandez, Construction Section Chief John Michael Ramos, Planning and Design Section Chief Ernesto Galang kag 15 ka iban pa.
english: Brice Ericson Hernandez, Construction Section Chief John Michael Ramos, Planning and Design Section Chief Ernesto Galang and 15 others.

text: Lakip man sa amo nga reklamo sang DPWH ang mga kontraktor nga sanday Cezarah Sarah Discaya sang St.
english: The DPWH's complaint also includes contractors Cezarah Sarah Discaya of St.

text: Timothy Construction Corporation, Ma.
english: Timothy Construction Corporation, Ma.

text: Angeline Rimando sang St.
english: Angeline Rimando of St.

text: Timothy Construction Corp., Sally Santos sang SYMS Construction Trading, Mark Allan Arevalo, Wawao Builders, kag Robert Imperio sang IM Construction Corp.#
english: Timothy Construction Corp., Sally Santos of SYMS Construction Trading, Mark Allan Arevalo, Wawao Builders, and Robert Imperio of IM Construction Corp.#

text: Pagkatapos sang kapin apat ka dekada sa serbisyo publiko, naghatag sang panan-aw si anay Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas kun paano siya subong sa pribado nga kabuhi kag sa padayon nga isyu sa lokal nga politika.
english: After more than four decades in public service, former Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas gave an insight into how he is now in his private life and the ongoing issues in local politics.

text: PRIVATE LIFE AFTER PUBLIC SERVICESuno kay anay Mayor Treñas sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, mas nagahimakas siya subong sa personal nga oras.
english: PRIVATE LIFE AFTER PUBLIC SERVICEAccording to former Mayor Treñas in an interview with Bombo Radyo, he is now struggling more with personal time.

text: Iya ginpakigbahin nga nasadyahan siya kag may tsansa na siya nga maka-upod niya ang mga suod nga abyan nga madugay na niya nga wala nakaupod, bisan sa simple nga pangape-kape.
english: He shared that he was happy and that he had a chance to be with his close friends whom he had not seen for a long time, even for a simple coffee.

text: Ginbunyag man sini nga may pila ka imbitasyon siya nga nabaton para magtudlo bilang professor sa Political Law.
english: He also revealed that he has received several invitations to teach as a professor of Political Law.

text: May posibilidad man nga mabalik siya sa iya law office bilang corporate lawyer, kung sa diin naga-handle siya sang mga civil cases.
english: There is also the possibility that he will return to his law office as a corporate lawyer, where he handles civil cases.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga kapin 40 ka tuig ang iya total nga serbisyo sa gobyerno kag subong, mas madamo na siya sang tulog.
english: He said he has more than 40 years of total government service and now, he sleeps more.

text: ON RAISA TREÑAS AND POLITICAL OPPOSITIONGinpahayag man ni Treñas nga bisan bag-uhanon ang iya anak nga si Raisa sa politika, dugay na ini nga naga-upod sa iya sa mga buluhaton.
english: ON RAISA TREÑAS AND POLITICAL OPPOSITIONG Treñas also said that although his daughter Raisa is new to politics, she has been with him for a long time.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga si Raisa ang nagsilbi bilang iya Chief of Staff halin pa sang iya pagpungko bilang konsehal tubtob congressman.
english: He said Raisa served as his Chief of Staff from his tenure as councilor to congressman.

text: Suno pa sa iya, natural na nga may oposisyon sa politika, kag sa 40 ka tuig niya nga serbisyo, lakip na ang kampo ni Congresswoman Jamjam Baronda, Vice Mayor Love Baronda, kag anay Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog.
english: He said it is natural to have political opposition, and in his 40 years of service, including the camp of Congresswoman Jamjam Baronda, Vice Mayor Love Baronda, and former Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog.

text: Gin-ako ni Treñas nga indi gid malikawan ang kritisismo sa politika kag dapat lang nga ginakabig ini nga bahin sang serbisyo.
english: Treñas acknowledged that political criticism is inevitable and should be considered part of the service.

text: CITY HALL SPACE ISSUEGinpat-od man ni Treñas nga suno sa Local Government Code, may gahum ang alkalde sa pag-assign sang espasyo sa sulod sang City Hall para sa mga opisina sang LGU.
english: CITY HALL SPACE ISSUE Treñas also assured that according to the Local Government Code, the mayor has the power to assign space inside the City Hall for LGU offices.

text: Ginpanugyan niya nga kinahanglan ang mga bag-o nga opisyales nga magsunod sa seminar nga ginasuporta sang DILG agud mas mangin epektibo sa ila papel.
english: He advised that the new officers should follow the seminar supported by the DILG to be more effective in their role.

text: FLOODING ISSUESa isyu sang pagbaha sa siyudad ilabi na sa Jaro.
english: FLOODING ISSUESa issue of flooding in the city especially in Jaro.

text: Ginpunto sini nga indi si Raisa ang nagareklamo kundi ang mga pumuluyo mismo.
english: He pointed out that it was not Raisa who was complaining but the residents themselves.

text: Suno kay Treñas, dapat tutukan sang DENR kag DPWH ang problema ilabi na kon apektado na ang seguridad sang publiko, kag may responsibilidad ang LGU nga magpasiguro ang ‘safety’ sang tanan.
english: According to Treñas, the DENR and DPWH should focus on the problem especially when public safety is affected, and the LGU has a responsibility to ensure the safety of everyone.

text: REAL PROPERTY TAXGinpahanumdom man ni Treñas nga sa panahon sang administrasyon ni President Duterte, ginsuguran ang implementasyon sang Mandanas Ruling nga naga-apekto sa real property tax kag iban pa nga revenue sharing sa mga LGU.
english: REAL PROPERTY TAXTreñas also reminded that during the administration of President Duterte, the implementation of the Mandanas Ruling affecting the real property tax and other revenue sharing in LGUs began.

text: 2028 COMEBACK POSSIBILITYSa katapusan, ginbuyagyag ni anay Mayor Treñas nga posible siya magabalik sa politika sa 2028 nga eleksyon, apang subong nagakabuhi siya sing malinong kag pribado kaupod ang pamilya kag mga abyan.
english: 2028 COMEBACK POSSIBILITYFinally, former Mayor Treñas revealed that he may return to politics in the 2028 elections, but now he lives peacefully and privately with family and friends.

text: ANG poker isa ka hampang nga popular sa mga pelikula ni James Bond, nga masami ginaupdan sang apat ka humalampang sa isa ka lamesa.
english: POKER is a game popular in James Bond movies, often involving four players at a table.

text: Gamit diri ang 52 ka baraha nga ginagamit man sa hampang nga Lucky Nine.
english: It uses 52 cards that are also used in the game Lucky Nine.

text: Ginalakipan ini sang apat ka klase nga baraha  – card of hearts, diamonds, clubs kag spades.
english: It consists of four types of cards  – card of hearts, diamonds, clubs and spades.

text: Ang kada humalampang diri magabaton sang lima ka baraha halin sa manugtagtag nga ang obligasyon ginapalibut sa kada pagpanibag-o sang hampang.
english: Each player here will receive five cards from the dealer with the obligation rotated at each renewal of the game.

text: Ang una nga humalampang magatulod sang iya taya halin sa iya “capital” sa iya atubangan nga pwede sabton sang masunod sa pagpati nga may inugbato ang iya lima ka baraha.
english: The first player will push his bet from his “capital” in front of him which the next can answer believing that his five cards have something to play with.

text: Pwede man ini sundan ukon pataasan pa sang pag-challenge sang masunod sa iya.
english: This can also be followed or increased by challenging the next person.

text: Ang indi na magbaton sang challenge ma-pass agud iyaub ang ila taya, meaning ginapa-pierde na niya ang iya taya.
english: Those who do not accept the challenge will pass to lower their bet, meaning he loses his bet.

text: Kon may  yara pa luyag updan ang ulihi nga challenge magpakitaay na sang baraha agud mahibal-an kon sin-o gid ang madaug.
english: If anyone else wants to join the last challenge, show each other the cards to see who will win.

text: Ugaling kon maatras na ang tanan nga iban i-deklarar na nga daug ang nabilin.
english: But when all the others have withdrawn, the rest will be declared victorious.

text: Pero, ang nadeklarar na nga nagdaug, siya gid bala ang may pinakamataas gid nga balor sang mga baraha?
english: But, the one who has been declared the winner, is he really the one with the highest value of the cards?

text: Not necessarily, kay basi “bluff” lang ang iya challenge kag nagdaug lang tungod nag-atras ang tanan niya nga mga kasumpoing sa ila pagpati nga siya gid ang nagauyat sang may pinakamataas nga balor sang mga baraha samtang indi man gali.
english: Not necessarily, because maybe his challenge was just a bluff and he won because all his opponents backed down in their belief that he was holding the highest value of cards when he wasn't.

text:
***

Sa aton panan-aw daw poker ang nagakatabo sa tulod-butong (kasubong sa taya-challenge sa poker) nga tindug sang Marcos Executive Dept.
english:
***

In our view, it seems that poker is happening in the tulod-butong (similar to the taya-challenge in poker) stance of the Marcos Executive Dept.

text: kag sang challenge sang Commission on Human Rights kon bala tugtan ang International Criminal Court (ICC) sa paghimo sang imbestigasyon sa mga drug cases sa panahon ni Duterte.
english: and the challenge of the Commission on Human Rights on whether to allow the International Criminal Court (ICC) to investigate drug cases during the Duterte era.

english: He said cases are being filed against the police officers involved, although if anyone is convicted, it seems to be in connection with the murder of minor Kian de los Santos, one of the 6,000 killed in police records.

text: Sang gin-announce sang ICC ang panguna sini nga inquiry sadtong 2018, sinabat ini ni Duterte paagi sa pag-withdraw sang Filipinas sa Human Rights Council.
english: When the ICC announced its main inquiry in 2018, Duterte responded by withdrawing the Philippines from the Human Rights Council.

text: Ang withdrawal ugaling nag-epekto lang sang Marso 2019 kon san-o may hurisdiksyon pa ang ICC halin sa pagsulod sang Filipinas sa HRC sadtong 2011.
english: The withdrawal, however, only took effect in March 2019 when the ICC still had jurisdiction since the Philippines' accession to the HRC in 2011.

text: Ginhimo sang ICC ang initial inquiry sang mabaton sini ang ginatos nga documented drug cases sang Rise Up for Life and Rights nga gin-organiza sang mga iloy.
english: The ICC conducted the initial inquiry when it received hundreds of documented drug cases by Rise Up for Life and Rights organized by mothers.

english: This was challenged by Duterte Exec.

english: Dept.

english: Dept.
