english: in their insistent belief that the Philippines has nothing to do with these drug cases because the Philippines withdrew from the Human Rights Council in 2018.

text: Lain naman ang tindug sang CHR sa pamuno ni CHR chairman Palpal-Latoc.
english: The CHR led by CHR chairman Palpal-Latoc has a different position.

text: Sunu sa iya may kaugalingon nga pag-imbestigar sa sining mga drug cases ang CHR kag, kon mag-request ang ICC, handa sila sa pag-share sini sa ICC.
english: He said the CHR has its own investigation into these drug cases and, if the ICC requests, they are ready to share it with the ICC.

text: “May independent nga mandate ang CHR agud hibaluon ining mga human rights concerns sang aton mga kautoran nga mga Filipino diri sa pungsod kag sa luas,” dugang niya.
english: “The CHR has an independent mandate to identify these human rights concerns of our Filipino brothers and sisters here in the country and abroad,” he added.

text: Sunu sa CHR report may 882 ka drug cases nga naga-involver sang 1,139 ka drug war victims.
english: According to the CHR report, there are 882 drug cases involving 1,139 drug war victims.

text: Mga public documents ini, siling niya, nga dapat bukas sa publiko kag kon sin-o man nga may pagkabalaka sa sini nga mga kaso.
english: These are public documents, he said, that should be open to the public and anyone else concerned about these cases.

text: Pila ka human rights advocates nag-label gani sini nga extrajudicial killings kag mga state-sanctioned murder.
english: Some human rights advocates have even labeled it extrajudicial killings and state-sanctioned murders.

text: Nagagwa, sunu sa CHR, nga ang PNP naggamit sang “excess, unreasonable force” nga may intensyon sa pagpatay sa sining mga biktima.
english: It appears, according to the CHR, that the PNP used “excess, unreasonable force” with the intention of killing these victims.

text: Nag-reklamo si Justice Secretary Remulla kag gin-insistir nga kinahanglan mag-consulta sa Presidente ang CHR sa ila desisyon sa paghatag sang resulta sang ila imbestigasyon sa ICC.
english: Justice Secretary Remulla complained and insisted that the CHR must consult the President on its decision to submit the results of its investigation to the ICC.

text: Kinahanglan gid bala ikonsulta sang CHR ining info sa ICC?
english: Does the CHR really need to consult this info with the ICC?

text: Daw wala man gapahilabot ang Presidente sa trabaho sang Comelec, nga independent man nga Constitutional body katulad sang CHR?
english: It seems that the President does not interfere in the work of the Comelec, which is also an independent Constitutional body like the CHR?

text: Halin ang poder sang Comelec sa Constitution kag indi sa Presidente, indi bala?/PN
english: The power of the Comelec comes from the Constitution and not from the President, right?/PN

text: Nangin manami ang umpisa sang atleta sang pungsod sa 33rd Southeast Asian Games nga ginpatigayon sa Bangkok, Thailand.
english: The country's athlete got off to a good start at the 33rd Southeast Asian Games held in Bangkok, Thailand.

text: Nagdaog sa una nga roud ang Men’s Polo team batok sa Indonesia sa 2-4 goals event VS Sports Club sa Samut Prakan.
english: The Men’s Polo team won the first round against Indonesia in a 2-4 goals event VS Sports Club in Samut Prakan.

text: Ini ang una nga pag-intra sang Mens’ Polo team matapos ang anom ka tuig nga indi pag-join.
english: This is the Mens’ Polo team’s first participation after a six-year absence.

text: Masunod nga masambuwa sang Pilipinas ang Thailand sa Sabado.
english: The Philippines will next face Thailand on Saturday.

text: Nagapasalamat ang Barangay Kagawad sang San Isidro, La Paz, nga amat-amat na nga nagakadakpan ang mga indibidwal sa likod sang iligal nga droga sa ila barangay, matapos ang nagluntad nga stabbing incident sang nagligad nga Marso 21, sa tunga sang Pamilya Muya kag Provido.
english: The Barangay Kagawad of San Isidro, La Paz, is grateful that the individuals behind illegal drugs in their barangay are slowly being arrested, after the stabbing incident that occurred last March 21, between the Muya and Provido families.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Benjie Legada, Barangay Kagawad sang nasambit nga lugar, iya ginpahayag nga ila na gid nga ginakonsiderar nga alarming na ang mga hitabo kag ang kadamuon sang durugista sa nasambit nga barangay.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Benjie Legada, Barangay Kagawad of the said area, said they are already considering the incidents and the number of drug pushers in the said barangay as alarming.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginpahayag ni Legada nga wala na makit-an sa ila barangay kag ginapatihan nga nalagyo si Alex Jadulos nga isa sa ginpasakaan sang kaso kaangot sa kamatayon sang apat ka mga indibidwal.
english: Meanwhile, Legada said Alex Jadulos, one of the suspects in connection with the deaths of four individuals, is no longer found in their barangay and is believed to have fled.

text: Suno kay Legada, mabuot kag wala sang gamo si Jadulos kun wala makainom, apang kun mahubog, nagalain na ang batasan sini.
english: According to Legada, Jadulos is kind and peaceful when he is not drinking, but when he is drunk, his behavior deteriorates.

text: Samtang, natalana naman subong nga adlaw nga ihaya ang bangkay ni Tyron Muya nga isa sa mga napatay.
english: Meanwhile, the body of Tyron Muya, one of the victims, is scheduled to be laid to rest today.

text: ILOILO CITY- Ikaw bala mahisaon, palahikay kag chismosa nga sahi sang tawo?
english: ILOILO CITY- Are you a jealous, gossip and gossip kind of person?

text: Oras na agud nga untaton ninyo ang mga nasambit nga pamatasan bangud ini ang may yara sang makakilibot kag negatibo nga epekto sa lawas.
english: It is time for you to stop these behaviors because they have a surprising and negative effect on the body.

text: Santu sa bag-o nga pagtuon sang College of Psychiatric Study of Human Behaviors sang University of Alabama sa Estados Unidos napamatud-an nga ang mga malain nga mga pamatasan kasubong na lang sang pagkamahisa, pagkapalakihay kag pagkachismosa ang mahimu nga tunaan sang seryoso nga mga mental disorder kag mahimu man nga tunaan sang early natural deaths ukon kamatayon.
english: According to a new study by the College of Psychiatric Study of Human Behaviors of the University of Alabama in the United States, it has been proven that bad behaviors such as jealousy, gossip and gossip can lead to serious mental disorders and can also lead to early natural deaths.

text: Suno sa mga eksperto, makakuha sang bastante nga anger kag envy stimuli sa lawas ang isa ka tawo nga nagapakita kag nagabatyag sang nasambit nga mga pamatasan kag ini ang naga-amat-amat kaon sa mga happy stimuli nga makita sa utok kag nagadevelop sa short term depression nga mahimu tunaan sang mas malala nga mga stages sang mental disorders kasubong na lang sang pagka-buang.
english: According to experts, a person who shows and feels these behaviors gets enough anger and envy stimuli in the body and this gradually eats away at the happy stimuli found in the brain and develops into short term depression that can lead to more serious stages of mental disorders such as insanity.

text: Dugang pa sang mga eksperto ang nasambit nga pamatasan ang nagapanubo man sang life span ukon kabuhi sang isa ka tawo bangud sa nagkalain-lain nga stress nga mahimu sini nga mabatyagan.
english: Experts add that this behavior also reduces the life span of a person due to the various stresses that it can feel.

text: May kaangtanan diri nagpanugyan ang eksperto nga untatan na ang pagkamahisa, pagkapalahikay kag pagkachismosa bangud ini ang wala sang maayo nga dulot sa ikaayong lawas.
english: In this regard, the expert advised to stop jealousy, gossip and gossip because it is not good for health.

text: Dismayado si Cagayan de Oro 2nd District Rep.
english: Cagayan de Oro 2nd District Rep.

text: Rofus Rodriguez sa nangin sabat ni VP Sara Duterte sa iya impeachment complaint.
english: Rofus Rodriguez on VP Sara Duterte's response to his impeachment complaint.

text: Ini matapos nga gindeklarar sang House Committee on Justice nga “sufficient in grounds” ukon may bastante nga basehan ang duha ka impeachment complaints batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: This comes after the House Committee on Justice declared the two impeachment complaints against Vice President Sara Duterte “sufficient in grounds”.

text: Ginhalimbawa ni Rep.
english: For example, Rep.

text: Rodriguez ang wala pagsabat sang kampo ni VP Sara sa mga grounds batok sa duha ka reklamo nga ginpasaka sa iya, apisar nga klaro nga dapat hatagan ini sang atensyon.
english: Rodriguez said VP Sara's camp did not respond to the grounds against the two complaints filed against him, despite the fact that it is clear that they should be given attention.

text: Suno sa mamalidha, may yara sang anum ka grounds sa ikatlo nga complaint kag lima naman ka grounds sa ikaapat nga reklamo.
english: According to the lawmaker, there are six grounds in the third complaint and five grounds in the fourth complaint.

text: Gindugang pa ni Rodriguez nga dapat kuntani, isa-isa nga ginsabat sang kampo ni VP Sara ang nasambit nga mga grounds, apang sang ginbasa na sini ang reply, nakibot na lang ini bangud wala sang nagakaigo nga sabat ang Bise Presidente sa mga alegasyon.
english: Rodriguez added that VP Sara's camp should have responded to the grounds one by one, but when he read the reply, he was surprised because the Vice President did not respond properly to the allegations.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang mga impeachment complaints batok kay VP Sara Duterte nagikan sa alegasyon sang betrayal of public trust, culpable violation of the Constitution, kag iban pa.
english: It is known that the impeachment complaints against VP Sara Duterte are based on allegations of betrayal of public trust, culpable violation of the Constitution, and others.

text: Ginduso sang isa ka French Euro-deputy center-left politician nga ibalik na lang sang Estados Unidos sa France ang gin-regalo sini anay nga Statue of Liberty.
english: A French Euro-deputy center-left politician has proposed that the United States return the Statue of Liberty to France.

text: Ang gintumod sini nga rason amo bangud wala na gina-representar sang United States of America ang “values” nga amo ang nagtulod anay sa France nga ihatag ang estatwa bilang gift.
english: The reason he gave was because the United States of America no longer represents the “values” that once led France to give the statue as a gift.

text: “Give us back the Statue of Liberty,” suno kay Raphael Glucksmann sa pagtilipon sang Place Publique center-left movement.
english: “Give us back the Statue of Liberty,” according to Raphael Glucksmann at a gathering of the Place Publique center-left movement.

text: “We’re going to say to the Americans who have chosen to side with the tyrants, to the Americans who fired researchers for demanding scientific freedom: ‘Give us back the Statue of Liberty,'” dugang sini samtang nagahinugyaw ang mga tawo.
english: “We’re going to say to the Americans who have chosen to side with the tyrants, to the Americans who fired researchers for demanding scientific freedom: ‘Give us back the Statue of Liberty,'” he added as the crowd cheered.

text: “‘We gave it to you as a gift, but apparently you despise it.
english: “‘We gave it to you as a gift, but apparently you despise it.

text: So it will be just fine here at home,'” pahayag pa niya.
english: So it will be just fine here at home,'” he said.

text: Ginpakita sa publiko ang Statue of Liberty sa New York City harbor sang October 28, 1886 para sa centennial sang American Declaration of Independence.
english: The Statue of Liberty was unveiled to the public in New York City harbor on October 28, 1886 for the centennial of the American Declaration of Independence.

text: May kaangay man sini nga estatwa sa Seine sa Paris apang mas magamay lamang.
english: There is a similar statue on the Seine in Paris but only smaller.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Glucksmann ang taga-suporta sang Ukraine kag isa siya sa nagapakamalaot sa kay US President Donald Trump bangud sa panindugan sini sa Russia-Ukraine war.
english: Glucksmann is a supporter of Ukraine and is one of those who criticizes US President Donald Trump for his stance on the Russia-Ukraine war.

text: Ginmuno man sang French ang pagbuhin ni Tump sang suporta sa US research institutions rason nga naghingyo na lang ang French government sa pila sa mga eksperto nga sa ila na lang mag-trabaho.
english: The French also criticized Tump's reduction in support for US research institutions, prompting the French government to ask some of the experts to work for them.

text: Sang nagbalik si Trump sa White House sang Enero, matandaan nga gin-utod sang iya gobyerno ang pila sa federal research funding kag ginpahalin sa trabaho ang ginatos nga federal workers sa health and climate research.
english: When Trump returned to the White House in January, it will be recalled that his administration cut some of the federal research funding and laid off hundreds of federal workers in health and climate research.

text: “The second thing we’re going to say to the Americans is: ‘if you want to fire your best researchers, if you want to fire all the people who, through their freedom and their sense of innovation, their taste for doubt and research, have made your country the world’s leading power, then we’re going to welcome them,'” pahayag pa ni Glucksmann.#
english: “The second thing we’re going to say to the Americans is: ‘if you want to fire your best researchers, if you want to fire all the people who, through their freedom and their sense of innovation, their taste for doubt and research, have made your country the world’s leading power, then we’re going to welcome them,'” Mr. Glucks said.

text: Masobra 2,000 ka mga balay kag mga imprastruktura ang naguba, samtang lima naman ang napatay sa nagluntad nga wildfire sa Los Angeles County, California, USA.
english: More than 2,000 homes and infrastructure were destroyed, while five people were killed in a wildfire in Los Angeles County, California, USA.

text: Suno kay Bombo Nilo Juaneza, Bombo International Correspondent sa California, USA, ang lima ka mga lawas ang nakit-an sa sulod sang tatlo ka mga building sa Altadena kon sa diin, ang Eaton fire ang naglupok, rason nga wala gilayon nakaluwas ang mga biktima.
english: According to Bombo Nilo Juaneza, Bombo International Correspondent in California, USA, the five bodies were found inside three buildings in Altadena where the Eaton fire broke out, causing the victims not to immediately escape.

text: Ginabanta nga masobra 1,000 ka mga istruktura ang naguba sa Palisades fire samtang 1,000 naman ang na-damage sa Eaton Fire.
english: It is estimated that more than 1,000 structures were destroyed in the Palisades fire while 1,000 were damaged in the Eaton Fire.

text: Suno sa Los Angels County Fire Department, ang mga kagamitan nga ginagamit sa pagpalong sang sunog ang nabudlayan matapos nagluntad ang sunog sa Hollywood Hills area mga alas-5:45 sa hapon sang Miyerkules, nga nagtulod sa pag-evacuate sa lugar sang Runyon Canyon.
english: According to the Los Angeles County Fire Department, firefighting equipment was hampered after a fire broke out in the Hollywood Hills area around 5:45 pm Wednesday, prompting an evacuation of the Runyon Canyon area.

text: Sa Pacific Palisades, nasunog ang masobra 15,800 ka ektarya sang tubtob sa Pacific Coast Highway, sa diin ginlamon sini ang mga minilyon ka dolyar nga mga puluy-an.
english: In Pacific Palisades, it burned more than 15,800 acres as far as the Pacific Coast Highway, where it engulfed millions of dollars in homes.

text: Tubtob subong, wala pa na natumod sang talatapan ang rason sang kamatayon sang lima ka mga indibidwal nga ginbawian sang kabuhi sa amo nga insidente.
english: To date, the office has not determined the cause of death of the five individuals who lost their lives in the incident.

text: Indi lang isa, indi lang duha, kundi tatlo ka gid bag-o nga Guinness World Records titles ang ginauyatan subong sang K-pop superstars nga BTS.
english: K-pop superstars BTS now hold not one, not two, but three brand new Guinness World Records titles.

text: Gin-anunsyo sang Guinness World Records nga gin-break sang BTS ang numero sang pinakadamo nga followers sa Instagram, Twitter kag TikTok.
english: Guinness World Records announced that BTS broke the number of the most followers on Instagram, Twitter and TikTok.

text: Suno sa Guinness, yara sa 60,151,959 ang followers sang BTS sa Instagram sang nagligad nga bulan; most followed music group man ini sa TikTok nga may 45.7 million followers; kag may 44,167,059 followers sa Twitter.
english: According to Guinness, BTS had 60,151,959 followers on Instagram last month; it is also the most followed music group on TikTok with 45.7 million followers; and has 44,167,059 followers on Twitter.

text: Bangud sini nga bag-o nga achievements, nagdangat na sa 28 ka titulo halin sa GWS ang ginauyatan sang grupo.
english: With these new achievements, the group now holds 28 titles from GWS.

text: Sang Septyembre 2021, ang BTS ang ginpasindunggan sa Guinness World Records 2022 Hall of Fame.Sa subong, gina-enjoy anay nila ang ila nga “extended break” samtang naga-preparar sa ila nga “Permission to Dance on Stage” world tour.
english: In September 2021, BTS was inducted into the Guinness World Records 2022 Hall of Fame. They are currently enjoying their “extended break” while preparing for their “Permission to Dance on Stage” world tour.

text: Ginbasura sang Malacañang ang mga panawagan nga i-abolish ang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).
english: Malacañang has rejected calls to abolish the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Claire Castro, apisar sang mga alegasyon sang kurapsyon batok sa mga opisyal sang ahensya, may mga public servants sa gihapon sa ahensya nga nagahimo sang ila nga obligasyon.
english: According to Palace Press Officer Claire Castro, despite allegations of corruption against agency officials, there are still public servants in the agency who are doing their duty.

text: Kun may kakason man suno kay Castro, ini amo ang mga nagahimo sang sala.
english: If anyone is to be removed, Castro said, it is those who commit crimes.

text: “Sa ngayon ay hindi pa naiisip kung dapat itong i-abolish dahil dapat ang tanggalin dito ay iyong mga gumagawa ng mali.
english: “At the moment, it is not yet decided whether it should be abolished because the ones who should be removed from it are those who are doing wrong.

text: Madali naman malaman kung sino-sino ito at sa tulong na rin po ni Secretary Vince, matatanggal ang dapat matanggal sa ahensiya,” pahayag sini.
english: It is easy to find out who it is and with the help of Secretary Vince, the agency will remove what should be removed,” he said.

text: Nahibaluan nga halin sang ginpa-imbestigaran ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: It is known that since the investigation of President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: ang mga iregularidad sa flood control projects, madamo sa mga district engineers sa DPWH ang naulamid kun sa diin gin-akusaran pa ang iban nga nagbulsa sang binilyon ka pesos nga pondo sang gobyerno.
english: irregularities in flood control projects, many of the district engineers in the DPWH were involved where others were accused of pocketing billions of pesos in government funds.

text: Sang weekend, una na nga ginpahayag ni DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon nga madamo sa mga empleyado sang ahensya ang pangkakason sa posisyon samtang padayon ang imbestigasyon.
english: Over the weekend, DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon earlier said that many of the agency's employees will be removed from their positions while the investigation continues.

text: Nagpahayag si Dizon nga buhion man sini ang “cadet engineering program” agud nga maka-produce sang maayo kag maalam nga mga civil engineers; mabalik ang morale; kag mapatay ang “padrino system” nga nag-infiltrate sa ahensya.#
english: Dizon said he will also revive the cadet engineering program to produce good and intelligent civil engineers; morale will be restored; and kill the “godfather system” that has infiltrated the agency.

text: Natalana nga pasakaan pa gid sang Department of Trade and Industry ang suggested retail prices para sa basic necessities and prime commodities sa bulan sang Enero 2023.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry is scheduled to further increase the suggested retail prices for basic necessities and prime commodities in January 2023.

text: Suno kay Trade and Industry Secretary Alfredo Pascual, ginatun-an sang ahensya ang price adjustment requests nga nagalakip sang 55 out of 218 stock keeping units nga ila nga gina-monitor.
english: According to Trade and Industry Secretary Alfredo Pascual, the agency is studying the price adjustment requests involving 55 out of 218 stock keeping units that they are monitoring.

text: Lakip sa mga produkto nga naga-request sang price hike amo ang canned goods, milk, bread, instant noodles, laundry soap, salt, soy sauce, toilet soap, kag candles.
english: Among the products requesting a price hike are canned goods, milk, bread, instant noodles, laundry soap, salt, soy sauce, toilet soap, and candles.

text: Lakip sa mga rason sa gina-request nga price hike amo ang pagsaka man sa presyo sang raw materials, packaging materials, production kag logistical support.
english: Among the reasons for the requested price hike is the increase in the price of raw materials, packaging materials, production and logistical support.

text: Una naman nga naga-reklamo ang mga konsumidor sa nagapanglalapaw nga presyo sang Noche Buena items subong nga Disyembre apang gin-athag sang Department of Trade and Industry nga wala sila sang kontrol diri bangud justified ini nga presyo.
english: Earlier, consumers complained about the exorbitant prices of Noche Buena items this December but the Department of Trade and Industry clarified that they have no control over this because the price is justified.

text: Gin-suspend sa isa ka hampang si Sacramento Kings forward Trey Lyles samtang ginmultahan naman sang $25,000 si Milwaukee Bucks center Brook Lopez bangud sang on-court altercation.
english: Sacramento Kings forward Trey Lyles was suspended for one game while Milwaukee Bucks center Brook Lopez was fined $25,000 for an on-court altercation.

text: Natabo ang away sa fourth quarter sang hampang sang Milwaukee batok sa Sacramento kun sa diin daog ang Bucks,133-124.
english: The fight happened in the fourth quarter of Milwaukee's game against Sacramento where the Bucks won, 133-124.

text: Na-foul ni Lyles si Milwaukee star Giannis Antetokounmpo kag gintiklod ang two-time NBA Most Valuable Player sa likod.
english: Lyles fouled Milwaukee star Giannis Antetokounmpo and pushed the two-time NBA Most Valuable Player to the back.

text: Gilayon nga ginkumpronta ni Lopez si Lyles kag naglab-ot pa sa pisikalanay nga kinahanglan pa nga untaton sang ila mga kaupdanan sa hampang.
english: Lopez immediately confronted Lyles and went so far as to get physical that their teammates had to stop.

text: May duha ka technical foul si Lyles kag ejected samtang si Lopez naman ang may isa ka technical foul kag ejected.
english: Lyles had two technical fouls and was ejected while Lopez had one technical foul and was ejected.

text: Pagkatapos sang hampang, ginpahayag ni Antetokounmpo nga wala siya sang ideya kun ano ang natabo apang nagsugot na ini nga i-reimburse si Lopez sa multa bangud nahangpan niya nga gin-depensahan lang siya sini.
english: After the game, Antetokounmpo said he had no idea what happened but had agreed to reimburse Lopez for the fine because he understood he was just defending him.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Bucks ang nagaangkon sang best record sa NBA nga may 50-19 samtang pangatlo naman ang Kings sa Western Conference nga may 40-27.
english: The Bucks have the best record in the NBA with 50-19 while the Kings are third in the Western Conference with 40-27.

text: Naangkon ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: ang mas mataas nga trust kag satisfaction ratings suno sa pinakaulihi nga survey sang OCTA Research group nga ginpatigayon sang Hulyo 12 tubtob 17.
english: the higher trust and satisfaction ratings according to the latest OCTA Research group survey conducted July 12 to 17.

text: Suno sa OCTA, nagtaas sa 64 porsyento ang trust rating sang Presidente halin sa 60 porsyento sang Abril.
english: According to the OCTA, the President's trust rating rose to 64 percent from 60 percent in April.

text: Ang porsyento sang wala nagasalig sa iya nagnubo sa 20 porsyento gikan sa 23 porsyento, samtang ang mga undecided nagnubo man sa 16 porsyento gikan sa 18 porsyento.
english: The percentage of those who don’t trust him dropped to 20 percent from 23 percent, while the undecided also dropped to 16 percent from 18 percent.

text: Nagsaka man ang satisfaction rating ni Marcos sa 62 porsyento sang Hulyo gikan sa 59 porsyento sang Abril.
english: Marcos’ satisfaction rating also rose to 62 percent in July from 59 percent in April.

text: Ang porsyento sang mga indi kuntento halos wala nagbago nga may 19 porsyento halin sa 20 porsyento.
english: The percentage of those dissatisfied was almost unchanged with 19 per cent from 20 per cent.

text: samtang ang undecided nagnubo sa 18 porsyento gikan sa 20 porsyento.
english: while undecided dropped to 18 percent from 20 percent.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, si Bise Presidente Sara Duterte nakit-an sang OCTA nga may gamay nga pagnubo sa iya trust kag satisfaction ratings.
english: On the other hand, Vice President Sara Duterte was found by OCTA to have a slight decline in her trust and satisfaction ratings.

text: Ginpatigayon ang survey pila ka semana antes sang iya ika-apat nga State of the Nation Address (SONA) kag antes pa man ginpagwa sang Korte Suprema ang desisyon nga nagadeklara sang impeachment complaints batok sa iya nga unconstitutional.
english: The survey was conducted a few weeks before his fourth State of the Nation Address (SONA) and before the Supreme Court issued its decision declaring the impeachment complaints against him unconstitutional.

text: Passi City, Iloilo – Pilason ang iloy kag anak sini nga babaye matapos nagbunggo ang ila ginasakyan nga Toyota Fortuner sa isa ka poste kag pader sa Barangay Sablogon, Passi City.
english: Passi City, Iloilo – A mother and her daughter were injured after their Toyota Fortuner collided with a pole and wall in Barangay Sablogon, Passi City.

text: Ang iloy ang naga-edad sang 75 anyos kag ang iya anak naman ang 34 anyos kag amo ang nagamaneho sang salakyan.
english: The mother is 75 years old and her son is 34 years old and was driving the car.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Fire Officer 1 Jeric John Casamayor sang Passi City Fire Station, iya ginpahayag nga na-trap sa sulod sang salakyan ang mga biktima.
english: Fire Officer 1 Jeric John Casamayor of Passi City Fire Station said the victims were trapped inside the vehicle.

text: Suno kay Casamayor, gilayon nga nagresponde ang mga rescuers sa ginluntaran sang insidente.
english: According to Casamayor, rescuers immediately responded to the scene of the incident.

text: Nag-angkon naman sang pilas kag nagpalanakit ang dughan sang senior citizen matapos naglampos sa pulungkuan, samtang may lagob naman ang iya anak.
english: The senior citizen sustained injuries and chest pain after being hit by a chair, while his son sustained a bruise.

text: Gindala naman ang mga ini sa Don Valerio Palmares District Hospital agud madapatan sang nagakaigo nga pagbulong.
english: They were brought to the Don Valerio Palmares District Hospital for treatment.

text: Padayon naman ang imbestigasyon sang Passi City Police agud matumod ang rason sang aksidente.
english: Passi City Police are conducting an investigation to determine the cause of the accident.

text: -𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗝𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗿 𝗩𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗮
english: -Advice 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗝𝗼𝗿𝗿𝗿 𝗩𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗮

text: Nakit-an pa sa closed circuit television (CCTV) camera footage nga nakasakay pa sa isa ka pribado nga salakyan sa Pototan, Iloilo ang babayi nga sang ulihi nasapwan nga patay na, nakasulod sa sako, kag nahal-id sa Barangay Pacil, New Lucena, Iloilo.
english: Closed circuit television (CCTV) camera footage showed the woman riding in a private vehicle in Pototan, Iloilo, who was later found dead, wrapped in a sack, and lying in Barangay Pacil, New Lucena, Iloilo.

text: Marso 1 sang ginapahayag nag-abot ang biktima nga si Jonalyn Sucaldito sa atubang sang Iloilo Provincial Hospital sa Pototan sakay sa iya nga motorsiklo.
english: On March 1, the victim, Jonalyn Sucaldito, allegedly arrived in front of the Iloilo Provincial Hospital in Pototan on her motorcycle.

text: Sandig sa nakit-an sa CCTV footage, ginbilin sini ang iya nga motor kag nagsaylo sa isa ka pribado nga salakyan kag naglakat ang salakyan sa direksyon nga padulong sa Iloilo City.
english: According to CCTV footage, he left his motorcycle and moved to a private vehicle and the vehicle headed towards Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Pol.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Pol.

text: Lt.
english: Lt.

text: Jerson Baldevia, hepe sang New Lucena Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga indi klaro sa footage ang plate number sang salakyan gani nga ipasa pa ini sa Regional Anti-Cybercrime Unit (RACU) agud nga mas mabusisi.
english: Jerson Baldevia, chief of the New Lucena Municipal Police Station, said the plate number of the vehicle is not clear in the footage and will be forwarded to the Regional Anti-Cybercrime Unit (RACU) for further investigation.

text: Ginapahayag 9:40 am sang natabo ang pagsakay ni Sucaldito sa amo nga salakyan, kag wala man nakit-an nga daw ginpilit ukon ginpwersa ini gani posible suno sa pulis nga kilala niya kun sin-o ang yara sa amo nga private car.
english: It was reportedly 9:40 am when Sucaldito boarded the vehicle, and it was not seen that he was forced or forced, so it is possible that he knew who was in the private car.

text: Samtang, sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay George Jaranilla, utod ni Jonalyn, iya ginpahayag nga sang amo man nga adlaw, ginapahayag 2:00 sa hapon, nakapadala pa ini sang mensahe sa iya nga anak nga indi pagpabay-an ang iya nga mga manghod.
english: Meanwhile, in an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, George Jaranilla, Jonalyn's brother, said that on the same day, at 2:00 pm, he sent a message to his son not to neglect his brothers.

text: Apat ang anak ni Jonalyn kag subong ligum-dulom pa ang pamilya kun sin-o ang naghimo sang krimen.
english: Jonalyn has four children and the family is still in the dark about who committed the crime.

text:
Kun madumduman, sang nasapwan ang bangkay sang biktima, underwear na lang ang suksuk sini, kag may nakasulat sa sako nga ginsudlan sang bangkay nga: ‘Hayop ka Jovan Abantao at Alyas Supat.’

Si Jovan Abantao amo ang ginatudlo nga lider sang Abantao Drug Group sa Iloilo.
english:
When the victim's body was found, he was wearing only underwear, and the bag containing the body read: 'Hayop ka Jovan Abantao at Alyas Supat.'

Jovan Abantao is the alleged leader of the Abantao Drug Group in Iloilo.

text: May nakuha man ang otoridad nga lima ka sachets sang suspected shabu kaupod sa bangkay ni Sucaldito.
english: Police also recovered five sachets of suspected shabu from Sucaldito's body.

text: Si Sucaldito ang ginapahayag wala man sang rekord sa New Lucena kag Pototan MPS, kag wala man sang record sa Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) VI nga may involvement ini sa illegal drug operations.
english: Sucaldito allegedly has no record with the New Lucena and Pototan MPS, and no record with the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) VI of his involvement in illegal drug operations.

text: Nagalab-ot sa halos 2,000 ang bakante nga posisyon subong sa sulod sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).
english: There are currently nearly 2,000 vacancies within the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).

text: Suno ini kay DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon kadungan sang flag-raising ceremony sang ahensya subong nga aga, Oktubre 20.
english: This was stated by DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon during the agency's flag-raising ceremony this morning, October 20.

text: Pahayag sang tiglikom, hatagan sang prayoridad nga ma-promote sa sini nga mga posisyon ang current employees nga deserving, tampad, kag mapisan, lakip na ang job order employees.
english: The secretary said that priority will be given to promote to these positions current employees who are deserving, honest, and hardworking, including job order employees.

text: “Our priority to fill these positions is within the DPWH.
english: “Our priority to fill these positions is within the DPWH.

text: I want to promote and elevate deserving, honest, and hardworking people already in the agency, including our job order employees,” suno kay Dizon.
english: I want to promote and elevate deserving, honest, and hardworking people already in the agency, including our job order employees,” according to Dizon.

text: Pahayag sini, may kinamatarong man pati ang mga job order employee nga mapasaka ang posisyon agud nga mapuno ang 1,993 vacant positions.
english: He said job order employees also have the right to be promoted to fill the 1,993 vacant positions.

text: “Just because you have been a job order employee for a long time doesn’t mean you have no right or opportunity to advance.
english: “Just because you have been a job order employee for a long time doesn’t mean you have any right or opportunity to advance.

text: You will be prioritized for nearly 2,000 vacancies,” dugang sini.
english: You will be prioritized for nearly 2,000 vacancies,” it added.

text: Ginpromisa man sang tiglikom nga indi na ma-atrasar ang sweldo para sa mga JO.
english: The secretary also promised that the salaries for the JOs will not be delayed.

text: Nagpaandam ini nga sipaon sa trabaho ang mga responsable pananglitan ma-late na naman ang sweldo.
english: He warned that those responsible will be fired if the salary is late again.

text: Matandaan nga sa iya una nga adlaw sa pagpungko bilang DPWH Secretary, nagmandu si Dizon sang courtesy resignation sang mga opisyal sang amo nga ahensya.
english: On his first day as DPWH Secretary, Dizon ordered the courtesy resignation of the agency's officials.

text: Sakop sini nga mandu ang tanan nga nagapungko sa mataas nga posisyon sa central office tubtub sa mga nagapungko sa district offices.
english: This order covers all those occupying high positions in the central office to those occupying district offices.

text: Nagbulos si Dizon bilang tiglikom sa DPWH sa tunga sang mga imbestigasyon sa mga iregularidad sa flood control projects kag iban pa nga lapnagon nga kurapsyon sa infrastructure projects.#
english: Dizon took over as DPWH secretary amid investigations into irregularities in flood control projects and other widespread corruption in infrastructure projects.

text: May nagapamintana nga pagnubo sa presyo sang produktong petrolyo.
english: There is a pending decline in the price of petroleum products.

text:
Yari ang ginalauman nga rollback sa masunod nga semana:

DIESEL – maganubo sang P2.40 ang presyo sa kada litro

GASOLINA – maganubo sang P2.25 ang presyo sa kada litro

KEROSENE – maganubo sang P1.60 ang presyo sa kada litro

Kun matabo, ini na ang ikapito nga sunud-sunod semana sa pagnubo sa kada litro sang diesel samtang ikatatlo naman sa gasolina.
english:
Here’s what the rollback is expected to be next week:

DIESEL – price to drop by P2.40 per liter

GASOLINE – price to drop by P2.25 per liter

KEROSENE – price to drop by P1.60 per liter

If it happens, it will be the seventh consecutive week of decline per liter for diesel while the third for gasoline.

text: Sa Lunes natalana nga ipaguwa ang final price adjustment, samtang ipatuman naman ini epektibo sa Martes.
english: The final price adjustment is scheduled to be released on Monday, while it will be implemented effective Tuesday.

text: Padayon nga nagapaayo sa masakit ang aktres nga Kris Aquino sa diin base sa iya nga instagram account, plano sini nga magpadulong sa abroad agud didto magpabulong.
english: Actress Kris Aquino is still recovering from her illness and based on her Instagram account, she plans to go abroad for treatment.

text: Gin pahayag sang aktres nga halin sa iya bug-at nga 85 pounds yara na lang ini subong sa 38.5 kg.
english: The actress said that from her weight of 85 pounds she is now only 38.5 kg.

text: Suno kay Kris, natapos kag nangin madinlag-on ang iya nga Xolair injection.
english: According to Kris, her Xolair injection was completed and successful.

text: Kun wala sang aberya sa iya masunod nga dose, posible nga tugutan na ini nga magpadulong sa abroad.
english: If there is no defect in his next dose, he may be allowed to travel abroad.

text: Ang Xolair injection ang isa ka injectable prescription medicine nga ginagamit para bulngon ang “chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU) sa mga tawo nga naga edad sang 12 anyos pataas.
english: Xolair injection is an injectable prescription medicine used to treat “chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU) in people aged 12 years and older.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang nagligad nga tuig gin-anunsyo ni Kris Aquino nga may yara ini sang autoimmune disease.
english: Last year, Kris Aquino announced that she had an autoimmune disease.

text: Patay ang driver kag angkas sini nga iya hinablos matapos madagdag ang ginasakyan nga motorsiklo sa ginabulubanta tatlo ka tapak nga kataason nga kanal sa national road sang Sitio Malanay, Brgy.
english: The driver and his nephew were killed after their motorcycle fell into a three-foot-high canal on the national road of Sitio Malanay, Brgy.

text: Sebaste, Sibunag, Guimaras.
english: Sebaste, Sibunag, Guimaras.

text: Ang driver amo si Arnolfo Ganancial, 43-anyos, residente sang Brgy.
english: The driver was identified as Arnolfo Ganancial, 43, resident of Brgy.

text: Sebario, San Lorenzo, Guimaras samtang ang angkas sini amo ang 17-anyos nga solterito, residente sang Sitio Lanag, Brgy Ayangan, Sibunag, Guimaras.
english: Sebario, San Lorenzo, Guimaras while the passenger was a 17-year-old boy, resident of Sitio Lanag, Brgy Ayangan, Sibunag, Guimaras.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Leonard Jardiolin, Deputy sang Sebaste Municipal Police Station (MPS), iya ginpahayag nga papauli na kuntani ang duha halin sa isa ka resort matapos mag-selebrar sang wedding anniversary ang driver, sang nadulaan ini sang kontrol kag nakabunggo sa gutter nga rason sang pagkahulog.
english: Police Lieutenant Leonard Jardiolin, Deputy of the Sebaste Municipal Police Station (MPS), said the two were returning home from a resort after the driver lost control and hit the gutter causing the fall.

text: Gilayon ang mga ini nga gindala sa Dr. Catalino Nava Provincial Hospital apang gindeklara nga dead on arrival.
english: They were immediately brought to Dr. Catalino Nava Provincial Hospital but was declared dead on arrival.

text: Patal nga pilas sa ulo ang ila naagum nga nangin rason man sang ila kamatayon.
english: They sustained fatal head injuries which also led to their death.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, nakainom ang mga biktima kag posible madasig ang pagpadalagan sang motorsiklo.
english: According to the investigation, the victims were under the influence of alcohol and may have been driving fast.

text: Ginkilala sang Senado ang undefeated Filipino boxing star nga si Eumir Marcial kasunod sang iya ikaapat nga consecutive professional middleweight bout sa Alamodome sa San Antonio, Texas, USA sang Pebrero.
english: The Senate recognized undefeated Filipino boxing star Eumir Marcial following his fourth consecutive professional middleweight bout at the Alamodome in San Antonio, Texas, USA in February.

text: Sa plenary session subong nga Lunes, nag-adoptar ang upper chamber sang Senate Resolution Nos.
english: In plenary session this Monday, the upper chamber adopted Senate Resolution Nos.

text: 494 kag 256 nga nagapanginbulahan sa Zamboanga native nga may yara na subong sang matinlo nga rekord nga 4-0 kag 2 ka knockouts.
english: 494 and 256 congratulating the Zamboanga native who now has a clean record of 4-0 and 2 knockouts.

text: Nangin 2020 Tokyo Olympics bronze medalist anay si Marcial kag isa man ka sergeant sang Philippine Air Force.
english: Marcial is a former 2020 Tokyo Olympics bronze medalist and a sergeant in the Philippine Air Force.

text: Sang 2021, nahatagan man siya sang Philippine Senate Medal of Excellence bangud sa amo nga kadalag-an sa men’s middleweight boxing division sa Olympiada sa Japan.
english: In 2021, he was also awarded the Philippine Senate Medal of Excellence for his victory in the men’s middleweight boxing division at the Olympiad in Japan.

text: Magasugod na ang Department of Agriculture (DA) sa pagbaligya sang bugas sa balor nga P20 kada kilo sa mga pili nga lugar sa rehiyon 2 kag 3.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) will start selling rice at P20 per kilo in selected areas in Regions 2 and 3.

text: Suno kay DA Deputy Spokesperson Assistant Secretary Joycel Panlilio, sa Agosto 13, magasugod na sila sa pagbaligya sang bugas sa balor nga P20/kg sa mga pili nga lugar sa Rehiyon 2 kag 3, lakip ang mga mangunguma kag middle-income family.
english: According to DA Deputy Spokesperson Assistant Secretary Joycel Panlilio, on August 13, they will start selling rice at P20/kg in selected areas in Regions 2 and 3, including farmers and middle-income families.

text: May yara naman sang P18 billion nga budget ang ahensya nga ginpain para sa nasambit nga programa.
english: The agency has a P18 billion budget allocated for the program.

text: Madumduman nga gin-anunsyo ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr ang pagpalawig sang pagbaligya sang bugas sa balor nga P20/kg sa nagkalain-lain nga bahin sang pungsod.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. announced the extension of the sale of rice at P20/kg in various parts of the country.

text: Ginkalipay sang fans kag iban pa nga Pinoy celebrities ang liwat nga pag-upod sang aktor nga si Joshua Garcia kag aktres nga si Janella Salvador.
english: Fans and other Filipino celebrities welcomed the reunion of actor Joshua Garcia and actress Janella Salvador.

text: Sa instagram account, gin-post ni Joshua ang photo kaupod si Janella sa set sang ila bag-o nga proyekto.
english: On his instagram account, Joshua posted a photo with Janella on the set of their new project.

text: Sa amu nga photo, kuha ni Joshua ang isa ka mirror selfie kaupod si Janella sa sulod sang dressing room.
english: In the photo, Joshua took a mirror selfie with Janella inside the dressing room.

text: Ginsulat ni Joshua sa caption ang tinaga nga “Reunited”.
english: Joshua wrote the word “Reunited” in the caption.

text: Ini ang reunion project sang Joshnella matapos nga ginlunsar ang ila love team sang 2019.
english: This is Joshnella’s reunion project after launching their love team in 2019.

text: Ginpakigbahin man sang iban pa nga Pinoy celebrities ang ila kilig sang makit-an nga upod ang JoshNella.
english: Other Filipino celebrities also shared their excitement when they were seen with JoshNella.

text: Excited man ang fans sa reunion sang duha ka kilala nga personalidad sa showbusiness.
english: Fans are also excited about the reunion of two well-known personalities in showbusiness.

text: Nagbunggoanay ang duha ka salakyan nga pareho nga nagtambong sa isa ka lubong sa sulod mismo sang Forest Lake Cemetery sa Brgy.
english: Two vehicles collided while both were attending a funeral inside the Forest Lake Cemetery in Brgy.

text: Calajunan, Mandurriao, Iloilo City, pasado alas-5:50 kaina sang hapon, Hulyo 30.
english: Calajunan, Mandurriao, Iloilo City, around 5:50 pm yesterday, July 30.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Chief Master Sergeant Alfredo Masamong Jr., traffic investigator sang Traffic Enforcement Unit sang Mandurriao, iya ginpahayag nga ang insidente natabo sang aksidente nga natapakan sang driver sang SUV nga ginkilala nga si Alyas Jerry, 77-anyos, ang accelerator sang iya salakyan imbes nga preno kag nagdiretso ini nga nagbunggo sa nagapadulong nga L300 FB Van sang barangay responder sang Barangay West Habog-Habog, Molo nga ginamaneho naman ni Alyas Dionisio, 65 anyos.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Chief Master Sergeant Alfredo Masamong Jr., traffic investigator of the Traffic Enforcement Unit of Mandurriao, said the incident occurred when the driver of the SUV, identified as Jerry, 77, accidentally stepped on the accelerator of his vehicle. L300 FB Van of the barangay responder of Barangay West Habog-Habog, Molo driven by alias Dionisio, 65 years old.

text: Tungod sang impact sang salakyan, may mga nag-angkon sang minor injuries, lakip na ang 10 ka pasahero sang van.
english: Due to the impact of the vehicle, some people sustained minor injuries, including 10 passengers of the van.

text: May mga tawo man nga yara sa palibot sang dalan nga naigo kag nakaangkon sang gamay nga samad.Ang mga biktima nga may minor injuries gilayon man nga gindala sa malapit nga ospital para sa medical attention.
english: Some people around the road were also hit and sustained minor injuries. The victims with minor injuries were also immediately taken to a nearby hospital for medical attention.

text: Ang driver sang Fortuner nga si Alyas Jerry gin paidalum sa hospital arrest kag ginabantayan sang kapulisan samtang ginabulong sa Western Visayas Medical Center.
english: The driver of the Fortuner, alias Jerry, was placed under hospital arrest and is being treated at the Western Visayas Medical Center.

text: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑲𝒓𝒚𝒍𝒍𝒆 𝑴𝒆𝒍𝒍𝒊𝒛𝒂
english: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑲𝒓𝒚𝒍𝒍𝒆 𝑴𝒆𝒍𝒍𝒊𝒛𝒂

text: Matapos nagpamatok sa desisyon sang gobyerno nga mag-import sang 25,000 metric tons sang isda, ginhangkat sang isa ka grupo sang manugpangisda si President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: After opposing the government’s decision to import 25,000 metric tons of fish, a group of fishermen challenged President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: nga i-ban ang imported fish halin sa China.
english: to ban imported fish from China.

text: Suno sa Pambansang Lakas ng Kilusang Mamamalakaya ng Pilipinas, kalain panumdumom kag doble-insulto nga ang nagapanguna nga ginahalinan sang imported fish sa pungsod amo ang China, ang pungsod nga nagabutang man sang ila dalagku nga barko kag nagapangisda sa mismo teritoryo sang Pilipinas.
english: According to the Pambansang Lakas ng Kilusang Mamamalakaya ng Pilipinas, it is unfortunate and double-insult that the main source of imported fish in the country is China, the country that also puts its large ships and fishes in the territory of the Philippines.

text: Suno pa sa fishers’ group, ang round scad ukon ang galunggong nga iimport sang Pilipinas amo man ang masami nga nagakakuha gikan mismo sa West Philippine Sea ukon sa mga dagat sa Batangas, Mindoro, kag Palawan.
english: According to the fishermen's group, the round scad or galunggong that the Philippines imports is also often caught from the West Philippine Sea itself or from the seas of Batangas, Mindoro, and Palawan.

text: Matandaan nga gin anunsyo sang national government nga maga-import ang Pilipinas sang 25,000 metric tons sang frozen round scad ukon galunggong, bigeye scad, mackerel, bonito, kag moonfish agud indi magkulang ang suplay sa tion sang closed fishing season nga magaumpisa sa November kag matapos sa January 2023.
english: The national government announced that the Philippines will import 25,000 metric tons of frozen round scad or galunggong, bigeye scad, mackerel, bonito, and moonfish to ensure that there is no shortage of supply during the closed fishing season that starts in November and ends in January 2023.

text: Duha ka gold medals ang dala-pauli sang Pinoy gymnast nga si Carlos Yulo halin sa Baku, Azerbaijan leg sang International Gymnastics Federation (FIG) Artistic Gymnastics World Cup Series.
english: Pinoy gymnast Carlos Yulo brought home two gold medals from the Baku, Azerbaijan leg of the International Gymnastics Federation (FIG) Artistic Gymnastics World Cup Series.

text: Matapos nangibabaw sa parallel bars sang Sabado, ginpasagunsunan sini ang kadalag-an paagi sa pag-dominar sa vault kahapon, Domingo, Marso 12.
english: After dominating the parallel bars on Saturday, she followed up the victory by dominating the vault yesterday, Sunday, March 12.

text: Naka-skor si Yulo sang 14.933 points sa iya duha ka vaults (15.033 points sa first vault kag 14.833 sa second vault).
english: Yulo scored 14.933 points in her two vaults (15.033 points in the first vault and 14.833 in the second vault).

text: Nagpangaduha sa Pinoy Olympian si Harry Hepworth sang Great Britain nga may 14.816 points, samtang nagpangatlo naman si Shek Wai Hung nga may 14.716 points.
english: Harry Hepworth of Great Britain came second with 14.816 points, while Shek Wai Hung came third with 14.716 points.

text: Nangin consistent ang maayo nga performance sang 23-anyos nga gymnast sa World Cup series subong nga tuig, apang sa Baku ang gina-konsiderar nga pinakamaayo ipaanggid sa una nga tatlo ka legs.
english: The 23-year-old gymnast has consistently performed well in the World Cup series this year, but in Baku is considered the best compared to the first three legs.

text: Kun balikan, nabulsa sini ang bronze medal sa parallel bars sa opening leg sa Cottbus, Germany.
english: Looking back, he pocketed the bronze medal in the parallel bars in the opening leg in Cottbus, Germany.

text: Sa Doha, Qatar, nakakuha ini sang gold sa floor exercise, silver sa parallel bars, kag bronze sa vault.
english: In Doha, Qatar, she won gold in the floor exercise, silver in the parallel bars, and bronze in the vault.

text: Sa kabug-usan nga World Cup Series, may yara siya sang tatlo ka gold medals, isa ka silver, kag duha ka bronzes.
english: In total World Cup Series, he has three gold medals, one silver, and two bronzes.

text: Sunod nga balantayan amo ang katapusan nga leg sang series sa Cairo, Egypt nga matabo sa Abril 27 tubtub sa Abril 30.
english: Next up is the final leg of the series in Cairo, Egypt which will take place from April 27 to April 30.

text: Sa baylo nga magsuksok sang high-heeled shoes kaangay sang ginasuksok sang kaangay niya nga beauty queens, nagdesisyon ang former Miss Grand Ukraine nga magsuksok na subong sang combat boots.
english: Instead of wearing high-heeled shoes like her fellow beauty queens, the former Miss Grand Ukraine decided to wear combat boots.

text: Si Anastasia Lenna amo ang 2015 representative sang Ukraine sa Miss Grand International beauty contest.
english: Anastasia Lenna is the 2015 representative of Ukraine in the Miss Grand International beauty contest.

text: Sandig sa post sa iya nga Instagram account, nag-join ini sa military sang Ukraine agud batuan ang nagakatabo subong nga Russian invasion.
english: According to a post on his Instagram account, he joined the Ukrainian military to fight the ongoing Russian invasion.

text:
Sa isa sini ka latest post, ginpahayag ni Lenna nga: “Everyone who crosses the Ukrainian border with the intent to invade will be killed!”

May yara man sang gin-share nga laragway sang mga soldado nga nagalakat kaupod si Ukrainian President Zelensky.
english:
In one of her latest posts, Lenna stated that: “Everyone who crosses the Ukrainian border with the intent to invade will be killed!”

A picture of soldiers walking alongside Ukrainian President Zelensky was also shared.

text:
Gintawag ni Lenna ang presidente nga “true and strong leader.”

Sang nag-umpisa ang pagsulod sang Russia sa Ukraine, nangin consistent man ang beauty queen sa pag-engganyo sang suporta kag pag-tipon sang donasyon para sa Ukrainian armed forces.
english:
Lenna called the president a “true and strong leader.”

When Russia began invading Ukraine, the beauty queen also became consistent in encouraging support and raising donations for the Ukrainian armed forces.

text: Gin-release sang Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS-DOST) ang time-lapse footage sang natabo nga minor phreatomagmatic eruption sa main crater sang Taal Volcano.
english: The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS-DOST) released time-lapse footage of a minor phreatomagmatic eruption in the main crater of Taal Volcano.

text: Nag-umpisa ini 06:13 a.m. kag naglawig sang isa ka minuto.
english: It started at 06:13 a.m. and lasted one minute.

text: “This event generated plumes that rose 500 meters above the crater as recorded by the Main Crater IP Camera,” suno sa Phivolcs.
english: “This event generated plumes that rose 500 meters above the crater as recorded by the Main Crater IP Camera,” according to Phivolcs.

text: Nagapabilin sa Alert Level 1 ang status sang amo nga bulkan sa Batangas kun sa diin may posibilidad ang gulpyada nga steam ukon phreatic eruptions, volcanic earthquakes, manipis nga ashfall kag pagguwa sang poisonous gases.#
english: The status of the volcano in Batangas remains at Alert Level 1 with the possibility of sudden steam or phreatic eruptions, volcanic earthquakes, thin ashfall and release of poisonous gases.

text: Duha na ka mga tawo ang na-rekord nga patay kag madamo ang ginapahayag nga nasamaran bangud sa lapnagon nga wildfire sa Los Angeles, California, USA.
english: Two people have been recorded dead and many reportedly injured due to a widespread wildfire in Los Angeles, California, USA.

text: Magluwas diri, ginmandu man ang mandatory evacuations sang masobra sa 80,000 ka mga tawo sa area.
english: In addition, mandatory evacuations of more than 80,000 people in the area were also ordered.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon, ang Palisades Fire ang nakalamon na sang masobra sa 5,000 ka ektarya samtang ang Eaton Fire naman nakahalit na sang 2,200 ka ektarya.
english: According to initial information, the Palisades Fire has already consumed more than 5,000 hectares while the Eaton Fire has damaged 2,200 hectares.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, naglab-ot na sa 500 ka ektarya ang naapektuhan sa Hurst Fire.
english: On the other hand, 500 hectares have been affected by the Hurst Fire.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Pacific Palisades ang nahamtang sa tunga-tunga sang Santa Monica Mountains kag Pacific Ocean.
english: Pacific Palisades is located between the Santa Monica Mountains and the Pacific Ocean.

text: Nag-umpisa ang Eaton Fire 6:30 p.m. sa Pasadena kag Altadena area, samtang nagsunod ang Hurst Fire sang 10:30 p.m. sa Sylmar, north sang San Fernando.
english: The Eaton Fire started at 6:30 p.m. in the Pasadena and Altadena areas, while the Hurst Fire followed at 10:30 p.m. in Sylmar, north of San Fernando.

text: Natabo ang sunog bangud sa kumbinasyon sang dry conditions kag mabaskog nga hangin.
english: The fire was caused by a combination of dry conditions and high winds.

text: Lapaw naman sa 300,000 energy customers ang nautdan sang suplay sang kuryente suno sa PowerOutage.com.
english: More than 300,000 energy customers were without power, according to PowerOutage.com.

text: Gin-ban naman sang Federal Aviation Administration ang flights malapit sa areas sa Los Angeles kun sa diin may wildfires nga wala pa gihapon napatay sang fire authorities.
english: The Federal Aviation Administration has banned flights near areas in Los Angeles where there are wildfires that have not been extinguished by fire authorities.

text: Lakip sa mga nagbakwit amo ang film kag television stars nga sanday Jamie Lee Curtis, Mandy Moore kag James Woods nga tubtub subong wala pa sang kasiguruhan kun sarang makaluwas ang ila balay sa paglamon sang kalayo.
english: Among those evacuated were film and television stars Jamie Lee Curtis, Mandy Moore and James Woods who are still unsure whether their homes will survive the fire.

text: Ginbasura sang New York appellate court ang appeal ni President-elect Donald Trump nga indi pagdayunon ang pagsentensiya sa iya sa Biyernes kaangot sa pag-convict sa iya sa criminal charges nga nag-ugat sa hush money nga ginbayad sa isa ka porn star.
english: A New York appellate court rejected President-elect Donald Trump's appeal to stay his sentencing on Friday in connection with his conviction on criminal charges stemming from hush money paid to a porn star.

text: Ang amo nga request ni Trump sa korte ang nagarepresentar sang ulihi nga pagtinguha sini nga balabagan ang ruling sang trial judge nga dayunon ang pagbasa sang sentensiya nga natalana 10 ka adlaw antes ang iya inagurasyon.
english: Trump's request to the court represents his latest attempt to block the trial judge's ruling to proceed with the reading of the sentence scheduled 10 days before his inauguration.

text: Sa ruling sang Lunes, ginbasura ni Justice Juan Merchan ang request halin sa abogado ni Trump nga ipaiway ang pagsentensiya samtang ila ginaapelar ang duha sa nauna nga rulings sang huwes nga i-uphold ang guilty verdict sang Mayo sang huwes sa Manhattan sa 34 felony counts sang pagpeke sang mga business records.
english: In Monday’s ruling, Justice Juan Merchan denied a request from Trump’s lawyer to delay sentencing while they appealed both of the judge’s earlier rulings to uphold a Manhattan judge’s May guilty verdict on 34 felony counts of falsifying business records.

text: Gintawag sang judge nga “a repetition of the arguments he has raised numerous times in the past” ang delay request ni Trump.
english: The judge called Trump’s delay request “a repetition of the arguments he has raised numerous times in the past.”

text: Sa pagbasa sang sentensya sa Biyernes, ginsiling ni Merchan nga indi ini inclined nga ipapreso gid si Trump.
english: Reading the verdict Friday, Merchan said he was not inclined to actually send Trump to prison.

text: Suno sa iya, ang sentence sang unconditional discharge, nga magadagdag sang judgment of guilt sa record ni Trump nga wala sang penalidad ukon probation, amo ang pinaka- praktikal nga approach ilabi na nga natalana nga magbalik ini sa posisyon bilang presidente.
english: He said the sentence of unconditional discharge, which would add a judgment of guilt to Trump's record without penalty or probation, is the most practical approach especially as he is set to return to office as president.

text: Nangulintas sang gold medal ang Filipino Olympian nga si Carlos Edriel Yulo sa parallel bars finals sang Azerbaijan leg sang Artistic Gymnastics World Cup series sa Baku.
english: Filipino Olympian Carlos Edriel Yulo won the gold medal in the parallel bars finals of the Azerbaijan leg of the Artistic Gymnastics World Cup series in Baku.

text: Naka-skor ang Pinoy gymnast sang 15.400 nga ginsundan ni Kovtun Illia sang Ukraine nga may 15.366 kag Bernard Cameron-Lie sang France nga may 14.600.
english: The Pinoy gymnast scored 15.400 followed by Kovtun Illia of Ukraine with 15.366 and Bernard Cameron-Lie of France with 14.600.

text: Napaslawan naman si Yulo nga makadangat sa podium sa rings final bangud nagpang-pito lamang ini sa kumpetisyon nga may 14.166.
english: Yulo failed to reach the podium in the rings final as he finished seventh in the competition with a score of 14.166.

text: Subong nga adlaw matapos ang iya Baku campaign kadungan man sang final sa vault kun sa diin isa man siya sa ginabantayan.
english: Today after his Baku campaign coincides with the final in the vault where he is also one of the watched.

text: Antes sini, apat na ka mga medalya ang nadag-an sang Pinoy Olympian subong nga World Cup series, lakip ang bronze sa parallel bars bronze sa Cottbus, Germany leg.
english: Earlier, the Pinoy Olympian had won four medals in the current World Cup series, including bronze in the parallel bars bronze in the Cottbus, Germany leg.

text: Sa Doha, Qatar naman, nakakuha ini sang gold sa floor exercise, silver sa parallel bars, kag bronze sa vault.
english: In Doha, Qatar, she won gold in the floor exercise, silver in the parallel bars, and bronze in the vault.

text: May yara gid man bala sang third party sa pagbulagay sang celebrity couple nga sanday Carla Abellana kag Tom Rodriguez?
english: Was there really a third party in celebrity couple Carla Abellana and Tom Rodriguez’s divorce?

text: Isa ka bulan matapos ginbalita nga break na ang mag-asawa, ginkakibot sang netizens ang ‘marital issue’ nga a,u una nga ginpahayag rason sang ila pagbulagay.
english: A month after it was reported that the couple had broken up, netizens were shocked by the 'marital issue' that was initially said to be the reason for their separation.

text: Naggwa ang mga huring huring nga may yara sang third party sa ila nga relasyon matapos nga gin-like sang aktres ang komento nga nagatawag kay Tom nga “cheater”.
english: Rumors surfaced of a third party in their relationship after the actress liked a comment calling Tom a “cheater”.

text: Nadalahig man sa amu nga isyu ang The World Between Us co-star ni Tom nga si Kelley Day.
english: Tom's The World Between Us co-star Kelley Day was also involved in the issue.

text: Parehos man nga “tikom-bibig” ang duha ka personalidad angut sa ila break up.
english: Both personalities are also “tight-lipped” about their break up.

text: Ginpulihan sang kastigo ang isa ka lalaki nga nadakpan nga nagapangawat sa Barangay San Isidro, Antipolo City.
english: A man who was caught stealing in Barangay San Isidro, Antipolo City was punished.

text:
Ang suspek amo si alyas “Bai.”

Narekober sa iya ang mga bayo kag underwear.
english:
The suspect was identified as alias “Bai.”

Clothes and underwear were recovered from him.

text: Suno sa otoridad, notoryus nga kawatan kag akyat-bahay ang suspek, nga involved man sa iligal nga droga.
english: According to the authorities, the suspect is a notorious thief and housebreaker, who is also involved in illegal drugs.

text: Nag-ako naman sa krimen ang 30-anyos nga suspek.
english: The 30-year-old suspect confessed to the crime.

text: Preso na ini subong kag nagapangatubang sang nagakaigo nga kaso.
english: He is now in custody and facing appropriate charges.

text: Nakilala na ang mga suspek sa pagbuno-patay kay Delfin Donito Jr.
english: The suspects in the murder of Delfin Donito Jr. have been identified.

text: sa Infante Drive, Barangay San Felix, City Proper, sang Hulyo 26.
english: at Infante Drive, Barangay San Felix, City Proper, on July 26.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Michael Tuburan, hepe sang Iloilo City Police Station 7, iya ginkumpirmar nga natukoy na sang kapulisan ang pagkakilanlan sang duwa ka suspek apang wala pa ginpangalanan bangud padayon pa sa gihapon ang ila imbestigasyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Michael Tuburan, chief of Iloilo City Police Station 7, confirmed that the police have identified the two suspects but have not yet named them as their investigation is still ongoing.

text: Suno kay PCapt.
english: According to PCapt.

text: Tuburan, ang isa ka lalaki nga suspek residente sang Lapuz Norte, samtang taga Boulevard, Molo naman ang babayi.
english: Tuburan, a male suspect is a resident of Lapuz Norte, while the female is a resident of Boulevard, Molo.

text: Nahibaluan man nga maglive-in partners ang duwa.
english: It is also known that the two are live-in partners.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang kapulisan agud matukoy ang pagkakilanlan sang isa pa gid ka lalaki nga ginapatihan nga upod sang duha sa insidente.
english: Police are still investigating to identify another man believed to be with the two in the incident.

text: Dugang pa ni Tuburan, dako ang nabulig sang cartographic sketch nga ginpagwa sang kapulisan sa pagkilala sang mga suspek.
english: Tuburan said the cartographic sketch released by the police helped in identifying the suspects.

text: Sa karon, nagapadayon ang follow-up operation sang mga otoridad, lakip na ang proseso sa pagpasaka sang kaso kag pagtukoy sang posible nga motibo sa krimen.
english: The authorities are currently conducting a follow-up operation, including the process of filing a case and identifying a possible motive for the crime.

text: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑲𝒓𝒚𝒍𝒍𝒆 𝑴𝒆𝒍𝒍𝒊𝒛𝒂
english: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑲𝒓𝒚𝒍𝒍𝒆 𝑴𝒆𝒍𝒍𝒊𝒛𝒂

text: Nagapangabay ang Aquaculture industry sa gobyerno nga indi man paghimuon nga rason ang bagyo agud nga iduso na naman ang pag-import sang isda para sa Pilipinas.
english: The aquaculture industry is asking the government not to use the typhoon as an excuse to push back the importation of fish for the Philippines.

text: Suno sa mga grupo sang manugpangisda, bastante ang domestic supply sa pungsod kag indi kinahanglan ang importasyon.
english: According to fishermen’s groups, the domestic supply in the country is sufficient and there is no need for imports.

text: Sa latest data sang Department of Agriculture, nagdangat sa P201.64 million ang napyerde sa fisheries sector matapos nga naapektuhan man sang bagyo ang fishponds kag ang cages sang bangrus kag tilapia amo man ang seaweed farms, kag nahalitan man ang non-motorized boats kag municipal fishing boats.
english: According to the latest data of the Department of Agriculture, the fisheries sector lost P201.64 million after the typhoon also affected fishponds and cages of bangrus and tilapia as well as seaweed farms, and non-motorized boats and municipal fishing boats were also damaged.

text: Apang suno kay Taal Lake Aquaculture Alliance Incorporated director Mario Balazon, indi ini bastante nga excuse agud nga pasudlan na naman sang imported fish ang local market.
english: However, according to Taal Lake Aquaculture Alliance Incorporated director Mario Balazon, this is not enough excuse to reintroduce imported fish into the local market.

text: Suno sa grupo, kuntani mahangpan sang gobyerno nga resilient ang fishing industry sa Pilipinas apisar ano pa ka kusog ang huyop sang hangin kag bisan ano pa nga pagbaha ang matabo.
english: According to the group, the government should understand that the fishing industry in the Philippines is resilient despite the strong winds and flooding.

text: Apelar sini sa national government, untaton na ang paggamit sa mga kalamidad bilang rason agud nga ma-justify ang pagpasulod sang produkto sang iban nga mga pungsod.
english: He appealed to the national government to stop using disasters as an excuse to justify the importation of products from other countries.

text: Mas maayo suno sa grupo nga suportahan anay ang mga manugpangisda diri sa Pilipinas antes magtalikod kag mangayo ukon magbakal sang isda sa iban nga mga pungsod.
english: The group said it is better to support the fishermen here in the Philippines before turning away and asking or buying fish in other countries.

text: Ginsurpresa ni James Reid ang iya fans pinaagi sa pag-post sang teaser sang iya collaboration kaupod ang South Korean singer nga si Jay B sang K-pop group nga Got7, kag Taiwanese-American rapper nga si ØZI.
english: James Reid surprised his fans by posting a teaser of his collaboration with South Korean singer Jay B of K-pop group Got7, and Taiwanese-American rapper ØZI.

text: ”Hello” ang titulo sang collaboration song track nga ginapreparar sang tatlo.
english: ”Hello” is the title of the collaboration song track that the three are preparing.

text: Ang updated version sang amo nga ambahanon ang iga-release sa palaabuton nga Marso 11.
english: The updated version of the song will be released on March 11.

text:
Una na gin-anunsyo ni James ang iya international collaboration pila ka adlaw antes ini nagpadulong sa Los Angeles sa Estados Unidos, nga nagtuga man sang madamo nga espekulasyon may kaangtanan sa iya ‘career move.’

Apang gin-athag sang iya amay nga si Malcolm Reid, nga ang pagpadulong sang actor-singer sa US, “for recording sessions” lang kag para sa family visit.
english:
James had previously announced his international collaboration a few days before he headed to Los Angeles in the United States, which also sparked a lot of speculation in relation to his ‘career move.’

But his father, Malcolm Reid, clarified that the actor-singer's trip to the US was only for recording sessions and family visits.

text: Ginakahangaw-an nga ma-sideline lamang si National Basketball Association (NBA) superstar Kevin Durant sa nabilin nga bahin sang regular season kag sa pag-umpisa sang playoffs bangud sa gin-suprer nga Grade 2 ankle sprain.
english: National Basketball Association (NBA) superstar Kevin Durant is expected to be sidelined for the rest of the regular season and the start of the playoffs due to a Grade 2 ankle sprain.

text: Kasunod ini sang wala nadayon nga home debut ni Durant para sa Phoenix Suns bangud sang ankle injury sang warm-ups antes ang hampang batok sa Oklahoma City Thunder.
english: This follows Durant missing his home debut for the Phoenix Suns due to an ankle injury during warm-ups before the game against the Oklahoma City Thunder.

text: Tatlo ka games pa lamang ang naintrahan ni Durant sa Suns halin sang gin-trade ini halin sa Brooklyn sang nagligad nga bulan.
english: Durant has only played three games with the Suns since being traded from Brooklyn last month.

text: Natalana pa ini nga magpaidalom sa magnetic resonance imaging scan agud matumod kun ano kalala ang injury.
english: He is scheduled to undergo a magnetic resonance imaging scan to determine the severity of the injury.

text: Matandaan nga ang knee injury man subong nga season ang rason kun ngaa wala nakahampang ang 34-anyos nga NBA superstar sa 20 ka mga games sang yara pa ini sa Nets.
english: It can be recalled that a knee injury this season is the reason why the 34-year-old NBA superstar missed 20 games while he was with the Nets.

text: Sa pag-upod sini sa Phoenix sa nagligad nga mga hampang, may yara siya sang average nga 26.7 points kag 7.3 rebounds.
english: During his time with Phoenix in previous games, he averaged 26.7 points and 7.3 rebounds.

text: Ginpromisa ni President kag concurrent Agriculture secretary Bongbong Marcos nga solbaron sini ang problema sa sugar industry sa Pilipinas.
english: President and concurrent Agriculture Secretary Bongbong Marcos has promised to solve the problem of the sugar industry in the Philippines.

text: Gin-ako man sini nga madugay na nga wala na nahatagan sang igtalupangod ini nga problema sa pungsod.
english: He also acknowledged that this problem has not been given attention in the country for a long time.

text: Sa iya pagpanguna sang pagpanagtag sang ayuda sa lain-lain nga mga sektor sa Talisay City, ginpahayag ni Marcos nga apisar maayo man ang hulag sang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas, wala nakaluwas ang pungsod sa problema nga gina-agyan sang iban nga trade partners.
english: Leading the distribution of aid to various sectors in Talisay City, Marcos said that although the Philippine economy is doing well, the country has not escaped the problems faced by other trade partners.

text: Gin-mensyonar sini ang sitwasyon sang sugar industry sa Talisay nga nahamtang sa Negros Occidental nga amo ang nagapanguna nga sugar-producing province sa Pilipinas.
english: He mentioned the situation of the sugar industry in Talisay located in Negros Occidental which is the leading sugar-producing province in the Philippines.

text: Apisar sang amo nga promisa, wala man ginhatag sang presidente ang detalye kun paano sini itib-ong ang sugar industry.
english: Despite the promise, the president did not give details on how he will unite the sugar industry.

text: Naga-contribute ini nga industriya sang ginabanta P90 billion sa ekonomiya sang pungsod kada tuig.
english: This industry contributes an estimated P90 billion to the country's economy annually.

text: Nagaplano ang Senado nga buhinan sang 15% tubtob 20% ang budget sang mga infrastructure projects sa idalom sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) bilang tikang batok sa ginaalegar nga overpriced infrastructure projects.
english: The Senate plans to reduce the budget of infrastructure projects under the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) by 15% to 20% as a measure against allegedly overpriced infrastructure projects.

text: Suno kay Senate President Vicente “Tito” Sotto III, ini nga plano ang na-diskusyonan na nila ni Senate Finance Committee Chair Sherwin Gatchalian.
english: Senate President Vicente “Tito” Sotto III said the plan has already been discussed with Senate Finance Committee Chair Sherwin Gatchalian.

text: Ang nasambit nga proposal ang nagguwa kasunod sang mga nabuyagyag nga anomaliya sa budget, partikular na ang ginahimo sang pila ka district engineers kag opisyal sang DPWH agud mabayran ang mga nagaproponer sang proyekto.
english: The proposal came out following the revelations of anomalies in the budget, particularly the actions of some district engineers and DPWH officials to pay the project proponents.

text: Ginpakamalaot man ni Gatchalian ang natukiban nga P10.3 billion nga balor sang mga overpriced farm-to-market road projects halin pa sang 2023 tubtob 2024 base sa budget deliberations sang Department of Agriculture.
english: Gatchalian also condemned the discovery of P10.3 billion worth of overpriced farm-to-market road projects from 2023 to 2024 based on the budget deliberations of the Department of Agriculture.

text: Nagpatawag man sang imbestigasyon si Sotto angot sa mga super health centers, kun sa diin nahibaluan nga may 300 sa sini ang non-operational tubtob subong.
english: Sotto also called for an investigation into the super health centers, where it was learned that 300 of them are non-operational so far.

text: Ginpahayag ni Sotto nga posible nga ang committee report angot sa mga maanomaliya nga flood control projects ipasa sa Department of Justice (DOJ), Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI), kag sa Office of the Ombudsman para sa angay nga legal nga tikang.
english: Sotto said it is possible that the committee report on the anomalous flood control projects will be forwarded to the Department of Justice (DOJ), Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI), and the Office of the Ombudsman for appropriate legal action.

text: Nahibaluan nga nakigkita si Sotto kay Senate Blue Ribbon Committee acting chair Erwin Tulfo agud istoryahan ang direksyon sang imbestigasyon.
english: Sotto met with Senate Blue Ribbon Committee acting chair Erwin Tulfo to discuss the direction of the investigation.

text: Ginsiling pa niya nga posible makumbinsi sang majority block si Senator Panfilo “Ping” Lacson nga magbalik bilang committee chair.
english: He said the majority bloc is likely to convince Senator Panfilo “Ping” Lacson to return as committee chair.

text: Spotted sa isa ka beach ang aktor nga si John Lloyd Cruz kag ang anak sini nga si Elias kaupod ang rumored girlfriend sang aktor.
english: Actor John Lloyd Cruz and his son Elias were spotted on a beach with the actor's rumored girlfriend.

text: Apisar tubtub subong wala sang pahayag halin kay John Lloyd tuhoy sa iya nga lovelife, matunog ang espekulasyon sang mga fans nga may something special nga nagapatunga sa iya kag sa artist nga si Isabel Santos, anak sang respetado nga mga contemporary Filipino artists.Si Isabel amo ang apo ni the late Mauro “Malang” Santos, isa ka award-winning cartoonist, illustrator, kag painter.Si Isabel mismo ang nag-share sang bonding moments sang actor kag sang iya anak nga si Elias sa iya nga Instagram Story.
english: Although there is still no statement from John Lloyd about his lovelife, fans are speculating that there is something special between him and artist Isabel Santos, daughter of respected contemporary Filipino artists. shared the bonding moments of the actor and his son Elias on his Instagram Story.

text: Nakit-an nga duha ang kaupod ni John Lloyd kag may duha man ka bata sa isa ka pond.
english: John Lloyd was found with two companions and two children in a pond.

text: May beach moments man nga gin-share si Isabel kun sa diin may lalaki kag bata nga ginapatihan si John Lloyd kag si Elias.
english: Isabel also shared beach moments where there was a man and a child believed to be John Lloyd and Elias.

text: Nag-umpisa ang rumor nga magkarelasyon sanday Isabel kag John Lloyd sang nakit-an man ang mga ini nga magkaupod sang 2021.
english: Isabel and John Lloyd were rumored to be in a relationship when they were also spotted together in 2021.

text: Lakip diri ang pictures sang balay ni John Lloyd sa Antipolo nga yara man sa Instagram ni Isabel.
english: This includes pictures of John Lloyd's house in Antipolo that is also on Isabel's Instagram.

text: Pareho nga wala ginakumpirma sang duha kun ano ang ila nga relationship status.
english: Both have not confirmed their relationship status.

text: Padayon ang paghulag sang bagyo Ramil pagguwa sa pungsod.
english: Typhoon Ramil continues to move out of the country.

english: According to data from the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), it is moving West NorthWestward out of the PAR.

english: Typhoon Ramil is expected to leave the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility this morning, Monday, October 20.

text: Isinailalim na sa State of Calamity ang buong Iloilo City matapos aprubahan ng Sangguniang Panlungsod ang rekomendasyon ng Iloilo City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (CDRRMC) at ni Mayor Raisa Treñas, dahil sa matinding epekto ng mga bagyong Crising, Dante, at Emong.
english: The entire Iloilo City has been placed under a State of Calamity after the City Council approved the recommendation of the Iloilo City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (CDRRMC) and Mayor Raisa Treñas, due to the severe impact of typhoons Crising, Dante, and Emong.

text: Batay sa datos mula sa City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO), may kabuuang 240,304 na populasyon ang exposed base sa 2024 Philippine Statistics Authority data.
english: According to the City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO), a total of 240,304 people are exposed based on the 2024 Philippine Statistics Authority data.

text: Sa forecast, 38,062 ang posibleng maapektuhan (katumbas ng 15%).
english: In the forecast, 38,062 are likely to be affected (equivalent to 15%).

text: Subalit, sa situation report nitong Hulyo 28, umakyat na sa 56,881 ang bilang ng mga naapektuhan , 44,723 dahil sa matinding pagbaha, at 12,158 naman dahil sa storm surge.
english: However, in the situation report on July 28, the number of people affected rose to 56,881, 44,723 due to severe flooding, and 12,158 due to storm surge.

text: Ang nasabing bilang ay pasok sa batayan ng Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act of 2010, na nagpapahintulot sa deklarasyon ng State of Calamity kapag may malaking pinsala sa kabuhayan, imprastruktura, trabaho, at mobilidad ng mga residente.
english: The figure is part of the Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act of 2010, which allows for the declaration of a State of Calamity when there is severe damage to livelihoods, infrastructure, jobs, and mobility of residents.
