text: 1 Novak Djokovic sa Indian Wells Open subong nga semana, indikasyon nga posible napaslawan ang iya application nga magsulod sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga wala sang Covid-19 vaccination.
english: 1 Novak Djokovic at the Indian Wells Open this week, an indication that his application to enter the United States of America without Covid-19 vaccination may have failed.

text: Ang Serbian star isa sa most high-profile athletes sa kalibutan nga tubtub subong wala pa nabakunahan batok sa Covid-19.
english: The Serbian star is one of the most high-profile athletes in the world who has not yet been vaccinated against Covid-19.

text: Nag-apply siya sang nagligad nga bulan para sa special permission agud maghampang sa Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP) Masters events sa Indian Wells kag Miami.
english: He applied last month for special permission to play in the Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP) Masters events in Indian Wells and Miami.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa subong, ginadumilian sang US nga makasulod sa pungsod ang indi bakunado nga mga dumuluong, isa ka policy nga ginalauman nga ma-lift naman kun matapos na ang COVID-19 emergency sa US sa Mayo 11.
english: The US is currently banning unvaccinated foreigners from entering the country, a policy that is expected to be lifted when the COVID-19 emergency in the US ends on May 11.

text: Matandaan nga ang 35-anyos nga winner sang 22 ka Grand Slam titles ang nangin kampyeon man sa Australian Open sang nagligad nga bulan, kag siya man ang heavy favorite nga makakuha sang iya ika-anum na kuntani nga Indian Wells title.
english: The 35-year-old winner of 22 Grand Slam titles also won the Australian Open last month, and is also the heavy favorite to win his sixth Indian Wells title.

text: Nalutos si former world champion Mark ‘Magnifico’ Magsayo sa kamot sang isa man ka former world champion nga si Brandon Figueroa sa World Boxing Council (WBC) interim featherweight title bout sa Toyota Arena sa Ontario, Canada.
english: Former world champion Mark ‘Magnifico’ Magsayo lost to fellow former world champion Brandon Figueroa in the World Boxing Council (WBC) interim featherweight title bout at the Toyota Arena in Ontario, Canada.

text: Matapos ang 12 ka round sang sambuwa, gindeklarar nga nagdaog ang Mexican-American boxer via unanimous decision, 117-109, 117-109 kag 118-108.
english: After 12 rounds of the fight, the Mexican-American boxer was declared the winner via unanimous decision, 117-109, 117-109 and 118-108.

text: Nabuhinan si Magsayo sang duha ka puntos sa hampang bangud sa holding sa Round 8 kag 11.
english: Magsayo dropped two points in the match due to holding in Rounds 8 and 11.

text: Gin-insister sang 27-anyos nga tumandok sang Tagbilaran City nga indi patas ang pag-officiate sang referee sa hampang bangud sa deductions nga iya nakuha.
english: The 27-year-old native of Tagbilaran City insisted that the referee's officiating of the match was unfair because of the deductions he took.

text: Nagapati ang Pinoy boxer nga solid punches ang iya ginpangbuy-an kag lunsay nabatyagan sang kasumpong kag siya ang daog kun wala sang ginpangbuhin nga puntos.
english: The Filipino boxer believes that he unleashed solid punches and both were felt by his opponent and he would have won if no points had been deducted.

text: Ini ang ikaduha nga pagkalutos ni Magsayo sa iya 26-fight boxing career.
english: This is Magsayo's second defeat in his 26-fight boxing career.

text: Plano sini subong nga magsaka sa 130 pounds matapos ang bilog-karera nga paghampang sa featherweight.
english: He now plans to move up to 130 pounds after a career-long run at featherweight.

text: Madumduman nga Hulyo sang nagligad nga tuig sang nalutos man si Magsayo sa kamot ni Rey Vargas sang Mexico nga amo ang nakaagaw sang iya World Boxing Council featherweight crown.
english: It can be recalled that in July last year, Magsayo lost to Rey Vargas of Mexico who won his World Boxing Council featherweight crown.

text: Nakit-an ni Mayor Raisa Treñas ang kakulangan sang disaster response sang mga barangay officials sa syudad, ilabi na sa aspeto sang training kag komunikasyon sa tion nga mga bagyo kag pagbaha.
english: Mayor Raisa Treñas noted the lack of disaster response of barangay officials in the city, especially in the aspect of training and communication during typhoons and floods.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Trenas, ginpahayag sini nga kinahanglan sang husto nga preparasyon ang 180 ka mga barangay agud mangin mas epektibo ang ila pagresponde sa mga emerhensya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Trenas said the 180 barangays need proper preparation to be more effective in responding to emergencies.

text: Suno sa alkalde, pila lang sa mga opisyales ang aktibo nga nagaresponde sa tunga sang kalamidad, rason nga ginplastar niya ang plano nga magpatigayon sang training sa disaster response sa barangay level kag paayuhon ang sistema sang komunikasyon sa mga kabarangayan.
english: According to the mayor, only a few officials are actively responding in the midst of disasters, which is why he laid out the plan to conduct training on disaster response at the barangay level and improve the communication system in the barangays.

text: Ginapanawagan man sang alkalde ang aktibo nga partisipasyon sang mga barangay officials halin sa barangay captain tubtob sa mga kagawad, agud masiguro nga preparado ang komunidad sa tion sang kalamidad.
english: The mayor also called for the active participation of barangay officials from the barangay captain to the kagawads, to ensure that the community is prepared in times of disaster.

text: Pagpangimon ukon selos ang ginalantaw nga rason sang Passi City Police Station sa nagluntad nga rambol Passi City.
english: Jealousy is believed to be the reason for the Passi City Police Station.

text: Ang mga involved ang lunsay mga menor-de-edad.
english: Those involved are all minors.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Colonel Benjo Clarite, Chief of Police sang Passi City Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagaguwa sa imbesigasyon nga ang menor-de-edad ang nagselos sa isa ka menor-de-edad man bangud ang upod niya nga babaye ang gin-akbayan sini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Colonel Benjo Clarite, Chief of Police of Passi City Police Station, said the investigation revealed that the minor was jealous of another minor because he hugged his female companion.

text: Suno kay Clarite, bangud sa pag-akbay-akbay sang lalaki sa iya upod, gilayon ini nga nag-react kon sa diin, gintunaan man sang ila indi pag-intindihanay.
english: According to Clarite, because of the man's hug to her companion, she immediately reacted which, also caused them to misunderstand.

text: Indi man matumod sang natungdan kon ang nag-akbay nga lalaki sa babaye ang may relasyon.
english: He could not determine if the man who hugged the woman had a relationship.

text: Bangud sa tension sa duha ka lalaki, nag-intra man ang ila tagsa ka grupo tubtob nga nagrambol ang mga ini.
english: Due to the tension between the two men, their respective groups joined in until they fought.

text: Gin-athag man ni Clarite nga lunsay magkilalahay lang man ang mag menor-de-edad.
english: Clarite also explained that the minors were both acquaintances.

text: Sa subong, identified na ang mga kabataan kag nakatalana nga mag-atubangay sa barangay.
english: The children have now been identified and are scheduled to meet in the barangay.

english: Ramil maintained its strength as it moved westward towards mainland Bicol.

text: History in the making ang pagkapili sa isa ka Puerto Rican model nga may Down syndrome nga mangin kabahin sa angels sang Victoria’s Secret, ang bantog nga American lingerie, clothing, kag beauty brand.
english: History in the making was the selection of a Puerto Rican model with Down syndrome to be part of the angels of Victoria’s Secret, the famous American lingerie, clothing, and beauty brand.

text: Siya amo si Sofia Jirau, 24, kag pinaka-una nga Victoria’s Secret model nga may Down syndrome.
english: She is Sofia Jirau, 24, and the first Victoria’s Secret model to have Down syndrome.

text: Dream come true ini para kay Sofia nga nagahandum lang sadto nga mangin Victoria’s Secret Angel sa pihak sang iya nga kondisyon.
english: This is a dream come true for Sofia who used to dream of becoming a Victoria's Secret Angel despite her condition.

text: Nahibaluan nga nangin bantog man ang Victoria’s Secret bangud sa pagpatigayon sang annual lingerie fashion show, kun sa diin nagarampa ang mga matahum nga modelo, kalakip na ang mga supermodels.
english: Victoria's Secret also became famous for hosting its annual lingerie fashion show, where beautiful models, including supermodels, parade.

text: Big news naman ang pagkapili kay Sofia bangud ang nakaandan nga “beauty standard” sa nasambit nga brand amo ang indi magnubo sa 5’8″ nga height kag suno sa research sang The Boston Globe, 23.6 inches ang average waistline sang mga Angels sang tuig 2019, kag 34.4 inches naman sa hips.
english: Sofia's selection is big news because the usual beauty standard for the brand is at least 5'8′′ in height and according to research by The Boston Globe, the average waistline of the Angels in 2019 was 23.6 inches, and 34.4 inches at the hips.

text: Suno sa mga reports, kapin five feet ang height ni Sofia kag ang body measurement naman niya yara sa 34-26-34.
english: According to reports, Sofia is more than five feet tall and her body measurement is 34-26-34.

text: Ginpahayag naman ni Sofia sa iya Instagram post nga wala gid sing imposible sa tawo nga may handum.
english: Sofia said in her Instagram post that nothing is impossible for a person with a dream.

text: Translation sa iya Spanish caption: “One day I dreamed of it, I worked for it and today it’s a dream come true.
english: Translation to his Spanish caption: “One day I dreamed of it, I worked for it and today it’s a dream come true.

text: “I can finally tell you my big secret.
english: “I can finally tell you my big secret.

text: I am Victoria’s Secret’s first model with Down syndrome!”
english: I am Victoria’s Secret’s first model with Down syndrome!”

text: Ginpisa-pisa ni Senator Raffy Tulfo ang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) bangud sa ginapahayag indi healthy nga level sang sodium sa instant noodles nga ginabaligya sa Pilipinas.
english: Senator Raffy Tulfo has slammed the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) over the alleged unhealthy level of sodium in instant noodles sold in the Philippines.

text: Apang gin-insister naman sang ahensya nga indi sini mandato ang pag-regulate sang kadamuon sang asin sa mga pagkaon.
english: However, the agency insisted that it is not its mandate to regulate the amount of salt in foods.

text: Sa budget hearing sa senado para sa proposed 2023 budget sang ahensya, bitbit ni Tulfo ang pila ka instant noodle products kag ginpakita ini sa mga opisyal sang DTI.
english: During the budget hearing in the Senate for the agency's proposed 2023 budget, Tulfo carried several instant noodle products and showed them to DTI officials.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga nagaunod ini sang mataas nga lebel sang sodium nga indi na maayo sa ikaayong lawas sang tawo.
english: It stated that it contains high levels of sodium which is no longer good for human health.

text: Apang depensa naman ni Trade Secretary Alfredo Pascual, indi ang DTI ang husto nga ahensya agud magsabat sa sini nga concern.
english: However, Trade Secretary Alfredo Pascual defended that the DTI is not the right agency to respond to this concern.

text: Gin-insister sini nga gina-handle sang DTI ang non-food items samtang ang Department of Health ukon ang Food and Drug Administration naman ang responsable sa iban nga produkto ilabi na ang food items.
english: He insisted that the DTI handles non-food items while the Department of Health or the Food and Drug Administration is responsible for other products especially food items.

text: Ginkainit naman sang senador ang sabat sang tiglikom.
english: The senator took offense to the secretary's response.

text: “Ito na naman tayo nagtuturuan po kayo.
english: “Here we are again, you are teaching.

text: Walang gustong umamin.
english: No one wants to admit it.

text: Dito naman sa article 10 ng Consumer Act nakalagay ‘on ur own initiative’ so dapat kayo mismo gumagawa ng initiative.
english: Here in article 10 of the Consumer Act it says 'on ur own initiative' so you should take the initiative yourself.

text: Hindi na kayo dapat pagsabihan dahil at stake dito ‘yung welfare ng ating mahihirap na kababayan,” pahayag ni Tulfo.
english: You should not be told because the welfare of our poor fellow citizens is at stake here,” Tulfo said.

text: Sang ulihi, nag-concede si Tulfo nga wala sang gahum ang Department of Trade and Industry nga mag test sa food products apang kuntani suno sa iya, gina refer man ini sa relevant nga ahensya sang gobyerno.
english: Later, Tulfo conceded that the Department of Trade and Industry does not have the power to test food products but he said it should have been referred to the relevant government agency.

text: Nagpasalig naman si Pascual nga ipalab-ot ini nga concern sa Food and Drug Administration.
english: Pascual promised to convey this concern to the Food and Drug Administration.

text: Nag-convene ang Kongreso sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika agud isipon ang boto sang Electoral College kag pormal nga kilalahon ang pagdaog ni President-elect Donald Trump sa 2024 presidential election.
english: The United States Congress has convened to count the Electoral College votes and formally recognize President-elect Donald Trump's victory in the 2024 presidential election.

text: Mismo si Vice President Kamala Harris, nga napyerde kay Trump sang Nobyembre 2024 ang nag-preside sa joint session sang Kongreso sa diin nagaserbe ini nga president sang Senado kag mismo nag-anunsyo sang resulta sang mga piniliay.
english: Vice President Kamala Harris, who lost to Trump in November 2024, presided over the joint session of Congress where she serves as president of the Senate and personally announced the election results.

text: Nagdaog si Trump pinaagi sa 312 ka electoral votes, samtang si Harris naman ang may yara lang sang 226.
english: Trump won with 312 electoral votes, while Harris had only 226.

text: Wala naman sang objections sa chamber sang gin-anunsyo ang resulta sang piniliay sa kada estado.
english: There were no objections in the chamber when the results of the elections in each state were announced.

text: Ang pag-anunsyo sa kadalag-an ni Trump ang kadungan man sang nagakatabo nga winter storm sa Amerika lakip na ang Washington, D.C., sa diin sirado ang mga federal kag local government offices.
english: The announcement of Trump's victory also coincides with the ongoing winter storm in the United States including Washington, D.C., where federal and local government offices are closed.

text: Matandaan nga apat ka tuig na ang nagligad sang natabo nga pag-atake sa US Capitol matapos nag-riot ang mga supporters ni Trump sang nalutos ini sa eleksyon sang 2020.
english: It can be recalled that four years have passed since the attack on the US Capitol after Trump's supporters rioted when he lost the 2020 election.

text: Masobra naman sa 1,500 ka mga indibidwal ang ginsentensyahan bangud sa ila kaangtanan sa pag-atake sang January 6, 2021, sa diin ginpromisa ni Trump nga hatagan ang mga ini sang pardon sa tion nga makapungko na ini sa iya ikaduha nga termino.
english: More than 1,500 individuals have been sentenced for their involvement in the January 6, 2021 attack, for which Trump has promised to grant pardons once he is in his second term.

text: Pilason ang 16 ka pasahero matapos nahulog sa kanal ang ginasakyan nila nga jeep sa highway sa Brgy.
english: Sixteen passengers were injured after their jeep fell into a canal on the highway in Brgy.

text: Ibabao, Cuenca, Batangas.
english: Ibabao, Cuenca, Batangas.

text: Padulong sa Lemery, Batangas ang jeep sang nag-lock ang steering wheel sini kag didto na nadulaan sang kontrol sa manibela ang driver.
english: The jeep was heading to Lemery, Batangas when the steering wheel locked and the driver lost control of the steering wheel.

text: Nahulog sa kanal ang jeep nga nagresulta sa pag-angkon sang mga pilas sang mga pasahero.
english: The jeep fell into a ditch resulting in injuries to the passengers.

text: Madasig naman nga gindala sa ospital ang mga biktima.
english: The victims were rushed to the hospital.

text: Ginpaidalom naman sa kustodiya sang pulis ang driver sang jeep.
english: The driver of the jeep was taken into police custody.

text: INDI lang ‘Justice delayed, justice denied” ang nagakatabo diri sa aton pungsod sa madamo nga kaso.
english: It is NOT just ‘Justice delayed, justice denied” that is happening here in our country in many cases.

text: Kon indi tungod kulang ang aton mga hwes kag prosecutors, ang padayon nga corruption sa gobyerno ang daku pa gid naton nga problema.
english: If it weren't for our lack of judges and prosecutors, the continued corruption in government would be our biggest problem.

text: Katulad na lang sang makailinit nga delay sang lakat sang kaso nga ma-experyensyahan batok sa isa ka abusador kag impluwensyado nga akusado nga, gamit ang corrupt nga prosecutor, mapa-delay sini sing madugay ang magasto nga lakat sang iya kaso.
english: It is similar to the annoying delay in the progress of a case experienced against an abusive and influential defendant who, using a corrupt prosecutor, can delay the costly progress of his case for a long time.

text: Kag, tungod sini, ipaatras na gid lang sang pamilya ang ila akusasyon kag magpa-areglo na lang nga indi matagaan sing matuod-tuod nga hustisya ang nabiktima.
english: And, because of this, the family will withdraw their accusation and settle so that the victim will not be given true justice.

text: May nahibal-an man ako nga kaso kon diin na-detain ang isa ka akusado sa prisuhan sing duha (2) ka tuig tungod indi makabayad sang bailbond.
english: I also know of a case where a defendant was detained in jail for two (2) years for failing to pay bailbond.

text: Sang maaksyunan na sang korte ang iya kaso, ang sentensya niya tubtub man lang gali sa isa (1) ka tuig.
english: When the court finally heard his case, his sentence was only one (1) year.

text: Gani nakagwa siya dayon tungod sobra pa ang naprisuhan niya sangsa iya sentensya.
english: So he was released immediately because he had served more time in prison than he had sentenced.

text: In other words, may utang pa ang gobyerno sa iya sang isa (1) ka tuig nga perhwisyo sa iya pamilya nga syempre indi na niya masukot sa gobyerno.
english: In other words, the government still owes him one (1) year of damage to his family which of course he cannot pay back to the government.

text:
***

Kasubong man sini ang nagakatabo sa madamo nga proyekto sang gobyerno nga wala natapos sa natalana nga panahon, nga mabasol mismo sa gobyerno tungod sa pagpabaya sa pag-monitor, ukon sa delay sang pag-release sang pondo.
english:
***

The same is true of many government projects that are not completed on schedule, which can be blamed on the government itself for neglecting monitoring, or the delay in releasing funds.

text: Nagakatabo man gani ini sa mga government housing loan nga ang delay sang fund release naga-resulta man sa delayed project completion kag dugang pa nga gasto sa naga-loan.
english: This is also the case with government housing loans where the delay in fund release also results in delayed project completion and additional costs to the borrower.

text: Daku ini nga problema kon ang proyekto kinahanglanon gid, katulad sang pagpatukod sang eskwelahan kag ospital para sa mga kubos naton nga mga pumuluyo.
english: This is a big problem when the project is urgently needed, such as building a school and a hospital for our poor residents.

text: Ejemplo lang ang pagpatukod sang lima (5) ka state-owned hospital nga sunu sa Commission on Audit (COA) sadtong 2021 nagabalor sang P763.126 Million.
english: An example is the construction of five (5) state-owned hospitals which according to the Commission on Audit (COA) in 2021 worth P763.126 Million.

text: Natapos lang ini pagkaligad sang 24 tubtub 31 ka bulan.
english: It was completed after 24 to 31 months.

text: Susmariosep!
english: Susmariose!

text: Sa mga pasyente nga ang madalaganan nila amo gid lang ang ospital sang gobyerno, basi napatay na ang iban sa sige lang hulat sa sining ospital.
english: For the patients whose only option is the government hospital, some may have died while waiting in this hospital.

text: Labi pa kon ang madalaganan gid lang nila anay amo ang hampol-hampol kag may minama nga laway ni Mang Kepweng agud bulngon ang tunok sang tuktukon nga lansang, asthmatic attack ni baby, pagkagat sang buang nga idu, kag iban pa.
english: Especially if the only thing they can run to is Mang Kepweng's saliva to cure the thorn of a nail, a baby's asthmatic attack, a mad bear's bite, and so on.

text: Diri matuod masiling naton ang “Projects delayed, projects (man) denied”.
english: Here we can truly say “Projects delayed, projects (man) denied”.

text: In fact, sa report sang COA sadtong 2021, 17 ka infra projects gid ang na-delay ukon wala gid nakumpleto.
english: In fact, according to the COA report in 2021, 17 infra projects were delayed or not completed.

text: Estimated project costs sini naglab-ut sa P1.44 Trillion.
english: Estimated project costs of this reached P1.44 Trillion.

text: Nag-resulta ini, sunu sa COA, sa “waste of government funds” kag delay sang benepisyo sa mga pumuluyo nga tani nahatag sa ila kon natapos ining mga proyekto sa natalana nga panahon.
english: This resulted, according to the COA, in “waste of government funds” and delay of benefits to the people that would have been given to them if these projects were completed on time.

text: “May misuse kag abuse dira sang public funds sang mga erring public officials kag sang ila kahimbon sa private sector – lakip na ang contractors kag suppliers,” siling pa sadto ni Senador Panfilo Lacson angot sa ining report sang COA.
english: “There is misuse and abuse of public funds by erring public officials and their allies in the private sector – including contractors and suppliers,” Senator Panfilo Lacson said regarding the COA report.

text: Gin-akusaran man ni anay Senador Franklin Drilon ang gobyerno sang “criminal neglect” angot man sa sining COA-reported delayed kag abandoned infra projects.
english: Former Senator Franklin Drilon also accused the government of “criminal neglect” regarding these COA-reported delayed and abandoned infra projects.

text: Kon matuod, ngaa daw wala man kita sing nahibal-an nga nakalaboso nga mga “erring public officials”, contractors kag suppliers?
english: If so, why do we seem to know of no erring public officials, contractors and suppliers?

text: Well, sin-o man abe ang matindug sa pag-akusar ukon magtestigo man lang batok sa ila kay basi kahimbon man sila sa corruption?
english: Well, who will stand up to accuse or testify against them because they might be involved in corruption?

text:
***

By the way, nagapabilin nga sarado ang Ungka Flyover sa tunga sang siyudad sang Iloilo kag Pavia sugod sadtong Setyembre 2022 pagkatapos buksan ini sang Hunyo 2022 tungod sang pag-usmod sini.
english:
***

By the way, the Ungka Flyover between Iloilo City and Pavia remains closed since September 2022 after being opened in June 2022 due to its collapse.

text: Napat-ud na sang Third Party Consultant (TPC) ang problema, ti ngaa wala pa masugdan ang trabaho dira agud ma-korekan na ini?
english: The Third Party Consultant (TPC) has already identified the problem, so why hasn't the work started there to correct it?

text: .Agud ma-repair ining flyover kinahanglan ang mga P250M nga funding, sunu kay Engr.
english: To repair this flyover, about P250M in funding is needed, according to Engr.

text: Abinales sang TPC.
english: Abinales of TPC.

text: No problem, no doubt.
english: No problem, no doubt.

text: Madamo man bala kita kwarta sa sige pagpangutang naton, nga naglab-ut na karon sa mga PhP15 Trillion?
english: Do we have a lot of money from our constant borrowing, which has now reached about PhP15 Trillion?

text: Importante ini nga proyekto sa mga pumuluyo kag dapat ma-prayodad gid.
english: This project is important to the people and should be given high priority.

text: Nga daan lapit na sa isa ka tuig ang padayon nga pag-antos sang mga pumuluyo sa pagbaha-baha dira sa idalom kon mag-ulan kag padayon man ang pagginutok sang trapiko dira.
english: For almost a year, the residents have been suffering from flooding down there when it rains and traffic congestion there.

text: Perhwisyo gid sa mga importante nga kaladtuan kag negosyo!
english: What a damage to important destinations and businesses!

text: Atubanga lang ninyo ang mga akusasyon dira sang mga nagareklamo kay kinamatarong nila ina, pero sigeha lang bala ang pagpa-repair sining Ungka Flyover kay pasalamatan gid namon ina.
english: Just face the accusations of those who are complaining because it is their right, but please continue to repair this Ungka Flyover because we will appreciate it.

text: Madamo man gani ang nagahulat nga matagaan trabaho kon mapatigayon na ining repair works.
english: Many are even waiting to be given jobs when the repair works are completed.

text: Indi bala?/PN
english: Isn't it?/PN

text: Ang pagka-trap sa salakyan ang isa sa mga hitabo nga wala sang bisan isa sa aton ang gusto ma-eskperyensyahan.
english: Being trapped in a car is one of those events that none of us want to experience.

text: Delikado ini ilabi na sa mga bata gani nga extra halong gid kita kag bantayan sila sang maayo.
english: This is especially dangerous for children so be extra careful and watch them closely.

text: Apang didto sa Newton County sa Indiana, USA, isa ka milagro ang natabo sa isa ka 41-anyos nga babaye sang tion nga siya ang na-trap sa sulod sang iya kaugalingon nga salakyan.
english: But there in Newton County in Indiana, USA, a miracle happened to a 41-year-old woman at the time she was trapped inside her own car.

text: Suno sa Newton County Sheriff’s Office, ini nga babaye nga ginkilala kay Brieonna Cassell, 41, ang naga-drive halin sa Newton County Landfill sang Marso 6 antes siya gin-report nga missing sa mga otoridad.
english: According to the Newton County Sheriff’s Office, this woman, identified as Brieonna Cassell, 41, was driving from the Newton County Landfill on March 6 before she was reported missing to authorities.

text: Nagguwa gali nga natulugan si Cassell samtang naga-maneho kag nagbunggo ang iya car kag nahulog sa pil-as nga indi kit-anon sa mga tawo nga yara sa highway.
english: It turned out that Cassell fell asleep while driving and his car crashed and fell into a ravine out of sight of people on the highway.

text: Puerte nga kasakit ang nabatyagan ni Cassell sa iya lawas, nagsinggit siya agud mangayo sang bulig sa mga salakyan nga mabatian niya nga nagaagi apang indi man niya makita.
english: Cassell felt so much pain in his body, he screamed for help from cars he could hear passing but couldn't see.

text: Naglawig sang anum ka adlaw nga amo sini ang sitwasyon ni Cassel sa sulod sang salakyan bangud indi siya makaguwa kag halos madulaan na sang paglaum.
english: Cassel spent six days in this position inside the car because he could not get out and almost lost hope.

text: Apang sang tion nga nakit-an na gid man siya, conscious ini kag nagahambal pa.
english: But when he was finally found, he was conscious and still talking.

text: Pahayag sang pamilya, nakaluwas si Cassell paagi sa iya jacket nga iya ginatusmaw sa tubig nga yara sa creek kun sa diin nahulog ang iya salakyan.
english: According to the family, Cassell survived with his jacket that he dipped in the water in the creek where his car fell.

text: Kun matusmaw na niya ini kag ma-absorb na sini ang tubig, gina-amat-amat niya ini butong kag gina-supsop ang tubig para mabuhinan ang iya kauhaw.
english: When he has dipped it and absorbed the water, he slowly bites it and sucks the water to quench his thirst.

text: Sang nakit-an siya kag gindala sa ospital, nakit-an ang injuries sa iya nga paa, sa iya nga tyan, sa iya nga butkon kag iban nga parte sang lawas.
english: When he was found and taken to the hospital, injuries were found on his leg, his stomach, his arm and other parts of his body.

text: Gin-airlift man ini agud nga madala sa Chigaco hospital para sa treatment.
english: He was also airlifted to Chigaco hospital for treatment.

text: Ginapahayag nga stable na subong ang kondisyon sini.
english: His condition is reportedly stable.

text: “She would take her hoodie … and suck on it to have water,” suno sa iya iloy nga si Kim Brown.
english: “She would take her hoodie … and suck on it to have water,” said her mother Kim Brown.

text: “She persevered.
english: “She persevered.

text:
She wanted to stay alive.”

Excited na ang iya pamilya nga maka-pauli ini, ilabi na bangud may tatlo ini ka kabataan nga nagahulat sa iya, nga amo man posible ang nangin inspirasyon sini nga magtinguha nga mabuhi samtang yara sa mabudlay nga sitwasyon.#

with reports from NBC News
english:
She wanted to stay alive.”

His family is excited to have him home, especially since he has three children waiting for him, which is also likely what inspired him to try to survive while in a difficult situation.#

with reports from NBC News

text: Ginpagguwa na sang Gilas Pilipinas ang line-up nga magahampang sa Southeast Asian Games.
english: Gilas Pilipinas has released its line-up for the Southeast Asian Games.

text: Pangunahan ni Norman Black nga mangin coach sang men’s national basketball team.
english: Led by Norman Black who will coach the men’s national basketball team.

text: Siya ang nangin coach sang makuha sang men’s national basketball team ang gold medal sa SEA Games sang 2011.
english: He was the coach when the men’s national basketball team won the gold medal at the SEA Games in 2011.

text: Suno sa Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas (SBP) nga ang line-up ang ginalakipan sang professionals kag college players nga nagpaidalom sa apat nga revision bangud sa eligibility requirerments sang organizers sang SEA Games.
english: According to the Philippine Basketball Association (SBP), the line-up includes professionals and college players who underwent four revisions due to the eligibility requirements of the organizers of the SEA Games.

text: Ang lineups ang ginalakipan nanday: Jamie Malonzo, Dalph Panopio, Thirdy Ravena, Matthew Wright, Ray Parks, Ced Manzano, Justin Chua , Robert Bolick, Von Pessumal, Allen Liwag, Abu Tratter kag Veejay Pre.
english: The lineups include: Jamie Malonzo, Dalph Panopio, Thirdy Ravena, Matthew Wright, Ray Parks, Ced Manzano, Justin Chua , Robert Bolick, Von Pessumal, Allen Liwag, Abu Tratter and Veejay Pre.

text: Magaumpisa ang SEA Games halin Disyembre 9 tubtob 20 sa Bangkok, Thailand.
english: The SEA Games will run from December 9 to 20 in Bangkok, Thailand.

text: Indi luyag ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. does not want to

text: nga maglab-ot sa P60 ang baylo sang isa ka US dollar.
english: to reach P60 in exchange for one US dollar.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni Palace Press Officer Claire Castro sang ginpamangkot kun ano ang mahimo magtulod sa Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas nga magpatunga na samtang nagaluya ang balor sang piso kontra sa dolyar.
english: Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said this when asked what could prompt the Central Bank of the Philippines to intervene as the peso weakens against the dollar.

text: Enero 21 sang nagkitaay sanday Marcos kag BSP Governor Eli Remolona Jr.
english: On January 21, Marcos and BSP Governor Eli Remolona Jr. met.

text: sa Malacañang agud nga diskusyunan ang policy action sang bangko central agud nga mabuhinan ang interest rates.
english: in Malacañang to discuss the policy action of the central bank to reduce interest rates.

text: Suno kay Castro, pananglitan maglapaw sa P60 threshold ang kampyo sang piso kontra dolyar, mahimo ini magresulta sa pagtimbuok sang utang sang Pilipinas.
english: According to Castro, if the peso against the dollar exceeds the P60 threshold, it could result in the Philippines' debt accumulation.

text: “Kapag tumaas po kasi ng 60 pesos, bumaba iyong value ng peso definitely mag-i-increase iyong debt natin because iyong palitan po ay tataas po iyon,” suno sa iya.
english: “When the value of the peso goes up by 60 pesos, the value of the peso will definitely increase because the exchange rate will go up,” he said.

text: Ginsulit man sini nga indi lang Pilipinas ang naga-eksperyensya sang pagluya sang balor sang currency kundi mangin ang iban nga mga pungsod sa Asya bangud sa nanuhay-tuhay nga global factors.
english: He also reiterated that not only the Philippines is experiencing currency depreciation but also other Asian countries due to various global factors.

text: “Sa usapin ng pamilihang pinansiyal, ang paghina ng piso ay dulot ng kakulangan sa balanse ng kalakalan at pananalapi.
english: “In terms of financial elections, the weakening of the peso is due to a lack of balance of trade and finance.

text: Hindi lamang ito nararanasan ng Pilipinas sapagkat maging ang ibang bansa sa Asia ay may katulad na kalagayan – nakakaranas din ng paghina ng kanilang mga pera noong 2025,” suno sa iya.
english: Not only is the Philippines experiencing this but other Asian countries are also experiencing a similar situation – they are also experiencing a weakening of their currencies by 2025,” he said.

text: “Ipinakikita rin nito ang pangkalahatang pag-igting ng US dollar at ang inaasahang pagkaantala sa pagbaba ng interest rates ng US Federal Reserve.
english: “It also reflects the general tightening of the US dollar and the expected delay in lowering interest rates by the US Federal Reserve.

text: So, mas nakatuon po ang BSP sa pagpigil sa labis na paggalaw ng halaga ng piso kaysa sa pagtatakda ng tiyak na antas ng palitan,” dugang sini.
english: So, the BSP is more focused on preventing excessive movements in the value of the peso rather than setting a fixed exchange rate,” he added.

text: Sa pihak sini suno sa Palace official, kontrolado ang headline inflation sang Pilipinas kag ginalauman nga sulod gihapon sa target range sang gobyerno sa 2026 kag 2027.
english: Meanwhile, the Palace official said the Philippines' headline inflation is under control and is expected to remain within the government's target range in 2026 and 2027.

text: Matandaan nga sa pagtakop sang trading sang Enero 15, nagdangat sa P59.46 ang baylo sang isa ka US dollar nga lapaw pa sa nauna nga historic low nga P59.44 nga na-rekord sang Enero 14.#
english: It can be recalled that at the close of trading on January 15, the exchange rate of one US dollar reached P59.46, above the previous historical low of P59.44 recorded on January 14.#

text: Nagpangabay sang klaro nga koordinasyon ang Iloilo City Local Government Unit (LGU) sa Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) matapos ginbuyagyag nga may proyekto ang ginpatuman nga wala sang konsultasyon sa lokal nga pamunuan.
english: The Iloilo City Local Government Unit (LGU) has requested clear coordination with the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) after it was revealed that a project was implemented without consultation with the local government.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, tagpamaba ni Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas, ginpahayag nga nagpakigsapul si Engr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, spokesperson of Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas, said Engr.

text: Joel Limpengco, Officer-in-Charge sang DPWH Region VI kay Mayor Treñas para istoryahan ang mga isyu nga ginbanggit sang anay alkalde nga si Jerry Treñas sa iya social media post.
english: Joel Limpengco, Officer-in-Charge of DPWH Region VI to Mayor Treñas to discuss the issues mentioned by former mayor Jerry Treñas in his social media post.

text: Lakip sa ginpunto amo ang kakulangan sang koordinasyon sa mga proyekto sang Iloilo City District Engineering Office, nga halos tanan wala sang klaro nga kasugtanan sa LGU antes pa man magsugod.
english: Among the points made was the lack of coordination in the projects of the Iloilo City District Engineering Office, almost all of which do not have a clear agreement with the LGU before they start.

text: Ginklaro sa sinapol nga dapat may koordinasyon gid ang DPWH sa lokal nga gobyerno antes magpatuman sang ano man nga proyekto, lakip na ang mga barangay kag stakeholders nga posible maapektuhan.
english: The meeting clarified that the DPWH must have coordination with the local government before implementing any project, including the barangays and stakeholders that may be affected.

text: Ginmention man ni Gorzal nga ang bike lane/revetment wall project sa Jaro, nga ginpatuman ni Congresswoman Jamjam Baronda, ginausisa na subong kun may environmental compliance kag epekto sini sa pagbaha, kag nagpadala na sila sang sulat sa DENR para sini.
english: Gorzal also mentioned that the bike lane/revetment wall project in Jaro, implemented by Congresswoman Jamjam Baronda, is now being examined for environmental compliance and its impact on flooding, and they have already sent a letter to the DENR for this.

text: Posible nga mabasura ang ethics complaint batok kay Sen.
english: The ethics complaint against Sen.

text: Bato Dela Rosa bangud sa padayon sini nga pag-absent sa senado apisar nga may ara ini sang obligasyon bilang senador sang pungsod.
english: Bato Dela Rosa for his continued absence from the Senate despite his obligations as a senator of the country.

text: Ginpahayag ni Ethics Committee Chairman Senator JV Ejercito nga kinahanglan anay nga amyendahan ang Senate rules angut sa hingyo sa ethics complaint nga indi pagpaswelduhon si Dela Rosa.
english: Ethics Committee Chairman Senator JV Ejercito said it is necessary to amend the Senate rules regarding the request in the ethics complaint not to pay Dela Rosa.

text:
Suno kay Ejercito nga wala sang provision sa rules sang Senate Committee on Ethics and Privileges nahanungod sa polisa nga “no work, no pay.”

Nahibaluan nga naglab-ot na sa apat ka bulan ang pag-absent ni Dela Rosa sa Senate plenary sessions kag committee hearings kasunod sang pag-tag sini sa iya bilang co-perpetrators nga gina-alegar kaangtanan sini sa kaso nga ginapangatubang ni Duterte sa International Criminal Court (ICC).
english:
Ejercito said there is no provision in the rules of the Senate Committee on Ethics and Privileges regarding the “no work, no pay” policy.

Dela Rosa has been absent from Senate plenary sessions and committee hearings for four months following his tagging as co-perpetrators allegedly linked to Duterte's case at the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Dugang pa ni Ejercito nga wala ginadepensahan sang senado ang kaangay nila nga upod nga senador sa ginapangatubang sini nga reklamo.
english: Ejercito added that the senate is not defending his fellow senator in the complaint he is facing.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga sila man mismo nga kaangay nga senador ang nagadali man nga mapasar ang adoption of rules agud tanan sila ang makadesisyon.
english: He said that they themselves as senators are also in a hurry to pass the adoption of rules so that they can all decide.

text: Ginkakas ni Shuvee Etrata ang iya nga opisyal X Twitter account pila ka adlaw matapos siya nga ginkondenar bangud sa isa ka video kun sa diin ginapakita niya ang simpatiya para kay anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Shuvee Etrata deleted his official X Twitter account a few days after he was condemned for a video in which he showed sympathy for former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Umpisa sang Setyembre 28, indi na ma-acess sang mga netizen ang iya nga X page.
english: As of September 28, netizens can no longer access his X page.

text: Apisar sang natabo, aktibo sagihapon ang actress sa Instagram, kun sa diin nagpakigbahin siya sang mga highlights sang iya mga ginhimo sang Sabado, Setyembre 27 nga may caption nga “Padayon lang ta” (Let’s just keep going).
english: Despite the incident, the actress is still active on Instagram, where she shared highlights of her activities on Saturday, September 27 with the caption “Let’s just keep going”.

text: Nag-umpisa ang kontrobesya sang naglapta ang isa ka screen-recorded video sang aktres nga nagapakita sang iya simpatiya sa pagkaaresto ni Duterte sang International Criminal Court (ICC) sang Marso.
english: The controversy began when a screen-recorded video of the actress went viral expressing her sympathy for Duterte's arrest by the International Criminal Court (ICC) in March.

text: Matapos ang backlash, nagpangayo si Shuvee sang patawad kag nagsiling nga indi niya gusto nga mangin bukas sa mga amo nga mga estorya bangud sa nangin “divisive” ini.
english: After the backlash, Shuvee apologized and said he did not want to be open to such stories because they became “divisive”.

text: Samtang, gindepensahan naman siya sang iya ka tiyo kag handler nga si Yure, pati man si Annette Gozon-Valdes, kun sa diin ginpahayag sini nga indi naman siya isa ka “diehard” sang bisan sin-o nga pulitiko.
english: Meanwhile, his uncle and handler Yure, as well as Annette Gozon-Valdes, defended him, saying he is not a diehard of any politician.

text: Ginakaalarma sang Department of Health (DOH) ang nagapanglakaak nga numero sang kaso sang tuberculosis infection sa Pilipinas nga nagdangat sa 612,534 sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: The Department of Health (DOH) is alarmed by the increasing number of cases of tuberculosis infection in the Philippines which reached 612,534 last year.

text: Suno kay Health Secretary Ted Herbosa, sang 2023, naka-rekord ang Pilipinas sang 549 tuberculosis cases sa kada 100,000 nga populasyon ngas mataas ipaanggid sa case notification rate nga 439 cases per 100,000 population sang 2022.
english: According to Health Secretary Ted Herbosa, in 2023, the Philippines will record 549 tuberculosis cases per 100,000 population which is high compared to the case notification rate of 439 cases per 100,000 population in 2022.

text: Gin-report man sini nga 10,426 ka mga tawo nga may tuberculosis ang napatay base sa data sang Integrated Tuberculosis Information System.
english: It also reported that 10,426 people with tuberculosis died based on Integrated Tuberculosis Information System data.

text: Apang gin-athag sini nga indi tanan ang napatay direkta bangud sa amo nga infectious disease.
english: However, he explained that not all of the deaths were directly caused by the infectious disease.

text: Dugang pa sang tiglikom, indi lamang problema sa ikaayong lawas ang tuberculosis apang nahimo na nga socioeconomic problem bangud naapektuhan sini ang pigado nga mga tawo.
english: The secretary added that tuberculosis is not only a health problem but has become a socioeconomic problem because it affects poor people.

text: Lakip sa tuyo sang DOH amo nga tapuson ang tuberculosis sa Pilipinas pag-abot sa 2030, apang bangud endemic na ini nga balatian sa Pilipinas, mas tutukan na lang suno sa iya ang pag-angkon sang 100% sang mga may tuberculosis nga ma-diagnose.
english: Among the goals of the DOH is to eradicate tuberculosis in the Philippines by 2030, but since the disease is endemic in the Philippines, he said the focus will be on getting 100% of those with tuberculosis diagnosed.

text: Ang ikaduha nga tuyo amo nga mapabulong ang 99% sang mga na-diagnose nga may amo nga balatian.
english: The secondary goal is to treat 99% of those diagnosed with the disease.

text: Kinahanglan man ang prevention sang balatian kag mahimo ini paagi sa bakuna nga maga-guwa sa 2028, ukon mahimo man paagi sa treatment sa family members nga na-expose sa household.
english: Prevention of the disease is also needed and can be done through a vaccine that will be released in 2028, or it can be done through treatment of family members who have been exposed in the household.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Herbosa nga ginalantaw sini nga kakason ang pangalan sang Pilipinas sa Top 10 list sang mga pungsod nga may pinakamataas nga numero sang kaso sang tuberculosis sa pagtakop sang iya termino sa DOH.
english: Earlier, Herbosa said he expects to remove the Philippines' name from the Top 10 list of countries with the highest number of tuberculosis cases at the end of his term at the DOH.

text: Ang tuberculosis, suno sa World Health Organization (WHO), amo ang makalalaton nga balatian nga masami nagaapekto sa baga kag nagalapta paagi sa hangin ukon kun mag-ubo, magpangatsi, ukon magdupla ang infected nga tawo.
english: Tuberculosis, according to the World Health Organization (WHO), is an infectious disease that often affects the lungs and is spread through the air or when an infected person coughs, sneezes, or spits.

text: Lakip sa mga sintomas sini amo ang madugay nga pag-ubo, pagpalanakit sa dughan, kakapoy, hilanat, kag pagbuhin sang bug-at.#
english: Symptoms include prolonged cough, chest pain, fatigue, fever, and weight loss.#

text: 23,000 gid ka mga Pinoy ang madulaan sang trabaho kun dumilian na sa pungsod ang Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators.
english: 23,000 Filipinos will lose their jobs if Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators are banned in the country.

text: Suno ini sa Association of Service Providers and POGOs.
english: This is according to the Association of Service Providers and POGOs.

text: Suno sa spokesperson sang grupo nga si Atty. Mike Danganan, mas madamo ang Pinoy nga empleyado sang Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators ipaanggid sa foreigners.
english: According to the group's spokesperson, Atty. Mike Danganan, there are more Filipino employees of Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators compared to foreigners.

text: Indi lamang palangabuhian ang madula suno kay Danganan kundi ang suporta sa ila tagsa ka mga pamilya.
english: Danganan said not only will their livelihood be lost but also the support of their families.

text: Suno pa sa grupo, handa sila nga magkooperar sa otoridad agud nga mauntat ang iligal nga kag criminal activities nga nakapalibot sa amo nga mga operasyon.
english: The group said they are ready to cooperate with the authorities to stop illegal and criminal activities surrounding these operations.

text: Sa bahin naman sang Department of Justice, nagpasalig man ini nga maga-coordinate sila sa Association of Service Providers and POGOs.
english: On the part of the Department of Justice, he also assured that they will coordinate with the Association of Service Providers and POGOs.

text: Ginaplano nga ihaya sa Iloilo City National High School ang abo ang sang mag-asawa nga manunudlo nga napatay sa sunog sa Brgy.
english: The ashes of a teacher couple who died in a fire in Brgy.

text: Infante, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: Infante, Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Ang mga biktima amo ang mag-asawa nga sanday Julius Reyes kag Louelyn Reyes nga pareho nga manunudlo sa Iloilo City, kag ang ila anak nga si Amber Marie, pito ka tuig.
english: The victims were identified as Julius Reyes and Louelyn Reyes, both teachers in Iloilo City, and their daughter, Amber Marie, seven years old.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alpha Java, Principal sa Iloilo City National High School, iya ginpahayag nga samtang yara ang abo sang mag-asawa sa buluthuan, magapatigayon sila sang vigil kag tribute.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Alpha Java, Principal of Iloilo City National High School, said that while the couple's ashes are at the school, they will hold a vigil and tribute.

text: Suno kay Java, ini agud nga tanan nga mga manunudlo ang makadu-aw lang man sa mag-asawa bisan sa ulihi nga tinion.
english: According to Java, this is so that all teachers can visit the couple even at a later time.

text: Nagpalab-ot man sang pinansyal nga bulig ang faculty sang Iloilo City National High School sa pamilya sang mga manunudlo.
english: The faculty of Iloilo City National High School also extended financial assistance to the families of the teachers.

text: Una na nga nagpabutyag ang eskwelahan nga dako nga kadulaan sa ila buluthuan ang pagtaliwan sang mag-asawa nga manunudlo.
english: Earlier, the school expressed that the death of the couple of teachers is a great loss to their school.

text: Nahibaluan nga may patigayunon pa kontani nga ‘Pinta Tawo’ ang mag-asawa nga manunudlo, ini ang bag-o nga aktibidad sa Special Program in the Arts (SPA) sa amo man nga buluthuan.
english: It was learned that the teacher couple was going to hold a 'Pinta Tawo', a new activity in the Special Program in the Arts (SPA) at the same school.

text: Ang mga manunudlo ang naka-focus sa pagtudlo sa Program in the Arts Major in Visual Arts.
english: Faculty are focused on teaching the Program in the Arts Major in Visual Arts.

text: Palaban-mode liwat ang kontrobersyal nga sexy actress nga si AJ Raval matapos liwat nga ginpunsukan sang bashers bangud sang iya kaangtanan sa hunk actor nga si Aljur Abrenica.
english: Controversial sexy actress AJ Raval is back in fashion after she was once again slammed by bashers for her relationship with hunk actor Aljur Abrenica.

text: Kasunod ini sang pag-viral sang picture sang duha samtang magkaupod sa isa ka hotel sa Leyte sang Valentine’s Day.
english: This follows the viral picture of the two while together at a hotel in Leyte on Valentine's Day.

text: Una na nga ginrason ni Aljur nga para sa trabaho ang ila pagpadulong didto, nag-ilis lang sila, nagkaon, kag nag-freshen up sa hotel.
english: Earlier, Aljur reasoned that they were going there for work, they just changed, ate, and freshened up at the hotel.

text: Ginhangkat naman ni AJ ang iya bashers nga ibato na sa iya ang pinakamasakit nga mga tinaga kun amo sini ang makapahalipay sa ila.
english: AJ challenged his bashers to throw the most painful words at him if that makes them happy.

text: “Maraming taong mas pinipiling maging bobo kesa piliin na maunawaan at maintindihan ang sitwasyon ng iba.
english: “Many people choose to be stupid rather than choose to understand and understand the situation of others.

text: Welcome sa lahat ng bashers comment lang kayo… feel free to bash don’t be shy ilabas nyo yang galit nyo na makakatulong sa buhay nyo at sa ika uunlad ng pilipinas,” suno kay AJ.
english: Welcome to all bashers just comment... feel free to bash don't be shy express your anger that will help your life and the development of the Philippines,” said AJ.

text: Obedient man ang pila ka detractors, kag gin-bash pa gid si AJ.
english: Some detractors were also obedient, and even bashed AJ.

text: Pila sa komento ang sarkastiko man nga ginsabat sang young aktres.
english: Some of the comments were sarcastically responded by the young actress.

text: Kontrobersyal si AJ kag si Aljur bangud si AJ ang ginatudlo rason sa likod sang pagbulagay nanday Aljur kag estranged wife sini — ang aktres nga si Kylie Padilla.
english: AJ and Aljur are controversial because AJ is allegedly the reason behind the breakup of Aljur and his estranged wife — actress Kylie Padilla.

text: May netizen man nga nag-post sa comment section sang picture ni Kylie, kag may words nga ‘THE LEGAL’ bangud kasal gihapon si Kylie kag si Aljur.
english: A netizen also posted a picture of Kylie in the comment section, with the words 'THE LEGAL' because Kylie and Aljur are still married.

text: Sabat ni AJ?
english: AJ’s response?

text: Tatlo ka hearts nga emoji.
english: Three hearts emoji.

text: Ginkalipay ni City Councilor Johnny Young, Chairman sang Committee on Engineering, Construction and Public Works, ang direktiba ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: City Councilor Johnny Young, Chairman of the Committee on Engineering, Construction and Public Works, welcomed the directive of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: nga ipa-audit ang mga flood control projects sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: to audit flood control projects nationwide.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, ginpahayag ni Young nga antes pa man gin-anunsyo sang presidente, nakapatawag na siya sang meeting kaupod ang mga ahensya sa syudad kag nagpa-review na sang mga proyekto, ilabi na bangud sang mga bag-o lang nga pagbaha sa Iloilo City.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Young said that even before the president's announcement, he had already convened a meeting with the city's agencies and reviewed the projects, especially due to the recent floods in Iloilo City.

text: Magapatawag liwat si Young sang dugang nga meeting kaupod ang mga barangay kapitan sang nagkalain-lain nga barangay sa syudad upod ang DPWH, city engineers kag concerned department heads agud mahibaluan kun may permiso, legal, kag usisaon kun insakto ang scope of work sa mga proyekto.
english: Young will also convene additional meetings with the barangay captains of various barangays in the city along with the DPWH, city engineers and concerned department heads to determine if there are permits, legal, and check if the scope of work in the projects is correct.

text: Ginsuportahan man ni Young ang ginpagwa nga cease and desist order ni Mayor Raisa Treñas nga nagpauntat anay sang tanan nga proyekto sa syudad tubtob matapos ang imbestigasyon.
english: Young also supported the cease and desist order issued by Mayor Raisa Treñas that suspended all projects in the city until the investigation is completed.

text: Liwat nga nagapanawagan si Navotas Rep.
english: Navotas Rep. once again calls for

text: Toby Tiangco sa Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) nga gilayon na nga kanselahon ang pasaporte sang anay Ako Bicol Rep.
english: Toby Tiangco to the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) to immediately cancel the passport of former Ako Bicol Rep.

text: Zaldy Co, bilang tikang parara maprotektahan ang national security.
english: Zaldy Co, as a measure to protect national security.

text: Suno kay Tiangco, may enough na nga gahom kag legal nga basehan ang DFA agud i-cancel ang passport ni Co.
english: Tiangco said the DFA has enough power and legal basis to cancel Co.

text: Ini base sa Article III, Section 6 sang Constitution kag pila ka mga probisyon sang Administrative Code.
english: This is based on Article III, Section 6 of the Constitution and certain provisions of the Administrative Code.

text: Ang pahayag ni Tiangco ang kasunod sang panindugan sang DFA nga kinahanglan magpaidalo sa due process ang kanselasyon sang pasaporte, kasunod sa New Philippine Passport Act.
english: Tiangco's statement follows the DFA's position that the cancellation of passports must go through due process, in accordance with the New Philippine Passport Act.

text: Suno sa DFA, ang kanselasyon ang possible lamang igamando sang korte kun ang may uyta sang pasaporte ang isa ka fugitive.
english: According to the DFA, the cancellation is only possible to be ordered by the court if the holder of the passport is a fugitive.

text: Matandaan nga nag-resign si Co bilang kongresista sang nagligad nga bulan, samtang siya ang nagapangatubang sa mga alegasyon sang iregularidad sa paggamit sang pondo para sa mga proyekto sa flood control projects.
english: Co resigned as a congressman last month, while facing allegations of irregularities in the use of funds for flood control projects.

text: Ginkumpirma sang Department of Justice (DOJ) nga naghingyo na ini sang bulig halin sa Interpol agud nga matultulan na Co, matapos nagguwa ang report nga ini ang nagpalagyo padulong sa France.
english: The Department of Justice (DOJ) confirmed that it has requested assistance from Interpol to track down Co, after reports emerged that he had fled to France.

text: Napatay sa heart attack si former Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) Rookie of the Year Boybits Victoria.
english: Former Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) Rookie of the Year Boybits Victoria died of a heart attack.

text: Ginkumpirma sang iya anak nga si Nathan nga nagtaliwan na ang iya amay sa edad nga 50 anyos matapos ang reports nga nagpaidalom ang former Sunkist kag San Miguel Beer guard sa angioplasty sang damlag lang.
english: His son Nathan confirmed that his father had passed away at the age of 50 after reports that the former Sunkist and San Miguel Beer guard underwent angioplasty recently.

text: Isa ka seven-time PBA champion si Victoria kag nangin Rookie of the Year sang 1994.
english: Victoria was a seven-time PBA champion and was Rookie of the Year in 1994.

text: Madinuagon ang iya karera sa PBA matapos ang iya stellar collegiate stint sa San Beda Red Lions.
english: He had a colorful career in the PBA after his stellar collegiate stint with the San Beda Red Lions.

text: Ginbuligan man sini ang RFM Corporation franchise (gin-rename sa Sunkist) nga makadaog sang duha sa tatlo championships sa 1995 season.
english: It also helped the RFM Corporation franchise (renamed to Sunkist) win two of three championships in the 1995 season.

text: Nakakuha man ini sang lima ka dugang nga PBA titles kaupod sa San Miguel halin sang 1999 tubtub 2001.
english: He also won five additional PBA titles with San Miguel from 1999 to 2001.

text: Matapos nag-retiro sa basketball, nagtilaw man si Victoria sa coaching kag sa broadcasting kag nangin panelist para sa radio kag TV coverages sang liga.
english: After retiring from basketball, Victoria also tried her hand at coaching and broadcasting and became a panelist for radio and TV coverages of the league.

text: Sa labing-una nga tion halin sang ginkoronahan bilang Miss Universe Philippines kag pagtapos sa Top 5 sa 70th Miss Universe, nagpa-guwa na sang statement si reigning Miss Universe Philippines Beatrice Luigi Gomez may kaangtanan sa ila breakup sang iya long-time partner nga si DJ Kate Jagdon.
english: For the first time since being crowned Miss Universe Philippines and finishing in the Top 5 at the 70th Miss Universe, reigning Miss Universe Philippines Beatrice Luigi Gomez has issued a statement regarding her breakup with her long-time partner DJ Kate Jagdon.

text: Tatlo ka bulan naman ang nagligad halin sang nagbulagay ang duha.
english: Three months have passed since the two broke up.

text: Sa serye sang Instagram stories, ginpahayag ni Bea nga mauntat na siya sa paghipos bangud kapoy na siya sa padayon nga harassment nga nabaton niya kag sang iya mga pinalangga sa kabuhi.
english: In a series of Instagram stories, Bea said she will stop being silent because she is tired of the constant harassment she and her loved ones have received in life.

text: Suno pa kay Bea, para man ini sa iya nga peace of mind.
english: According to Bea, this is also for her peace of mind.

text: Ginpahayag sang beauty queen nga apisar sang judgment sang iban nga tawo, wala gid sang nabatian halin sa iya sang una bangud nagtutok siya para sa Miss Universe crown.
english: The beauty queen said that despite the judgment of other people, nothing was heard from her before because she was focused for the Miss Universe crown.

text: Gin-ako sini nga nakaapekto na sa iya nga mental health ang hate messages nga nabaton halin sang nasapubliko ang ila breakup sang iya nga girlfriend.
english: He admitted that the hate messages he received since his breakup with his girlfriend became public have affected his mental health.

text: Ginpaathag ni Bea nga natabo ang breakup matapos sini nadiskubrehan nga indi na loyal si Kate sa iya.
english: Bea explained that the breakup happened after she discovered that Kate was no longer loyal to her.

text: Antes pa man ang MUPH pageant, ginapahayag nga masobra isa ka tuig na nga may gina-entertain si Kate nga persona nga gintawag kay Adam, kag ginapahayag naga-make out man si Kate sa ‘someone else’, naga-himo sang move sa iban nga babayi, kag nagakadugayan sa paglagaw kag indi na makapauli sang pila ka adlaw.
english: Even before the MUPH pageant, Kate had reportedly been entertaining a person called Adam for more than a year, and Kate was also reportedly making out with ‘someone else’, making moves on other women, and staying out late and not coming home for days.

text: Naglab-ot sa punto suno kay Bea nga indi na niya makilala si Kate kag naglain na ang dalagan sang mga bagay.
english: Bea says it got to the point where she couldn't recognize Kate and things went from bad to worse.

text: Apisar gin-ako ni Bea nga may mga sala man siya sa ila nga relationship, ginpahayag sini nga nangin VICTIM si Kate sa ila nga pagbulagay bangud amo sini ang iya nga ginpili.
english: Although Bea admitted that she made mistakes in their relationship, she said that Kate became a VICTIM in their breakup because that's what she chose.

text: Sa katapusan nga bahin sang iya nga mensahe, ginpasalamatan ni Bea ang iya constants, kag ginpahayag nga pareho sila ni Kate nga deserving nga mangin happy.
english: In the last part of her message, Bea thanked her constants, and said that she and Kate both deserve to be happy.

text: Ang statement sang beauty queen ang ginpaguwa isa ka adlaw matapos nga gin-post sini ang picture kun sa diin kaupod niya ang lalaki nga iya nga Valentine’s date.
english: The beauty queen's statement came a day after she posted a picture of herself with her Valentine's date.

text: Ginalantaw sang Iloilo City Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) nga posible electrical in nature ang rason sang sunog nga nagluntad sa Brgy.
english: The Iloilo City Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) believes that the cause of the fire that broke out in Brgy.

text: Infante, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: Infante, Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Ang mga biktima amo ang mag-asawa nga sanday Julius Reyes kag Louelyn Reyes nga pareho nga manunudlo sa Iloilo City, kag ang ila anak nga si Amber Marie, pito ka tuig.
english: The victims were identified as Julius Reyes and Louelyn Reyes, both teachers in Iloilo City, and their daughter, Amber Marie, seven years old.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Senior Fire Officer 1 Denmark Macoco, Chief sang Intelligence and Investigation Unit sang Iloilo City Fire Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagsugod gid ang kalayo sa hallway sang ika-duha nga panalgan sang balay sang pamilya Reyes.
english: Senior Fire Officer 1 Denmark Macoco, chief of the Intelligence and Investigation Unit of the Iloilo City Fire Station, said the fire started in the hallway of the second floor of the Reyes family's house.

text: Suno kay Macoco, indi pa man matul-id kon ano gid ang kabangdanan sang sunog bangud tubtob subong, ginapaidalom sa laboratory analysis ang mga na-recover nga electrical wires.
english: Macoco said the exact cause of the fire is still unknown because the recovered electrical wires are still being subjected to laboratory analysis.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga ang mga electric wire ang may senyales sang short circuit apang agud makasigurado sang conclusion, ginpasigurado sang talatapan nga ipadala sa national nga opisina sang BFP agud mapaidalom sa tests.
english: He also explained that the electric wires have signs of short circuit but to ensure the conclusion, the office ensured that they will be sent to the national office of the BFP for tests.

text: Ginasekyar man sang BFP ang pila ka mga closed circuit television (CCTV) sa mga kaingod balay agud mahibaluan kon intentional ang nagluntad nga sunog.
english: The fire brigade is also checking several closed circuit televisions (CCTVs) in neighboring houses to determine if the fire was intentional.

text: Gin-anunsyo ni Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau ang iya resignation bilang lider sang Liberal Party kag pagpanaog man sa pwesto bilang prime minister kun may mapili na nga bag-o nga lider ang ruling party.
english: Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau has announced his resignation as leader of the Liberal Party and will also step down as prime minister when the ruling party elects a new leader.

text: Pahayag sini, magapabilin siya anay subong bilang prime minister apang sa caretaker capacity.
english: He said he will remain as prime minister but in a caretaker capacity.

text: 11 ka tuig nga ginpangunahan ni Trudeau ang Liberal Party kag siyam ka tuig naman sa pwesto bilang prime minister antes sini ginpaguwa ang desisyon.
english: Trudeau led the Liberal Party for 11 years and served as prime minister for nine years before the decision was announced.

text: Ginalantaw nga gin-unahan lang sini ang desisyon sang Canada bangud may general election man nga hiwaton subong nga tuig kag ginapanan-aw na ang iya kalutusan.
english: He is believed to have preempted Canada's decision because there is also a general election to be held this year and his defeat is expected.

text: Patigayunon ang piniliay antes ukon mismo sa Oktubre 20, apang sa idalom ni Trudeau, madamo ang nagsiling nga mapierde na ang Liberal Party batok sa oposisyon nga Conservative Party nga ginapangunahan ni Pierre Poilievre.
english: The election will be held before or right on October 20, but under Trudeau, many have said the Liberal Party will already lose to the opposition Conservative Party led by Pierre Poilievre.

text: Matandaan nga nagtay-og gid ang administrasyon ni Trudeau sang nag-resign ang iya Deputy Prime Minister kag Finance Minister nga si Chrystia Freeland inoras antes ang pagdeliver kuntani sini sang annual fiscal update.
english: It can be recalled that the Trudeau administration was shaken when his Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Chrystia Freeland resigned hours before it was supposed to deliver the annual fiscal update.

text: Ginpaulanan sini sang kritisismo ang “political gimmicks” ni Trudeau lakip na ang two-month sales tax holiday kag 250 Canadian dollar ($175) rebates para sa kadam-an nga workers.
english: It rained criticism on Trudeau’s “political gimmicks” including a two-month sales tax holiday and 250 Canadian dollar ($175) rebates for most workers.

text: Ginhimo ini sa tunga sang seryoso nga pamahog ni US President-elect Donald Trump sa mas daku nga taripa sa Canadian goods nga magasulod sa Estados Unidos.
english: This was done amid US President-elect Donald Trump’s serious threat of greater tariffs on Canadian goods entering the United States.

text:
Ginapakanubo man ni Trump si Trudeau kag ang Canada sa social media kun sa diin gintawag sini ang prime minister bilang “governor” sang “Great State of Canada.”

Nahibaluan nga antes sini, tatlo ka beses nga na-eleher si Trudeau bilang prime minister.
english:
Trump also belittled Trudeau and Canada on social media where he called the prime minister the “governor” of the “Great State of Canada.”

Before that, Trudeau was elected prime minister three times.

text: Sang 2021 amo ang iya ulihi nga pagdaog apang nadulaan sang governing majority rason nga nakakuha sang lead ang Conservative Party sa Liberal Party sang masobra 20% sa national polling averages.
english: In 2021 he last won but lost the governing majority, giving the Conservative Party a lead over the Liberal Party of more than 20% in national polling averages.

text: Naghatag sang bag-o nga paglaum sa madamo nga Israeli ang subong nga ceasefire sa Gaza.
english: The current ceasefire in Gaza has given many Israelis new hope.

text: Ini possible nga pag-umpisa ang pagbangon sang imahe sang Israel, matapos ang halos duha ka tuig nga gyera.
english: This is likely to be the beginning of the recovery of Israel's image, after nearly two years of war.

text: Nagbag-o ang panan-aw sang publiko humalin sang nag-umpisa ang gyera sang Oktubre 7, 2023, matapos ang pag-atake sang grupo nga Islamista nga Hamas sa Israel, sa diin ginabulubanta 1,200 ka mga tawo ang napatay kag 251 ang ginbihag.
english: Public perceptions have changed since the war began on October 7, 2023, after the Islamist group Hamas launched an attack on Israel, in which an estimated 1,200 people were killed and 251 captured.

text: Apang, samtang nga nagadugay ang tension, padayon man nagabaskog ang panawagan batok sa dakagkuan nga halit tuga sang opensiba sang Israel sa Gaza.
english: However, as tensions rise, calls against the massive damage caused by Israel's offensive in Gaza continue to grow louder.

text: Pila sa mga pungsod sa nakatundan ang ginkilala na nga estado sang Palestina sang nagligad nga bulan.
english: Several of the western countries already recognized the state of Palestine last month.

text: Apisar sang 41 puntos nga natipon ni Justin Brownlee agud itib-ong ang Gilas Pilipinas, nagkabos ang national team sang isa gid lamang ka punto sa kamot sang Jordan sa FIBA World Cup Asian Qualifiers sa Philippine Arena sa Bulacan.
english: Despite Justin Brownlee's 41 points to lead Gilas Pilipinas, the national team fell one point short of Jordan in the FIBA ​​World Cup Asian Qualifiers at the Philippine Arena in Bulacan.

text: Nagtapos ang hampang 91-90 pabor sa foreign team.
english: The game ended 91-90 in favor of the foreign team.

text:
Bangud sini, abanse na sa 6-4 win-loss record ang nahimo sang Jordan sa qualifiers nga patas sa Gilas Pilipinas sa team standings sa Group E.

Pareho man nga sulod ang duha ka team sa World Cup.
english:
As a result, Jordan is ahead with a 6-4 win-loss record in the qualifiers, tied with Gilas Pilipinas in the team standings in Group E.

Both teams are also in the World Cup.

text: Kasunod sini, gin-ako ni Gilas Pilipinas coach Chot Reyes nga kulang ang height sang Gilas sang nakaatubang sa mas dalagku nga Jordanians.
english: Subsequently, Gilas Pilipinas coach Chot Reyes admitted that Gilas lacked height when facing the bigger Jordanians.

text: Ginalantaw suno kay Reyes ang posibilidad nga magpasulod sang isa pa ka naturalized player kun indi makaupod si Kai Sotto sa main draw sang 2023 FIBA World Cup nga magaumpisa sa Agusto.
english: Reyes said the possibility of bringing in another naturalized player is being considered if Kai Sotto is not included in the main draw of the 2023 FIBA ​​World Cup starting in August.

text: Absent ang 7-foot-2 basketball star sa Pilipinas kagab-i bangud bag-o pa lamang ini nakapirma sa Japan B.League.
english: The 7-foot-2 basketball star was absent from the Philippines last night as he recently signed with the Japan B.League.

text: Apisar yara na si Ange Kouame, kinahanglan suno kay Reyes sang dugang nga bulig kay Brownlee kun mag-atubang na sa mas dalagku nga koponan sa FIBA World Cup.
english: Although Ange Kouame is already there, Reyes said Brownlee will need more help when he faces bigger teams in the FIBA ​​World Cup.

text: Gina-huring huring man ang posibilidad nga makabalik sa main draw ang Fil-Am NBA star nga si Jordan Clarkson, apang daku nga milagro kun matabo ini suno kay Reyes.
english: There are also rumors about the possibility of Fil-Am NBA star Jordan Clarkson returning to the main draw, but it would be a big miracle if it happens, Reyes said.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang Utah Jazz guard nga apisar masako siya sa pagpanguna sa team sa tunga tunga sang NBA season, nagahanda siya pananglitan kinahanglanon siya sang Gilas sa mismo World Cup sa Agusto.##
english: Earlier, the Utah Jazz guard said that although he is busy leading the team in the middle of the NBA season, he is preparing in case the Gilas need him at the World Cup in August.##

text: Nagdesisyon nga magpasakop sa Miss Universe Philippine 2022 ang beauty queen nga si Michelle Dee.
english: Beauty queen Michelle Dee has decided to participate in Miss Universe Philippine 2022.

text: Sa iya social media account, ginkumpirma sini ang balita pinaagi sa pagpost sang picture niya nga nagpagunting sang buhok.
english: On his social media account, he confirmed the news by posting a picture of him getting a haircut.

text: Mangin representatvie ang 26-anyos sang Makati.
english: The 26-year-old will represent Makati.

text: Suno kay Michelle, indi mahapos ang nasambit nga pageant gani dako gid ini nga pagpanghangkat para sa iya.
english: According to Michelle, the pageant was not easy and it was a big challenge for her.

text: Gin-ako man sini nga luyag niya mangin inspirasyon sa iban rason nga nadesisyunan niya nga mag-intra sa nasambit nga pageant.
english: She also admitted that she wanted to be an inspiration to others which is why she decided to participate in the said pageant.

text: Magapasaka sang hagna si Senate President Francis Escudero nga magadumili sa mga paryente sang opisyal sang gobyerno tubtob ika-upat nga degree nga magkuha sang kontrata bilang contractor ukon supplier sa mga proyekto sang gobyerno.
english: Senate President Francis Escudero will introduce a bill that would prohibit relatives of government officials up to the fourth degree from obtaining contracts as contractors or suppliers in government projects.

text: Ini nga panukala sabat sa direktiba ni Presidente Marcos Jr.
english: This proposal is in response to the directive of President Marcos Jr.

text: nga imbestigaran ang mga substandard nga flood control projects nga ginbuyagyag sa SONA.
english: to investigate the substandard flood control projects exposed in the SONA.

text: Suno kay Escudero, may conflict of interest kon ang mga paryente sang opisyal amo ang nagabaton sang kontrata, nga nagapadaku sang posibilidad sang korapsyon.
english: According to Escudero, there is a conflict of interest when the official’s relatives are the recipients of the contract, which increases the possibility of corruption.

text: Ginpanghiwala man niya nga may personal siya nga ginansya sa mga proyekto sa Sorsogon, kag ginpahayag nga ang mga alegasyon batuk sa iya parte lamang sang PR campaign.
english: He also denied that he had any personal profit from the projects in Sorsogon, and said the allegations against him were just part of a PR campaign.

text: Ginaplano ni Escudero nga ihimo nga priority bill ang panukala kag posible ini ipasaka sa masunod nga Martes
english: Escudero plans to make the proposal a priority bill and it is likely to be filed next Tuesday

text:
Gin-adjust sang Gilas Pilipinas ang lineup sini sa pag-atubang sa Jordan para sa FIBA World Cup Asian qualifiers sa Philippine Arena sa Bocaue, Bulacan 6:00 karon sa gab-i.

Sa baylo nga si Calvin Oftanan, ginpasulod sa national team si Kevin Quiambao para sa ikaduha nga home game sang Gilas subong nga tuig kasunod sang 107-96 nga kadalag-an batok sa Lebanon sang nagligad nga Byernes.
english:
Gilas Pilipinas has adjusted its lineup to face Jordan for the FIBA ​​World Cup Asian qualifiers at the Philippine Arena in Bocaue, Bulacan at 6:00 pm tonight.

In place of Calvin Oftanan, Kevin Quiambao was introduced to the national team for the Gilas' second home game this year following a 107-96 win over Lebanon last Friday.

text: Kaupod ni Quiambao ang naturalized player nga si Justin Brownlee, big men nga sanday Mason Amos, June Mar Fajardo kag Jamie Malonzo, CJ Perez, mag-utod nga sanday Kiefer kag Thirdy Ravena, reigning PBA Most Valuable Player nga si Scottie Thompson, Ray Parks Jr., Jordan Heading, kag si Dwight Ramos.
english: With Quiambao are naturalized player Justin Brownlee, big men Mason Amos, June Mar Fajardo and Jamie Malonzo, CJ Perez, brothers Kiefer and Thirdy Ravena, reigning PBA Most Valuable Player Scottie Thompson, Ray Parks Jr., Jordan Heading, and Dwight Ramos.

text: Wala sang bearing ini nga match bangud pareho na nga kuwalipikado ang duha ka pungsod sa main competition.
english: This match has no bearing as both countries have already qualified for the main competition.

text: Tuyo sang Jordan nga makabalos sa Pilipinas matapos nakaangkon sang mapait nga kalutusan, 76-44, sang nagligad nga Nobyembre 2022.
english: Jordan aims to avenge the Philippines after suffering a bitter defeat, 76-44, last November 2022.

text: Sa subong, yara na sa 6-3 ang rekord sang Pilpinas, buot silingon, pangatlo sa Group E, nga nagasunod lang sa Lebanon kag New Zealand nga lunsay may 7-2 records.
english: The Philippines currently has a 6-3 record, which means it is third in Group E, behind only Lebanon and New Zealand who both have 7-2 records.

text: Kun magdaog ang Pilipinas, magapangaduha ini sa table kag maga-tie sa second place sa anuman nga team nga malutos sa tunga sang Lebanon kag New Zealand.
english: If the Philippines wins, it will finish second in the table and tie for second place with any team that loses between Lebanon and New Zealand.

text: ILOILO – Patay ang menor de edad nga manugbantay sang bibe matapos gintiro sang iya amo sa Brgy.
english: ILOILO – A minor beekeeper was shot dead by his employer in Brgy.

text: Santol, San Dionisio, Iloilo.
english: Santol, San Dionisio, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Alyas Jose, 15, estudyante, samtang ang suspek naman amo si Alyas Pedro, 49, mangunguma, kag lunsay residente sang nasambit nga barangay.
english: The victim was identified as Jose, 15, a student, while the suspect was identified as Pedro, 49, a farmer, both residents of the said barangay.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Edward Villanis, Hepe sang San Dionisio Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga naga inom-inom ang biktima kag suspek.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Edward Villanis, chief of the San Dionisio Municipal Police Station, said the victim and the suspect were drinking.

text: Sa ulihi, ginsunlog sang suspek ang biktima nga “Alyas black”.
english: Later, the suspect stabbed the victim, “Alyas black”.

text: Apang napikon ang biktima kag nagpanghangkat nga maglabu-anay sa suspek.
english: However, the victim became angry and challenged the suspect to fight.

text: Diri na kag nagpauli ang suspek kag nagkuha sang pusil kag ginluthang ang biktima sa nawala kag natuo nga dughan nga naglapos sa likod.
english: The suspect then returned home and took out a gun and shot the victim in the left and right chest.

text: Arestado naman ang suspek matapos gin-negosyar sang ila Punong Barangay nga mag-surrender.
english: The suspect was arrested after being negotiated by their Punong Barangay to surrender.

text: Posible naman nga magapangatubang sang kaso nga murder ang suspek.
english: The suspect is likely to face charges of murder.

text: -𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗣𝗵𝗮𝘂𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲 𝗣𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗿𝗮
english: -Advanced 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗣𝗵𝗮𝘂𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲 𝗣𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗿𝗮

text: Ginabantayan ang panibag-o nga tuyo nga arestuhon subong nga adlaw ang na-impeach nga president sang South Korea nga si President Yoon Suk Yeol.
english: South Korea's impeached president, President Yoon Suk Yeol, is being watched for a new arrest today.

text: Ini bangud karon man sa tungang gab-i maga-expire ang warrant of arrest nga ginpaguwa batok kay Yoon bangud sa ginaalegar nga insurrection kaamngot sa iya gulpyada nga pagdeklarar sang martial law sang Disyembre.
english: This is because the warrant of arrest issued against Yoon for alleged insurrection in connection with his sudden declaration of martial law in December will expire at midnight.

text: Suno kay Bombo Danah Vasquez, international correspondent sa South Korea, halin sang napaslawan ang criminal investigators nga makasulod sa presidential compound sang nagligad nga Biyernes bangud sa security detail kag mga soldado nga naga-protekta kay Yoon, may ginahimo sila subong nga bag-o nga estratehiya apang ginasigurado nga wala sang may mahalitan nga mga sibilyan.
