english: According to Bombo Danah Vasquez, international correspondent in South Korea, since criminal investigators failed to enter the presidential compound last Friday due to the security detail and soldiers protecting Yoon, they are now working on a new strategy but making sure that no civilians are harmed.

text: Matandaan nga anum ka oras ang standoff sang Biyernes tubtub nagdesisyon ang otoridad nga maghalin na lang anay agud nga indi na madalahig ang mga tawo.
english: The standoff lasted for six hours on Friday until the authorities decided to leave so that people would not be involved.

text: Bisan naga-snow subong sa Seoul, linibo ka mga supporters sang presidente ang nagatipon gihapon sa guwa sang iya nga official residence.
english: Despite the snowfall in Seoul, thousands of the president's supporters are still gathering outside his official residence.

text: Kahapon, minus 5 degrees Celsius ang temperatua kag masobra 6 cm ukon 2.4-inches ang snow sa pila ka parte sang Seoul apang may protesters nga nagpaligad sang gab-i sa downtown para lamang sa ila nga kawsa para kay Yoon.
english: Yesterday, the temperature was minus 5 degrees Celsius and more than 6 cm or 2.4-inches of snow fell in some parts of Seoul but there were protesters who spent the night in downtown just for their cause for Yoon.

text: Una naman nga gin-athag sang presidential security service nga indi sila magkooperar sa officials nga maga-aresto kay Yoon bangud sa legal debate nga nagapalibot sa isyu sang pagdakop sa iya.
english: Earlier, the presidential security service clarified that it will not cooperate with officials who will arrest Yoon because of the legal debate surrounding the issue of his arrest.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Yoon amo ang first incumbent South Korean president nga gindagdagan sang arrest warrant kasunod sang iya tikang sa martial law kag nagpa-ibwal pa gid sang political chaos sa South Korea nga amo ang fourth-largest economy sa Asya.
english: Yoon is the first incumbent South Korean president to be issued an arrest warrant following his move to martial law and further sparked political chaos in South Korea, the fourth-largest economy in Asia.

text: Ginpasaka na sang state weather bureau ang storm surge warning sa pila ka mga baybayon sa Luzon kag Visayas bangud sa bagyo Ramil.
english: The state weather bureau has already raised the storm surge warning for some coasts in Luzon and Visayas due to Typhoon Ramil.

text: Suno kay state meteorologist Bennison Estareja, nagapaandam ang isa tubtob duha ka metro (1-2m) nga kataason sang alimpulos sa mga baybayon sa eastern seaboard.
english: According to state meteorologist Bennison Estareja, a storm surge of one to two meters (1-2m) is warning of the beaches in the eastern seaboard.

text: Ginakalakipan ini sang mga probinsya sang Albay, Aurora, Camarines Norte, Camarines Sur, Catanduanes, Eastern Samar, Isabela, Northern Samar, Quezon, Western Samar, kag Sorsogon.
english: It includes the provinces of Albay, Aurora, Camarines Norte, Camarines Sur, Catanduanes, Eastern Samar, Isabela, Northern Samar, Quezon, Western Samar, and Sorsogon.

text: Panugyan ni Estareja sa publiko, likawan anay ang pagpadulong sa mga baybayon nga sakop sang mga nasambit nga probinsya.
english: Estareja advised the public to avoid going to the beaches of these provinces.

text: Mahimo man nga maglab-ot sa coastal communities ang mga matag-as nga alimpulos, rason nga ginaabisuhan ang mga lokal nga gobyerno nga bantayan ang sitwasyon sa mga ini kag magpatigayon sang pre-emptive evacuation kun kinahanglan.
english: High waves may also reach coastal communities, which is why local governments are advised to monitor the situation in them and conduct pre-emptive evacuation if necessary.

text: Ginpahibalo sang Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) nga ila pa i-upgrade ang Emergency 911 system sa bug-os nga pungsod agud mapabaskug ang pagresponde kag koordinasyon sa tion sang emerhensya kag kalamidad.
english: The Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) announced that it will upgrade the Emergency 911 system nationwide to strengthen response and coordination in times of emergency and disaster.

text: Suno kay DILG Secretary Jonvic Remulla, kabahin ini sang ila tinutuyo nga matutukan ang kahandaan sang mga local government units (LGUs) kag masiguro nga makaresponde na ang mga ini antes pa man mag-abot ang bagyo ukon iban pa nga kalamidad.
english: According to DILG Secretary Jonvic Remulla, this is part of their goal to focus on the preparedness of local government units (LGUs) and ensure that they can respond before typhoons or other disasters strike.

text: Ginpanugyan man ni Remulla ang mga LGU nga i-update ang disaster preparedness plans, bantayan ang mga waterways, kag ihanda ang rescue assets samtang wala pa ang peligro.
english: Remulla also advised LGUs to update disaster preparedness plans, monitor waterways, and prepare rescue assets before the threat.

text: Ginsiguro ni Remulla nga seryoso ang DILG sa pagpanguna sa mga reporma para mas epektibo nga maserbisyuhan ang publiko sa oras sang krisis.
english: Remulla assured that the DILG is serious about leading reforms to serve the public more effectively in times of crisis.

text: Kilalahon naton subong ang bag-o nga naga-uyat sang record bilang pinakatigulang nga tawo sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: We will now recognize the new record holder as the oldest person in the world.

text: Ini matapos napatay na ang nauna nga nagapanag-iya sang record nga amo ang 116-anyos nga si Tomiko Itooka sang Japan.
english: This comes after the death of the previous record holder, 116-year-old Tomiko Itooka of Japan.

text: Ang bag-o nga record-holder amo si Inah Canabarro Lucas sang Brazil nga naga-edad sang 116 years kag 210 days sang ginkilala ini sang Guinness World Records.
english: The new record-holder is Inah Canabarro Lucas of Brazil who was 116 years and 210 days old when recognized by Guinness World Records.

text: Si Sister Inah man ang pinakatigulang nga madre sa kalibutan nga nabun-ag sang June 8, 1908 sa Sao Francisco de Assis sa Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil.
english: Sister Inah is also the oldest nun in the world having been born on June 8, 1908 in Sao Francisco de Assis in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil.

text: Nabun-ag siya bilang tuman ka niwang nga bata kag gindumdom sang iban nga indi na siya maka-survive kun maka-edad-edad na.
english: He was born as a very thin child and some thought that he would not survive when he was old.

text: Apang malawig pa ang iya nangin kabuhi kag nangin kabahin dira ang iya pagka-madre.
english: But she lived a long life and became a nun.

text: Nagsaylo siya anay sa Montevideo, Uruguay sang nagpanumpa na nga mangin madre sang December 1928.
english: She first moved to Montevideo, Uruguay when she was vowed to become a nun in December 1928.

text: Sang 1930, nagbalik siya sa Brazil kag nangin manunudlo sang Portuguese kag mathematics sa eskwelahan sa Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro.
english: In 1930, he returned to Brazil and became a teacher of Portuguese and mathematics at the school in Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro.

text: Naglawig sang dinekada ang iya teaching career nga amo man ang nagdala sa iya sa lain-lain nga mga lokasyon.
english: His teaching career spanned decades, which also took him to different locations.

text: Sa iya ika-110 nga kaadlawan sang 2018, nakabaton siya sang apostolic blessing halin kay Pope Francis.
english: On his 110th birthday in 2018, he received an apostolic blessing from Pope Francis.

text: Si Sister Inah amo ang ginasiling nga last living person nga nabun-ag sang 1908 kag isa sa tatlo na lamang ka mga tawo nga nabun-ag sang 1900s nga subong nagakabuhi pa.
english: Sister Inah is said to be the last living person born in 1908 and one of only three people born in the 1900s who are still alive.

text: Ginbasura sang Korte Suprema ang petisyon nga gin-file ni Cassandra Li Ong batok sa nga komite sang Senado kag House of Representatives nga nagapatigayon sang imbestigasyon sang anomailya sa Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGOs).
english: The Supreme Court has dismissed a petition filed by Cassandra Li Ong against the Senate and House of Representatives committees investigating anomalies in Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGOs).

text: Base sa desisyon nga pirmado ni Associate Justice Jhosep Lopez nga ginkilala sang Supreme Court (SC) ang gahom sang Kongreso nga magpatigayon sang hearing in aid of legislation.
english: Based on the decision signed by Associate Justice Jhosep Lopez, the Supreme Court (SC) recognized the power of Congress to conduct hearings in aid of legislation.

text: Si Ong ang may kahilabtanan sa operasyon sang Lucky South 99 sa Porac, Pampanga nga gin-raid sang mga otoridad bangud sa iligal nga operasyon sini.
english: Ong was involved in the operation of Lucky South 99 in Porac, Pampanga which was raided by the authorities for its illegal operation.

text: Ginplastar ni Ong sa iya petisyon ang ginlapas sang Kongreso ang iya Karapatan para para maghipos kag right against self-incrimination.
english: Ong raised in his petition that Congress violated his right to remain silent and right against self-incrimination.

text: Gin-akusaran pa sini ang House QuadComm nga gin-abuso ang gahom kag paglapas sa hurisdiction sa pagpatigayon sang imbestigasyon bangud sa ginapilit siya nga maghatag sang impormasyon.
english: He further accused the House QuadComm of abuse of power and violation of jurisdiction in conducting the investigation as he was pressured to provide information.

text: Ginklaro sang SC nga ang legislative power sang Kongreso ang nakabutang sa 1987 Constitution kag wala may Nakita nga paglapas.
english: The SC clarified that the legislative power of Congress is enshrined in the 1987 Constitution and found no violation.

text: Si Ong kag iba pa ang naulamid sa kaso nga qualified human trafficking nga ginpasaka sang Abril.
english: Ong and others are involved in a qualified human trafficking case filed in April.

text: Ginlunsar sang gobyerno sang China ang una nga nationwide nga subsidy program nga nagatuyo nga mapadamo ang ila populasyon paagi sa insentibo sa mga mag-asawa nga may kabataan nga edad tatlo paubos.
english: The Chinese government has launched the first nationwide subsidy program aimed at increasing its population through incentives to couples with children aged three and under.

text: Sa idalum sang programa, ang tagsa ka ginikanan makabaton sang tig-$500 kada bata nga nagaedad 0 tubtob 3 anyos nga nagakahulugan nga ang isa ka kabataan mahimo maka-income sang kapin P87,000 kada tuig.
english: Under the program, each parent will receive $500 per child aged 0 to 3 years old which means that a child can earn more than P87,000 per year.

text: Ginalauman nga makabulig ini sa lapit 20 milyones ka pamilya sa pagtubos sang ila adlaw-adlaw nga pangkinahanglanon.
english: It is expected to help nearly 20 million families meet their daily needs.

text: Ginpahayag man nga may pila na ka probinsya sa China nga una na nagpatuman sang pareho nga polisiya agud pasangkaron ang natalana nga pagnubo sang populasyon bangud sa taas nga gastos kag kabudlayan sa pagpadako sang bata.
english: It was also reported that several provinces in China have already implemented similar policies to accelerate the projected population decline due to the high cost and difficulty of raising children.

text: Apisar predominantly Muslim ang populasyon sa Kingdom of Bahrain, gina-abi abi na sang mga Bahraini ang pag-selebrar sang Valentine’s Day, ang adlaw nga gina-obserbar sunod sa Christian patron saint for lovers.
english: Although the Kingdom of Bahrain has a predominantly Muslim population, Bahraini people welcome the celebration of Valentine's Day, the day observed after the Christian patron saint for lovers.

text: Malayo ini sa sitwasyon sang nagliligad nga tuig kun sa diin may mga religious leaders nga nagapaandam batok sa pag-selebrar sa Adlaw sang Tagipusuon bangud ginpahayag nga isa ini ka pagan tradition nga naga-promote sang bisyo kag moral corruption.
english: This is far from the situation last year where some religious leaders warned against celebrating Valentine's Day because it was said to be a pagan tradition that promotes vice and moral corruption.

text: Ginkontra man ini anay sa amo nga Western Asian island country bangud wala ini nagasanto sa Islamic values kag social traditions bangud mga tawo lang sa West ang nagahimo sini.
english: It was also opposed in the West Asian island country because it does not correspond to Islamic values ​​and social traditions because only people in the West do it.

text: Sa subong suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Domingo Camus direkta sa Bahrain, mangin ang mga Bahrainis ang nagabitbit man sang bouquet of flowers sa Pebrero 14.
english: Currently, according to Bombo International Correspondent Domingo Camus directly in Bahrain, even Bahrainis are also carrying bouquets of flowers on February 14.

text: May nagaraya man ang mga manugbaligya sang bulak sa higad sang dalan kag kalabanan sa flower vendors amo ang mga dumuluong bangud masami nga naga-order lang ang mga tumandok.
english: There are also flower vendors on the side of the road and most of the flower vendors are foreigners because often the locals only order.

text: Ginakabig man ni Camus nga daku ang nangin impluwensya sang mga Pinoy sa amo nga pungsod sa iban nga Bahrainis pag-abot sa pag-feel sang Valentine vibe.
english: Camus also believes that Filipinos in the country have had a great influence on other Bahrainis when it comes to feeling the Valentine vibe.

text: Ini bangud masami man nga mga Pinoy ang gina-hire nga mag -desinyo sang mga bulak sa weddings kag iban nga okasyon nga para sa couples.
english: This is because Filipinos are often hired to design flowers for weddings and other occasions for couples.

text: Mismo si Camus ang nagaplano man nga magpatindog sa flower shop sa amo nga lugar.
english: Camus himself is also planning to build a flower shop in the area.

text: Sa rekord sang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), may 40,000 Filipinos sa amo nga pungsod.
english: According to the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), there are 40,000 Filipinos in the country.

text: Atubangon sang Gilas Pilipinas ang Lebanon ‘las sais karon sa gab-i sa Philippine Arena sa Bulacan para sa sixth kag final window sang Fiba World Cup Asian Qualifiers.
english: Gilas Pilipinas will face Lebanon at 6 pm tonight at the Philippine Arena in Bulacan for the sixth and final window of the Fiba World Cup Asian Qualifiers.

text: Pangunahan ni Justin Brownlee ang national team kag ini man ang iya una nga official game bilang isa na ka Filipino citizen.
english: Justin Brownlee will lead the national team and this will also be his first official game as a Filipino citizen.

text: Makaupod sini sa team sanday six-time Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) Most Valuable Player (MVP) June Mar Fajardo, Mason Amos, Jamie Malonzo, Jordan Heading, CJ Perez, Calvin Oftana, Ray Parks Jr., Dwight Ramos, mag-utod nga Kiefer kag Thirdy Ravena, kag reigning PBA MVP Scottie Thompson.
english: The team will be joined by six-time Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) Most Valuable Player (MVP) June Mar Fajardo, Mason Amos, Jamie Malonzo, Jordan Heading, CJ Perez, Calvin Oftana, Ray Parks Jr., Dwight Ramos, brothers Kiefer and Thirdy Rave, and PBA MVP Scott Thompson.

text: Wala na sang bearing sa duha ka team ang anuman nga resulta sang hampang bangud pareho ini nga kuwalipikado sa 2023 FIBA World Cup.
english: There is no bearing on either team any outcome of the game as both are qualified for the 2023 FIBA ​​World Cup.

text: Sa pihak sini, ginabantayan gihapon ini sang basketball fans ilabi na bangud tuyo sa gihapon sang Gilas nga makabalos matapos duha ka beses nga ginlutos sang Lebanon sang nagligad nga tuig — hampang sa Indonesia kag hampang sa Beirut.
english: Meanwhile, basketball fans are still watching it especially since the Gilas are still trying to get even after being defeated twice by Lebanon last year — a game in Indonesia and a game in Beirut.

text: Wala nangin upang ang snowstorm para sa mga South Korean protesters nga nagapanawagan nga maaresto si suspended President Yoon Suk Yeol.
english: The snowstorm was no obstacle for South Korean protesters calling for the arrest of suspended President Yoon Suk Yeol.

text: Ini ang kasunod sang kapaslawan nga maaresto si Yoon sa diin indi magnubo sa 48 ka oras ang nabilin antes ang pag-expire sang warrant.
english: This follows the failure to arrest Yoon with at least 48 hours remaining before the expiration of the warrant.

text: Matandaan nga ginbutang ni Yoon ang South Korea sa political chaos sang nagligad nga bulan kasunod sang iya pagdeklarar sang martial law.
english: Yoon plunged South Korea into political chaos last month following his declaration of martial law.

text: Suno kay Bombo Danah Vasquez, international correspondent sa South Korea, indi mahapos ang pag-aresto kay Yoon bangud sa ginatos ka mga loyal security officers nga nagapamalabag sa pag-aresto sa iya.
english: According to Bombo Danah Vasquez, international correspondent in South Korea, it was not easy to arrest Yoon because of the hundreds of loyal security officers who are obstructing his arrest.

text: Nahibaluan nga napuno sang mga protesters ang mga mayor nga dalanon sa Seoul matapos napaslawan ang pag-aresto sa diin ang isa ka grupo ang naga-demand sa pag-aresto kay Yoon, samtang isa naman ka grupo ang nagapanawagan nga ideklarar nga invalid ang iya impeachment.
english: Protesters filled the main streets of Seoul after the failed arrest with one group demanding Yoon's arrest, while another group called for his impeachment to be declared invalid.

text: Ang rally sa tunga sang snowstorm ang kasunod man sang pahayag ni Yoon nga nagalantaw siya sa livestream sa YouTube sa mga nagasuporta nga ipakigbato ang natabo nga pag-agaw sa iya gahom.
english: The rally in the middle of the snowstorm also followed Yoon's statement that he was watching a livestream on YouTube to supporters to fight the usurpation of his power.

text: Nagapangatubang si Yoon sang kaso kriminal nga insurrection, isa sa pila ka mga krimen nga indi sakop sang presidential immunity, buot silingon, mahimo ini nga mapreso kag ang pinakamalala amo nga masentensyahan ini sang death penalty.
english: Yoon faces charges of criminal insurrection, one of the few crimes not covered by presidential immunity, meaning, he could be imprisoned and at worst sentenced to the death penalty.

text: Sa tion nga ma-execute ang warrant, si Yoon ang mangin pinakauna nga sitting South Korean president nga maaresto.
english: Once the warrant is executed, Yoon will become the first sitting South Korean president to be arrested.

text: Nahanay sa grupo sang mabaskug nga mga pungsod ang Philippine Women’s National Football Team sa AFC Women’s Asian Cup 2026.
english: The Philippine Women's National Football Team has qualified for the 2026 AFC Women's Asian Cup.

text: Kaupod sang Filipinas sa Group A ang Australia, Korea Republic, kag Iran.
english: The Philippines is in Group A with Australia, Korea Republic, and Iran.

text: Ginkilala ang grupo nga isa sa pinakamabakas, matapos nga pareho na nga nakauna sa Pilipinas ang Korea Republic sa 2022 semifinals kag ginpahalin man sini ang Australia sa quarterfinals.
english: The group was recognized as one of the strongest, after Korea Republic had both topped the Philippines in the 2022 semifinals and knocked out Australia in the quarterfinals.

text: Una pa lang ini nga sabak sang Iran sa torneo matapos magdaog sa qualifiers.
english: This is Iran's first win in the tournament after winning the qualifiers.

text: Magahampang ang Filipinas batok sa host country nga Australia sa Marso 1, 2026 sa Perth Stadium.
english: The Philippines will play host country Australia on March 1, 2026 at Perth Stadium.

text: Ang torneo magaluntad tubtob Marso 21.
english: The tournament runs until March 21.

text: Ang top teams sa kada grupo, upod ang best third-placers, magalab-ot sa knockout stage, kag ang top 6 sa kabug-usan kwalipikado na sa 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup sa Brazil.
english: The top teams in each group, along with the best third-placers, will reach the knockout stage, and the top 6 overall have qualified for the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup in Brazil.

text: Nagapangibabaw ang abilidad sang Pinoy boxers sa 74th Strandja International Boxing Tournament sa Sofia, Bulgaria.
english: Pinoy boxers are dominating their skills at the 74th Strandja International Boxing Tournament in Sofia, Bulgaria.

text: Daog ang Tokyo Olympic medalist nga si Carlo Paalam batok sa kasumpong nga si Enver Muzaffer sang Turkey, 5-0, sa 54kg bantamweight class.
english: Tokyo Olympic medalist Carlo Paalam defeated Turkey's Enver Muzaffer, 5-0, in the 54kg bantamweight class.

text: Sunod nga atubangon ni Paalam sa quarterfinals si Mirazizbek Mirzakhalilov sang Uzbekistan.
english: Paalam will next face Mirazizbek Mirzakhalilov of Uzbekistan in the quarterfinals.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nalutos man sang Davao City native nga si Junmilardo Ogayre ang una sini nga kasumpong nga si Riad Labidi sang France sa second round sang men’s 57kg featherweight bout.
english: Meanwhile, Davao City native Junmilardo Ogayre also defeated his first opponent Riad Labidi of France in the second round of the men’s 57kg featherweight bout.

text: Duha pa ka boksidor ang balantayan sa persona nanday Marvin Tabamo kag Tokyo Olympian nga si Irish Magno nga tumandok sang Janiuay, Iloilo.
english: Two other boxers are being watched in the person of Marvin Tabamo and Tokyo Olympian Irish Magno who is a native of Janiuay, Iloilo.

text: Atubangon sang Ilongga boxer si Maria Gonzalez Caceres sang Spain sa women’s 52kg flyweight division.
english: The Ilongga boxer will face Maria Gonzalez Caceres of Spain in the women’s 52kg flyweight division.

text: Nagbaskog kag nahimo nga tropical storm si Bagyo Ramil.
english: Typhoon Ramil strengthened into a tropical storm.

text: Sa 5:00 a.m. weather bulletin sang Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), ginpahayag nga ulihi nakit-an ang sentro sang bagyo sa kalayuon nga 305 km nasidlangan sang Juban, Sorsogon.
english: In the 5:00 a.m. weather bulletin of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), it was stated that the center of the typhoon was later found at a distance of 305 km east of Juban, Sorsogon.

text:
Dala sang bagyo ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 65 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 80 km/h. Nagahulag ini sa direksyon nga pa-nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 20 km/h.

Napaidalom na subong sa Wind Signal Number 2 ang Camarines Norte, Catanduanes, kag ang northern portion sang Camarines Sur.
english:
The typhoon brought winds of 65 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 80 km/h. It is moving in a westward direction at a speed of 20 km/h.

Camarines Norte, Catanduanes, and the northern portion of Camarines Sur are now under Wind Signal Number 2.

text: Sa Luzon gihapon, signal Number 1 sa Cagayan lakip na sa Babuyan Islands, Isabela, Quirino, Nueva Vizcaya, Apayao, Abra, Kalinga, Mountain Province, Ifugao, Benguet, Ilocos Norte, Ilocos Sur, La Union, Pangasinan, Aurora, Nueva Ecija, eastern portion sang Bulacan, eastern portion sang Tarlac, eastern portion sang Pampanga, northern kag eastern portions sang Quezon lakip na sa Polillo Islands, Camarines Norte, nabilin nga bahin sang Camarines Sur, Albay, Sorsogon, Burias Island, kag Ticao Island.
english: Also in Luzon, signal Number 1 in Cagayan including Babuyan Islands, Isabela, Quirino, Nueva Vizcaya, Apayao, Abra, Kalinga, Mountain Province, Ifugao, Benguet, Ilocos Norte, Ilocos Sur, La Union, Pangasinan, Aurora, Nueva Ecija, eastern portion, Bustern, Tartary, and portions eastern portion of Pampanga, northern and eastern portions of Quezon including the Polillo Islands, Camarines Norte, the rest of Camarines Sur, Albay, Sorsogon, Burias Island, and Ticao Island.

text: Sa Visayas, napaidalom man sa Signal No.
english: In the Visayas, also under Signal No.

text: 1 ang Northern Samar, northern portion sang Eastern Samar, kag northern portion sang Samar.
english: 1 is Northern Samar, northern portion of Eastern Samar, and northern portion of Samar.

text: Gina-forecast nga magahulag si Ramil pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan padulong sa area sang Central-Southern Luzon.
english: Ramil is forecast to move west northwest towards the area of ​​Central-Southern Luzon.

text: Sa forecast track, mahimo mag-landfall ukon maglabay ang sentro sang bagyo malapt sa Catanduanes karon sa hapon ukon sa gab-i. Pagkatapos, magahulag ang bagyo pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan kag magalaslas malapit sa Vinzons, Camarines Norte kag Polillo Islands buwas sa aga.
english: According to the forecast track, the center of the typhoon may landfall or pass near Catanduanes this afternoon or evening. The typhoon will then move west northwest and land near Vinzons, Camarines Norte and Polillo Islands tomorrow morning.

text: Sa aga ukon sa hapon buwas, Oktubre 18, mahimo mag-landfall pa gid ang bagyo sa Aurora ukon Isabela.
english: In the morning or afternoon tomorrow, October 18, the typhoon may landfall in Aurora or Isabela.

text:
Pagkatapos, magaagi ini sa kabukiran sang Northern kag Central Luzon kag magatuhaw liwat sa West Philippine Sea sa buwas sa hapon ukon sa gab-i.

Ginalantaw nga magaguwa ang bagyo sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) sa Lunes sang aga.
english:
It will then pass through the mountains of Northern and Central Luzon and reappear in the West Philippine Sea tomorrow afternoon or evening.

The typhoon is expected to leave the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) on Monday morning.

text: Unbothered ang aktres nga si Toni Gonzaga apisar nga wala-tuo nga pag-bash ang iya naangkon sang nag-host ini sa proclamation rally sang BBM-Sara tandem sa Philippine Arena.
english: Actress Toni Gonzaga is unbothered despite the unfair bash she received when she hosted the proclamation rally of the BBM-Sara tandem at the Philippine Arena.

text: Sa isa ka Facebook post, mismo si presidential candidate Bongbong Marcos ang nagpasalamat sa aktres sa pag-host sa event sang Uniteam.
english: In a Facebook post, presidential candidate Bongbong Marcos himself thanked the actress for hosting the Uniteam event.

text:
Sa isa naman ka Instagram story, nagsabat si Toni kay Marcos kag nagsiling, “You’re welcome, my President.”

Magluwas sa suporta sa mga Marcos, gin-bash man sang mga netizens si Toni bangud sa pag-introduce sa senatorial candidate nga si House Deputy Speaker Rodante Marcoleta nga kabahin sang Marcos-Duterte senatorial slate.
english:
In another Instagram story, Toni responded to Marcos and said, “You’re welcome, my President.”

Aside from supporting the Marcoses, netizens also bashed Toni for introducing senatorial candidate House Deputy Speaker Rodante Marcoleta who is part of the Marcos-Duterte senatorial slate.

text: Si Marcoleta ang makabig lead figure sa pagpamatok sa franchise renewal para sa media giant nga ABS-CBN nga amo ang home network ni Toni nga na-shutdown sang 2020.
english: Marcoleta is considered the lead figure in opposing the franchise renewal for media giant ABS-CBN, Toni's home network, which was shutdown in 2020.

text: Ginrekomenda sang Iloilo City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (CDRRMC) kay Mayor Raisa Treñas nga ipaidalom sa State of Calamity ang siyudad bangud sa nangin epekto sang mag nag-agi nga bagyo.
english: The Iloilo City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (CDRRMC) has recommended to Mayor Raisa Treñas that the city be placed under a State of Calamity due to the impact of the past typhoons.

text: Subong nga aga, nagpatawag sang emergency meeting ang alkalde kaupod ang CDRRMC agud i-review ang pagpaidalom sa State of Calamity sa siyudad.
english: This morning, the mayor called an emergency meeting with the CDRRMC to review the implementation of the State of Calamity in the city.

text: Base sa datos nga ginpresentar sang CDRRMO, may ara sang total exposed population of 240,304, based on 2024 PSA data; Ang forecasted affected population (15%) is 38,062; Kag base sa situation report sang July 28, —44,723 na ang naapektuhan sang pagbaha, kag 12,158 naman ang naapektuhan sang storm surge.
english: Based on data presented by the CDRRMO, there is a total exposed population of 240,304, based on 2024 PSA data; The forecasted affected population (15%) is 38,062; And based on the situation report on July 28, —44,723 have been affected by flooding, and 12,158 have been affected by storm surge.

text: May kabug-usan nga 56,881 affected individuals.
english: A total of 56,881 affected individuals.

text: Ini nga datos nakasulod sa criteria sa idalum sang Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act of 2010, nga naga-authorize sang declaration sang State of Calamity kun may daku nga epekto sa kabuhi, trabaho, infrastructure, kag mobility sang pumuluyo.
english: This data meets the criteria under the Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act of 2010, which authorizes the declaration of a State of Calamity if there is a significant impact on the lives, jobs, infrastructure, and mobility of the people.

text: Gani, gin-aprubahan sang konseho ang rekomendasyon, upod ang utilization sang ₱31.5 million gikan sa Quick Response Fund (QRF) sang siyudad.
english: Therefore, the council approved the recommendation, along with the utilization of ₱31.5 million from the city's Quick Response Fund (QRF).

text: Gin-aprubahan man ang mga programa nga ₱20M para sa site development sang relocation sites para sa mga evacuees sa Brgy.
english: Also approved were ₱20M programs for site development of relocation sites for evacuees in Brgy.

text: San Juan; ₱10M para sa comprehensive flood assessment and drainage master plan para sa bilog nga Siyudad sang Iloilo; ₱1.4M para sa food assistance sa mga displaced families; kag ₱ 100K para sa seed distribution sa mga apektado nga mangunguma.
english: St. John; ₱10M for comprehensive flood assessment and drainage master plan for the entire City of Iloilo; ₱1.4M for food assistance to displaced families; and ₱ 100K for seed distribution to affected farmers.

text: Suportado man ini sang alkalde kag bilang chairperson sang CDRRMC, magakoordinat ini sila sa Sangguniang Panlungsod para sa approval process.
english: The mayor also supports this and as chairperson of the CDRRMC, they will coordinate with the Sangguniang Panlungsod for the approval process.

text: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑯𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒂 𝑨𝒏𝒅𝒂𝒔𝒂
english: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑯𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒂 𝑨𝒏𝒅𝒔𝒂

text: Liwat nga maga-atubang si anay House Speaker Martin Romualdez sa hearing sang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) sa masunod nga semana may kaangtanan sa gin-aalegar nga irregularidad sa mga flood control projects, suno kay ICI Executive Director Brian Keith Hosaka.
english: Former House Speaker Martin Romualdez will again appear before the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) hearing next week over alleged irregularities in flood control projects, ICI Executive Director Brian Keith Hosaka said.

text: Natalana ang ikatatlo nga hearing ni Romualdez sa Myerkules, Oktubre 22.
english: Romualdez's third hearing is scheduled for Wednesday, October 22.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga semana, nagbisita si Romualdez sa opisina sang ICI sa Taguig agud magtambong sa closed-door hearing sang commission.
english: Last week, Romualdez visited the ICI office in Taguig to attend a closed-door hearing of the commission.

text: Suno kay Hosaka, wala ginpangalanan ni Romualdez ang bisan sin-o nga personalidad nga nalakip sa gin-aalegar nga korapsyon, apang gin-mention niya ang pila ka mga mamalidha nga may kahilabtanan sa national budget.
english: Hosaka said Romualdez did not name any personality involved in the alleged corruption, but he did mention some lawmakers involved in the national budget.

text: Ginpanginwala man sang anay House Speaker nga nagbaton siya sang kickbacks halin sa mga proyekto nga may kaangtanan sa flood control.
english: The former House Speaker also denied receiving kickbacks from flood control-related projects.

text: Ginsiling sang ICI nga ipatawag nila ang mga ginhingadlan nga indibidwal, apang suno kay Hosaka, magadepende pa ini sa resulta sang internal nga pag-istoryahanay sang commission.
english: The ICI said it would summon the named individuals, but Hosaka said it would still depend on the outcome of the commission’s internal talks.

text: Gin-unfollow sang aktres nga si Toni Gonzaga ang iya celebrity friends sa Instagram magluwas lang sa utod sini nga si Alex kag sa iban nga close friends.
english: Actress Toni Gonzaga has unfollowed her celebrity friends on Instagram except for her brother Alex and other close friends.

text: 22 na lang ang nabilin sa following list sang aktres, lakip na ang bana nga si Paul Soriano, utod nga si Alex, kag bana ni Alex nga si Mikee Morada.
english: 22 are left on the actress' following list, including husband Paul Soriano, brother Alex, and Alex's husband Mikee Morada.

text: Kasunod ini sang iya nga kumpirmasyon nga nagpaalam na siya bilang main host sa show nga Pinoy Big Brother (PBB).
english: This follows his confirmation that he has said goodbye as the main host of the show Pinoy Big Brother (PBB).

text: Kasunod man ini sang iya nga pag-host sa grand proclamation rally sang BBM-Sara UniTeam sang Martes, Pebrero 8, nga nag-angkon sang pagkadismaya halin sa publiko kag sa iban nga Kapamilya artists.
english: This also follows his hosting of the grand proclamation rally of the BBM-Sara UniTeam on Tuesday, February 8, which drew disappointment from the public and other Kapamilya artists.

text: As of press time, may 7 million followers si Toni sa Instagram.
english: As of press time, Toni has 7 million followers on Instagram.

text: Sa isa naman ka post subong nga Pebrero 9, ginpahayag ni Alex ang iya nga suporta kay Toni.
english: In another post on February 9, Alex expressed his support for Toni.

text: “You’re a queen forever!
english: “You’re a queen forever!

text: Nobody does it like you do sissszzz,” komento ni Alex.
english: Nobody does it like you do sissszzz,” Alex commented.

text: Nakabaton man si Toni sang suporta halin sa iya bana nga si Direk Paul nga nag-like man sa iya nga IG post.
english: Toni also received support from her husband Direk Paul who also liked her IG post.

text: Isa ka man bala sa napa-singgit kag naadik sa South Korean coming-of-age zombie television series nga All of Us Are Dead?
english: Are you one of those who are hooked on the South Korean coming-of-age zombie television series All of Us Are Dead?

text: Ini ang nangin top one most viewed content sa Netflix nga gin-istoryahan gid sang kadam-an sa bilog nga kalibutan kag ini nga 12-episode series ang nag-land man sa Top 10 list sa 91 ka mga pungsod lakip na ang Pilipinas halin sang premiere sini sang Enero 28.
english: It has become the top one most viewed content on Netflix that has been talked about by many people around the world and this 12-episode series has also landed in the Top 10 list in 91 countries including the Philippines since its premiere on January 28.

text: Pat-od nga mapa-‘Sana all ka’ bangud isa sa cast members sa sini nga serye ang tumandok sang Sitio Pamumbungan, Barangay Milibili, Roxas City, Capiz.
english: You will definitely be 'Sana all ka' because one of the cast members in this series is a native of Sitio Pamumbungan, Barangay Milibili, Roxas City, Capiz.

text: Ini amo si Noreen Joyce Guerra, 30, nga naga-trabaho man bilang isa ka manager sa isa ka financial company sa Seoul, Korea.
english: This is Noreen Joyce Guerra, 30, who also works as a manager at a financial company in Seoul, Korea.

text: Antes ang acting career sa South Korea, nag-graduate si Guerra sa University of the Philippines Visayas (UPV) – Iloilo kag nagtuon man sa Korean Cultural Center in the Philippines.
english: Before her acting career in South Korea, Guerra graduated from the University of the Philippines Visayas (UPV) – Iloilo and also studied at the Korean Cultural Center in the Philippines.

text: Paagi sa na-earn nga scholarship, nag-proceed ini sa South Korea para sa iya nga master’s degree sa Business Administration Major in Marketing.
english: Through the scholarship, he proceeded to South Korea for his master's degree in Business Administration Major in Marketing.

text: Bangud sa iya anay nga mga koneksyon sa industry sang diri pa sa Korean Cultural Center sa Pilipinas, nangin paagi ini agud nga makatrabaho man siya sa fashion show events, movies, kag drama awards sa South Korea apang sang amo nga tion, yara pa lang siya sa likod sang stage.
english: Due to her previous connections in the industry when she was here at the Korean Cultural Center in the Philippines, it became a way for her to also work in fashion show events, movies, and drama awards in South Korea but at that time, she was still behind the stage.

text: Sang ulihi, nahatagan sang kahigayunan si Guerra nga maka-act sa atubang sang camera, kag bangud man sa iya skills sa Korean roles ilabi na sa pang-high school nga mga roles, nangin sunod-sunod na ang iya nga mga nasudlan nga proyekto.
english: Later, Guerra was given the opportunity to act in front of the camera, and because of his skills in Korean roles especially in high school roles, he has been involved in a series of projects.

text: Sa anum ka tuig nga pagtinir sa South Korea, nangin kabahin na si Guerra sang 85 ka Korean dramas, 5 ka movies, kag kapin 10 ka commercials.
english: In six years in South Korea, Guerra has been part of 85 Korean dramas, 5 movies, and more than 10 commercials.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Guerra, iya ginpahayag nga hobby lang niya ang acting gani nga ginahimo lang niya ini sa weekends ukon sa holidays bangud mas nakatutok siya gihapon sa iya trabaho bilang isa ka manager sa isa ka financial company.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Guerra said that acting is his hobby and he only does it on weekends or holidays because he is still focused on his job as a manager in a financial company.

text: Indi man basta-basta ang nangin kaupod sini sa mga proyekto bangud lakip diri ang pila ka mga aktor kag aktres nga nagapakilig sa Filipino fans: sandayLee-Min Ho, Park Bo-gum, Hyun Bin, aktres nga si Song Hye-kyo, kag aktres nga si Kim Tae-hee.
english: It's not easy to be with him in the projects because it includes some actors and actresses who are exciting Filipino fans: Lee-Min Ho, Park Bo-gum, Hyun Bin, actress Song Hye-kyo, and actress Kim Tae-hee.

text: Tuman naman ang pagpasalamat ni Guerra sa mga Ilonggo nga nagsuporta gid sa ila nga hit Korean zombie series.
english: Guerra expressed his gratitude to the Ilonggos who supported their hit Korean zombie series.

text: Nagalaum man ini nga padayon nga suportahan ang iban pa nga mga proyekto sa South Korea.
english: It also hopes to continue supporting other projects in South Korea.

text: Kabahin si Guerra sang isa pa ka South Korean movie nga natalana naman nga ipa-guwa sa bulan sang Abril subong nga tuig.
english: Guerra is part of another South Korean movie that is scheduled to be released in April this year.

text: Naghatag sang bugal sa Pilipinas ang Grade 10 students sang PAREF Westbridge School matapos nagdaog sa International Science and Math Olympiad Competition of Southeast Asia (ISOCSEA) sa Chiang Mai, Thailand.
english: The Grade 10 students of PAREF Westbridge School made the Philippines proud after winning the International Science and Math Olympiad Competition of Southeast Asia (ISOCSEA) in Chiang Mai, Thailand.

text: Ang kompetisyon ang ginpatigayon sang Disyembre 20 tubtob 24, 2024.
english: The competition was held from December 20 to 24, 2024.

text: Lakip sa mga nakakuha sang gold medal sa International Science Olympiad Competition of Southeast Asia amo sanday Shaun Ryielle Yap, Jose Iñigo Sotelo, Jose Gabriel Amarante kag Gualfredo Ramon Servano.
english: Among the gold medalists at the International Science Olympiad Competition of Southeast Asia were Shaun Ryielle Yap, Jose Iñigo Sotelo, Jose Gabriel Amarante and Gualfredo Ramon Servano.

text: Magluwas diri, nakakuha man sang bronze medal si Yap sa International Math Olympiad Competition.
english: Yap also won a bronze medal in the International Math Olympiad Competition.

text: Nagpasakop ang mga ini sa national rounds sa Pilipinas antes nakalab-ot sa international rounds.
english: They participated in the national rounds in the Philippines before reaching the international rounds.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Yap, residente sang Bitoon, Jaro, Iloilo City, iya ginpahayag nga ini na ang iya ikatatlo nga beses nga nagpasakop sa kompetisyon sa diin una diri ang sa  Malaysia, Hong Kong kag pinakaulihi naman sa Thailand.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Yap, a resident of Bitoon, Jaro, Iloilo City, said this is his third time participating in the competition.

text: Nakakuha ini sang gold medal sa Malaysia kag bronze medal sa Hong Kong.
english: It won a gold medal in Malaysia and a bronze medal in Hong Kong.

text: Nahimo naman sini nga mabalanse ang pagtuon kag ang extra-curricular activities bilang President sang Student Council.
english: He was able to balance his studies and extra-curricular activities as President of the Student Council.

text: Wala naman nagalaom si Sotelo nga magdaog ini sa pinakauna niya nga pagpasakop sa kompetisyon.
english: Sotelo did not expect to win his first competition.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Sotelo, residente sang Don Francisco Village sa M.H. Del Pilar, Jaro, Iloilo City, iya ginpahayag nga ang iya gid nga mga ginikanan ang nagtulod sa iya nga magpasakop sa kompetisyon kag nagapasalamat man ini sa iya lolo kag lola.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Sotelo, resident of Don Francisco Village in M.H. Del Pilar, Jaro, Iloilo City, he said that his parents encouraged him to participate in the competition and he is also grateful to his grandparents.

text: Bilang isa ka varsity player sa football, gin-ako ni Sotelo nga ginsakripisyo sini ang iya hampang, agud makatutok sa pagtuon.
english: As a varsity player in football, Sotelo admitted he sacrificed his game, in order to focus on studies.

text: Suno naman kay Servano sang Ungka, Jaro, Iloilo City, iya ginpahayag nga dungan sila nga classmates nga nagatuon sa tion nga matapos ang klase.
english: Servano of Ungka, Jaro, Iloilo City said they were classmates who studied together after school.

text: Nangin dako man nga bulig ang ila manunudlo nga si Bryan Tagabe sa ila training.
english: Their teacher, Bryan Tagabe, was also a big help in their training.

text: Kaangay ni Sotelo, ginbalanse man sini ang iya paghampang sang football kag pagtuon.
english: Like Sotelo, he also balanced playing football with studies.

text: Nakapili na ang Team Scottie kag ang Team Japeth sang ila mga kaupdanan para sa pagbalik sang Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) All-Star Game nga patigayunon sa Marso 12 sa Passi City.
english: Team Scottie and Team Japeth have already selected their partners for the return of the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) All-Star Game to be held on March 12 in Passi City.

text: Una nga nagpili si team captain Scottie Thompson kag ang ginpasulabi sini amo ang iya Barangay Ginebra teammate nga si Christian Standhardinger.
english: Team captain Scottie Thompson chose first and preferred his Barangay Ginebra teammate Christian Standhardinger.

text: Ginpili naman sang team Japeth Aguilar ang six-time Most Valuable Player (MVP) nga si June Mar Fajardo.
english: Team Japeth Aguilar selected six-time Most Valuable Player (MVP) June Mar Fajardo.

text: Magluwas kay Standhardinger, yara man sa Team Scottie sanday CJ Perez sang San Miguel; Calvin Abueva sang Magnolia; Robert Bolick sang NorthPort; Arvin Tolentino sang NorthPort; Kevin Alas sang NLEX; Jayson Castro sang TNT; Stanley Pringle sang Barangay Ginebra; Marcio Lassiter sang San Miguel; Mark Barroca sang Magnolia; kag James Yap sang Rain or Shine.
english: In addition to Standhardinger, Team Scottie also includes CJ Perez of San Miguel; Calvin Abueva of Magnolia; Robert Bolick of NorthPort; Arvin Tolentino of NorthPort; Kevin Alas of NLEX; Jayson Castro of TNT; Stanley Pringle of Barangay Ginebra; Marcio Lassiter of San Miguel; Mark Barroca of Magnolia; and James Yap of Rain or Shine.

text: Mabaskog man ang Team Japeth kun sa diin yara si Jamie Malonzo sang Ginebra; Chris Newsome sang Meralco; Roger Pogoy sang TNT; LA Tenorio sang Barangay Ginebra; Mikey Williams sang TNT; Paul Lee sang Magnolia; Jeremiah Gray sang Barangay Ginebra; Gian Mamuyac sang Rain or Shine; Nards Pinto sang Barangay Ginebra; kag Terrence Romeo sang San Miguel.
english: Team Japeth is also strong with Jamie Malonzo of Ginebra; Chris Newsome of Meralco; Roger Pogoy of TNT; LA Tenorio of Barangay Ginebra; Mikey Williams of TNT; Paul Lee of Magnolia; Jeremiah Gray of Barangay Ginebra; Gian Mamuyac sang Rain or Shine; Nards Pinto of Barangay Ginebra; and Terrence Romeo of San Miguel.

text: Sa All-Star festivities sa Passi City sa Marso, may iban man nga balantayan nga aktibidad kaangay sang Slam Dunk Challenge, Skills Contest, kag Three-Point Shooting contest.
english: During the All-Star festivities in Passi City in March, there will also be other activities to watch such as the Slam Dunk Challenge, Skills Contest, and Three-Point Shooting contest.

text: Ginkilala sang Guinness World Record ang Probinsiya sang Sorsogon bangud sa paghimo sang nut brittle sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: The Guinness World Record recognized the Province of Sorsogon for producing nut brittle in the world.

text: Masobra 200 ka mga volunteers ang nagtipon-tipon sa Provincial Gymnasium sang Sorsogon kag naggamit sang 1,400 ka kilo sang pili nuts nga naghalin sa mga lokal na mangunguma.
english: More than 200 volunteers gathered at the Provincial Gymnasium of Sorsogon and used 1,400 kilos of pili nuts from local farmers.

text: Matapos ang pila ka oras nga pagluto, nakahimo sila sang pili nut brittle na may kadakuon sa 144.16 square meters nga katumbas sang one-third sang isa ka basketball court.
english: After several hours of cooking, they produced a pili nut brittle that measured 144.16 square meters, equivalent to one-third of a basketball court.

text: Ginsiling ni Jerome Dio sang Museo Sorsogon acting curator kag organizer sang Guinness World Record Official Attempt nga tinutuyo nila nga makilala ang ila rehiyon bilang Pili Capital sang pungsod.
english: Jerome Dio of Museo Sorsogon acting curator and organizer of the Guinness World Record Official Attempt said they aim to recognize their region as the Pili Capital of the country.

text: Ka-Bombo, ano ang mas naluyagan mo sa pandesal?
english: Ka-Bombo, what do you like more about pandesal?

text: Ang medyo ma-alat alat, ukon ang matam-is?
english: The slightly salty, or the sweet?

text: Sa tunga sang nagasaka nga presyo sa kalamay sa Pilipinas, may grupo sang community bakers nga nagaduso nga ibalik ang traditional “salty” pandesal ukon ang medyo ma-alat alat nga sahi sang pandesal.
english: Amid the rising price of sugarcane in the Philippines, there is a group of community bakers who are pushing to bring back the traditional “salty” pandesal or the slightly salty type of pandesal.

text: Suno kay Asosayon ng Panaderong Pilipino president Lucito Chavez, madamo na sang magagmay nga bakeries sa pungsod ang napilitan nga magsirado bangud sa padayon nga pagsaka sang presyo sang ingredients sa paghimo sini.
english: According to Asosayon ​​ng Panaderong Pilipino president Lucito Chavez, many small bakeries in the country have been forced to close due to the continuous rise in the price of ingredients to make them.

text: Bangud sini, ginakonsiderar sang grupo nga i-reformulate ang pandesal recipe agud mahimo ini nga maasin-asin.
english: Because of this, the team is considering reformulating the pandesal recipe to make it salty.

text: Sa pagkamatuod, ang pandesal nagakahulugan sang “salt bread” apang diri sa Pilipinas, masami nga matam-is ang sabor sini.
english: Actually, pandesal means “salt bread” but here in the Philippines, it usually tastes sweet.

text: Kaangot diri, nagapanawagan si Chavez sa iban pa nga mga panadero nga tun-an liwat ang traditional nga recipe kag ipatilaw sa mga kabataan ang sabor.
english: In this regard, Chavez called on other bakers to relearn the traditional recipe and make children taste it.

text: Ginpanugyan man sini nga i-include ang healthy additives sa bread products kaangay sang kalabasa, kamote, carrots, kag balunggay.
english: He also suggested including healthy additives in bread products such as pumpkin, sweet potatoes, carrots, and bananas.

text: Sa bahin naman sang Department of Agriculture ginasuportahan sini ang nasambit nga ideya kag nagpahayag man nga may mga tikang na nga ginahimo agud nga ma-address ang nagasaka nga presyo sang ingredients.
english: The Department of Agriculture, on the other hand, supports the idea and said that steps are being taken to address the rising prices of ingredients.

text: Kun matandaan, ang Department of Agriculture kaupod ang Department of Trade and Industry, Department of Science and Technology kag ang private sector ang naglunsar anay sang “coco pandesal” — ang version sang bread roll nga human sa coconut flour.
english: The Department of Agriculture together with the Department of Trade and Industry, Department of Science and Technology and the private sector launched the “coco pandesal” — the version of bread roll made from coconut flour.

text: Ang pagdevelop sang flour variant ang isa ka tikang agud nga mabuligan ang community bakers bangud mas barato ini ipaanggid sa naandan nga flour kag madamo pa sang benepisyo sa ikaayong lawas.
english: The development of the flour variant is a step to help community bakers because it is cheaper than conventional flour and has many health benefits.

text: Liwat nga napilian bilang Deputy Majority Floor Leader si Iloilo City Lone District Congresswoman Julienne “Jamjam” Baronda sa 20th congress.
english: Iloilo City Lone District Congresswoman Julienne “Jamjam” Baronda was re-elected as Deputy Majority Floor Leader in the 20th congress.

text: Ini na ang ikaduha nga kahigayunan sa diin iya man gin-uyatan sang 19th congress.
english: This is the second time he has served in the 19th congress.

text: Samtang, matunog naman nga ginpalakpakan sang mga kongresista ang pagpili kay Iloilo 3rd District Congressman Lorenz Defensor bilang senior deputy majority leader sa 20th Congress.
english: Meanwhile, the congressmen loudly applauded the election of Iloilo 3rd District Congressman Lorenz Defensor as senior deputy majority leader in the 20th Congress.

text: Mismo si Ilocos Norte 1st District Congressman kag majority leader nga si Ferdinand Alexander “Sandro” Marcos ang nagduso sang motion.
english: Ilocos Norte 1st District Congressman and majority leader Ferdinand Alexander “Sandro” Marcos himself proposed the motion.

text: Sang 19th Congress, si Defensor ang deputy majority leader kag nangin kabahin sang house prosecutors para sa impeachment ni Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: In the 19th Congress, Defensor was the deputy majority leader and was part of the house prosecutors for the impeachment of Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Sang Hulyo 28, nangin acting floor leader siya sa pinakauna nga regular session sang Kamara kun sa diin, napilian bilang majority leader si Ilocos Norte 1st District Congressman Ferdinand Alexander “Sandro” Marcos.
english: On July 28, he became the acting floor leader in the first regular session of the House of Representatives where Ilocos Norte 1st District Congressman Ferdinand Alexander “Sandro” Marcos was elected as the majority leader.

text: Si Defensor ang yara na sa iya ikatatlo kag katapusan niya nga termino.
english: Defensor is now in his third and final term.

text: Apisar bag-o pa lang gin-seryoso ang sports, nagapanglaka-ak na sa Metro Manila ang abilidad sang 17-anyos nga si Nash Candelario nga subong ginakilala nga Manila Meet Sprint King.
english: Although the sport has just been taken seriously, the skills of 17-year-old Nash Candelario, now known as the Manila Meet Sprint King, are already spreading in Metro Manila.

text: Tumandok sang Barangay Napnapan, Tigbauan, Iloilo ang pamilya ni Nash.
english: Nash's family is a native of Barangay Napnapan, Tigbauan, Iloilo.

text: Anak siya sang Ilonggo kag former Southeast Asian Games 400 meters gold medalist nga si Ernie Candelario.
english: He is the son of Ilonggo and former Southeast Asian Games 400 meters gold medalist Ernie Candelario.

text: Sa bag-o lang nagtapos nga Manila Athletics Meet sa Pasig City, tatlo gid ka gold medals ang nabulsa ni Nash matapos mangibababaw sa 400, 100, kag 200 meters sprint.
english: At the recently concluded Manila Athletics Meet in Pasig City, Nash won three gold medals after dominating the 400, 100, and 200 meters sprint.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa Ilonggo athlete, ginpahayag sini nga nagpasakop siya sa Iloilo Invitation Sports Championship sang nagligad nga tuig, apang samtang yara sa 200-meter dash, nadasma siya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, the Ilonggo athlete said he participated in the Iloilo Invitation Sports Championship last year, but while in the 200-meter dash, he crashed.

text: Ang iya mga kalutusan suno sa iya ang nagtulod sa iya nga mag-seryoso na sa sports kag mas mangin mapisan sa training ilabi na bangud coach man niya ang iya amay nga isa ka Southeast Asian champion.
english: His failures, he said, pushed him to take sports seriously and be more diligent in training especially since he also coached his father who is a Southeast Asian champion.

text: Grade 12 na si Nash sa Adamson University sa Manila kag subong nagabaton sang offer halin sa top-tier universities sa Metro Manila para sa iya tertiary education.
english: Nash is in Grade 12 at Adamson University in Manila and is currently receiving offers from top-tier universities in Metro Manila for his tertiary education.

text: Gin-share sini nga ultimate goal niya nga mangin kabahin sang national team sang Pilipinas, kag malapawan ang rekord sang iya amay.
english: He shared that his ultimate goal is to be part of the Philippine national team, and surpass his father's record.

text: Ginhingadlan bilang national hero sang Barbados ang 33-anyos nga singer and makeup mogul nga si Rihanna.
english: 33-year-old singer and makeup mogul Rihanna has been named Barbados' national hero.

text: Opisyal nga ginpakilala si Rihanna dala ang amo nga titulo kadungan sang seremonya sang ginselebrar sang Barbados ang bag-o sini nga status bilang isa na ka Republika.
english: Rihanna was officially introduced with the title during a ceremony when Barbados celebrated its new status as a Republic.

text: Ginpakilala si Rihanna bilang “designee for national hero of Barbados, ambassador Robyn Rihanna Fenty”.
english: Rihanna was introduced as “designee for national hero of Barbados, ambassador Robyn Rihanna Fenty”.

text: Nabun-ag ang amo nga singer sa Saint Michael kag ginpadaku sa Bridgetown, Barbados.
english: The singer was born in Saint Michael and raised in Bridgetown, Barbados.

text: Sang teenager na, nagsaylo siya sa United States agud i-pursue ang iya nga music career.
english: As a teenager, he moved to the United States to pursue his music career.

text: Nangin ambassador of Barbados siya sang 2018, kag nangin cultural ambassador man sang amo nga pungsod sang 2008.
english: He became ambassador of Barbados in 2018, and cultural ambassador of that country in 2008.

text: Sa amo man nga seremonya, nagsumpa bilang first elected president sang Barbados si Sandra Mason, kag ginkakas si Queen Elizabeth II sang Britanya bilang ila head of state.
english: At the same ceremony, Sandra Mason was sworn in as Barbados' first elected president, and Queen Elizabeth II of Britain was removed as their head of state.

text: Gintumod sang otoridad nga wala sang kaangtanan sa terorista nga pagpang-atake ang pagsigabong sang Tesla Cybertruck sa guwa sang Trump hotel sa Las Vegas, Nevada, USA.
english: Authorities have ruled that the Tesla Cybertruck explosion outside the Trump hotel in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA, has nothing to do with a terrorist attack.

text: Sa baylo, ang nadiskubrehan sang mga imbestigador amo nga nagasuprer sang post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) ang 37-anyos nga decorated Green Beret nga si Matthew Livelsberger nga amo ang nagadala sang salakyan.
english: Instead, what investigators discovered was that 37-year-old decorated Green Beret Matthew Livelsberger, who was driving the vehicle, was suffering from post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD).

text: Miyembro ang natungdan sang elite US Special Forces kag naka-leave sa trabaho sang natabo ang insidente.
english: The suspect was a member of the elite US Special Forces and was on leave from work when the incident occurred.

text: Gintiro sini ang iya kaugalingon sa mismo New Year’s Day sa sulod sang cybertruck nga puno sang fuel containers kag fireworks rason sang pagsigabong.
english: He shot himself on New Year's Day inside a cybertruck loaded with fuel containers and fireworks causing a fire.

text: Pito ka mga tawo malapit sa hotel ang napilasan man kadungan sang hitabo.
english: Seven people near the hotel were also injured during the incident.

text: Suno pa sa Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), may nakit-an sila nga duha ka sulat sa phone sang soldado kun sa diin ginpangbutang sini kun ano kabudlay para sa iya ang pagpatay kag iban pa nga mga isyu.
english: According to the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), they found two letters on the soldier's phone in which he expressed how difficult it was for him to kill and other issues.

text: Ginklaro man nga bisan natabo ang insidente sa guwa sang hotel nga ginapanag-iyahan ni US President-elect Donald Trump, wala ini sang kaangtanan ukon kalain sang buot sa amo nga Republican leader.
english: He also clarified that although the incident occurred outside the hotel owned by US President-elect Donald Trump, it had nothing to do with the Republican leader.

text: Ginalantaw man sang FBI nga may mga isyu pa sa personal nga bahin kag sa pamilya nga mahimo nagtulod sa soldado sa pagpanginmatay.
english: The FBI also believes that there were other personal and family issues that may have led the soldier to commit suicide.

text: Bangud sini nga imbestigasyon, gin-athag naman sang otoridad nga wala sang kaangtanan ang insidente sa Las Vegas sa pagpang-atake sa New Orleans, Louisiana kun sa diin isa ka US army veteran nga tampad sa Islamic State jihadist group ang nang-arado sang mga tawo samtang nagaselebrar sang New Year.
english: Due to this investigation, the authorities clarified that the incident in Las Vegas is not related to the attack in New Orleans, Louisiana where a US army veteran loyal to the Islamic State jihadist group plowed people while celebrating the New Year.

text: 14 ang patay sa amo nga krimen.
english: 14 people were killed in the crime.

text: Patay man ang suspek sang nagbato ini sa mga pulis.
english: The suspect was also killed when he threw stones at the police.

text: Liwat nga nabuhi ang istorya natuhoy sa ginapahayag ‘sumpa sa paghigugma’ sa likod sang Miss Universe Philippines crown.
english: The story of the alleged 'love curse' behind the Miss Universe Philippines crown has come to life again.

text: Kasunod ini sang kumpirmasyon nga bulagay na matuod sanday Miss Universe Philippines 2021 Beatrice Luigi Gomez kag ang long-time girlfriend sini nga si Kate Jagdon nga naka-relasyon niya sa sulod sang kapin 7 ka tuig.
english: This follows the confirmation that Miss Universe Philippines 2021 Beatrice Luigi Gomez and her long-time girlfriend Kate Jagdon, whom she has been in a relationship with for more than 7 years, are indeed separated.

text: Ang tuhay lang subong sa istorya, gintapos na nga daan nanday Bea kag Kate ang ila same-sex relationship antes pa man magpasakop si Bea sa 70th Miss Universe sa Israel sa December 12, 2021.
english: The only difference now in the story is that Bea and Kate had already ended their same-sex relationship before Bea was to compete in the 70th Miss Universe in Israel on December 12, 2021.

text: Indi malikawan sang mga netizens nga balikan ang relationships sang iban man nga past winners sang Miss Universe Philippines.
english: Netizens can't help but look back at the relationships of other past winners of Miss Universe Philippines.

text: Matapos nagdaug bilang 1st runner-up sa 48th Miss Universe sa Trinidad and Tobago sang May 26,1999, nagbulag si Miriam Quiambao sa iya boyfriend nga si Martin Bernardo.
english: After winning as 1st runner-up in the 48th Miss Universe in Trinidad and Tobago on May 26, 1999, Miriam Quiambao broke up with her boyfriend Martin Bernardo.

text: First runner-up man si Janine Tugonon sa 61st Miss Universe sa Las Vegas, Nevada sang December 19, 2012 apang sang ulihi, natapos man ang ila relasyon sang boyfriend nga si Jaypee Santos.
english: Janine Tugonon was also first runner-up in the 61st Miss Universe in Las Vegas, Nevada on December 19, 2012 but later, her relationship with her boyfriend Jaypee Santos ended.

text: Wala man sini ginpalampas si Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray.
english: Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray was not left out.

text: Nag-break sanday Cat kag Clint Bondad matapos nadag-an ni Cat ang korona sa 67th Miss Universe sang December 17, 2018 sa Bangkok, Thailand.
english: Cat and Clint Bondad broke up after Cat won the crown at the 67th Miss Universe on December 17, 2018 in Bangkok, Thailand.

text: May entry man ang Ilongga beauty queen kag Miss Universe Philippines 2020 nga si Rabiya Mateo bangud apisar sang promisa sini nga indi sila magbulagay sang boyfriend nga si Neil Salvacion bisan makuha niya ang korona, nagbulagay man gihapon sila.
english: Ilongga beauty queen and Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo also had an entry because despite her promise that she would not break up with her boyfriend Neil Salvacion even if he won the crown, they still broke up.

text: — with a report from PEP.ph
english: — with a report from PEP.ph

text: May kapasidad pa bala ang mga lokal nga panguluhan sa Iloilo sa pagtapna sang padayon nga pagbaha kag epekto sang climate change?
english: Do local government units in Iloilo still have the capacity to prevent continued flooding and the effects of climate change?

text: Para kay Board Member Rolando Distura, kinahanglan sang bag-o nga direksyon kag mas epektibo nga disaster strategies bangud sang climate-change.
english: For Board Member Rolando Distura, climate-change requires a new direction and more effective disaster strategies.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Board Member Rolando Distura, Chairman sang Committee on Disaster Risk Reduction and Management, iya ginpabutyag nga dapat na kilalahon sang tanan ang realidad sang “new normal” sa kalamidad kag ang kinahanglanon nga magbag-o man sang mga estratehiya sa lokal nga lebel.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Board Member Rolando Distura, Chairman of the Committee on Disaster Risk Reduction and Management, said that everyone should recognize the reality of the “new normal” in disasters and the need to change strategies at the local level.

text: Suno kay BM Distura, indi na mabawi ang epekto sang climate change gani kinahanglan nga mag-adoptar ang mga local government units sang mas epektibo nga mga tikang para ma-mitigate ang epekto sini.
english: According to BM Distura, the effects of climate change are irreversible and local government units need to adopt more effective measures to mitigate its effects.

text: Iya ginpunto nga dapat sundon ang Comprehensive Land Use Plan, may malig-on nga Disaster Management Plan, kag istrikto nga implementasyon sang National Building Code sa mga high-risk areas.
english: He pointed out that the Comprehensive Land Use Plan, a solid Disaster Management Plan, and strict implementation of the National Building Code in high-risk areas must be followed.

text: Dugang pa niya, isa sa mga aktibidad nga ginhimo amo ang pagpahamtang sang mga DOLE-TUPAD workers para magtinlu sang mga cross-drainage systems sa mga banwa.
english: He added that one of the activities carried out was the deployment of DOLE-TUPAD workers to clean the cross-drainage systems in the towns.

text: Gintumod man niya ang kahalugan sang database policy kag ang regular nga pag-review sang disaster plans agud siguruhon nga epektibo kag up-to-date ini sa kahimtangan subong.
english: He also pointed out the importance of the database policy and the regular review of disaster plans to ensure that they are effective and up-to-date with the current situation.

text: Suno sa iya, indi malikawan nga isa sa mga dako nga problema sang probinsya amo ang pagbaha, kag dapat tutukan ini sa paagi sang pagsunod sa mga polisiya.
english: He said it is inevitable that one of the biggest problems of the province is flooding, and it should be addressed through the implementation of policies.

text: Nagpanawagan man siya nga gamiton ang science and technology sa pagporma sang mga flood control systems nga mas angay sa present nga sitwasyon.
english: He also called for the use of science and technology to form flood control systems that are more suitable for the present situation.

text: Nalutos ang Kaya Football Club-Iloilo sa una sini nga home game subong nga tuig nga ginpatigayon sa Iloilo Sports Complex.
english: Kaya Football Club-Iloilo lost its first home game this year held at the Iloilo Sports Complex.

text: Nangibabaw ang Dynamic Herb Cebu, 3-2, sa hampang matapos ang goal nanday Daniel Gadia, Leaford Allen, kag Jacob Liao.
english: Dynamic Herb Cebu won the game, 3-2, after goals from Daniel Gadia, Leaford Allen, and Jacob Liao.

text: Isahanon naman ang league top scorer nga si Daizo Horikoshi nga naka-goal para sa Iloilo-based club sa ika-35 kag ika-60 nga minuto sang hampang.
english: League top scorer Daizo Horikoshi scored alone for the Iloilo-based club in the 35th and 60th minutes.

text: Nangin talalupangdon man sa match ang tensyon antes ang half-time matapos ginpaguwa-an sang red card sanday Gadia kag Kaya defender nga si Simone Rota kasunod sang foul nga nakomiter sang Cebu midfielder.
english: Tension was also highlighted in the match before half-time after Gadia and Kaya defender Simone Rota were shown red cards following a foul committed by the Cebu midfielder.

text: Ini ang una nga kalutusan sang Kaya sa home soil halin sang 2018.
english: It was Kaya’s first defeat on home soil since 2018.

text: Antes ang hampang sa Iloilo Sports Complex, nakasambuwa na ang Kaya kag ang Dynamic Herb sang makaduha ka beses kun sa diin Kaya ang daog sa una nga encounter sa Rizal Memorial Football Stadium samtang nagbawi naman ang Dynamic Herb sa ikaduha nga pagkitaay sa Cebu City.
english: Before the match at the Iloilo Sports Complex, Kaya and Dynamic Herb had already met twice where Kaya won the first encounter at the Rizal Memorial Football Stadium while Dynamic Herb recovered in the second encounter in Cebu City.

text: Bangud sa kadalag-an sa resumption sang 2022-2023 Philippines Football League, nag-improve na ang Cebu sa 24 points, anum ka puntos nga mas manubo sa 30 ka puntos sang Kaya nga amo ang yara subong sa pinakaibabaw sang standings.
english: With the victory in the resumption of the 2022-2023 Philippines Football League, Cebu has improved to 24 points, six points below the 30 points of Kaya who are currently at the top of the standings.

text: Lakip ang mag-utod nga Pinay sa tatlo nga napatay bangud sa pagsigabong sang fireworks sa Honolulu, Hawaii kadungan sang pagsug-alaw sa New Year.
english: The Filipino brothers were among three killed in fireworks in Honolulu, Hawaii during the New Year celebrations.

text: Ginkilala ini nga sanday Carmelita Turalva Benigno kag Nelly Turalva Ibarra.
english: They were identified as Carmelita Turalva Benigno and Nelly Turalva Ibarra.

text: Ang duha ka mga bata ni Carmelita, iya hinablos, kag ang iya tatlo ka tuig nga apo ang nasunog man kag subong yara pa sa ospital.
english: Carmelita's two children, her nephew, and her three-year-old grandson were also burned and are still in the hospital.

text: Ang ginhalinan sang pagsigabong amo ang ginatawag sang otoridad nga “cake” ukon ang cluster sang tubes nga may unod nga tubtub sa 50 aerial rockets.
english: The source of the explosion was what authorities called a “cake” or a cluster of tubes containing up to 50 aerial rockets.

text: Base sa inisyal nga reports, masobra ka 30 ka mga tawo ang nasamaran sa amo nga explosion apang natalana pa nga ipaguwa sang otoridad ang mga pangalan kag kun pila gid man ang nakaangkon sang injuries.
english: According to initial reports, more than 30 people were injured in the explosion but authorities are yet to release the names and number of injuries.

text: Ini man nga insidente ang ginakabig nga pinakamalala nga fireworks-related incident sa Hawaii sa sulod sang 14 ka tuig.
english: This same incident is considered the worst fireworks-related incident in Hawaii in 14 years.

text: Padayon ang pag-monitor sang Philippine consulate general sa Honolulu sa sitwasyon kag nagapakig-angot man sa Honolulu Police Department.
english: The Philippine consulate general in Honolulu continues to monitor the situation and is also in contact with the Honolulu Police Department.

text: Nagalaum ang Alas Pilipinas Women’s volleyball team nga matapos na ang duha ka dekada nga medal drought sa masunod nga 33rd Southeast Asian Games sa Thailand.
english: The Alas Pilipinas Women’s volleyball team hopes to end its two-decade medal drought at the upcoming 33rd Southeast Asian Games in Thailand.

text: Ini matapos nga nagpagguwa ang Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) sang opisyal nga listahan sang 14 ka players nga magatiglawas sang pungsod.
english: This comes after the Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) released the official list of 14 players who will represent the country.

text: Pangunahan sang beterana nga setter nga si Jia De Guzman ang lineup, upod ang mga libero nga sanday Dawn Catindig kag Justine Jazareno, samtang mangin pwersa sa net defense ang mga blockers nga sanday Dell Palomata kag Maddie Madayag.
english: Veteran setter Jia De Guzman will lead the lineup, along with liberos Dawn Catindig and Justine Jazareno, while blockers Dell Palomata and Maddie Madayag will be a force in net defense.

text: Nalakip man sa listahan ang mga bata-on nga spikers nga sanday Bella Belen, Shaina Nitura, Angel Canino, Alyssa Solomon kag Alleiah Malaluan, kag middle blocker nga si Amie Provido.
english: Also on the list are young spikers Bella Belen, Shaina Nitura, Angel Canino, Alyssa Solomon and Alleiah Malaluan, and middle blocker Amie Provido.

text: Sa frontline offense, yara man ang mga attackers nga sanday Vanie Gandler, Eya Laure, kag setter/opensa nga si Mars Alba.
english: In the frontline offense, there are also attackers Vanie Gandler, Eya Laure, and setter/offense Mars Alba.

text: Ang ila coach amo si Jorge de Brito nga nagpamuno sa Alas Women sa breakthrough sa AVC Nations Cup sini nga tuig kag pila pa ka podium finishes.
english: Their coach is Jorge de Brito who led Alas Women to the breakthrough at the AVC Nations Cup this year and several other podium finishes.

text: Sa nagahilapit nga SEA Games, nagapadayon ang preparasyon sang team nga may dako nga paglaum nga makabalik sa medal standings matapos ang 20-ka-tuig.
english: With the upcoming SEA Games, the team continues to prepare with high hopes of returning to the medal standings after 20 years.

text: Ginkilala ni Iloilo City Vice Mayor Love Baronda ang kinahanglanon nga masolusyunan ang problema sa limitado nga espasyo sa sulod sang session hall, kasunod sang obserbasyon ni Councilor Rudolph Jeffrey Ganzon .
english: Iloilo City Vice Mayor Love Baronda acknowledged the need to solve the problem of limited space inside the session hall, following the observation of Councilor Rudolph Jeffrey Ganzon.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, ginpahayag ni Baronda nga bilang presiding officer, iya man nakita ang kakulangan sa husto nga lugar para sa mga media personnel kag mga bisita, kag ginklaro nga wala man sang kagamo nga natabo, kundi kulang lang gid ang lugar para sa mga nagatindog sa kilid sang session hall.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Baronda said that as presiding officer, he also saw the lack of proper space for media personnel and guests, and clarified that there was no chaos, but there was a lack of space for those standing on the side of the session hall.

text: Suno pa sa iya, indi man dako nga problema ini, apang dapat na nga matutukan agud masiguro nga may husto nga pulungkuan ang mga bisita kag media nga naga-cover sang session.
english: He said this is not a big problem, but it should be addressed to ensure that the guests and media covering the session have the right seats.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Baronda nga ila pagarebyuhon ang kahimtangan sa session hall, nga subong pa lang ikatatlo nga gingamit.
english: Baronda also said they will review the situation in the session hall, which is just being used for the third time.

text: Sampaw-sampaw nga reklamo ang atubangon sang isa ka 33-anyos nga lalaki matapos ini nanghangkat sang away kag nag-spray pa sang gasolina sa isa ka gas station.
english: A 33-year-old man will face multiple charges after he challenged a fight and sprayed gasoline at a gas station.

text: Natabo ini sa Barangay Poblacion Ward 2 sa Minglanilla, Cebu nga nakuhaan pa sang closed circuit television (CCTV).
english: This happened in Barangay Poblacion Ward 2 in Minglanilla, Cebu which was caught on closed circuit television (CCTV).

text: Aga pa sang nagkadto ang lalaki nga si Mamerto Reyes Pandola III sa gas station, kag gin-alegar nga agresibo na nga daan, kag naghangkat gilayon sang tapungulay.
english: The man, Mamerto Reyes Pandola III, went to the gas station early in the morning, and was allegedly aggressive, and immediately challenged the fight.

text: Isa sa iya ginhangkat amo ang operations manager sang gasolinahan nga iya man lang kasilingan.
english: One of his challenges was the operations manager of the gas station who was also his neighbor.

text: Sunod sini nga ginkuha ang fuel hose kag didto na kag gin-spray sini ang gasolina sa palibot.
english: Next he took the fuel hose and there and sprayed the gasoline around.

text: May ginkuha man ini nga botelya, kag sa kahadlok sang mga empleyado nga maglala pa ang iya himuon, gintawag ang pulis.
english: He also picked up a bottle, and with the employees fearing he would do something worse, the police were called.

text: Naglab-ot sa masobra P2,000 ang balor sang gasolina nga gin-usik sang lalaki.
english: The man wasted more than P2,000 worth of gasoline.

text: Gintinguhaan man sini nga magwaras sang nag-abot ang otoridad apang wala na ini sang nahimo sang ginposasan.
english: He also tried to escape when the authorities arrived but could not do anything when he was handcuffed.

text: Sang yara na sa custodial facility, ginsiling sini nga indi na niya madumduman kun ano ang iya ginhimo.
english: Once in the custodial facility, he said he could not remember what he had done.

text: Nagdepensa man siya nga indi siya hubog kag wala man suno sa iya nagagamit sang iligal nga droga.
english: He also defended that he was not drunk and did not use illegal drugs.

text: Lakip sa iya atubangon amo ang reklamo nga alarm and scandal, resistance and disobedience to person in authority, kag malicious mischief.
english: Among the charges he will face are alarm and scandal, resistance and disobedience to person in authority, and malicious mischief.

text: NALANGKAG gid ang aton abyan nga si Pedro sa prediction sang Pag-asa nga masugod na luntad ang El Nino sa Oktubre sa sining tuig sa Filipinas.
english: OUR friend Pedro is very excited about Pag-asa's prediction that El Nino will start to occur in October this year in the Philippines.

text: Kag daw lampason gid sini ang anom ka bulan tubtub Pebrero.
english: And it seems to be more than six months until February.

text: Indi katingalahan kay may diutay siya nga talamnan sang humay kag tapos sang ani sa Setyembre, kon magsugod na gid man ang ulan, masugod na liwat ang tagtalanom.
english: Not surprisingly, he had a small rice field and after the harvest in September, when the rains started, the planting started again.

text: In other words, maabtan ining tagtalanom sa iya uma sang El Nino samtang wala pa ang ani sa pagkaligad sang 3-6 ka bulan depende sa variety sang humay.
english: In other words, this farmer will be caught in his field by El Nino before the harvest after 3-6 months depending on the variety of rice.

text: So, posible maabtan ini sang tagtuyot (drought) ukon bagyo nga pabaskugon sang El Nino kag basi hibian gid niya.
english: So, it is possible that it will be hit by a drought or a typhoon that will be strengthened by El Nino and it will cry.

text: Pobre man ang akon abyan kon matabo.
english: My friend is also poor if it happens.

text: Well may medyos dira Pedro, siling ko nga nagalahog.
english: Well there's something here Pedro, I said with a smile.

text: Itanom ang imo humay sa sulod sang malabodega nga lugar nga ang init makalusot sa salaming nga atop kag mabunyagan ang itanom mo dira tubtub maglipas ang drought ukon bagyo man.
english: Plant your rice inside a warehouse area where the heat can penetrate the glass roof and baptize your plants there until the drought or typhoon passes.

text: Parti sa problema sa El Nino nga ang sobra nga init sini nagatuga sang mabaskug nga bagyo, pwede man naton mapalamig ang Pacific Ocean nga gasakop sang aton pungsod.
english: Regarding the problem of El Nino whose excessive heat causes strong typhoons, we can also cool the Pacific Ocean that covers our country.

text: Paano?
english: How?

text: Ganuyon sang aton mga barko ang mga dalagku nga bloke sang yelo halin sa Arctic Region pakadto sa Pacific Ocean agud maglamig ini kag mapagar ang mala-demonyo sini nga mga bagyo.
english: Our ships drag large blocks of ice from the Arctic Region to the Pacific Ocean to cool them and fend off their demonic storms.

text:
Nagsunggod si Pedro kag nagsiling: “Indi ka man mglahog subong sina…Gaproblema na kita pero daw ginahimo mo lang lango-lango.”

Sorry, siling ko, ginalingaw ko lang ikaw agud indi mo gid pagseryosohon ang problema.
english:
Peter started and said: “Don't be so stupid...We're in trouble but you're just acting like a drunkard.”

Sorry, I said, just entertaining you so you don’t take the problem too seriously.

text: Ginbaton niya ang pagpa-sorry ko.
english: He accepted my apology.

text: Gani gindugang ko nga segurohon lang niya nga ang iya tanom may crop insurance agud indi matam-an.
english: So I added that he should just make sure his plant has crop insurance to avoid overgrowth.

text: Sa masami, may ginabulig man ang gobyerno sa mga mangunguma.
english: Often, the government also helps farmers.
