text: By the way, may pasalig man nga bulig ang gobyerno sa indi mangunguma kon magluntad na ang El Nino.
english: By the way, the government has also promised to help non-farmers when El Nino occurs.

text: Sunu kay PBBM bastante pa ang rice stock naton tubtub sa pagtupa sang El Nino samtang sige luntad sini tubtub sa sunod nga tuig, 2024.
english: According to PBBM, we have enough rice stocks until the arrival of El Nino while it will continue until next year, 2024.

text: Ginpuis ini ugaling ni Pedro.
english: But Peter denied it.

text: “Ti, ngaa subong pa lang ma-import na kita sang bugas?” siling niya.
english: “Well, why should we import rice now?” he said.

text: Lakip dira seguro ang ining pasalig ni PBBM sa aton iga-import, siling ko.
english: That probably includes PBBM's assurance of our imports, I said.

text: Nagtang-tango siya ng daw kumporme man siya.
english: He nodded in agreement.

text: “Ti ngaa nagsaka ang bili sang bugas sing P4 kada kilo sa halos tanan nga lugar sa Filipinas?
english: “So why did the price of rice go up by P4 per kilo in almost every part of the Philippines?

text: Indi bala gapasalig ang Rice Tarrification Law nga mapanubo sini ang presyo sang bugas?
english: Doesn't the Rice Tarrification Law promise to lower the price of rice?

text: Sadtong 2019 siling nila manubo na ang bili sang bugas sa P37 per kilo, pero karon gani may P44 kilo na,” dugang pa niya ugaling.
english: In 2019, they said the price of rice was low at P37 per kilo, but now it is P44 per kilo,” he added.

text: Wala na lang ako magtugda kay wala pa man ako matugda parti sina.
english: I didn't suggest it because I hadn't been suggested about it.

text:
***

INDI INI YA LAHOG… Sunu sa pila ka climatologist nga nagatuon sa kahimtangan sang lakat sang panahon sang sini lang (2023), ang padayon nga pagtunaw sang yelo (ice) sa Greenland, nga bahin sang Arctic Region, daku ang epekto sini sa kalibutan.
english:
***

THIS IS NOT A JOKE... According to some climatologists who are studying the weather conditions recently (2023), the continuous melting of ice in Greenland, part of the Arctic Region, will have a profound impact on the world.

text: Tungod sini, posible matabo ang pagbaliswa sang kuryente sang tubig (sea current) nga pwede mabatyagan na sa pagsugod sang 2025.
english: As a result, there is a possibility of a reversal of the sea current that could be felt in early 2025.

text: Of course, ang iban nagapaandam nga indi man ini dale-dale matabo, ukon indi gid gani matabo.
english: Of course, some warn that this will not happen soon, or at all.

text: Ini nga hitabo, kon tawgon nila amo ang Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC).
english: This phenomenon, when they call it is the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC).

text: Magadala ini sang mainit (warm) nga tubig sa North (pa-North America) kag sa East (pa-Uropa) halin sa Caribbean Islands sa natung-an sang North kag South (Latin) America sa Atlantic Ocean.
english: It will bring warm water North and East from the Caribbean Islands between North and South America in the Atlantic Ocean.

text: Magaresulta ini sa weather changes.
english: This will result in weather changes.

text: Ang North America, nga galakip sang Canada kag US, maka-experyensya, sunu sa ila, sang “more severe hurricanes” kag ang Uropa maka-experyensya sang dugang nga kalamig.
english: North America, which includes Canada and the US, will experience, they said, “more severe hurricanes” and Europe will experience more cold.

text: Of course, siling nila, indi man kinahanglan nga makakita kita sang mga igloos, puluy-an sng mga Eskimo sa Alaska, sa Uropa.
english: Of course, they say, we don't have to see igloos, Eskimo homes in Alaska, in Europe.

text: Indi ayhan may kasubong man nga pagbaliswa sang klima ang mahimo matabo sa Pacific Ocean kon diin kita nagaluntad?/PN
english: Isn't there a similar climate change that could happen in the Pacific Ocean where we exist?/PN

text: Nagapabilin ang mga presyo sang mga pangunahon nga balaklon sa Pilipinas, suno sa Department of Trade and Industry (DTI).
english: Prices of basic commodities remained stable in the Philippines, according to the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI).

text: Ginpahayag sang DTI nga wala nagtaas ang presyo sang delata sang tomato sauce, instant mami noodles, habon nga panglaba, kandila, tinapay, kag mga baterya.
english: The DTI said the prices of cans of tomato sauce, instant mami noodles, laundry soap, candles, bread, and batteries did not increase.

text: Suno sa ahensya, ini nga mga produkto ang nagaporma sang 91 % ukon 186 sa 205 ka stock-keeping units nga yara sa listahan sang basic necessities kag prime commodities.
english: According to the agency, these products form 91% or 186 of the 205 stock-keeping units on the list of basic necessities and prime commodities.

text: Suno kay Trade Secretary Cristina Roque, padayon nga bantayan sang gobyerno ang mga presyo sang mga nagapanguna nga balaklon.
english: According to Trade Secretary Cristina Roque, the government will continue to monitor the prices of basic commodities.

text: Duha ka mga pamilya ang naapektohan sa nagluntad nga sunog sa Brgy.
english: Two families were affected by the fire in Brgy.

text: Calaparan, Arevalo, Iloilo City.
english: Calaparan, Arevalo, Iloilo City.

text: Ang magpamilya amo ang Caro Family, Francisco, Family, kag Pinto Family.
english: The families are the Caro Family, Francisco, Family, and Pinto Family.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Kagawad Rodrigo Montaño sang Brgy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Kagawad Rodrigo Montaño of Brgy.

text: Calaparan, Arevalo, iya ginpahayag nga sa subong, wala pa sang tul-id nga ihibalo kon sa diin nga balay nagsugod ang kalayo.
english: Calaparan, Arevalo, he said that at present, there is no exact knowledge of which house started the fire.

text: Suno kay Montaño, padayon pa nga ginaimbestigaran sang Iloilo City Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) ang nagluntad nga sunog.
english: Montaño said the Iloilo City Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) is still investigating the cause of the fire.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga indi manegar nga tuman ka populated ang ila lugar rason nga medyo nabudlayan sila nga magresponde.
english: He also said that there is no denying that their area is very populated so it is a bit difficult for them to respond.

text: Nahibaluan nga kahapon nga adlaw, duha ka mga sunog ang nagluntad sa Iloilo City kon sa diin, patay gid ang mag-asawa nga manunudlo lakip ang ila anak sa Infante, Molo, samtang ginsundan ini sa Calaparan, Arevalo.
english: It is known that yesterday, two fires broke out in Iloilo City where, a couple of teachers and their son were killed in Infante, Molo, while it was followed in Calaparan, Arevalo.

text: Gin-ako sang aktres kag host nga si Karla Estrada nga nagaka-stress ang iya anak nga si Daniel Padilla bangud sa pagpadalagan nila ni Rommel Padilla sa politika.
english: Gin-ako sang aktres kag host nga si Karla Estrada nga nagaka-stress ang iya anak nga si Daniel Padilla bangud sa pagpadalagan nila ni Rommel Padilla sa politika.

text: Suno kay Karla, nagalikaw sa istorya-politika ang iya nga anak apang nakahibalo siya nga 100% ang suporta sa ila ni Daniel.
english: According to Karla, her daughter avoids political talk but she knows that Daniel has 100% support for them.

text: Pahayag pa niya, wala man nagakontra si Daniel sa ila nangin desisyon ni Rommel kag ang importante lamang suno sa iya anak amo nga malipayon ang iya mga ginikanan.
english: He said Daniel is not against Rommel's decision and the only important thing, according to his son, is that his parents are happy.

text: Nahibaluan nga nag-file sang certificate of candidacy si Karla bilang third nominee sang Tingog — party-list nga ginapangunahan ni Rep.
english: Karla filed her certificate of candidacy as the third nominee of Tingog — a party-list led by Rep.

text: Yedda Romualdez.
english: Romualdez walked away.

text: Samtang ang amay ni Daniel nga si Rommel ang nag-file man sang kandidatura sa pagka-congressman sa first district sang Nueva Ecija.
english: Meanwhile, Daniel's father, Rommel, also filed his candidacy for congressman in the first district of Nueva Ecija.

text: Nag-donar ang BTS member nga si J-Hope sang 100 million Korean won (ginabanta $68,000 ukon P3.8 million) agud suportahan ang mga pamilya sang mga biktima sang nagtibusok ang eroplano sang Jeju Air sang nagligad nga Disyembre 29.
english: BTS member J-Hope donated 100 million Korean won (approximately $68,000 or P3.8 million) to support the families of the victims of the Jeju Air plane crash on December 29.

text: Ginhatag sang South Korean idol ang iya donasyon paagi sa Hope Bridge National Disaster Relief Association.
english: The South Korean idol gave her donation through the Hope Bridge National Disaster Relief Association.

text: Antes sini, miyembro na nga daan si J-Hope sang Hope Bridge Honor Club nga grupo sang “high-value” donors nga nagasuporta sa nagkalain-lain nga kawsa kag nagahatag sang bulig sa mga nagakinahanglan.
english: Earlier, J-Hope was already a member of the Hope Bridge Honor Club, a group of high-value donors who support various causes and provide assistance to those in need.

text: Magluwas sa iya charitable efforts, gina-istoryahan man subong ang upcoming solo activities ni J-Hope matapos nakumpleto ang mandatory military service sang Oktubre 2024.
english: Aside from his charitable efforts, J-Hope's upcoming solo activities are also being discussed after completing his mandatory military service in October 2024.

text: Balantayan ang “J-HOPE TOUR – HOPE ON THE STAGE” concert sa Seoul sa Feb.
english: Watch the “J-HOPE TOUR – HOPE ON THE STAGE” concert in Seoul on Feb.

text: 28 tubtub March 2 subong nga tuig.
english: 28 to March 2 this year.

text: May full comeback man ang BTS sini nga 2025.
english: BTS will also have a full comeback this 2025.

text: Kun matapos na ang ila military obligations, magabalik ang grupo sa global stage para sa celebratory world tour nga nagamarka sang ila 10th anniversary sang iconic nga “The Most Beautiful Moment in Life” series.
english: Once their military obligations are over, the group will return to the global stage for a celebratory world tour marking their 10th anniversary of the iconic “The Most Beautiful Moment in Life” series.

text: Sa subong, lima sa pito ka BTS members ang nagaserbe pa sa military nga amo sanday SUGA, RM, Jimin, V kag Jungkook apang natalana nga makatapos na sa mid-2025.
english: Currently, five of the seven BTS members are still serving in the military namely SUGA, RM, Jimin, V and Jungkook but are scheduled to graduate in mid-2025.

text: Ginbuyagyag ni Vice President Sara Duterte nga ang confidential funds sang Department of Education (DepEd) sa iya pagpanguna sang una ang gin-gamit sa pag-imbestigar sang ginapatihan nga lapnagon nga kurapsyon sa sulod sang ahensya.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte has revealed that confidential funds of the Department of Education (DepEd) under her former leadership were used to investigate alleged widespread corruption within the agency.

text: Lakip na ang P2.9-billion nga kontrata para sa mga laptop nga outdated kag overpriced.
english: This includes the P2.9-billion contract for outdated and overpriced laptops.

text: Ini nga pahayag ni Duterte ang kabaliskaran sa una nga deklarasyon sang DepEd sang nagligad nga tuig, kun sa diin ginpahayag nga wala sila sang impormasyon kun paano gingasto ang P112.5 million nga confidential funds para sa tuig 2023.
english: Duterte's statement is contrary to the DepEd's initial declaration last year, where it said it had no information on how the P112.5 million confidential funds for 2023 were spent.

text: Matandaan nga nagpamalibad si Duterte nga isugid ang detalye sang paggasto sang secret funds kag ginpasa ang responsibilidad sa Commission on Audit (COA) nga amo lang ang otorisado nga magbuyagyag sang impormasyon kun angot diri.
english: It can be recalled that Duterte refused to disclose the details of the spending of the secret funds and passed the responsibility to the Commission on Audit (COA) which is the only one authorized to disclose information in this regard.

text: Sang Marso 2022, gin-flag sang COA ang DepEd sa pagpamuno ni anay Secretary Leonor Briones bangud sa kontrobersyal nga pagbakal sang P2.4 billion nga balor sang mga laptop para sa mga manunudlo nga nagaserbe sa online learning sang 2021 sa tunga sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: In March 2022, the COA flagged the DepEd led by former Secretary Leonor Briones for the controversial purchase of P2.4 billion worth of laptops for teachers serving in online learning in 2021 amid the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Ginklaro ni Duterte nga sa ila ginpatigayon nga imbestigasyon, nahibaluan nga ang actual nga pagbakal sang mga laptop ang yara sa sulod sang Procurement Service sang Department of Budget and Management (PS-DBM), indi sa DepEd.
english: Duterte clarified that in their investigation, it was learned that the actual purchase of the laptops was within the Procurement Service of the Department of Budget and Management (PS-DBM), not the DepEd.

text: Suno pa sa Bise Presidente, wala sila nangin madinalag-on sa pag-blacklist sa mga kompaniya kag nagsalig lamang sa mga rekomendasyon sang COA kag sang Senate blue ribbon committee nga naga-invistigate sang amo nga isyu.
english: The Vice President said they were not successful in blacklisting the companies and relied only on the recommendations of the COA and the Senate blue ribbon committee investigating the issue.

text: Nagpaguwa na sang iya statement si Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Usec.
english: Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Usec.

text: Arrey Perez matapos nag-resign sa posisyon.
english: Arrey Perez after resigning from the position.

text: Pahayag sini, ginpili niya nga manaog sa pwesto, bangud nakahibalo siya nga kasunod sang “malicious insinuations” batok sa iya, mahimo na lamang ini nga hampang sa pulitika.
english: He said he chose to step down because he knew that following the “malicious insinuations” against him, it would become a political game.

text: Pahayag sini, indi siya magpasugot nga gamiton siya agud nga maliso ang atensyon gikan sa kun ano ang dapat nga tutukan.
english: He said he will not allow himself to be used to divert attention from what should be focused on.

text: “Let the fight against corruption continue and let me continue to do my work in it from a position of integrity,” kabahin sang statement sini.
english: “Let the fight against corruption continue and let me continue to do my work in it from a position of integrity,” it said in a statement.

text: Kaina sang hapon sang ginkumpirma ni DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon nga nagpasa si Perez sang irrevocable resignation agud mahatagan sang ligwa ang imbestigasyon kag agud nga malikawan nga mangin distraction samtang nga yara siya sa ahensya.
english: DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon confirmed yesterday afternoon that Perez submitted an irrevocable resignation to facilitate the investigation and to avoid becoming a distraction while he is in the agency.

text: Una naman nga ginpasiguro ni Dizon nga magapadayon ang imbestigasyon kay Perez apisar pa nga nagpanaog na ini sa iya nga posisyon.
english: Earlier, Dizon assured that the investigation into Perez will continue despite his resignation.

text: Matandaan nga ginbulgar ni Batangas Representative 1st District Rep.
english: It can be recalled that Batangas Representative 1st District Rep.

text: Leandro Leviste ang pangalan ni Perez kaina sang aga matapos ginhangkat siya ni Dizon nga magsapubliko sang mga pangalan sang DPWH officials nga may link sa mga kontraktor.
english: Leandro Leviste named Perez this morning after Dizon challenged him to make public the names of DPWH officials who have links to contractors.

text: Una naman nga gin-athag ni Leviste nga “multiple sources” ang iya ginbasehan apang ini ang verbal gid lamang nga mga impormasyon.#
english: Leviste earlier explained that he was based on “multiple sources” but these were only verbal information.

text: Dungog para kay Kelly Williams nga makaupod sa Gilas Pilipinas para sa sixth window sang Fiba World Cup Asian Qualifiers subong nga bulan.
english: Kelly Williams is honored to join Gilas Pilipinas for the sixth window of the Fiba World Cup Asian Qualifiers this month.

text: Sorpresa nga ginlakip si Williams sa national team matapos ginkumpirma nga indi makaintra sanday Japeth Aguilar kag naturalized player Ange Kouame bangud sa injuries.
english: Williams was surprisingly included in the national team after Japeth Aguilar and naturalized player Ange Kouame were confirmed to be out due to injuries.

text: Wala man sa team si Kai Sotto.
english: Kai Sotto is also not on the team.

text: “I’m grateful that my talents and my abilities are being appreciated.
english: “I’m grateful that my talents and my abilities are being appreciated.

text: Since I’ve been here, a lot of emphasis is put on how old a player is despite how effective he is playing,” pahayag ni Williams.
english: Since I’ve been here, a lot of emphasis is put on how old a player is despite how effective he is playing,” stated Williams.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, yara man si Williams sa second window sang qualifiers nga amo ang iya una nga Gilas duty sa isa ka major competition halin sang 2011 Fiba Asia Championship sa Wuhan, China.
english: Last year, Williams was also in the second window of qualifiers which was his first Gilas duty in a major competition since the 2011 Fiba Asia Championship in Wuhan, China.

text: Ulihi nga hampang ni Williams amo ang pagbulig sa TNT Tropang Giga nga magdaog batok sa Blackwater Bossing sa PBA Governors’ Cup kahapon.
english: Williams’ last match was helping TNT Tropang Giga win against Blackwater Bossing in the PBA Governors’ Cup yesterday.

text: Sa edad nga 41 anyos, si Williams ang pinakatigulang nga player sa team sang Gilas Pilipinas nga magabunggo batok sa Lebanon kag Jordan subong nga Pebrero.
english: At 41 years old, Williams is the oldest player in the Gilas Pilipinas team that will clash against Lebanon and Jordan this February.

text: Ginpasiguro ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas nga magabulig sa mga biktima sang sunog ilabi na sa mga napatyan nga pamilya sa Zone 6, Brgy.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas assured that he will help the victims of the fire especially the families who lost their lives in Zone 6, Brgy.

text: Infante, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: Infante, Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga sa subong, indi pa man sini matul-id ang exact amount nga iya itanyag sa pamilya apang nagapanigurado ini nga magabulig.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Treñas said that at present, he cannot determine the exact amount he will offer to the family but he is sure to help.

text: Ginkasubo naman sang alkalde ang natabo sa mga residente ilabi na sa mga napatay nga manunudlo nga mag-asawa lakip na ang ila pito ka tuig nga anak.
english: The mayor expressed his condolences to the residents especially to the deceased teacher couple including their seven-year-old son.

text: Nahibaluan nga personal gid ini nga nagpadulong sa lugar agud nga sekyaron ang mga naapektohan sang insidente.
english: It was learned that he personally went to the scene to check on those affected by the incident.

text: Nagpabutyag man ini nga ang natabo nga sunog ang isa ka ‘wake up call’ sa mga pumuluyo nga tsekyaron gid ang ila tagsa ka mga electrical devices agud nga malikawan nga matunaan sang sunog.
english: He also expressed that the fire is a wake up call to the residents to check their electrical devices to avoid causing fires.

text: Nahibaluan nga makabaton sang P7,000 ang balay nga partially burned, samtang P10,000 naman ang ihatag sa mga totally burned nga balay.
english: Partially burned houses will receive P7,000, while totally burned houses will receive P10,000.

text: DUMANGAS, Iloilo — Padayon pa nga ginapangita sang mga otoridad si alyas “BemBem,” isa ka tanod sang Barangay Sulangan, Dumangas, matapos gintudlo nga responsable sa pagtiro kay Samuel Adelantar.
english: DUMANGAS, Iloilo — Authorities are still searching for alias “BemBem,” a tanod of Barangay Sulangan, Dumangas, after he was identified as responsible for the shooting of Samuel Adelantar.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jessa Adelantar, anak sang biktima, ginsiling niya nga dismayado sila sa mga tanod bangud sa indi maabtik nga pagresponde sa insidente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jessa Adelantar, daughter of the victim, said they are disappointed with the tanods for not responding quickly to the incident.

text: Suno sa iya, nangayo sila sang bulig agud matawgan ang ambulansya kag ang kapulisan agud madakpan si “BemBem,” apang ginsugo lang sila nga magkadto pa sa barangay hall.
english: He said they asked for help to call an ambulance and the police to arrest “BemBem,” but they were told to go to the barangay hall.

text: Ginbuyagyag pa ni Adelantar nga may isa pa ka tanod nga ginpangayuan nila bulig pero nagsabat nga indi siya pwede kay may bisita siya.
english: Adelantar revealed that there was another tanod whom they asked for help but he replied that he could not because he had a guest.

text: Nagpanindugan si Adelantar nga responsibilidad sang mga tanod ang magresponde sa insidente, bisan pa may personal nga bisita.
english: Adelantar insisted that it is the responsibility of the tanods to respond to the incident, even if there is a personal visitor.

text: Suno sa iya, ex-kagawad pa ang nangita sang paagi nga matawgan ang pulis, samtang ang mga tanod, wala sang ginbuhat kundi magpungko lang kag magsabat sa ila.
english: He said the ex-kagawad was looking for a way to call the police, while the tanods did nothing but sit down and answer them.

text: Ginausisa pa sang otoridad ang rason sang insidente nga ginalantaw nga personal nga hiligut-anon ang rason.
english: Authorities are still investigating the cause of the incident, which is believed to be a personal quarrel.

text: Naka-abot na sa Thailand ang Filipina beauty queen nga si Samantha Panlilio agud maghanda para sa Miss Grand International pageant.
english: Filipina beauty queen Samantha Panlilio has arrived in Thailand to prepare for the Miss Grand International pageant.

text: Si Samantha ang ikatatlo kag katapusan nga Binibining Pilipinas 2021 titleholder nga maga-compete sa international stage subong nga tuig.
english: Samantha is the third and final Binibining Pilipinas 2021 titleholder to compete on the international stage this year.

text: Inspired si Samantha nga sundan ang duha ka asud-asud nga kadalag-an nanday Cinderella Faye Obeñita kag Maureen Montagne nga ginpangkoronahan bilang Miss Intercontinental 2021 kag Miss Globe 2021.
english: Samantha is inspired to follow in the footsteps of Cinderella Faye Obeñita and Maureen Montagne who were crowned Miss Intercontinental 2021 and Miss Globe 2021 respectively.

text: Kun magdaog si Samantha, siya ang mangin labing-una nga Filipina nga mangin Miss Grand International.
english: If Samantha wins, she will be the first Filipina to become Miss Grand International.

text: Patigayunon ang amo nga pageant sa Bangkok, Thailand sa maabot nga Disyembre 4.##
english: The pageant will be held in Bangkok, Thailand on December 4.##

text: Siraduhon ang mga embahada kag iban pa nga foreign missions sang Estados Unidos sang Amerik sa bilog nga kalibutan sa Enero 9 kadungan sang national day of mourning para kay late US president Jimmy Carter.
english: US embassies and other foreign missions around the world will be closed on January 9 in conjunction with the national day of mourning for late US President Jimmy Carter.

text: Ipatuman ini matapos nagpaguwa si US President Joe Biden sang executive order nga nagamandu sa tanan nga departments kag ahensya sang US federal government nga magasirado bilang respeto sa ika-39 nga presidente sang pungsod.
english: This will be implemented after US President Joe Biden issued an executive order ordering all departments and agencies of the US federal government to close in respect of the country's 39th president.

text: Si Carter nga nagtaliwan sa edad nga 100-anyos ang kilala nga Nobel peace laureate nga nagdaku sa Georgia kag nagpamuno sa US halin sang 1977 tubtub sang 1981.
english: Carter, who died at the age of 100, was a well-known Nobel peace laureate who grew up in Georgia and led the US from 1977 to 1981.

text: Ginbawian siya sang kabuhi sa iya hometown sa Plains, Georgia.
english: He passed away in his hometown of Plains, Georgia.

text: Nagasentro karon ang imbestigasyon sang Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) sa ika-duha nga panalgan sang balay sang pamilya Reyes kon sa diin, ginalantaw nga nagsugod ang sunog sa Zone 6, Brgy.
english: The Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) is now focusing on the second floor of the Reyes family's house where the fire is believed to have started in Zone 6, Brgy.

text: Infante, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: Infante, Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Ang mga biktima amo ang mag-asawa nga sanday Julius Reyes kag Louelyn Reyes nga pareho nga manunudlo sa Iloilo City, kag ang ila anak nga si Amber Marie, pito ka tuig.
english: The victims were identified as Julius Reyes and Louelyn Reyes, both teachers in Iloilo City, and their daughter, Amber Marie, seven years old.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Fire Superintendent Melanie Habawel, Iloilo City Fire Marshal, iya ginpahayag nga may patimaan nga ang kalayo ang nag-umpisa sa ika-duha nga panalgan sang balay.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Fire Superintendent Melanie Habawel, Iloilo City Fire Marshal, she said there are signs that the fire started on the second floor of the house.

text: Suno kay Habawel, may nakit-an nga abo nga nagahatag sang simbolo nga nauna ini sunog antes pa man naglapta ang kalayo.
english: According to Habawel, ashes were found to give a symbol that there was a fire before the fire spread.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ang kalayo ang nagsaka sa atop sang balay tubtob nga naglapta.
english: He also said the fire rose to the roof of the house until it spread.

text: Dugang pa ni Habawel, nagakuha na sila sang dugang nga mga ebidensya agud nga matul-id ang ginhalinan sang sunog.
english: Habawel said they are collecting more evidence to determine the cause of the fire.

text: Plano man nga magkuha sang sample sang mga debris agud nga mapaidalom sa tests kag kon mahibaluan kon may foul play nga natabo.
english: It is also planned to take samples of the debris for tests and to determine if foul play occurred.

text: Una na nga gintuad sang otoridad nga human sa light materials ang balay rason nga madasig man ini nga ginlamon sang kalayo.
english: Earlier, authorities admitted that the house was made of light materials and was quickly engulfed in flames.

text: Nagbiya na sa Japan si former Japanese Princess Mako agud nga mag-sugod sang panibag-o nga kabuhi kaupod ang iya bana nga isa ka commoner.
english: Former Japanese Princess Mako has left Japan to start a new life with her husband, a commoner.

text: Sang nagligad lang nga bulan sang ginkasal si Mako kag iya college sweetheart nga si Kei Komuro.
english: It was only last month when Mako and his college sweetheart Kei Komuro got married.

text: Si Mako amo ang hinablos sang emperor sang Japan, kag anak nanday Crown Prince Akishino kag Crown Princess Kiko.
english: Mako is the nephew of the emperor of Japan, and the daughter of Crown Prince Akishino and Crown Princess Kiko.

text: Nagpadulong sanday Mako kag Kei sa New York kun sa diin nagatrabaho si Kei sa isa ka law firm.
english: Mako and Kei went to New York where Kei worked in a law firm.

text: Antes sini, nangin sentro sang atensyon ang lovestory nanday Mako kag Kei bangud nadalahig pati ang gender roles sa Royal Family sa Japan.
english: Earlier, Mako and Kei's lovestory became the center of attention because it also involved gender roles in the Royal Family in Japan.

text: Sa tuman ka intense nga media coverage kag money scandal nga ginkaulamiran sang relasyon sang duha, na-diagnose si Mako sang post-traumatic stress disorder.
english: With the intense media coverage and money scandal surrounding the relationship between the two, Mako was diagnosed with post-traumatic stress disorder.

text: Matandaan nga pagkatapos sang ila kasal sang nagligad nga bulan, naproseso kag nabaton ni Mako ang iya nga passport agud nga makasunod sa iya nga bana sa Estados Unidos.
english: It can be recalled that after their wedding last month, Mako processed and received her passport to follow her husband to the United States.

text: Nagdepensa si Punong Barangay Antonio Sarroza sang Brgy.
english: Punong Barangay Antonio Sarroza of Brgy.

text: Sulangan, Dumangas, Iloilo nga ginaapinan nila ang tanod nga si alyas “Bembem” nga ginatudlo sa pagtiro kay Samuel Adelantar.
english: Sulangan, Dumangas, Iloilo that they are defending the tanod alias “Bembem” who is accused of shooting Samuel Adelantar.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Sarroza, ginpahayag niya nga ginapanugyanan niya gid nga ang mga tanod dapat nga mag-duty kag mag-ubra sang ila responsibilidad para sa kahilwayan kag katawhay sang barangay.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Sarroza said he strongly advises the tanods to be on duty and fulfill their responsibilities for the freedom and order of the barangay.

text: Ginpahayag pa niya nga ginmanduan niya mismo si Alyas “Bembem” nga magsurender bangud personal ina nga sala nga dapat niya atubangon.
english: He said he personally ordered Alyas “Bembem” to surrender because it was a personal offense that he had to face.

text: Gindugang niya nga ginahingyo lang nila nga indi sila pagsulsulan bangud ginapaninguhaan man nila nga magpabilin ang kalinong sa barangay.
english: He added that they are just asking not to be harassed because they are also trying to maintain peace in the barangay.

text: Kalakip ang swimmer-actor nga si Enchong Dee sa mga artista nga “very vocal” sa mga isyu kag kontrobersiya nga ginakaulamiran sang mga government official.
english: Swimmer-actor Enchong Dee is among the artists who are “very vocal” on issues and controversies that government officials are aware of.

text: Apang sa subong wala pa siya nakapaguwa sang pahayag may kaangtanan sa P1-billion cyberlibel complaint nga ginpasaka batuk sa iya ni Representative Claudine Diana Bautista-Lim sang Drivers United for Mass Progress and Equal Rights (DUMPER) Party-list sa Provincial Prosecutor’s Office sa Davao Occidental.
english: However, he has not yet issued a statement regarding the P1-billion cyberlibel complaint filed against him by Representative Claudine Diana Bautista-Lim of the Drivers United for Mass Progress and Equal Rights (DUMPER) Party-list at the Provincial Prosecutor's Office in Davao Occidental.

text: Matandaan nga ginkasal si Bautista sa negosyante nga si Jose French “Tracker” Lim sa Balesin Island sa Polillo, Quezon sang Hulyo.
english: Bautista was married to businessman Jose French “Tracker” Lim on Balesin Island in Polillo, Quezon in July.

text: Kag isa si Enchong sa mga shobiz personalities nga nag-criticize sa enggrande nga kasal sang mamalidha.
english: And Enchong is one of the showbiz personalities who criticized the lawmaker's grand wedding.

text: Ginahingyo subong sang publiko ang pagresponde sa isa ka ginbakbak nga karsada sa JM Basa Street bangud sa kakulangan sang early warning device (EWD) kag klaro nga traffic rerouting.
english: The public is now urged to respond to a blocked road on JM Basa Street due to the lack of early warning device (EWD) and clear traffic rerouting.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, tagpamaba ni Mayor Raisa Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga tungod sa Facebook post sang Bombo Radyo kag mga reklamo sang concerned nga netizens, gilayon niya ini ginpaabot kay Mayor Raisa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, spokesperson of Mayor Raisa Treñas, said that due to Bombo Radyo's Facebook post and complaints from concerned netizens, she immediately informed Mayor Raisa.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga-Gorzal, nakita sang alkalde ang posibilidad sang disgrasya sa lugar, gani gilayon nga ginmando ni Mayor Raisa Treñas nga ipa-review kag ipa-inspect sang City Engineer’s Office ang proyekto, upod ang iban pa nga mga ongoing projects sa siyudad.
english: According to Fantilaga-Gorzal, the mayor saw the possibility of accidents in the area, so Mayor Raisa Treñas immediately ordered the City Engineer's Office to review and inspect the project, along with other ongoing projects in the city.

text: Ginpahanumdom man sang alkalde nga kinahanglan may early warning device ang tanan nga proyekto kag kontrata nga may kaangtanan sa konstruksyon, agud malikawan ang peligro sa mga motorista kag pedestrian.
english: The mayor also reminded that all projects and contracts related to construction must have an early warning device, to avoid danger to motorists and pedestrians.

text: Base sa resulta sang inspeksyon, nadiskubrehan nga expired na ang temporary road closure permit sang proyekto.
english: Based on the results of the inspection, it was discovered that the temporary road closure permit of the project has expired.

text: Wala man ini sang Mayor’s Permit, wala sang klaro nga koordinasyon sa lokal nga gobyerno, kag wala sang traffic rerouting scheme nga ginpresentar.
english: It also does not have a Mayor's Permit, no clear coordination with the local government, and no traffic rerouting scheme has been presented.

text: Padayon subong ang pag-imbestigar sang City Hall kag ginpaandam nga posible nga may katapat nga penalidad ang contractor kun mapamatud-an nga wala nagpatuman sang sakto nga proseso.
english: The City Hall is still investigating and warned that the contractor may face penalties if found not to have implemented the proper process.

text: Nagmandu ang Pre-Trial Chamber sang International Criminal Court (ICC) nga ipaidalom sa medical examination si anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The Pre-Trial Chamber of the International Criminal Court (ICC) has ordered the medical examination of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Ini agud madeterminar kun fit bala ang anay presidente nga magpaidalom sa pre-trial proceedings lakip na sa confirmation of charges.
english: This is to determine whether the former president is fit to undergo pre-trial proceedings including confirmation of charges.

text: Naghatag sang order ang tatlo ka mga judge nga sanday Judges Iulia Antoanella Motoc, Reine Adélaïde Sophie Alapini-Gansou, kag María del Socorro Flores Liera, agud nga ma-facilitate sang Registry ang medical examination.
english: The three judges, Judges Iulia Antoanella Motoc, Reine Adélaïde Sophie Alapini-Gansou, and María del Socorro Flores Liera, gave the order for the Registry to facilitate the medical examination.

text: Dapat man nga i-provide ang kumpleto nga mga record ni Duterte sa panel sang tatlo ka independent medical experts.
english: Duterte's complete records should also be provided to a panel of three independent medical experts.

text: Ini nga mga eksperto ginabug-usan sang isa ka forensic psychiatrist, isa ka neuropsychologist, kag isa ka geriatric and behavioral neurologist.
english: These experts consisted of a forensic psychiatrist, a neuropsychologist, and a geriatric and behavioral neurologist.

text: Sila ang maga-assess kun may kondisyon sa ikaayong-lawas si Duterte nga mahimo makaapekto sa iya nga partisipasyon sa nagapadayon nga pre-trial phase.
english: They will assess whether Duterte has any health conditions that may affect his participation in the ongoing pre-trial phase.

text: Ini man nga mga eksperto ang maga-rekomendar sang special measures nga kinahanglan agud matatap kun may kondisyon si Duterte sa tion sang proceedings.
english: These experts will also recommend special measures needed to address if Duterte has any conditions during the proceedings.

text: Wala ginsapubliko ang pangalan sang mga doktor, apang suno sa ICC, ini nga tikang ang kabahin sang pagpakita sang “fair trial rights” para sa former Philippine leader.
english: The names of the doctors were not made public, but the ICC said the move was part of a demonstration of “fair trial rights” for the former Philippine leader.

text: “The Chamber instructs the Panel to only utilise the information it receives for the purpose of formulating its reports, and orders it not to divulge any information without prior approval of the Chamber.
english: “The Chamber instructs the Panel to only utilize the information it receives for the purpose of formulating its reports, and orders it not to divulge any information without prior approval of the Chamber.

text: Moreover, in order to maintain the impartiality of the Panel, the parties and participants shall refrain from any contact with the appointed experts,” kabahin sang desisyon.
english: Moreover, in order to maintain the impartiality of the Panel, the parties and participants shall refrain from any contact with the appointed experts,” part of the decision.

text: Matandaan nga ginbasura sang ICC ang request sang kampo ni Duterte para sa interim release.
english: The ICC rejected the Duterte camp's request for interim release.

text: Nauna na nagpahayag ang defense team nga nagamalipaton na si Duterte kag indi na ini makadumdom sa mga hitabo, sa mga petsa, ukon mangin sa iya nga pamilya.
english: Earlier, the defense team said that Duterte is forgetful and cannot remember events, dates, or even his family.

text: Sa statement anay ni Vice President Sara Duterte, ginsiling sini nga may source siya nga nagsugid nga nasapwan man anay ang iya amay nga wala sang animo samtang yara sa detention cell.#
english: In a statement, Vice President Sara Duterte said she had a source who told her that her father was also found unconscious while in the detention cell.

text: Wala si Barangay Ginebra forward Japeth Aguilar sa team sang Gilas Pilipinas sa nagahilapit nga FIBA World Cup Asian qualifying window.
english: Barangay Ginebra forward Japeth Aguilar is not in the team of Gilas Pilipinas in the upcoming FIBA ​​World Cup Asian qualifying window.

text: Duha na ka hampang sang Ginebra sa Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) Governors’ Cup ang wala man sini naintrahan bangud sa injury kag ginabanta nga tatlo ka semana pa ang kalawigon antes siya maka-recover.
english: Ginebra has missed two games in the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) Governors' Cup due to injury and is estimated to have three weeks to recover.

text: Naangkon sang 36-anyos nga veteran forward ang injury sa tuhod sang nakasumpong sang team ang NLEX Road Warriors sang nagligad nga Pebrero 8.
english: The 36-year-old veteran forward suffered a knee injury when the team faced the NLEX Road Warriors on February 8.

text: Mangin si Ginebra coach kag Gilas assistant Tim Cone ang nagaduda man kun makapasakop pa si Aguilar sa showdown sang Gilas sa Lebanon kag Jordan.
english: Even Ginebra coach and Gilas assistant Tim Cone doubts whether Aguilar will be able to participate in the Gilas' showdown with Lebanon and Jordan.

text: Antes sini, kabahin na si Aguilar sang 24-man pool sang national team para sa sixth kag final window sang FIBA World Cup Asian qualifiers.
english: Earlier, Aguilar was part of the 24-man pool of the national team for the sixth and final window of the FIBA ​​World Cup Asian qualifiers.

text: Pananglitan indi gid man maka-recover si Aguilar, daku ini nga kadulaan sa Gilas ilabi na bangud ginalauman nga wala man sa team si Kai Sotto sa ila hampang sa Lebanon sa Pebrero 24 kag batok sa Jordan sa Pebrero 27.
english: If Aguilar does not recover, it will be a big loss for the Gilas especially since Kai Sotto is expected to be out of the team for their games in Lebanon on February 24 and against Jordan on February

text: Naga-average si Aguilar sang 13.5 points, 4.0 rebounds, kag 2.0 assists sa duha sini ka appearances para sa Barangay Ginebra sa season-ending conference.
english: Aguilar is averaging 13.5 points, 4.0 rebounds, and 2.0 assists in his two appearances for Barangay Ginebra in the season-ending conference.

text: Gintuad sang punong barangay sang Brgy.
english: The barangay captain of Brgy.

text: Bakhaw, Mandurriao, Iloilo City nga antes pa man nadakpan, nakaagi na sila istoryahanay ni Alias “Ariane” ang regional top-listed drug personality kag nagpahayag nga mabag-o na ini.
english: Bakhaw, Mandurriao, Iloilo City that before being arrested, they had a conversation with Alias ​​“Ariane” the regional top-listed drug personality and said that this will change.

text: Si Alias “Ariane”, 48-anyos, residente sang Zone 2, Barangay Bakhaw, Mandurriao, Iloilo City; isa sa mga subject nga nadakpan sa drug buy-bust operation sa Barangay Calumpang, Molo.
english: Alias ​​“Ariane”, 48 years old, resident of Zone 2, Barangay Bakhaw, Mandurriao, Iloilo City; one of the subjects arrested in a drug buy-bust operation in Barangay Calumpang, Molo.

text: Kaupod sini Alias “Toto”, 32-anyos, isa ka security guard kag residente sang Capiz.
english: He was accompanied by Alias ​​“Toto”, 32, a security guard and resident of Capiz.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Joel Alvarado sang Bakhaw, Mandurriao, iya ginpahayag nga sang bag-o ini nakaguwa sa presohan, nagpangako pa ini sa iya nga magbag-o na.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Punong Barangay Joel Alvarado of Bakhaw, Mandurriao said that before he was released from jail, he promised him to change.

text: Apang makaligad ang isa ka bulan, may mga report nga nabaton ang barangay nga nagagamit si Alias Ariane, rason nga gin-monitor ini sang barangay.
english: But after a month, the barangay received reports that Alias ​​Ariane was using, so the barangay monitored him.

text: Suno kay Alvarado, may kakilala si Ariane nga masami ginakadtuan sa ila lang man nga barangay nga posible kaupod man sini sa iligal nga transaksyon.
english: According to Alvarado, Ariane has an acquaintance who often visits her in the same barangay who may be involved in illegal transactions.

text: Padayon man ang koordinasyon sang Barangay Anti-Drug Abuse Council (BADAC) sa kapulisan agud magpatuman sang drug assembly kag mapahanumdom sa pumuluyo ang pagpamatok sa iligal nga druga.
english: The Barangay Anti-Drug Abuse Council (BADAC) also continues to coordinate with the police to implement drug assemblies and remind the public of the fight against illegal drugs.

text: Nahibaluan nga nakumpiskar kay Alias Ariane kag Alias Toto ang 1,100 grams sang suspected shabu nga nagabalor sang ginabanta P7.5 million.
english: It was learned that Alias ​​Ariane and Alias ​​Toto were seized with 1,100 grams of suspected shabu worth P7.5 million.

text: Lakip na diri ang 39 ka heat-sealed plastic sachets nga may unod sang suspected shabu (lakip na ang buy-bust item),4 ka knot-tied nga plastic packs, buy-bust money kag non-drug-related items.
english: Among them were 39 heat-sealed plastic sachets containing suspected shabu (including the buy-bust item), 4 knot-tied plastic packs, buy-bust money and non-drug-related items.

text: Wala sang pagpangduha-duha kag kumpiyansa nga ginsabat ni anay Department of the Interior and Local Government Secretary Mel Sarmiento nga si Kris Aquino na ang luyag niya nga makaupod tubtob sa ulihe.
english: Former Department of the Interior and Local Government Secretary Mel Sarmiento answered without hesitation and confidence that Kris Aquino is the one he wants to be with until the end.

text: Gingamit ni Mel ang account ni Kris sa pagsabat sa mga palamangkutanon sang netizens.
english: Mel used Kris' account to answer netizens' questions.

text: Suno sa anay tiglikom, wala sang may matabo nga bulagay bangud ginapalangga niya si Kris.
english: According to the former secretary, there will be no breakup because he loves Kris.

text: Una nga ginsapubliko sang duha ang ila relasyon sang Agosto kag sang Oktubre 24 gin-announce ni Kris ang ila engagement.
english: The two first went public with their relationship in August and on October 24, Kris announced their engagement.

text: Nagpahayag sang iya reaksyon si Engr.
english: Expressing his reaction, Engr.

text: Nilo Jardeleza, Chairman sang Infrastructure Development Committee sang Regional Development Council (RDC) VI, matapos ang panawagan ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Nilo Jardeleza, Chairman of the Infrastructure Development Committee of the Regional Development Council (RDC) VI, following the call of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sa pag-audit kag imbestigasyon sa mga flood control projects nga ginbanggit sa iya SONA.
english: to audit and investigate the flood control projects mentioned in his SONA.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jardeleza, iya ginpahayag nga nakita niya na sang temprano pa ang problema sa flood control kag dapat ini tutukan indi lang sa konstruksyon kundi pati sa maintenance kag operasyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jardeleza said he saw the problem in flood control early on and it should be focused not only on construction but also on maintenance and operation.

text: Ginpunto niya nga indi gid mapunggan ang baha, apang pwede ini nga ma-mitigate, paagi sa husto nga pondo kag atensyon sa mga proyekto.
english: He pointed out that floods can never be prevented, but they can be mitigated, with the right funding and attention to projects.

text: Gindugang pa ni Jardeleza nga may problema sa pag-realign sang mga suba, kun sa diin kun temprano pa lang ginhimo na ang adjustments, mas barato ang magasto kag ma-limit lang ang damages kag mas mabakod ang mga naubra nga proyekto.
english: Jardeleza added that there is a problem with the realignment of rivers, where if the adjustments are made early, the cost will be cheaper and the damages will be limited and the projects will be stronger.

text: Apang ginbuyagyag man niya nga kulang ang pondo nga ginahatag bisan may ara na sang mga standard design halin sa central office.
english: However, he also revealed that the funds provided are insufficient even though there are standard designs from the central office.

text: Ginpanugyan niya nga dapat usisaon sang implementing agencies ang applicability sang design base sa aktwal nga kondisyon sang lugar, suno sa 2000 memorandum ni Secretary Simeon Datumanong.
english: He suggested that the implementing agencies should examine the applicability of the design based on the actual condition of the site, according to the 2000 memorandum of Secretary Simeon Datumanong.

text: Ginklaro ni Jardeleza nga may madamo nga pamaagi nga makabulig ang gobyerno sa pagtukod sang mas mabakod nga flood control structures, apang kinahanglan nga siguraduhon ang kalidad agud indi mauyang ang pondo.
english: Jardeleza clarified that there are many ways that the government can help build stronger flood control structures, but quality must be ensured so that funds are not wasted.

text: Ginpaandam man niya ang publiko nga ang pagbaha isa ka seryoso nga problema nga dako ang halit sa tanan nga aspeto sang kabuhi.
english: He also warned the public that flooding is a serious problem that causes great damage to all aspects of life.

text: Ginaengganyo man niya ang mga pumuluyo nga mangin mabinantayon kag magreklamo kun may mga proyekto nga wala sang maayo nga epekto, kag magpartisipar sa mga polisa para sa kaayuhan sang tanan.
english: He also urged residents to be vigilant and complain if there are projects that do not have a good impact, and to participate in policies for the benefit of all.

text: Nag-resign na sa posisyon si Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Undersecretary Arrey Perez matapos ginhingadlan ni Batangas 1st District Rep.
english: Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Undersecretary Arrey Perez has resigned from his position after Batangas 1st District Rep.

text: Leandro Leviste nga may kakilala ini nga flood control contractors.
english: Leandro Leviste said he knows flood control contractors.

text: Ginkumpirma ini ni Secretary Vince Dizon subong nga hapon, Oktubre 17.
english: This was confirmed by Secretary Vince Dizon this afternoon, October 17.

text: Suno kay Dizon, nagpasa si Perez sang irrevocable resignation agud nga mahatagan sang ligwa ang imbestigasyon kag agud nga malikawan nga mangin distraction samtang nga yara siya sa ahensya.
english: Dizon said Perez submitted an irrevocable resignation to facilitate the investigation and to avoid becoming a distraction while he is in the agency.

text: Apang suno kay Dizon, magapadayon ang imbestigasyon kay Perez apisar pa nga nagpanaog na ini sa iya nga posisyon.
english: However, Dizon said the investigation into Perez will continue despite his resignation.

text: Pahayag sang tiglikom, ang mga imbestigasyon sa DPWH ang indi maapektuhan sang mga personalidad ukon pulitiko.
english: The secretary said the investigations in the DPWH will not be affected by personalities or politicians.

text: Wala sang paboran sa cleansing process suno sa iya — bisan nga ang mga tawo nga involved ang nag-resign na ukon halin sa nagligad nga administrasyon, ukon bisan pa kun ini nga mga tawo ang ginpasulod mismo ni Dizon sa ahensya.
english: There is no one in favor of the cleansing process, he said — even if the people involved have resigned or are from the previous administration, or even if these people were brought into the agency by Dizon himself.

text: Matandaan nga ginbulgar ni Leviste ang pangalan ni Perez kaina sang aga matapos ginhangkat siya ni Dizon nga magsapubliko sang mga pangalan sang DPWH officials nga involved sa mga kontraktor.
english: Leviste revealed Perez's name yesterday morning after Dizon challenged him to make public the names of DPWH officials involved with contractors.

text: Una naman nga gin-athag ni Leviste nga “multiple sources” ang iya ginbasehan apang ini ang verbal gid lamang nga mga impormasyon.#
english: Leviste earlier explained that he was based on “multiple sources” but these were only verbal information.

text: Wala sang na-report nga Pinoy nga naulamid sa duha ka magkasunod nga ginapahayag terror attack sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: No Filipinos have been reported involved in two consecutive alleged terror attacks in the United States of America.

text: Ang una nga insidente ang ginakaulamiran sang isa ka Tesla Cybertruck ang nagsigabong sa gwa sang Trump International Hotel sa Las Vegas, Nevada samtang isa naman ka pickup truck ang nang-arado sang mga tawo sa Bourbon Street sa New Orleans, Louisiana.
english: The first incident involved a Tesla Cybertruck that caught fire outside the Trump International Hotel in Las Vegas, Nevada while another pickup truck plowed into people on Bourbon Street in New Orleans, Louisiana.

text: Suno kay Bombo Mary Drake, international correspondent sa Amerika, nagapadayon pa subong ang imbestigasyon sang Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) sa insidente.
english: According to Bombo Mary Drake, international correspondent in the United States, the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) is still investigating the incident.

text: Wala naman ginadula sang FBI ang posibilidad nga may mga kaangtanan ang duha ka mga pag-atake.
english: The FBI is not ruling out the possibility of links between the two attacks.

text: Nahibaluan nga 15 ang napatay sa terror attack sa New Orleans sa diin ang suspek amo si Shamsud-Din Jabbar, 42, isang U.S.-born citizen kag army veteran halin sa Texas.
english: At least 15 people were killed in a terror attack in New Orleans in which the suspect was identified as Shamsud-Din Jabbar, 42, a U.S.-born citizen and army veteran from Texas.

text: Isa ka hayahay naman sang Islamic State of Iraq and Syria (ISIS) ang nakita sa pickup truck nga iya ginrentahan kag ginatinguhaan naman sang FBI nga matumod ang kaangtanan sini sa anuman nga organisasyon sang terorista.
english: An Islamic State of Iraq and Syria (ISIS) symbol was found in the pickup truck he rented and the FBI is trying to determine its link to any terrorist organization.

text: Nagsulod si Jabbar sa army sang 2007, aktibo siya sa serbisyo sa human resources kag information technology kag nadestino sa Afghanistan humalin sang 2009 tubtob 2010.
english: Jabbar joined the army in 2007, he was active in human resources and information technology services and was stationed in Afghanistan from 2009 to 2010.

text: Nagsaylo siya sa Army Reserve sang 2015 kag naghalin sang 2020 nga may rangko nga staff sergeant.
english: He transferred to the Army Reserve in 2015 and left in 2020 with the rank of staff sergeant.

text: ANTIQUE – Patay ang isa ka tuig nga bata matapos nalumos sa baybay sa Barangay Atabay, Tobias Fornier, Antique.
english: ANTIQUE – A one-year-old boy died after drowning on the beach in Barangay Atabay, Tobias Fornier, Antique.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Staff Sergeant Richmond Roquero, imbestigador sang Tobias Fornier Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga ginpabantayan sang amay ang biktima sa iya anom ka tuig nga anak bangud may trabaho ini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Staff Sergeant Richmond Roquero, investigator of the Tobias Fornier Municipal Police Station, said the father asked the victim to watch his six-year-old son because he had a job.

text: Samtang ang iloy naman ang bata ang nagabaligya pinaagi sa paglibod.
english: While the mother and the child are selling by going around.

text: Sang nagpauli ang iloy sa ila balay, ginpangita niya ang iya duha ka mga anak sa diin nakit-an niya ang iya anom ka tuig nga anak nga nagapaligo sa baybay.
english: When the mother returned home, she looked for her two children and found her six-year-old son swimming on the beach.

text: Sa amo man nga lugar, nakit-an sini nga naga-utaw-utaw na ang iya isa ka tuig nga anak.
english: In the same area, she found her one-year-old son drowning.

text: Gindala pa kuntani ang isa ka tuig nga bata sa ospital, apang gindeklarar nga dead on arrival.
english: The one-year-old was rushed to the hospital, but was declared dead on arrival.

text: Ginaeksperyensiya subong sang mga motorista ang ila problema sa paggutok sang trapiko sa JM Basa- Aldeguer Streets sa Calle Real bangud sa gina-ubra nga dalan kag indi epektibo nga mga early warning signs sa lugar.
english: Motorists are currently experiencing their problem of traffic congestion at JM Basa-Aldeguer Streets in Calle Real due to the road construction and ineffective early warning signs in the area.

text: Ginbakbak ang half lane sang dalan, nga may 5 tubtob 6 ka metros ang kalaparon, bilang kabahin sang isa ka ongoing nga construction project.
english: The half lane of the road, which is 5 to 6 meters wide, was dug up as part of an ongoing construction project.

text: Suno sa mga motorista, delikado ini labi na sa mga nagaagi sang kun kaagahon ukon sa mga madulom nga oras.
english: According to motorists, it is dangerous especially for those who pass in the morning or in the dark.

text: Ang ginbutang nga metal block nga may “No Entry” sticker kag ang basurahan, indi dayon makit-an sang mga nagalabay gani madamo ang nagaalang-alang, kag may kahadlok nga posible pa ini magresulta sa disgrasya.
english: The metal block with the “No Entry” sticker and the garbage can are not immediately visible to passers-by so many are hesitant, and there is a fear that it could result in an accident.

text: Ginapanawagan naman sang publiko nga magbutang sang mas epektibo kag mas visible nga mga warning signs sa lugar, pareho sang reflectorized cones, blinking lights ukon barikada nga may klaro nga sinulatan, agud malikawan ang peligro sa dalan.
english: The public is urged to install more effective and visible warning signs in the area, such as reflectorized cones, blinking lights or barricades with clear writing, to avoid road hazards.

text: Ginpasangkad na sang syudad sang Iloilo ang preparasyon batok sa posibilidad sang mabaskug nga linog kag tsunami nga mahimo magtupa sa tion sang ‘worst-case scenario’.
english: The city of Iloilo has expanded its preparations against the possibility of strong earthquakes and tsunamis that could strike during the worst-case scenario.

text: Nagpatigayon sang pagsinapol ang Iloilo City Disaster Risk Reduction Management Office kaupod ang iban pa nga mga opisina nga may kaangtanan sa emergency response agud mapabaskug ang kapasidad sang syudad sa pag-atubang sang dalagku nga kalamidad.
english: The Iloilo City Disaster Risk Reduction Management Office held a meeting with other offices related to emergency response to strengthen the city's capacity to deal with major disasters.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Darwin Papa, Chief sang Iloilo City Disaster Risk Reduction Management Office, ginpahayag niya nga base sa mga historical nga datos, posible nga maghulag ang Negros Trench nga may kabaskugon nga 8.2 magnitude.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Darwin Papa, Chief of the Iloilo City Disaster Risk Reduction Management Office, said that based on historical data, the Negros Trench is likely to move with a magnitude of 8.2.

text: Dugang pa niya nga ini nga linog mahimo magtuga sang tsunami nga ang kataason ginabulubanta ang kataason nga kaangay sang tatlo ka panalgan nga building (3-storey building), kag may posibilidad nga magaigu sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: He added that this earthquake could cause a tsunami that is estimated to be the height of a three-storey building, and is likely to hit Iloilo City.

text: Ginsiling pa ni Papa nga may yara lamang sang 15 minutos nga escape time ang mga pumuluyo sa tion nga may tsunami nga magaluntad, rason nga ginpatigayon sang Oktubre 16, 2025 ang “Oplan Pangaman” ukon preparasyon para sa worst-case earthquake.
english: Papa said that residents have only 15 minutes of escape time in case of a tsunami, which is why the “Oplan Pangaman” or preparation for the worst-case earthquake was conducted on October 16, 2025.

text: Ginpabaskug diri ang mga preventive safety measure kag gin-review ang operational plan agud masiguro nga madasig kag maayo ang koordinasyon sa tion sang emerhensya.
english: It strengthened preventive safety measures and reviewed the operational plan to ensure quick and efficient coordination in times of emergency.

text: Gin-updan sang City Disaster Risk Reduction Management Council ang aktibidad kag gin-check man ang kahimtangan sang mga building sa syudad.
english: The City Disaster Risk Reduction Management Council accompanied the activity and also checked the condition of buildings in the city.

text: Ginlantaw man ang contingency plan base sa mga secondary hazards kag historical nga mga kalamidad.
english: The contingency plan was also looked at based on secondary hazards and historical disasters.

text: Matandaan sa maragtas ang natabu sang Enero 25, 1948, sang ginbansagan nga ”Lady Caycay” earthquake nga may magnitude 7.8 kag nagtuga sang daku nga damages sa Iloilo City kag iban pa nga banwa sa Panay.
english: History remembers what happened on January 25, 1948, when the so-called "Lady Caycay" earthquake measured 7.8 on the Richter scale and caused severe damage to Iloilo City and other towns in Panay.

text: Suno kay Papa, available na ang mga rescue teams kag magahiwat sang orientation para sa structural operations kag pagrescue sa tion sang dalagku nga kalamidad.
english: Papa said rescue teams are already available and will conduct orientation for structural operations and rescue during major disasters.

text: Ginpahayag man niya nga may nagakaigu nga mga volunteers, serbisyo, kag mga organisasyon nga magabulig sa emergency operations, kag napreparahan na ang tanan nga posibilidad.
english: He also said that there are adequate volunteers, services, and organizations that will assist in emergency operations, and all possibilities have been prepared.

text: Gin-review sang mga miyembro sang mga cluster sang City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council ang Operational Plan for Earthquake bilang kabahin sang pagpabakod sang kapasidad sang syudad sa pagresponder.
english: Members of the City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council clusters reviewed the Operational Plan for Earthquake as part of strengthening the city’s response capacity.

text: Gin-organisar ini sang CDRRM Office sa Gaisano ICARE Center kag gin-updan sang mga cluster sang Critical Infrastructure; Logistics; Law and Order; Food and Non-Food; Public Information and Community Advocacy; kag Search, Rescue and Retrieval.
english: It was organized by the CDRRM Office at the Gaisano ICARE Center and accompanied by Critical Infrastructure clusters; Logistics; Law and Order; Food and Non-Food; Public Information and Community Advocacy; and Search, Rescue and Retrieval.

text: Ginpahayag man nga gin-upod ang syudad sa lima ka operational divisions para sa mas sentro nga tikang sa tion sang dalagku nga linog, halin sa search and rescue operations, evacuation site management, tubtob sa pagprotekta sang critical infrastructure.
english: The city was also reportedly merged into five operational divisions for more centralized measures during major earthquakes, from search and rescue operations, evacuation site management, to protecting critical infrastructure.

text: Ginalauman nga magahiwat man sang mga orientation para sa Collapsed Structure Search and Rescue (CSSR), resource mapping, kag mga drills ang mga teams agud mapabaskug pa gid ang kahandaan sang syudad.
english: The teams are also expected to conduct orientations for Collapsed Structure Search and Rescue (CSSR), resource mapping, and drills to further strengthen the city's preparedness.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Papa nga ipresentar sa kay Mayor Raisa Trenas ang mga plano kag magahiwat sang dugang nga training para sa mga personnel.
english: Papa also said that the plans will be presented to Mayor Raisa Trenas and additional training will be conducted for the personnel.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Negros Trench isa ka aktibo nga ‘subduction zone’ sa nakatundan nga porsyon sang Panay kag ginakabig nga isa ka “earthquake generator” nga may posibilidad nga makaapekto sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: The Negros Trench is an active subduction zone in the western portion of Panay and is considered an earthquake generator with the possibility of affecting Iloilo City.

text: 17, 2025) Written by James Daccer
english: 17, 2025) Written by James Daccer

text: Ginhingyo ni Public Works Secretary Vince Dizon si Batangas 1st District Representative Leandro Leviste nga ibulgar ang mga pangalan sang mga tinawo halin sa Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) nga ginaalegar nagapakigkita sa mga kontraktor para maka-secure sang kickback.
english: Public Works Secretary Vince Dizon asked Batangas 1st District Representative Leandro Leviste to disclose the names of personnel from the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) who are allegedly meeting with contractors to secure kickbacks.

text: Ini ang sabat sang tiglikom matapos ang press conference ni Leviste kahapon, Oktubre 16, kun sa diin ginkwestyon sini ang posible nga koneksyon sang team ni Dizon sa mga kontraktor.
english: The secretary said this after Leviste's press conference yesterday, October 16, where he questioned the possible connection of Dizon's team with contractors.

text: Ginsiling sang kongresista nga may mga nakasugid sa iya nga may mga myembro sang team ni Dizon nga amo mismo ang mga kontraktor.
english: The congressman said that some people told him that there are members of Dizon's team who are themselves contractors.

text: Gindugang man sini nga may iban naman nga mga tinawo nga nakasugod na sa pagsapol sa mga kontraktor agud makig-negosyar.
english: He added that other personnel have already started meeting with contractors to negotiate.

text: Gin-ako naman ni Leviste nga verbal lang ang iya nga impormasyon kag wala sang ebidensya nga nahatag sa iya, apang mapatihan ang iya source suno sa mamalidha, kag indi lang isa kundi madamo ang nakasugid sini sa iya.
english: Leviste admitted that his information was verbal and no evidence was given to him, but his source was credible, according to the lawmaker, and not just one but many people told him.

text: Sa bahin ni Dizon, nanindugan ini nga sa iya ginpili nga mga undersecretary, wala siya sang nahibal-an nga may yara sang kontraktor.
english: For his part, Dizon insisted that among the undersecretaries he chose, he did not know that there was a contractor.

text: Apang gindugang sini nga handa siya nga makigkita kay Leviste para makakuha sang impormasyon.
english: But he added that he is ready to meet with Leviste to get information.

text: “Sa pagkakalaam ko dito sa mga Undersecretaries na ating inaya, at hindi madaling mag-aya ng Undersecretary sa DPWH sa panahong ito, wala sa kanila ang contractor,” suno sa tiglikom.
english: “As far as I know, the Undersecretaries that we have hired, and it is not easy to hire an Undersecretary in the DPWH at this time, none of them are contractors,” the secretary said.

text: Nagpasalig man ini nga magahimo siya sang internal investigation kaangot sa sini nga alegasyon.
english: He also assured that he will conduct an internal investigation regarding this allegation.

text: Gindugang man sang tiglikom nga may mga kunsekwensya gid pananglitan mapamatud-an nga may mga tinawo pa sa ahensya nga nagapakig-negosyar sa mga kontraktor para sa kickback.
english: The secretary also added that there will be consequences if it is proven that there are still employees in the agency who are negotiating with contractors for kickbacks.

text: Pahayag sini, indi lang pagkakas sa pwesto ang maabtan sang mga tawo nga involved sa kurapsyon, kundi kasuhan gid mismo.
english: He said that people involved in corruption will not only be removed from office, but will be prosecuted themselves.

text: “Handpicked ko talaga sila pero iimbestigahan ko sila.
english: “I actually handpicked them but I will investigate them.

text: Titignan ko kung sino ba dyan ang posibleng either related, kumausap, kung anuman… But I would really appreciate if Cong.
english: I'll see who's there who might be either related, talk, whatever... But I would really appreciate if Cong.

text: Leviste could give me more specifics.
english: Leviste could give me more specifics.

text: If possible, names and circumstances, and believe me I will act on it,” dugang ni Dizon.#
english: If possible, names and circumstances, and believe me I will act on it,” Dizon added.#

text: Nadakpan na sang mga otoridad ang walo sa napulo ka mga Persons Deprived of Liberty (PDLs) nga nagsipalagyo sa Batangas Provincial Jail sa Brgy.
english: Authorities have arrested eight of the 10 Persons Deprived of Liberty (PDLs) who escaped from the Batangas Provincial Jail in Brgy.

text: Malainin, Ibaan, Batangas, sa ginpatigayon nga hot pursuit operation, samtang ang duha padayon nga ginapangita.
english: Malainin, Ibaan, Batangas, in a hot pursuit operation, while the two are still wanted.

text: Suno sa mga otoridad, ginalauman nga ang ginareklamo nga inhumane treatment ukon malain nga pagtrato sang mga jail guards ang nagtulod sa mga PDLs nga magpalagyo pasado alas-9:30 sang aga.
english: According to the authorities, it is expected that the complained inhuman treatment or ill-treatment of the jail guards prompted the PDLs to flee around 9:30 am.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, isa sa mga PDL ang nagtawag sa jail guard samtang naga preparar ini sang pagkaon, gin-agawan sang pusil kag ginhana sang balisong antes ginkuha ang yabe kag ginpreso pa mismo ang jail guard sa selda.
english: According to the investigation, one of the PDLs called the jail guard while he was preparing food, robbed him of a gun and stabbed him with a balisong before taking the key and imprisoning the jail guard in the cell.

text: Tatlo ka PDL ang nadakpan sa malapit nga katalunan pinaagi sa drone operation, samtang lima ang nagtiner sa Alps bus nga pa-Cubao halin sa San Juan.
english: Three PDLs were arrested in a nearby forest through a drone operation, while five stayed on the Alps bus bound for Cubao from San Juan.

text: Nakabaton sang alerto ang driver nga si Angelito Alcantara halin sa bus inspector, gani ginpaliko sini ang bus sa Sto.
english: Driver Angelito Alcantara received an alert from the bus inspector, so he turned the bus to Sto.

text: Tomas City kun sa diin ginlibutan sang kapulisan.
english: Tomas City where he was surrounded by police.

text: Ginpangayo sang mga PDL nga may media present antes sila boluntaryo nga nagsungka matapos ang kapin 20 minutos nga negosasyon.
english: The PDL demanded that the media be present before they voluntarily surrendered after more than 20 minutes of negotiations.

text: Wala sang ginreport nga nasamaran sa insidente, kag narekober sang mga pulis ang isa ka 9mm pistol, bala, balisong kag P59,000 nga kwarta.
english: No injuries were reported in the incident, and police recovered a 9mm pistol, ammunition, ammunition and P59,000 in cash.

text: Duhá sa mga nadakpan nga PDLs ang nagbuyagyag nga ginalikupan sila sang pagpangbuno kag pangabuso sa sulod sang prisohan, gani nagapangabay sila nga indi na ibalik sa Batangas Provincial Jail.
english: Two of the arrested PDLs revealed that they were surrounded by beatings and abuse inside the jail, so they asked not to be returned to the Batangas Provincial Jail.

text: Ginsugo na ni Governor Vilma Santos-Recto ang imbistigasyon matapos sang insidente, samtang padayon ang manhunt sa duha pa ka PDL nga nakapalagyo.
english: Governor Vilma Santos-Recto has ordered an investigation after the incident, while the manhunt for the two other PDLs who escaped continues.

text: Nagsalangisag ang mga tawo sa opening night sang music festival sa Houston, Texas sa Estados Unidos.
english: The opening night of a music festival in Houston, Texas in the United States was packed.

text: Patay ang walo ka tawo samtang madamo naman ang pilason matapos nga nagdinaguso kag nagtinikludanay ang mga tawo agud lang nga makapaatubang sa stage samtang nagaperform ang rapper nga si Travis Scott.
english: Eight people were killed and several others injured after people rushed and crouched down to face the stage while rapper Travis Scott was performing.

text: 11 ka tawo ang gindala sa ospital bangud sa cardiac arrest kag walo ang napatay lakip na ang 10 ka tuig nga bata.
english: 11 people were taken to hospital due to cardiac arrest and eight died including a 10-year-old child.

text: Ginabanta yara sa 50,000 ka tawo ang nagtambong sa amo nga event.
english: An estimated 50,000 people attended the event.

text: Suno sa Houston Chronicle, makapila ka beses nag-untat si Travis Scott sa iya nga 75-minute performance sang iya nakit-an ang mga fans nga nagapangayo sang bulig sa atubang sang stage.
english: According to the Houston Chronicle, Travis Scott stopped several times during his 75-minute performance when he saw fans asking for help in front of the stage.

text: Gilayon man nga nagpangayo sang security ang rapper agud nga makuha ang mga tawo nga na-ipit kag na-pilpilan.
english: The rapper immediately called for security to rescue the people who were trapped and trapped.

text: Si Travis Scott amo ang nagtukod sang nasambit nga festival nga para kuntani sa iya nga youth charity.
english: Travis Scott founded the festival for his youth charity.

text: Ginapahayag gin-trade na sang Brooklyn Nets ang 13-time All-Star nga si Kevin Durant sa Phoenix Suns.
english: The Brooklyn Nets have reportedly traded 13-time All-Star Kevin Durant to the Phoenix Suns.

text: Nalab-ot ang amo nga agreement pila ka adlaw lamang matapos nga gin-trade man sang Nets ang ila star guard nga si Kyrie Irving sa Dallas Mavericks.
english: The agreement was reached just days after the Nets also traded their star guard Kyrie Irving to the Dallas Mavericks.

text: Nagdugang ang 34-anyos nga basketball superstar sa starting lineup sang Suns kun sa diin yara na nga daan sanday Chris Paul kag Devin Booker kag center nga si Deandre Ayton.
english: The 34-year-old basketball superstar added to the Suns' starting lineup that already includes Chris Paul and Devin Booker and center Deandre Ayton.

text: Bilang baylo kay Durant, mabaton sang Nets ang forwards nga sanday Mikal Bridges, Cameron Johnson kag Jae Crowder kaupod ang apat ka first-round draft picks.
english: In exchange for Durant, the Nets will receive forwards Mikal Bridges, Cameron Johnson and Jae Crowder along with four first-round draft picks.

text: Maangkon naman sang Suns ang forward nga si T.J. Warren halin sa Nets.
english: The Suns will acquire forward T.J. Warren from the Nets.

text: Nakadaog na si Durant sang duha ka National Basketball Association (NBA) championships sang yara pa sa Golden State Warriors; nakakuha sang NBA Most Valuable Player honor sang 2013-2014; kag isa man ka 13-time All-Star.
english: Durant has won two National Basketball Association (NBA) championships while with the Golden State Warriors; earned NBA Most Valuable Player honor in 2013-2014; and also a 13-time All-Star.

text: Apisar naga-edad na sang 34-anyos, ginalaragway nga sa “elite level” sa gihapon ang kalidad sang hampang ni Durant nga naga-average sang 30 points per game sa sini nga season.
english: Despite being 34-years-old, Durant is still described as being at an “elite level”, averaging 30 points per game this season.

text: Wala pa nakaagi daog sang NBA Championship ang Phoenix.
english: Phoenix has never won an NBA Championship.

text: Nakalab-ot ini sa Finals duha ka season na ang nakaligad apang ginlutos sang Milwaukee Bucks.
english: Nakalab-ot ini sa Finals duha ka season na ang nakaligad apang ginlutos sang Milwaukee Bucks.

text: Nakahampang man ang team sa Finals sang 1976 kag 1993.
english: The team also played in the Finals in 1976 and 1993.

text: Nagdangat sa 10 ka teenagers ang nasamaran sa shooting incident nga natabo sa guwa sang nightclub sa New York City sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: At least 10 teenagers were injured in a shooting incident outside a nightclub in New York City in the United States of America.

text: Suno sa New York Police Department, ginabanta 15 ka mga tawo ang nagabantay sa guwa sang Amazura Concert Hall sa Jamaica, Queens pasado alas onse sang gab-i agud maghulat sa isa ka pribado nga kahiwatan.
english: According to the New York Police Department, approximately 15 people stood guard outside the Amazura Concert Hall in Jamaica, Queens just after 11pm to wait for a private event.

text: Sunod nga may nag-abot nga apat ka mga lalaki kag nagpangluthang.
english: Four men then arrived and opened fire.

text: Ginabanta 30 ka mga lupok ang nabatian antes nagpalagyo ang mga suspek kag nagsakay sa sedan nga may out-of-state plates.
english: Approximately 30 shots were fired before the suspects fled and got into a sedan with out-of-state plates.

text: Ginkumpirma naman sang kapulisan nga 16 to 20 years old ang edad sang mga biktima kag subong yara sa ospital apang indi man kritikal ang mga kondisyon.
english: Police confirmed that the victims are aged 16 to 20 years old and are currently in hospital but their conditions are not critical.

text: Padayon pa subong ang imbestigasyon sa amo nga insidente.
english: The investigation into the incident is ongoing.

text: Natabo ini matapos ang krimen sa New Orleans kun sa diin gin-arado sang truck ang mga tawo kag 15 ang patay.
english: This happened after the crime in New Orleans where people were plowed by a truck and 15 were killed.

text: Sa Las Vegas naman, isa ka Tesla truck ang nagsigabong sa guwa sang Trump hotel kun sa diin pito ang pilason kag patay ang driver matapos ginluthang ang iya kaugalingon.
english: In Las Vegas, a Tesla truck caught fire outside the Trump hotel, injuring seven and killing the driver after he shot himself.

text: Wala pa sang gana si Los Angeles Lakers superstar LeBron James nga buy-an ang bola sa National Basketball Association (NBA) apisar nakuha niya ang maragtason nga kadalag-an bilang all-time leading scorer sa liga.
english: Los Angeles Lakers superstar LeBron James has no desire to release the ball to the National Basketball Association (NBA) despite winning the historic victory as the league's all-time leading scorer.

text: Ini matapos nalapawan sang 19-time NBA All-Star ang rekord ni Hall of Famer Kareem Abdul-Jabbar sa all-time scoring list paagi sa iya 38-point haul sa hampang sang Lakers batok sa Oklahoma City Thunder.
english: The 19-time NBA All-Star surpassed Hall of Famer Kareem Abdul-Jabbar's all-time scoring record with his 38-point haul in the Lakers' game against the Oklahoma City Thunder.

text: Gintapos ni James ang amo nga hampang paagi sa 38,390 career regular season points, mas mataas sang tatlo sa 38,387 nga tally ni Abdul-Jabbar, ang record nga amo ang nagapanguna sa lista sang all-time leading scorers halin sang 1984.
english: James finished that game with 38,390 career regular season points, three more than Abdul-Jabbar’s 38,387 tally, the record that has topped the list of all-time leading scorers since 1984.

text: Suno sa 38-anyos nga basketball star, ginalauman niya nga magatinir pa siya sa iya nga career sa amo nga liga sa sulod sang duha ka tuig.
english: The 38-year-old basketball star said he expects to stay in his career in the league for two years.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga marasangan pa niya nga mag-compete sa championships kag motivated pa siya nga himuon ini.
english: He also said that he can still compete in championships and he is still motivated to do so.

text: “I know I can play a couple more years.
english: “I know I can play a couple more years.

text: The way I’m feeling, the way my body’s been reacting to me through this season.
english: The way I’m feeling, the way my body’s been reacting to me through this season.

text: I know I can play a couple more years — it’s all about my mind.
english: I know I can play a couple more years — it’s all about my mind.

text: If my mind is still into it, if I’m still motivated to go out and try to compete for championships, I feel like I can still do that,” suno sa basketball superstar.
english: If my mind is still into it, if I’m still motivated to go out and try to compete for championships, I feel like I can still do that,” according to the basketball superstar.

text:
Sang ginpamangkot kun ang iya bag-o nga achievement ang nagakahulugan nga siya ang “greatest player in NBA history”, sabat ni James, “I’ll let everybody else decide who that is… But it’s great barber shop talk.”

Ginbaha naman sang pagpanginbulahan si James halin kay United States President Joe Biden, big basketball stars kaangay kanday Stephen Curry kag Kevin Durant, celebrities kaangay ni Rihanna, kag iban pa nga kabahin sang National Basketball Association community.
english:
When asked if his recent achievement means he is the “greatest player in NBA history”, James replied, “I’ll let everybody else decide who that is… But it’s great barber shop talk.”

James was flooded with congratulations from United States President Joe Biden, big basketball stars like Stephen Curry and Kevin Durant, celebrities like Rihanna, and other parts of the National Basketball Association community.
