text: Ginpangalanan ni Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla si Senador Christopher Lawrence “Bong” Go nga posible nga gina-protektahan sang mag-asawa nga kontraktor nga sanday Curlee kag Sarah Discaya.
english: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla has named Senator Christopher Lawrence “Bong” Go as possibly being protected by contractor couple Curlee and Sarah Discaya.

text: Ini matapos ginbawi sang mag-asawa ang ila nauna nga desisyon nga magakooperar sila sa Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI).
english: This comes after the couple withdrew their earlier decision to cooperate with the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI).

text: Suno kay Ombudsman Remulla, wala na siya nakibot sa ginhimo sang mag-asawa bangud nakahibalo siya nga may ginatago sila nga mga tawo kaangay kay Senador Go.
english: Ombudsman Remulla said he was not surprised by the couple's actions because he knew they were hiding people like Senator Go.

text: “Evasive talaga siya.
english: “He was really evasive.

text: Hindi niya talaga sasabihin lahat.
english: He won't really tell you everything.

text: Selective lang.
english: Just selective.

text: Meron siyang selective recall ng mga bagay-bagay,” suno kay Remulla.
english: He has a selective recall of things,” Remulla said.

text: “He’s protecting people, like Bong Go.
english: “He’s protecting people, like Bong Go.

text: Kasi nga, yung joint venture nila, eight projects worth P800 million.
english: Because, their joint venture, eight projects worth P800 million.

text: Doon sila nagsimulang lumaki.
english: There they began to grow up.

text: But they will not talk about it,” dugang sang opisyal.
english: But they will not talk about it,” the official added.

text: Ang ginatumod sang Ombudsman amo ang joint ventures nga ginsudlan sang kumpaniya sang mga Discaya nga St.
english: The Ombudsman is referring to the joint ventures entered into by the Discaya company St.

text: Gerrard Construction kag ang CLTG Builders nga amo naman ang contractor nga ginadumala sang amay kag utod ni Senator Go.
english: Gerrard Construction and CLTG Builders, the contractor managed by Senator Go's father and brother.

text: Nag-umpisa ini nga joint ventures sang 2017 sang tion nga nagaserbe pa lamang si Go bilang Special Assistant ni anay President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The joint ventures began in 2017 when Go was still serving as Special Assistant to former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Ini nga isyu ang nagtuhaw kadungan sang state witness evaluation sa mga Discaya kag sa case buildup nga ginapatigayon sang Department of Justice (DOJ).
english: The issue arose during the state witness evaluation of the Discayas and the case buildup conducted by the Department of Justice (DOJ).

text: Ginkumpirmar naman ni DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon nga magapatigayon sila kag ang Office of the Ombudsman sang imbestigasyon batuk sa CLTG Builders.
english: DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon confirmed that he and the Office of the Ombudsman will conduct an investigation against CLTG Builders.

text: Suno kay Dizon, ipasa nila sa Ombudsman ang tanan nga kontrata sang mga Discaya halin pa 2016 tubtob 2025 para sa madalom pa gid nga beripikasyon.
english: Dizon said they will submit to the Ombudsman all the contracts of the Discayas from 2016 to 2025 for more in-depth verification.

text: Nanindugan naman si Bong Go nga wala siya sang kaangtanan sa mga Discaya.
english: Bong Go insisted that he had nothing to do with the Discaya.

text: Nag-distansya man si Go sa negosyo sang iya pamilya, bangud suno sa iya, wala man siya sang kontrol diri.
english: Go also distanced himself from his family's business, saying he had no control over it.

text: “Ako po’y isang senador.
english: “I’m a senator.

text: Hindi po ako negosyante, hindi po ako contractor.
english: I'm not a businessman, I'm not a contractor.

text: Sana po huwag malihis po yung katotohanan,” suno sa senador.
english: I hope the truth does not deviate,” the senator said.

text: “Hindi ko kilala yung Discaya.
english: “I don't know Discaya.

text: At let me repeat, hindi po ako nakikipag-usap ng any government contracts o government transaction,” dugang sini.
english: And let me repeat, I am not talking about any government contracts or government transaction,” he added.

text: Naghatag sang nagkalain-lain nga mga reaksyon ang pila ka mga raleyista nga indi kuntento sa mga polisa nga ginapatuman sang Marcos Administration.
english: Some rallyists who are not satisfied with the policies implemented by the Marcos Administration gave different reactions.

text: Ini kadungan sa ginpatigayon nga 2025 State of the Nation Address ni President Marcos kahapon adlaw sa Quezon City.
english: This is in conjunction with the 2025 State of the Nation Address held by President Marcos yesterday in Quezon City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Raoul Manuel, anay representante sang Kabataan Partylist, iya ginpahayag nga ang SONA ni Marcos Jr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Raoul Manuel, former representative of the Kabataan Partylist, said that the SONA of Marcos Jr.

text: wala nagapakita sang matuod-tuod nga sitwasyon sang Pilipinas.
english: does not reflect the true situation of the Philippines.

text: Ginpunto niya ang problema sa edukasyon, kahimtangan sang mga mamumugon, mangunguma kag mangingisda, ang padayon nga pagsaka sang presyo sang mga balaklon kag ang wala pagpataas sang suweldo.
english: He pointed out the problem of education, condition of workers, farmers and fishermen, the continuous rise in commodity prices and the non-increase in wages.

text: Dugang pa niya nga wala sang klaro nga solusyon ang Presidente sa mga seryoso nga problema sang pungsod.
english: He added that the President has no clear solution to the country's serious problems.

text: Nakuha sang tiglawas sang Pilipinas nga si Maureen Montagne ang korona sa Miss Globe 2021.
english: Philippine representative Maureen Montagne won the Miss Globe 2021 crown.

text: Ang nasambit nga pageant ang ginpatigayon sa Opera Theater sa Tirana, Albania.
english: The pageant was held at the Opera Theater in Tirana, Albania.

text: Bag-o ang iya pagdaog, ginkoronahan man sang damlag lang ang iya batchmate sa Binibining Pilipinas nga si Cinderella Obeñita bilang Miss Intercontinental 2021 sa Egypt.
english: Prior to her win, her Miss Philippines batchmate Cinderella Obeñita was also recently crowned Miss Intercontinental 2021 in Egypt.

text: Sa coronation night sang Miss Globe 2021, ginlutos ni Montagne ang indi magnubo sa 40 ka mga kandidata sa diin siya na ang ika-duha nga Miss Globe titleholder sunod kay Ann Colis sang 2015.
english: At the coronation night of Miss Globe 2021, Montagne defeated at least 40 contestants to become the second Miss Globe titleholder after Ann Colis in 2015.

text: Ang runners-up sa nasambit nga international pageant ang ginalakipan sang mga kandidata halin sa Nigeria (first runner-up), Turkey (second runner-up), Venezuela (third runner-up), kag Canada (fourth runner-up).
english: The runners-up in the said international pageant include candidates from Nigeria (first runner-up), Turkey (second runner-up), Venezuela (third runner-up), and Canada (fourth runner-up).

text: Nahibaluan nga ang 28 anyos nga beauty queen nga tumandok sang Batangas City ang nangin first runner-up sa Miss Eco International 2019.
english: The 28-year-old beauty queen, a native of Batangas City, became the first runner-up in Miss Eco International 2019.

text: Ang Miss Eco International 2019 title ang gin-offer sa iya matapos na-dethrone ang winner nga si Suheyn Cipriani sang Peru bangud nagabusong ini.
english: The Miss Eco International 2019 title was offered to her after winner Suheyn Cipriani of Peru was dethroned because she was pregnant.

text: Wala ginbaton ni Montagne ang offer kag ang fourth runner-up nga si Amy Tinie Abdul Aziz sang Malaysia ang ginkoronahan sang amo nga tuig.
english: Montagne declined the offer and fourth runner-up Amy Tinie Abdul Aziz of Malaysia was crowned that year.

text: Matapos ang duha ka tuig nga magkarelasyon, engaged na ang American actress nga si Kristen Stewart sa iya partner nga si Dylan Meyer, isa man ka actress kag writer.
english: After two years of dating, American actress Kristen Stewart is engaged to her partner Dylan Meyer, also an actress and writer.

text: Suno kay Kristen, ang iya nga partner mismo ang nag-propose sa iya.
english: According to Kristen, her partner himself proposed to her.

text: Matandaan nga 2017 sang gin-ako sini nga isa siya ka bisexual.
english: It can be recalled that in 2017, he admitted that he is bisexual.

text: Si Kristen amo ang nagserbe nga “Bella” sa Twilight movies.
english: Kristen served as “Bella” in the Twilight movies.

text: Kag subong, siya naman ang maga-portray bilang si Princess Diana sang Britanya sa movie nga “Spencer”.
english: And now, she will portray Princess Diana of Britain in the movie “Spencer”.

text: ILOILO CITY – Lauman sang mga kunsumidor ang pagsaka sang electric bills sa masunod nga mga binulan.
english: ILOILO CITY – Consumers can expect electricity bills to rise in the coming months.

text: Ini matapos nga gin-aprubahan sang Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) ang petition sang National Power Corp.
english: This comes after the Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) approved the petition of National Power Corp.

text: (Napocor) nga i-rcover ang P2.6 billion worth sang kapyerdehan sa rural electrification subsidy sang 2012.
english: (Napocor) to cover the P2.6 billion worth of losses in rural electrification subsidy in 2012.

text: Sa resolution nga napetsahan sang Agosto 4, gin-resolve sang ERC ang pag-grant sanh final authority sa petition sang Napocor nga mag-recover sang kapyerdehan sa Universal Charge-Missionary Electrification (UC-ME) Subsidy sang 2012 nga nagabalor sang P2,606,208,364.83 nga may equivalent rate nga P0.0239 per kilowatt-hour (/kWh).
english: In a resolution dated August 4, the ERC resolved to grant final authority to Napocor's petition to recover the loss of the Universal Charge-Missionary Electrification (UC-ME) Subsidy in 2012 worth P2,606,208,363 with an equivalent rate. P0.0239 per kilowatt-hour (/kWh).

text: Bangud sini, ang regulatory board ang nagmandu sa tanan nga distribution utilities (DUs) kag National Grid Corp.
english: As a result, the regulatory board has directed all distribution utilities (DUs) and National Grid Corp.

text: of the Philippines nga magkolekta sa mga kunsumidor sang UC-ME true-up rate nga P0.0239/kWh magluwas sa existing UC-ME basic rate nga P0.1561/kWh sa sulod sang 12 ka bulan ukon tubtob nga mabawi ang full amount.
english: of the Philippines to collect from consumers the UC-ME true-up rate of P0.0239/kWh in addition to the existing UC-ME basic rate of P0.1561/kWh for 12 months or until the full amount is recovered.

text: Ang DUs kag ang NGCP ang ginamanduan nga mag-remit sang kwarta nga na-recover sa Power Sector Assets and Liabilities Corp.
english: The DUs and the NGCP are directed to remit the money recovered to the Power Sector Assets and Liabilities Corp.

text: (PSALM) on or before sang ika-15 nga adlaw sang mga masunod nga mga binulan.
english: (PSALM) on or before the 15th day of the following months.

text: Ginmanduan man sang ERC ang PSALM nga mag-disburse sa Napocor sang aprubado nga UC-ME recovery nga nagasanto sa true-up adjustment mechanism.
english: The ERC also directed PSALM to disburse to Napocor an approved UC-ME recovery consistent with the true-up adjustment mechanism.

text: Samtang, ginmandu-an man sang ERC ang PSALM nga mag-monitor kag mag-report sang progress sa collection kag disbursement sang true-up kag basic UC-ME agud nga ma-distinguish ang cash flow sa tagsa ka approved UC-ME rates.
english: Meanwhile, the ERC also directed PSALM to monitor and report progress in the collection and disbursement of true-up and basic UC-ME in order to distinguish cash flow from each approved UC-ME rates.

text: Ginpang-tiro patay sang isa ka lalaki ang 12 ka mga tawo sa Montenegro sa Southeastern Europe antes sini ginluthang man ang iya kaugalingon.
english: A man shot dead 12 people in Montenegro in Southeastern Europe before shooting himself.

text: Ginakabig ang insidente nga isa sa worst mass killings sa amo nga Balkan nation.
english: The incident is considered one of the worst mass killings in the Balkan nation.

text: Ang suspek amo si Aco Martinovic, 45, nga una nagpangluthang sa apat ka mga tawo sa sulod sang restaurant sa Cetinje matapos may nagluntad nga pagpu-isay.
english: The suspect was identified as Aco Martinovic, 45, who first shot four people inside a restaurant in Cetinje after an argument broke out.

text: Sunod sini nga ginpatay ang walo ka mga tawo lakip ang duha ka kabataan kag iya mismo utod nga babaye sa tatlo ka nagkalain-lain nga lokasyon.
english: He subsequently killed eight people including two children and his own sister in three different locations.

text: Tanan nga mga biktima suno sa pulis amo ang iya mga maninoy, mga abyan, kag mga tawo nga maayo man ang ila relasyon kag nakaupod pa gani niya sa pagselebrar sang New Year.
english: All the victims, according to police, were his in-laws, friends, and people with whom he had a good relationship and even celebrated the New Year with him.

text: Sang na-corner na sang mga pulis, didto na kag gintiro sini ang kaugalingon kag napatay samtang ginadala sa ospital.
english: When the police cornered him, he shot himself and died while being taken to the hospital.

text: Ginaalegar hubog ang suspek sang natabo ini.
english: The suspect was allegedly drunk when the incident occurred.

text: May nauna man ini nga kaso sang 2022 matapos nakitaan sang duha ka airguns kag homemade bomb sa iya balay.
english: He also had a previous case in 2022 after two airguns and a homemade bomb were found in his house.

text: Una naman ini nga napanugyanan nga magpaidalom sa psychiatric evaluation.
english: He was initially advised to undergo a psychiatric evaluation.

text: Ginlunsar sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) ang labing-una nga Philippine National Standard (PNS) para sa Christmas star lanterns ukon mas kilala nga mga parol.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) has launched the first-ever Philippine National Standard (PNS) for Christmas star lanterns or better known as lanterns.

text: Nakabutang ini sa PNS 2296-1:2025 – Lamps and Related Equipment – Part 1: Construction and Marking Requirements, nga gin-develop nga may kolaborasyon sa global safety organization nga UL Standards & Engagement (ULSE).
english: This is set out in PNS 2296-1:2025 – Lamps and Related Equipment – ​​Part 1: Construction and Marking Requirements, developed in collaboration with the global safety organization UL Standards & Engagement (ULSE).

text: Sa sini nga standards, gindetalye ang construction and marking requirements agud masigurado nga ang mga parol nga ginahimo para sa Paskuwa ang safe bisan yara sa sulod sang balay ukon pasilidad, ukon sa guwa sini.
english: In these standards, the construction and marking requirements are detailed to ensure that the lanterns made for Easter are safe whether inside the house or facility, or outside it.

text: Suno kay Trade Secretary Christina Roque, ang bag-o nga polisa amo ang magabulig sa mga magahimo sang parola agud masiguro man ang kalidad sang ila nga produkto kag para nga maka-compete man ini sa hinimuan sang iban.
english: According to Trade Secretary Christina Roque, the new policy will help lighthouse manufacturers to ensure the quality of their products and to compete with the work of others.

text: Pahayag pa sang tiglikom, isa man ini ka pagpakita sang suporta para sa local manufacturers sa idalom sang Tatak Pinoy brand.
english: The secretary said it is also a show of support for local manufacturers under the Tatak Pinoy brand.

text: “More than ensuring product safety, these standards uplift our parol makers whose craftsmanship reflects Filipino pride,” pahayag sang opisyal.
english: “More than ensuring product safety, these standards uplift our parol makers whose craftsmanship reflects Filipino pride,” the official said.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang DTI paagi sa Bureau of Philippine Standards (BPS) ang may yara sang mandato sa idalom sang layi nga mag-develop, mag-implementar, kag mag-coordinate sang standardization activities sa bilog nga Pilipinas.
english: The DTI through the Bureau of Philippine Standards (BPS) is mandated under the law to develop, implement, and coordinate standardization activities throughout the Philippines.

text: Nagaserbe man ang BPS bilang national standards body sang pungsod
english: The BPS also serves as the country’s national standards body

text: Nagpanguna ang Iloilo City sa may pinakamataas nga inflation sa bilog nga Western Visayas sa bulan sang Hulyo.
english: Iloilo City had the highest inflation rate in Western Visayas in July.

text: Base sa data sang Philippine Statistics Office (PSA) , nakarekord ang syudad sang 8.9 percent nga mas mataas sa regional average nga 6.9 percent kag national average nga 6.4 percent.
english: Based on data from the Philippine Statistics Office (PSA), the city recorded 8.9 percent, higher than the regional average of 6.9 percent and the national average of 6.4 percent.

text: Ini ang resulta sang pagtaas sang presyo sang pagkaon nga gin-updan man sang pagsaka sang presyo sang gatong.
english: This is the result of rising food prices that have also been accompanied by a rise in fuel prices.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Jerry Trenas, iya ginpahayag nga ginatinguhaan subong sang syudad nga mapahagan-hagan ang impact sang mataas nga inflation.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Jerry Trenas said the city is now trying to mitigate the impact of high inflation.

text: Suno sa alkalde, dako ang bulig sang pila ka program sang ahensya sang gobyerno kaangay sang cash-for-work program sang Iloilo City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO) kag Tulong Panghanapbuhay sa Ating Disadvantaged / Displaced Workers (TUPAD) sang Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE).
english: The mayor said that several programs of government agencies such as the cash-for-work program of the Iloilo City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO) and the Tulong Panghanapbuhay sa Ating Disadvantaged / Displaced Workers (TUPAD) of the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) are of great help.

text: Dugang sang alkalde, nagahulag man ang city government sa pagpasanyog pa sang nutritional status sang kabataan paagi sa pagpatigayon sang feeding programs.
english: The mayor added that the city government is also working to improve the nutritional status of children through feeding programs.

text: Magluwas diri, nakig-partner man ang syudad sa Iloilo Bakers Association para sa skills training sa idalom sang Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA) kag madamo pa nga mga programa.
english: In addition, the city also partnered with the Iloilo Bakers Association for skills training under the Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA) and many other programs.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa data sang PSA, halin sa 6.2 percent sang Hunyo, nagtaas ang inflation rate sang Western Visayas sa 6.9 percent sang Hulyo.
english: According to PSA data, from 6.2 percent in June, the inflation rate in Western Visayas rose to 6.9 percent in July.

text: Wala na napunggan sang action star nga si Jeric Raval nga makapautwas kasunod sang wala pa nagtahaw nga pagpang-bash batok sa iya anak, ang young actress and sexy star nga si AJ Raval, bangud sa kaangtanan sini kay Aljur Abrenica.
english: Action star Jeric Raval couldn't help but speak out following the unprecedented bashing against his son, young actress and sexy star AJ Raval, for his relationship with Aljur Abrenica.

text: Ginpahayag ni Jeric nga mabuot ang iya 21 anyos nga anak kag tuman nga naapektuhan bangud sang mga ginahaboy nga pagpakamalaot sa iya.
english: Jeric said his 21-year-old son is kind and was deeply affected by the insults thrown at him.

text: Mensahe ni Jeric sa mga bashers: “Unang una, sana po maka move on na po tayong lahat.
english: Jeric's message to the bashers: “First of all, I hope we can all move on.

text: At as much as possible sana ayaw ko ng magsalita about this kaya lang pangit naman kung hindi ako magsasalita.
english: And as much as possible I hope I don't want to talk about this so it's ugly if I don't.

text: Sana po lahat ng bashers niya ay maka-move on na po.
english: I hope all his bashers can move on.

text:
‘Wag po natin masyadong personalin, unang-una hindi naman po (ninyo) siya (si AJ) kilala at kung may nakakakilala po sa anak ko, ako po ‘yun at sinisigurado ko po mabuting bata po ‘yan, mabait na bata.”

Gin-athag man ni Jeric nga nakaistoryahanay na sila ni Aljur.
english:
Let's not take it too personally, first of all, you don't know him (AJ) and if anyone knows my son, I'm there and I'm sure he's a good child, a good child.”

Jeric also explained that he and Aljur have already spoken.

text: “Siyempre hindi ka na rin bata.
english: “Of course you’re not a kid anymore.

text: Aljur, magpaka-lalaki ka na lang, tol.
english: Aljur, just pretend to be a man, tol.

text: At wala naman akong masamang tinapay sayo.
english: And I don't have any bad bread for you.

text: Gaya nung una nating napag-usapan, i-ayos mo muna yung buhay mo.
english: Like we talked about earlier, get your life in order.

text: I-ayos mo lahat.
english: Fix everything.

text: Kailangan nasa ayos lahat.
english: Everything must be in order.

text: Yan ang lagi kong uulit-ulitin sayo.
english: That's what I always repeat to you.

text: Kung maayos lahat yan, wala ka ng problema sa akin,” suno pa sa action star.
english: If it's all right, you have no problem with me,” the action star said.

text: Suno kay Jeric, indi third party ang iya nga anak sa pagbulagay nanday Kylie Padilla kag Aljur, apang nag-abiso ini sa iya anak nga maghalong sa pagpangaluyag ni Aljur.
english: According to Jeric, his son is not a third party in the separation of Kylie Padilla and Aljur, but he warned his son to be careful with Aljur's dating.

text: “Kasi kahit anong sabihin natin, kasal pa rin si Aljur at tsaka si Kylie.
english: “Because no matter what we say, Aljur and Kylie are still married.

text: At walang magulang na gusto niya ang anak niya ay parang kabit.
english: And no parent wants their child to be like a wife.

text: Walang magulang na ganu’n.” Gin-ako man sini nga pati siya gina-bash na sang mga tawo.
english: No parent like that.” He also admitted that even he is being bashed by people.

text: Dugang pa sang aktor, “Apektado ‘yung anak ko, nakita ko, e, napaka-masiyahin ng batang ‘yun, eh.
english: The actor added, “My son is affected, I saw, e, very happy child, eh.

text: Playful pa rin ‘yun hanggang ngayon, naawa lang ako.
english: It's still playful to this day, I just feel sorry for it.

text: Ako, okay lang ako ma-bash, lalaki naman ako, sanay ako sa ganyan.
english: I'm okay with being bashed, I'm a man, I'm used to that.

text: Wag lang ‘yung anak ko, iba pag anak ko naawa ako.” ##
english: Not just my child, otherwise I feel sorry for my child.” ##

text: Satisfied ukon kuntento si Mayor Raisa Treñas sa performance ni Presidente Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: Mayor Raisa Treñas is satisfied with the performance of President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa alkalde, iya ginpahayag nga madamo na sang naobrahan si Marcos sa iya administrasyon nga nangin rason man nangin masako ang siyudad sa mga ginapadala sang Presidente nga mga proyekto .
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, the mayor said that Marcos has done a lot of work in his administration which has also been the reason why the city is busy with the projects sent by the President.

text: Suno kay Treñas, isa na diri ang pagpadala mismo sang Department of Transportation (DOTr) Undersecretary agud makabulig sa traffic kag transportation sang siyudad.
english: According to Treñas, one of these is the deployment of the Department of Transportation (DOTr) Undersecretary to assist in the traffic and transportation of the city.

text: Dugang man ang maayo nga performance sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) kun sa diin madasig ang disaster response kag pagbulig sa siyudad.
english: The good performance of the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) in terms of fast disaster response and assistance to the city was also added.

text: Pahayag ni Treñas, kun kaisa nagareklamo lang ang iban apang bilang Local Chief Executive, mabatyagan gid niya ang mga plano kag maayo nga binuhatan sang administrasyon.
english: Treñas said sometimes others just complain but as Local Chief Executive, he can feel the plans and good deeds of the administration.

text: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑯𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒂 𝑨𝒏𝒅𝒂𝒔𝒂
english: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑯𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒂 𝑨𝒏𝒅𝒔𝒂

text: Ginhingadlan ang 42-anyos nga Spanish legend nga si Pau Gasol bilang dugang nga global ambassador para sa FIBA World Cup 2023 kun sa diin ang mga host amo ang Pilipinas, Japan, kag Indonesia.
english: 42-year-old Spanish legend Pau Gasol has been named as an additional global ambassador for the FIBA ​​World Cup 2023 where the hosts are the Philippines, Japan, and Indonesia.

text: Gin-updan sang nasambit nga international basketball icon si Luis Scola sang Argentina nga una na na-anunsyo bilang isa man ka World Cup global ambassador.
english: The international basketball icon was accompanied by Luis Scola of Argentina who was previously announced as a World Cup global ambassador.

text: Katapusan nga naghampang si Gasol para sa Barcelona sang 2021 kag madumduman nga nagdaog man sa 2006 FIBA World Cup sa Japan.
english: Gasol last played for Barcelona in 2021 and remembered that he also won the 2006 FIBA ​​World Cup in Japan.

text: Sa kabug-usan, nakahampang si Gasol sa tatlo ka World Cups, lima ka Olympics, kag pito ka FIBA EuroBaskets.
english: In total, Gasol has played in three World Cups, five Olympics, and seven FIBA ​​EuroBaskets.

text: Ginbuligan sini nga itib-ong ang Espanya agud makadaog sang silver medals sa 2008 kag 2012 Olympics kag bronze medal naman sa 2016 Rio de Janeiro Games.
english: He helped lead Spain to silver medals at the 2008 and 2012 Olympics and a bronze medal at the 2016 Rio de Janeiro Games.

text: Isa man siya ka two-time National Basketball Association champion sang yara pa sa Los Angeles Lakers.
english: He was also a two-time National Basketball Association champion while with the Los Angeles Lakers.

text: Nagpabilin siya nga aktibo sa sports pagkatapos sang iya nga retirement sa international basketball pagkatapos sang Tokyo Olympics in 2021.
english: He remained active in sports after his retirement from international basketball after the Tokyo Olympics in 2021.

text: Bilang World Cup Global Ambassador, dal-on ni Gasol ang iya ihibalo kag passion sa basketball agud nga ma-promote kag masuportahan ang tournament.
english: As the World Cup Global Ambassador, Gasol will bring his knowledge and passion for basketball to promote and support the tournament.

text: Patigayunon ang FIBA World Cup halin sa Agusto 25 tubtub sa Septyembre 10.##
english: The FIBA ​​World Cup will be held from August 25 to September 10.##

text: Indi gid makalusot sa kamot sang otoridad sa Cebu ang isa ka lalaki nga vlogger matapos ini nagpatunga sa dalan kag nagpakuno-kuno nga taklong kag nagtuga sang pagpug-ok sang trapiko.
english: A male vlogger could not escape the hands of the authorities in Cebu after he stopped in the middle of the road and pretended to be a taklong and caused a traffic jam.

text: Bisan naham-ot man ang iban nga followers sa ginhimo ni Boss LB (Brian ang matuod nga pangalan) madamo gid ang naugot sa epekto sini sa trapiko sa highway sa banwa sang Consolacion sa northern Cebu.
english: Although some followers were pleased with what Boss LB (Brian's real name) did, many were angry with the impact on highway traffic in Consolacion town in northern Cebu.

text: Si Boss LB mismo ang nag-share sang iya video nga nagakamang-kamang sa highway samtang suksok sang green-colored costume.
english: Boss LB himself shared a video of him crawling down the highway while wearing a green-colored costume.

text: Ginatawag niya ang iya kaugalingon nga si Snail Man.
english: He calls himself Snail Man.

text: Bisan madamo na nga salakyan ang nagabusina sa iya, proud ini sa ginahimo kag naga-ngisi-ngisi pa sang nagpahigad na gid man ini sa dalan.
english: Even though there were many cars honking at him, he was proud of what he was doing and was still grinning when he finally pulled off the road.

text: Masobra sa 18,700 ang reactions sa original video kag masobra 15,000 ang nag-share.
english: The original video has more than 18,700 reactions and more than 15,000 shares.

text: Apang bangud madamo man ang nag-bash sa iya, nag-paguwa siya sang public apology kag nagpadulong sa police station.
english: However, since many people also bashed him, he issued a public apology and went to the police station.

text: “Mo volunteer diay ko nga moadto sa Consolacion Police Station mangayo ko og pasaylo sa akong dakong sayop nga nabuhat nga dili maayo.
english: “I will volunteer to go to the Consolacion Police Station to apologize for my big mistake.

text: Og usa pa sad naka cause ko og kasamok sa dan diri sa Consolacion, naka cause ko og trapik ba, mangayo lang gyud ko og dakong pasaylo gyud tungod sa akoang gibuhat nga di mao.
english: And another thing I caused trouble on the road here in Consolacion, I caused traffic, I just apologize for what I did wrong.

text: Ilabi na nga naghatag og di maayong pagtulon-an sa mga bata,” kabahin sang Facebook post.
english: Especially giving bad education to children,” part of the Facebook post.

text: Sa pihak sini, nag-rekomendar ang Highway Patrol Group sa Central Visayas (HPG-7) nga pasakaan gid ini sang kaso bangud sa inconvenience nga natuga kag posible pa nga naaksidente ang iban bangud sa iya stunt.
english: Meanwhile, the Highway Patrol Group in Central Visayas (HPG-7) recommended that he be prosecuted for the inconvenience caused and possible accidents to others due to his stunt.

text: Ginmanduan na ang legal team sang patrol group nga tumuron kun ano nga traffic violations ang nakomiter sang vlogger.
english: The legal team of the patrol group has been ordered to investigate the traffic violations committed by the vlogger.

text: Nagpaandam man ang police station nga final warning na ini sa iban nga vloggers nga pilion man ang ila nga content kag magpili man sang lugar nga indi makaperwisyo sa iban nga mga tawo.
english: The police station also warned that this is a final warning to other vloggers to choose their content and choose a place that will not harm other people.

text: Ginpangabay ni Councilor Ganzon, nga hawanan ang Session Hall agud hatagan pagkilala ang mga bisita kag mapalapad ang espasyo para sa media kag staff.
english: Councilor Ganzon requested that the Session Hall be cleared to give recognition to the guests and expand the space for the media and staff.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo City Councilor Rudolph Jeffrey Ganzon, ginpahayag sini nga nangin kabahin siya sang pag-request nga hawanan anay ang Session Hall sang konseho bangud sang kadamuon sang bisita kag line-up sa agenda sang ila sesyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo City Councilor Rudolph Jeffrey Ganzon said he was part of the request to vacate the Session Hall of the council due to the number of guests and line-up on the agenda of their session.

text: Suno kay Ganzon, importante nga mahatagan sang insakto nga pagkilala ang mga bisita, ilabi na ang media kag mga staff nga kis-a lang makakadto sa hall.
english: According to Ganzon, it is important to give proper recognition to the guests, especially the media and staff who only occasionally come to the hall.

text: Nahambal man sini nga pagkatapos sang photo opportunity, pwede man makabalik sa ila pulungkuan ang mga bisita.
english: He also said that after the photo opportunity, guests can return to their seats.

text: Dugang pa niya, kinahanglan man nga mangin convenient para sa tanan kag mahatagan sang lugar ang media team bangud limitado gid ang espasyo sa sulod.
english: He added that it also needs to be convenient for everyone and give the media team a place because the space inside is very limited.

text: Sa subong, nagapangita pa sila sang mas maayo nga paagi bangud tama kagamay sang Session Hall.
english: Currently, they are still looking for a better way because the Session Hall is too small.

text: Nakakuha ang Pilipinas sang 10 billion yen ukon kapin ₱3.7 billion nga emergency financing halin sa Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA).
english: The Philippines has received 10 billion yen or more than ₱3.7 billion in emergency financing from the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA).

text:
Ini agud suportahan ang post-typhoon response kag recovery kasunod sang kahalitan nga ginbilin sang bagyo “Tino.”

Suno sa JICA Philippines, ang pondo nagarepresentar sang first tranche sang Post-Disaster Standby Loan Phase 3 (PDSL3), nga gamiton agud suportahan ang relief, rehabilitation, kag reconstruction efforts sang gobyerno.
english:
This is to support the post-typhoon response and recovery following the damage left by typhoon “Tino.”

According to JICA Philippines, the fund represents the first tranche of the Post-Disaster Standby Loan Phase 3 (PDSL3), which will be used to support the government’s relief, rehabilitation, and reconstruction efforts.

text: Ginpahayag sang JICA nga ang pag- release sang pondo ang kasunod sang request halin sa Department of Finance (DOF) matapos gindeklarar ang state of national calamity bangud sa impact sang bagyo.
english: JICA said the release of the funds follows a request from the Department of Finance (DOF) after the state of national calamity was declared due to the impact of the typhoon.

text:
(Ika-4 kag Katapusan nga Bahin)

NAGBULOS-bulos na ang pagkirab sang kilat.
english:
(4th and Final Part)

THE lightning flashed one after another.

text: Wala pa isa ka minuto kag ginsundan ini sang pagdinaguob.
english: Less than a minute later and it was followed by thunder.

text: Samtang nagalumbayag sa balod ang amon sakayan nga nagaraginit sa pag-gios tubtub sa palo (mast) sa waswas sang balod kag hangin.
english: As our boat rolled in the waves, it was struggling to move up to the mast in the waves and wind.

text: Masalop ini kag maulian sa daluyong nga balod sang Habagat .
english: It will sink and be recovered by the southerly waves.

text: Kag, hambalon pa, todo sarado gid ang kapyot ko sa banting agud indi mahaboy sa lawod.
english: And, by the way, I had a tight grip on the banting so that it wouldn't be thrown into the sea.

text: Todo ursa ang pagdalagan sang amon sakayan agud masapar gid ang Tatlong Pulo nga ang garhom makita sa kada kirab sang kilat.
english: Our boat was running at full speed to cover the Three Islands whose glory could be seen in every flash of lightning.

text: Ugaling daw indi gid namon masapar ang Tatlong Pulo kay padayon nga lapaw ang amon lakat bisan anhon pa namon nga ursa.
english: But it seemed that we could never cross the Three Islands because we kept walking no matter how hard we tried.

text: Malapit na seguro sa isa ka oras ang amon panakayon sang nagrinagaak ang sunod-sunod nga pagkirab sang kilat, nga sinundan sang ulihi sang asod-asod nga mala-bomba kag makatilingil nga pagdinaguob.
english: We had been traveling for about an hour when a series of flashes of lightning struck, followed by a bomb-like smoke and a deafening thunder.

text: Nag-amat-amat man hina ugaling ang ulan.
english: The rain gradually subsided.

text: Sa pagpati sang mga katigulangan diri, patimaan ini nga manug-ubos na ang paghulog sang ulan halin sa langit.
english: The ancestors here believe that this is a sign that the rain is about to fall from the sky.

text: Kaagahon na ato.
english: It was morning.

text: Natalupangdan namon nga yara na gali kami sa lawod sang Oton, mga duha ka milya seguro ang antad sa Tatlong Pulo.
english: We noticed that we were in the Oton Sea, about two miles from Tatlong Pulo.

text: Panagatan man ini nga lugar kag naisip sang tiyo ko nga managat kami anay liwat.
english: It was also a fishing spot and my uncle thought we should go fishing again.

text: Nga daan wala gid kami sing hulik.
english: That before we never had a kiss.

text: Nakahulik gid man kami diri sang isa ka tangegue, mga duha ka kilo seguro.
english: We actually caught a tangegue here, about two kilos probably.

text: Sang amat-amat balik ang mabaskug nga hangin kag balod, nag-alsa na kami pondo agud magpauli.
english: When the strong winds and waves gradually returned, we raised funds to return home.

text: Nagsulod kami seguro sadto sa eye-of-the-storm sa pagbalik man sang malain nga panahon.
english: We must have entered the eye-of-the-storm with the return of bad weather.

text: Mga a las nwebe na kami makaabot sa baybay kon diin madamo na ang nagahulat sa ila kalangkag kon ano na ang natabo sa amon.
english: About nine o'clock we reached the beach where many people were waiting in their curiosity to see what had happened to us.

text:
***

Well, indi lang ato ang naagihan ko nga peligro sa lawod sa pagpanagat.
english:
***

Well, that's not the only danger I've experienced at sea while fishing.

text: Tatlo kami ang nagpalawod.
english: Three of us sailed.

text: Wala pa kami kaabot sa pondohan sang nagbaskug ang hangin kag balod.
english: We had not yet reached the dock when the wind and waves became stronger.

text: Nabalian kami sang palo (mast) kag ginsulod sang balod ang amon sakayan.
english: We broke a mast and the waves took our boat.

text: Naghingagaw kami pauli nga nagabugsay lang.
english: We rowed home just rowing.

text: Sa sulod sang Lawi kami nagtupa sa lugar nga sa Tatlong Pulo.
english: Inside Lawi we landed at the place at Three Islands.

text: Sang aga na lang kami nagbugsay liwat pauli.
english: It wasn't until morning that we rowed home again.

text: Naanod man ako samtang nagapanagat sang pisogo nga isahanon sa isa ka baroto sa likod sang Naburot, nga isa man ka gamay nga pulo sa unhan lang sang Tatlong Pulo.
english: I also drowned while fishing alone in a boat behind Naburot, which is also a small island just off the Three Islands.

text: Gabiti sadto ang init kon san-o masami maayo ang hulik sang pisogo sa ina nga lugar.
english: It was the heat of the day when the pisogo was usually good in that area.

text: Madamo kami sadto ang nagapanagat sang pisogo, ugaling nauna pauli ang iban.
english: Many of us were fishing for pisogo, but others went home earlier.

text: Nagpabilin ako anay kay medyo nahuya man ako kay diutay lang ang akon hulik samtang madamo ang hulik sang iban.
english: I stayed for a while because I was a little embarrassed because I had a little kiss while others had a lot of kisses.

text: Malas seguro kay nalastra ang akon pondo pakadto sa kadadalman nga indi na makapanghawid ang akon ankla.
english: Unfortunately, my funds were dragged to the depths that my anchor could no longer hold.

text: Inanod ako palawod kay indi ko na masarangan bugsayan ang baroto pabalik sa panghigaron, tubtub nagkambyo ang hangin kag napadpad ako pahigad.
english: I was swept out to sea because I couldn't paddle the boat back to shore, until the wind changed and I washed ashore.

text: Nakahawid ako sa Punta Lawi kon diin may nagsapupo sa akon nga abyan ni papa.
english: I was stranded in Punta Lawi where a friend of my father's took me in.

text: Dulom na sadto.
english: It was already dark.

text: Nag-abot ako sa Tatlong Pulo sang mga a las otso sang aga pagkatapos sang mga duha ka oras nga pagbugsay nga nagapanghigaron.
english: I arrived at Three Islands at around eight in the morning after about two hours of snorkeling.

text: Naabtan ko ang isa ka kandila nga natibsok sa balas.
english: I found a candle stuck in the sand.

text: Pensar gali sang lola ko nga wala na ako tungod ginpangita nila ako sa tanan nga bahin sang kalalawran nga malab-utan nila kag wala gid ako makita.
english: My grandmother thought I was gone because they searched for me in every part of the ocean they could reach and never found me.

text:
***

Sa nasiling ko na, indi ko luyag i-rekomendar ining natabo sa akon sa luyag maglingaw-lingaw sa pagpanagat diri sa amon sitio.
english:
***

As I said, I would not recommend this experience to anyone who wants to enjoy fishing here in our sitio.

text: Luas lang kon mananagat ukon sakayanon man sila.
english: Unless they are fishermen or boatmen.

text: In fact, pinakamaayo ang pagduaw diri sa amon sitio agud maglingaw-lingaw kon panahon sang Amihan.
english: In fact, it is best to visit our sitio to have fun during the Amihan season.

text: Masinaw ang tubig sa baybay, wala sing gapamerwisyo nga salabay, kag masami makanay ang balod para mag-swimming, magpamunit sa nabawan sakay ang isa ka barato ukon managat sa layo-layo gawa sakay ang motorized banca, kag kon ano pa nga luyag mo ma-experyensya nga hilimuon sang mga taga-baryo sa takas.
english: The water on the beach is clear, there are no harmful currents, and the waves are often gentle enough for swimming, fishing on a cheap boat or fishing in the distance even on a motorized banca, and whatever else you want to experience the activities of the villagers across the street.

text: By the way, lain na sa karon ang nagapanag-iya sang beach area namon dira sa amon sitio.
english: By the way, someone else now owns our beach area here in our sitio.

text: Beach resort na ini.
english: It’s a beach resort.

text: Sa pihak sang bukid may beach resort man didto.
english: On the other side of the mountain there is also a beach resort.

text: May mga guest house man dira kon diin ma-akomodar ang mga bisita sa ila luyag nga maglingaw-lingaw diri sa amon baryo.
english: There are also guest houses here where visitors can be accommodated if they want to have fun here in our village.

text: Mahimo man ini sang pila ka farm sa Iloilo nga malapit sa baybay.
english: Some farms in Iloilo near the coast can do the same.

text: Sa takas pwede man ang mountain resort, orchard ukon mango farm, ang may suba ukon waterfall, resting place sa mga mountain climbers, kag kon paano pa maka-enjoy sa pagpamasyal ang isa ka turista sa kaumhan./PN
english: Across the street can also be a mountain resort, orchard or mango farm, the one with a river or waterfall, resting place for mountain climbers, and how else a tourist can enjoy sightseeing in the countryside./PN

text: ILOILO CITY- Wala pa sang banwa sa probinsya sang Iloilo ang naka-umpisa sang sentineling program kasunod sang African Swine Fever nga na-eksperyensyahan.
english: ILOILO CITY- No town in Iloilo province has yet started a sentineling program following the African Swine Fever experienced.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Darel Tabuada, Provincial Veterinarian, iya ginpahayag nga may yara sang gin-set nga timeline ang probinsya sa Oktubre 31 kun sa diin tanan nga banwa nga luyag nga magpatigayon sang programa ang nagakadapat nga magpasa sang mga requirements.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Darel Tabuada, Provincial Veterinarian, said the province has a set timeline of October 31 where all towns that want to conduct the program must submit the requirements.

text: Pagkatapos nga makapasa suno kay Dr. Tabuada, i-endorso ini gilayon sa Department of Agriculture agud nga ma-check ang dokumento kun kwalipikado ang isa ka lugar.
english: After passing, according to Dr. Tabuada, it will be endorsed immediately to the Department of Agriculture so that the document can be checked if a place is eligible.

text: Agud nga ma-qualify para sa sentineling, kinahanglan nga wala na sang outbreak ang isa ka banwa sa sulod sang 40 ka adlaw, wala sang may nabilin nga baboy sa barangay, apang kun may yara man, dapat nga ilakip ini sa programa kag i-subject sa surveillance, kinahanglan nga in place man ang biosecurity measure, nagapatigayon sang disinfection sa pagpanguna sang Municipal Agriculture Office kag dapat may yara sila sang African Swine Fever ordinance.
english: To qualify for sentineling, a town must have no outbreak within 40 days, no pigs left in the barangay, but if there are, they must be included in the program and subjected to surveillance, biosecurity measures must be in place, disinfection is being conducted under the leadership of the Municipal Agricultural Office and they must have an African Agricultural Office. Fever ordinance.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, kada qualified farmer ang makabaton sang tatlo ka mga baboy apang isa anay ang una nga ihatag kag kun maka-survive, dugangan ini sang duha apang kun magpositibo sa African Swine Fever, i-subject ini sa depopulation.
english: He added that each qualified farmer will receive three pigs but one will be given first and if it survives, it will be increased by two but if it tests positive for African Swine Fever, it will be subjected to depopulation.

text: Ginapatihan sang Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) nga 100% nga ginsunod sa Islamic State of Iraq and Syria (ISIS) ang pagpang-atake sa New Orleans kun sa diin gin-arado sang truck ang mga tawo nga nagaselebrar sang New Year.
english: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) believes that the Islamic State of Iraq and Syria (ISIS) was 100% responsible for the attack in New Orleans where a truck plowed into people celebrating the New Year.

text: Suno pa sa FBI, isahanon lamang ang 42-anyos nga suspek nga si Shamsud-Din Jabbar sang ginhimo sini ang krimen.
english: According to the FBI, the 42-year-old suspect, Shamsud-Din Jabbar, was alone when he committed the crime.

text: 14 ka mga tawo ang patay sa amo nga lugar kag madamo ang pilason kag patay man ang suspek sang nagbato ini sa mga pulis.
english: 14 people were killed in the area and many were injured and the suspect was also killed when he threw stones at the police.

text: “This was an act of terrorism.
english: “This was an act of terrorism.

text: It was premeditated and an evil act.
english: It was premeditated and an evil act.

text: He was 100% inspired by ISIS,” suno kay Christopher Raia, deputy assistant director sang counterterrorism division sang FBI.
english: He was 100% inspired by ISIS,” said Christopher Raia, deputy assistant director of the FBI’s counterterrorism division.

text: Isa ka Army veteran ang suspek nga tumandok sang Texas.
english: The suspect is an Army veteran who is a native of Texas.

text: Nakit-an man nga may flag sang ISIS sa iya salakyan sang nag-atake ini sa amo nga lugar.
english: He was also found with an ISIS flag on his vehicle when he attacked the area.

text: Sa videos sini nga gin-post antes ang pagpang-atake, ginkumpirma sini nga nagsulod gid man siya sa amo nga terorista nga grupo.
english: In videos posted before the attack, he confirmed that he had indeed joined the terrorist group.

text:
Nagguwa nga Disyembre 30 pa sini gin-arkilahan ang Ford F-150 pickup truck sa Houston kag gindala ini sa New Orleans sang Disyembre 31 sang gab-i.

Sang kaagahon sang New Year’s Day, nangtanum pa si Jabbar sang improvised explosive devices sa intersection sang dalan sa Bourbon kag New Orleans kag iban pa nga lokasyon.
english:
It turned out that the Ford F-150 pickup truck was rented in Houston on December 30 and brought to New Orleans on the night of December 31.

On New Year's Day morning, Jabbar planted improvised explosive devices at the intersection of Bourbon and New Orleans roads and other locations.

text: Sunod ini nga nagpang-post sang videos sa Facebook nagtuad nga iya kuntani pamilya kag mga abyan ang unahon niya patay.
english: He later posted videos on Facebook confessing that he should have put his family and friends first.

text: Naghatag man ini sang last will kag testament sa iya katapusan nga video antes sini ginhimo ang krimen.#
english: He also gave a last will and testament in his last video before he committed the crime.

text: Daog via unanimous decision sa iya una nga sambuwa sa Las Vegas ang subang nga anak ni boxing icon Manny Pacquiao nga si Jimuel.
english: Boxing icon Manny Pacquiao's youngest son, Jimuel, won via unanimous decision in his first fight in Las Vegas.

text: Ginlutos ni Jimuel ang mas mabakod sini nga kasumpong nga si Marco Rosales sang Amerika sa 3 two-minute amateur rounds sang “Fights of Fury 8” charity event.
english: Jimuel defeated his stronger opponent Marco Rosales of America in 3 two-minute amateur rounds of the “Fights of Fury 8” charity event.

text: Ini ang Las Vegas debut ni Jimuel kag pang-anum naman sa tanan niya nga mga away sa iya boxing career.
english: This is Jimuel's Las Vegas debut and the sixth in all his fights in his boxing career.

text: Nagabug-at sang 136-and-a-half pounds ang anak sang Pinoy boxing legend samtang yara naman sa 148 pounds si Rosales.
english: The son of the Pinoy boxing legend weighs 136-and-a-half pounds while Rosales is at 148 pounds.

text: Nakakuha si Jimuel sang commemorative belt pagkatapos sang amo nga kadalag-an.
english: Jimuel earned a commemorative belt after that victory.

text: Ang amo nga amateur boxing ang gin-organisa sang Manny Pacquiao Foundation agud makatipon sang pondo para sa pila ka non-profits sa Las Vegas.
english: The amateur boxing was organized by the Manny Pacquiao Foundation to raise funds for several non-profits in Las Vegas.

text: Lakip sa nagsuporta kay Jimuel sa amo nga event amo sanday Olympic bronze medalist Eumir Marcial, former world champions Jerwin Ancajas kag Marlon Tapales, kag ang top contender nga si Jade Bornea.
english: Among those supporting Jimuel at the event were Olympic bronze medalist Eumir Marcial, former world champions Jerwin Ancajas and Marlon Tapales, and top contender Jade Bornea.

text: Nag-isyu na sang subpoena ang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) sa talent manager nga si Annabelle Rama may kaangtanan sa cyber libel complaint nga ginpasaka batuk sa iya sang former aide ni Senator Manny Pacquiao.
english: The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has issued a subpoena to talent manager Annabelle Rama in connection with a cyber libel complaint filed against her by a former aide of Senator Manny Pacquiao.

text: Gina-imbitahan si Annabelle nga magpadulong sa NBI sa Nobyembre 3.
english: Annabelle is invited to appear before the NBI on November 3.

text: Suno kay NBI regional director Atty. Emeterio Dongallo, ang katuyuan sang subpoena amo nga mahatagan sang kahigayunan si Annabelle nga mapaathag ang iya nga kaugalingon.
english: According to NBI regional director Atty. Emeterio Dongallo, the purpose of the subpoena is to give Annabelle the opportunity to explain herself.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang Oktubre 22, nag-tweet ang talent manager sa wala sini ginpangalanan nga inbidwal tuhoy sa financial deals sa hampang sadto ni Pacquiao.
english: On October 22, the talent manager tweeted to an unnamed individual about financial deals in Pacquiao's fight.

text: Gintawag naman sang anay aide sang senador nga si Jayke Joson si Annabelle nga “epal” kag “sipsip” bangud sa akusasyon batuk sa iya.
english: Former senator Jayke Joson called Annabelle “epal” and “sipsip” over the accusations against him.

text: Nagapanindugan naman ang talent manager sa iya nga statements batuk kay Joson kag handa man ini nga atubangon ang ano man nga kaso nga ipasaka sa iya.
english: The talent manager stands by his statements against Joson and is ready to face any case filed against him.

text: Nahimo na nga bagyo ang isa ka Low Pressure Area (LPA) nga gina-monitor sa sulod sang Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR).
english: A Low Pressure Area (LPA) monitored within the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) has become a typhoon.

text: Gintawag ini sang state weather bureau sa local name nga Ramil.
english: The state weather bureau called it by the local name Ramil.

text: Sa latest nga weather bulletin, ulihi nga nakit-an ang sentro sang Tropical Depression Ramil sa kalayuon nga 1,145 km nasidlangan sang Southeastern Luzon.
english: In the latest weather bulletin, the center of Tropical Depression Ramil was last located at a distance of 1,145 km east of Southeastern Luzon.

text:
Dala sini ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 45 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 55 km/h.

Nagahulag ini pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan kag nagaapekto sa Central Luzon, Southern Luzon, kag sa Visayas.
english:
It brought winds of 45 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 55 km/h.

It is moving west northwest and affecting Central Luzon, Southern Luzon, and the Visayas.

text: Gilayon nga ginpaidalom sa Signal Number 1 ang areas sang Luzon nga amo ang easternmost portion sang Quezon, Camarines Norte, Catanduanes, Camarines Sur, Albay, kag northern kag eastern portions sang Sorsogon.
english: Areas of Luzon, namely the easternmost portion of Quezon, Camarines Norte, Catanduanes, Camarines Sur, Albay, and northern and eastern portions of Sorsogon, were immediately placed under Signal Number 1.

text: Sa Visayas, ginpaidalom sa Signal Number 1 ang eastern portion sang Northern Samar.
english: In the Visayas, the eastern portion of Northern Samar was placed under Signal Number 1.

text: Sa track forecast, mahimo maglaslas ang bagyo malapit sa Catanduanes buwas sa aga ukon sa hapon kag mag-landfall sa Aurora ukon sa Quezon sa Domingo sang aga ukon sa hapon.
english: According to the track forecast, the typhoon could break near Catanduanes tomorrow morning or afternoon and landfall in Aurora or Quezon on Sunday morning or afternoon.

text: Kun magsaylo ang direksyon sini pa-nabagatnan, mahimo nga sa lain ini nga area mag-landfall ukon mas madamo nga areas ang ipaidalom sa wind signal.
english: If its direction shifts south, it may landfall in a different area or more areas may be subjected to wind signals.

text:
Kun maka-landfall na, magalabay ang bagyo sa kabukiran sang Northern ukon Central Luzon kag magatuhaw sa West Philippine Sea sa Domingo sang hapon ukon sa gab-i.

Santo sa weather bureau, mahimo magbaskog ang bagyo kag magatupa sa tropical storm category sa buwas sang kaagahon samtang yara ini sa Philippine Sea.
english:
Once it makes landfall, the typhoon will pass through the mountains of Northern or Central Luzon and emerge in the West Philippine Sea on Sunday afternoon or evening.

According to the weather bureau, the typhoon may intensify and fall into the tropical storm category tomorrow morning while it is in the Philippine Sea.

text: Mahimo ini magguwa sa PAR sa Lunes sang aga.#
english: It may appear on the PAR on Monday morning.#

text: Indi magatan-aw si Vice President Sara Duterte sang State of the Nation Address (SONA) ni President Bongbong Marcos subong nga adlaw bangud ginahambal niya nga ginakalain siya sang buot sa mga ginahambal sang presidente.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte will not watch President Bongbong Marcos' State of the Nation Address (SONA) today because she says she is offended by the president's remarks.

text: Sa isa ka rally sa South Korea, ginsiling ni Duterte nga mas maayo pa nga basahon na lang niya ang SONA kag hibaluon kun ano pa ang ginatawag niya nga “kabutigan” sa pumuluyo.
english: At a rally in South Korea, Duterte said it would be better for him to read the SONA and find out what else he calls “lies” to the people.

text: Ginaangkon man niya nga indi nabatyagan sang ordinaryo nga mga pumuluyo ang ginahambal nga kauswagan sa SONA kag ginpabutyag nga ang mga Pilipino nagakinahanglan sang mas maayo nga klase sang serbisyo halin sa gobyerno.
english: He also claimed that the ordinary citizens did not feel the talked about development in the SONA and expressed that Filipinos need a better class of services from the government.

text: Nakit-an na nga wala sang kabuhi ang 5 ka tuig nga bata matapos nga nagkapan ang pumboat nga ginasakyan sini kaupod ang iya amay sa Sitio Tumanda, Barangay Cabano, San Lorenzo, Guimaras.
english: A 5-year-old boy was found dead after the pumboat he was riding with his father capsized in Sitio Tumanda, Barangay Cabano, San Lorenzo, Guimaras.

text: Ang 5 ka tuig nga bata amo si John Jezther Gamilong, samtang ang amay sini amo si Johnel Gamilong, residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The 5-year-old child was identified as John Jezther Gamilong, while his father was identified as Johnel Gamilong, resident of the said area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Joje Gania, Officer in Charge sang San Lorenzo, Guimaras Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga apat sila nga nagpadulong sa lawod kon sa diin, makuha lang kontani sang lambat nga ila man nga ginbutang.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Joje Gania, Officer in Charge of San Lorenzo, Guimaras Municipal Police Station, said the four of them went to the sea to retrieve the net they had set up.

text: Apang sa amo nga tion, gulpi lang nga nagbaskog ang balod rason nga nagkaya gid ang ila ginasakyan nga pumboat.
english: But at that moment, the waves suddenly became stronger and the boat they were riding capsized.

text: Nakalangoy pa pabalik sa shoreline ang iban nga kaupdanan sang mag-amay.
english: Some of the father's companions were able to swim back to the shoreline.

text: Gintuad man sang mga kaupdanan sang biktima nga ginlangoy pa sang amay ang iya anak agud nga mapahigad apang bangod sa mabalod ang lawod, nagsarurot man ang duha.
english: The victim's companions also confessed that the father even swam his son to the shore but due to the rough sea, the two also drowned.

text: Suno kay Gania, nasapwan ang lamharon sa bulig sang rescue team, sang San Lorenzo Municipal Police Station, Philippine Coast Guard, Bantay Dagat, kag Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction Management Office.
english: According to Gania, the youth was found with the help of the rescue team, the San Lorenzo Municipal Police Station, Philippine Coast Guard, Bantay Dagat, and the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction Management Office.

text: Nakit-an nga nagautaw-utaw ang bata sa baybayon nga sakop sang Brgy.
english: The child was found floating on the beach in Brgy.

text: Sebario, San Lorenzo, Guimaras.
english: Sebario, San Lorenzo, Guimaras.

text: Padayon naman ang search and rescue operation sang otoridad sa amay sang biktima nga tubtob subong, nagapabilin nga missing.
english: The search and rescue operation of the victim's father is ongoing.

text: Ginkumpirma ni Queen of All Media Kris Aquino nga engaged na siya kay anay Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Mel Sarmiento!
english: Queen of All Media Kris Aquino confirmed that she is engaged to former Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Mel Sarmiento!

text: Sa isa ka Instagram post, ginpasalamatan ni Kris si Mel nga gintawag man niya nga best friend bangud ginpalangga siya sini nga wala sang agenda.
english: In an Instagram post, Kris thanked Mel, whom she also called her best friend, for loving her without an agenda.

text: Suno pa sa 50 anyos nga aktres, proud siya nga mangin Aquino apang looking forward na siya nga mangin Sarmiento.
english: The 50-year-old actress said she is proud to be Aquino but she is looking forward to being Sarmiento.

text: Ginpasalamatan man ni Kris ang iya utod nga si former President Benigno “Noynoy” Aquino III nga amo ang iya ginkabig matchmaker in heaven.
english: Kris also thanked her brother, former President Benigno “Noynoy” Aquino III, whom she considered her matchmaker in heaven.

text: Agusto subong nga tuig sang na-reveal ang identity sang mystery man ni Kris bangud nga nag-comment ini sa iya nga post.
english: In August this year, the identity of Kris' mystery man was revealed after he commented on her post.

text: Si Mel ang nagserbe nga DILG secretary halin 2015 tubtub 2016.
english: Mel served as DILG secretary from 2015 to 2016.

text: Padayon pa nga gina-imbestigaran sang otoridad ang kaangtanan sang duha ka magkasunod nga insidente sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika kun sa diin isa ka Tesla Cybertruck ang nagsigabong sa Las Vegas, Nevada samtang isa naman ka truck ang nang-arado sang mga tawo sa New Orleans, Louisiana.
english: Authorities are still investigating the relationship between two consecutive incidents in the United States of America where a Tesla Cybertruck caught fire in Las Vegas, Nevada while another truck plowed into people in New Orleans, Louisiana.

text: Suno kay US President Joe Biden, wala pa sang link ukon kaangtanan nga nakit-an subong.
english: According to US President Joe Biden, no link or relationship has been found so far.

text: Base naman sa Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) kag sa local law enforcement, posible nga isa ka isolated incident ang natabo sa Las Vegas apang wala man ginadula ang anggulo kun isa ini ka akto sang terorismo.
english: According to the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) and local law enforcement, it is possible that an isolated incident occurred in Las Vegas but the angle is not ruled out if it was an act of terrorism.

text: Natabo ang insidente sa guwa sang isa ka hotel nga ginapanag-iyahan ni president-elect Donald Trump.
english: The incident occurred outside a hotel owned by president-elect Donald Trump.

text: Ang nagadala sang Tesla Cybertruck amo ang highly-decorated soldier kag active-duty US Army Green Beret nga si Matthew Alan Livelsberger.
english: Driving the Tesla Cybertruck is highly-decorated soldier and active-duty US Army Green Beret Matthew Alan Livelsberger.

text: Napatay man si Livelsberger sa amo nga insidente matapos sini gintiro ang iya kaugalingon sa sulod mismo sang salakyan.
english: Livelsberger also died in the incident after he shot himself inside the vehicle.

text: Isa siya ka Army Special Forces operations master sergeant kag yara sa active duty sa Germany kaupod sa 10th Special Forces Group apang naka-leave sang natabo ang insidente.
english: He was an Army Special Forces operations master sergeant and was on active duty in Germany with the 10th Special Forces Group but was on leave when the incident occurred.

text: Ang US Special Forces ukon ginatawag nga “Green Berets” amo ang elite fighting force nga bantog sa guerilla warfare kag unconventional tactics sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: The US Special Forces or commonly known as “Green Berets” are the elite fighting force famous for guerilla warfare and unconventional tactics abroad.

text: Sang natabo ang insidente, gin-park anay ang electric vehicle sa guwa sa glass entrance sang Trump International Hotel antes ini nagsigabong kag napilasan man ang pito ka iban pa nga mga tawo.
english: When the incident occurred, the electric vehicle was parked outside at the glass entrance of the Trump International Hotel before it caught fire and injured seven other people.

text: Iban pa sa nakit-an sa sulod sang truck amo ang second firearm, fireworks, passport, military ID, credit cards, iPhone kag smartwatch.
english: Other items found inside the truck were a second firearm, fireworks, passport, military ID, credit cards, iPhone and smartwatch.

text:
PAGPANG-ATAKE SA NEW ORLEANS

Ginapatihan naman sang FBI nga 100% nga ginsunod sa Islamic State of Iraq and Syria (ISIS) ang pagpang-atake sa New Orleans kun sa diin gin-arado sang truck ang mga tawo nga nagaselebrar sang New Year.
english:
ATTACK IN NEW ORLEANS

The FBI believes that the Islamic State of Iraq and Syria (ISIS) was 100% responsible for the attack in New Orleans where a truck plowed into people celebrating the New Year.

text: Suno pa sa FBI, isahanon lamang ang 42-anyos nga suspek nga si Shamsud-Din Jabbar sang ginhimo sini ang krimen.
english: According to the FBI, the 42-year-old suspect, Shamsud-Din Jabbar, was alone when he committed the crime.

text: 14 ka mga tawo ang patay sa amo nga lugar kag madamo ang pilason kag patay man ang suspek sang nagbato ini sa mga pulis.
english: 14 people were killed in the area and many were injured and the suspect was also killed when he threw stones at the police.

text: Isa ka Army veteran ang suspek nga tumandok sang Texas kag may flag man sang ISIS sa iya salakyan.
english: The suspect is an Army veteran who is a native of Texas and also had an ISIS flag on his vehicle.

text: Sa videos sini nga gin-post antes ang pagpang-atake, ginkumpirma sini nga nagsulod gid man siya sa amo nga terorista nga grupo.
english: In videos posted before the attack, he confirmed that he had indeed joined the terrorist group.

text:
Nagguwa nga Disyembre 30 pa sini gin-arkilahan ang Ford F-150 pickup truck sa Houston kag gindala ini sa New Orleans sang Disyembre 31 sang gab-i.

Sang kaagahon sang New Year’s Day, nangtanum pa si Jabbar sang improvised explosive devices sa intersection sang dalan sa Bourbon kag New Orleans kag iban pa nga lokasyon.
english:
It turned out that the Ford F-150 pickup truck was rented in Houston on December 30 and brought to New Orleans on the night of December 31.

On New Year's Day morning, Jabbar planted improvised explosive devices at the intersection of Bourbon and New Orleans roads and other locations.

text: Sunod ini nga nagpang-post sang videos sa Facebook nagtuad nga iya kuntani pamilya kag mga abyan ang unahon niya patay.
english: He later posted videos on Facebook confessing that he should have put his family and friends first.

text: Naghatag man ini sang last will kag testament sa iya katapusan nga video antes sini ginhimo ang krimen.#
english: He also gave a last will and testament in his last video before he committed the crime.

text: Opisyal na nga ginkasal sanday Carla Abellana kag Tom Rodriguez.
english: Carla Abellana and Tom Rodriguez are officially married.

text: Sa mga pictures nga nagguwa online, makit-an nga ‘glowing’ si Carla samtang nagalakat sa aisle.
english: In the pictures that surfaced online, Carla can be seen glowing while walking down the aisle.

text: Makit-an man ang matam-is nga yuhom sang actress.
english: The actress' sweet smile is also visible.

text: ‘Dashing’ naman si Tom sa iya nga look.
english: Tom is 'dashing' in his look.

text: Nahibaluan nga na-engaged sanday Carla kag Tom sang Oktubre 2020 apang ginsapubliko lang sang Marso subong nga tuig.
english: Carla and Tom were engaged in October 2020 but only made it public in March this year.

text: Mapilitan ang anay Filipino world champion nga si Nonito Donaire Jr.
english: Former Filipino world champion Nonito Donaire Jr. will be forced to fight.

text: nga magpangita sang iban nga kasumpong agud makuha liwat ang titulo nga world champion matapos nag-atras ang Australian boxer nga si Jason Moloney sa ila natalana nga sambuwa.
english: to find another opponent to regain the title of world champion after Australian boxer Jason Moloney withdrew from their scheduled fight.

text: Naka-schedule kuntani nga mag-atubangay sanday Donaire kag Moloney para sa bakante nga World Boxing Council (WBC) bantamweight crown nga ginbuy-an sang damlag lang sang Japanese icon kag undisputed champion nga si Naoya Inoue bangud ginpili sini nga magsaka sa super bantamweight class.
english: Donaire and Moloney were scheduled to face each other for the vacant World Boxing Council (WBC) bantamweight crown that was recently vacated by Japanese icon and undisputed champion Naoya Inoue as he chose to move up to the super bantamweight class.

text: Apang suno kay WBC president Mauricio Sulaiman, wala na sang interes si Moloney nga lagson pa ang bantamweight title.
english: But according to WBC president Mauricio Sulaiman, Moloney has no interest in chasing the bantamweight title.

text: Wala man sang problema nga nakit-an ang council sa Filipino boxer bangud handa ini nga atubangon ang bisan-o sin-o nga kasumpong.
english: The council did not see any problem with the Filipino boxer because he is ready to face any opponent.

text: Si Donaire ang nagauyat sang rekord bilang pinakatigulang nga boksidor nga nagadaog pa sang bantamweight title.
english: Donaire holds the record as the oldest boxer to win the bantamweight title.

text: Sa edad nga 38, gin-knockout sini ang unbeaten WBC titlist nga si Nordine Oubaali sang Mayo 2021.
english: At 38, he knocked out unbeaten WBC titlist Nordine Oubaali in May 2021.

text: Ginsundan pa ini sang isa ka madinalag-o nga title defense sang gintumba man sini si Reymart Gaballo sang Disyembre 2021.
english: This was followed by a successful title defense when he also knocked out Reymart Gaballo in December 2021.

text: Apang sang Hunyo sang nagligad nga tuig, nalutos si Donaire sa kamot sang three-division world champion nga si Inoue kag halin sadto, wala na ini nakabalik sa boxing ring.
english: But in June last year, Donaire suffered a defeat at the hands of three-division world champion Inoue and since then, he has not returned to the boxing ring.

text: Gin-appoint bilang executive director sang Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission si anay Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Benjamin Acorda, Jr.
english: Former Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Benjamin Acorda, Jr. has been appointed as executive director of the Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirma ni Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro ang pag-appoint kay Acord nga magatal-os kay Gilbert Cruz.
english: This was confirmed by Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro the appointment of Acord to replace Gilbert Cruz.

text: Wala naghatag si Castro sang rason sa pagkakas kay Cruz nga gin-appoint sa pwesto humalin sa sang Enero 2023.
english: Castro did not give a reason for the removal of Cruz, who was appointed to the post from January 2023.

text: Una nga gin-appoint ni Pres.
english: First appointed by Pres.

text: Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text:
si Acoda bilang PNP Chief humalin Abril 2023 tubtob Marcos 2024

Myembro si Acorda sang Philippine Military Academy Sambisig Class of 1991 kag nagserbe man bilang director sang PNP Directorate for Intelligence antes nangin PNP Chief.
english:
Acoda as PNP Chief from April 2023 to March 2024

Acorda is a member of the Philippine Military Academy Sambisig Class of 1991 and also served as director of the PNP Directorate for Intelligence before becoming PNP Chief.

text: Ginbasura ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr. rejected the bill.

text: ang proposal nga mag-import sang dugang nga 300,000 metric tons sang kalamay.
english: the proposal to import an additional 300,000 metric tons of sugarcane.

text: Ginkumpirma ini sang Malacañang kasunod sang order nga ginpaguwa sang Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) may kaangtanan sa import program para sa crop year 2021-2022.
english: Malacañang confirmed this following an order issued by the Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) regarding the import program for the crop year 2021-2022.

text: Nakit-an sa amo nga order nga may pirma na sa ibabaw sang pangalan ni Marcos bilang SRA Board Chairperson kag Agriculture Secretary, apang suno kay Press Secretary Trixie Cruz-Angeles, indi ini matuod nga pirma sang presidente.
english: The order showed that there was already a signature above Marcos' name as SRA Board Chairperson and Agriculture Secretary, but according to Press Secretary Trixie Cruz-Angeles, it was not the real signature of the president.

text: Kun ikumparar ang pirma sa Sugar Order No.
english: If you compare the signature on Sugar Order No.

text: 4 sa nagligad nga issuance, nagaguwa nga ginpirmahan lang ang dokumento on behalf sang Presidente.
english: 4 in the previous issuance, it appears that the document was signed on behalf of the President.

text: Ginkwestyon kun si Agriculture Undersecretary Leocadio Sebastian ang nagpirma sa amo nga dokumento bangud siya anay ang gin-designar sang presidente nga alternate sa SRA board.
english: It was questioned whether Agriculture Undersecretary Leocadio Sebastian signed the document because he was previously designated by the president as an alternate on the SRA board.

text: Wala pa sang sabat ang SRA kag ang DA sa amo nga mga pamangkot kasunod sang pagpanginwala sang Malacañang.
english: The SRA and the DA have yet to respond to these questions following Malacañang's denial.

text: Indi na subong available ang dokumento sa website sang SRA.
english: The document is no longer available on the SRA website.

text: Ginahulat man subong ang paathag sang Malacañang kun ngaa gin-reject sang presidente ang amo nga proposal.
english: Malacañang is also awaiting an explanation as to why the president rejected the proposal.

text: KAUNDAN SANG ORDER NO.
english: CONTENTS OF ORDER NO.

text:
4

Nakasaad sa amo nga order nga indi dapat maglapaw sa 300,000 metric tons sang volume sang kalamay nga dapat i-import sang Pilipinas.
english:
4

The order states that the volume of sugarcane to be imported by the Philippines should not exceed 300,000 metric tons.

text: Ginsaad man nga as of July 31, yara sa 1,792,102 metric tons ang actual production sang raw sugar samtang 737,254 metric tons naman ang actual production sang refined sugar, mas manubo sang 16.18% kag 2.84% ipaanggid sa produksyon sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: As of July 31, the actual production of raw sugar was 1,792,102 metric tons while the actual production of refined sugar was 737,254 metric tons, down 16.18% and 2.84% respectively compared to last year's production.

text: Ginalantaw sang SRA nga magadangat sa 1.8 million metric tons ang raw sugar production sa crop year 2021-2022, mas manubo sang 16% halin sa produksyon nga 2,143,018 metric tons sang nagligad nga season.
english: The SRA expects raw sugar production to reach 1.8 million metric tons in the crop year 2021-2022, down 16% from the production of 2,143,018 metric tons last season.

text: Ginpahayag nga ginpaguwa ang amo nga order agud nga ma-address ang current sugar supply situation kag ang nagataas nga presyo sa merkado.
english: The order was issued to address the current sugar supply situation and rising market prices.

text: Antes pa man gin-isyu ang amo nga order, ginpahayag na ni SRA Administrator Hermenegildo Serafica nga ginalantaw ang pag-import sang 300,000 metric tons sang kalamay bangud sa kakulangan sa suplay.
english: Even before the order was issued, SRA Administrator Hermenegildo Serafica said the import of 300,000 metric tons of sugarcane is being considered due to supply shortages.

text: Una na nga ginlantaw nga posible iga-import ang kalamay gikan sa Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, kag Indonesia.##
english: It was previously considered that sugarcane could be imported from Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Indonesia.##

text: Gina-anunsyo ni Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas nga magabalik na ang klase kag opisina sa siyudad, Lunes, Hulyo 28, 2025, matapos mangin maayo na ang sitwasyon halin sa epekto sang Bagyo kag habagat.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas announced that classes and offices will resume in the city on Monday, July 28, 2025, after the situation improves from the effects of Typhoon and Habagat.

text: Sa iya Facebook post, ginpasalamatan ni Mayor Treñas ang tanan nga kabahin sang Emergency Operations Center, mga barangay response teams, kag volunteer groups nga nagtiner sa serbisyo sa tunga sang kalamidad.
english: In his Facebook post, Mayor Treñas thanked all members of the Emergency Operations Center, barangay response teams, and volunteer groups who remained in service in the midst of the disaster.

text: Base sa ulihi nga data sang LGU, 94 ka barangay ang naapektuhan sang baha, apang 83 na ang nagsubside.
english: Based on the latest data from the LGU, 94 barangays were affected by the floods, but 83 have already subsided.

text: May 11 ka kahoy nga natumba, 74 ka balay nga na-damage, kag 1,127 ka pamilya ukon 3,754 ka indibidwal ang na-evacuate.
english: There were 11 trees downed, 74 houses damaged, and 1,127 families or 3,754 individuals evacuated.

text: Tanan nga evacuees nakapauli na, samtang nagapadayon ang relief operations kag assessment sang City Social Welfare and Development Office.
english: All evacuees have returned home, while the relief operations and assessment of the City Social Welfare and Development Office continue.

text: Sa bulig sang City Health Office, nakapanagtag sang 101 ka tetanus shots, medical assistance sa kapin 800 ka pasyente, kag doxycycline sa kapin 50,000 ka residente.
english: With the help of the City Health Office, 101 tetanus shots, medical assistance to more than 800 patients, and doxycycline were distributed to more than 50,000 residents.

text: Naglab-ot naman sa 54,906 ka tawo ang naapektuhan sang kalamidad, pero nagapanumbalik na sa normal ang operasyon.
english: A total of 54,906 people were affected by the disaster, but operations are returning to normal.

text: Dayon na gid ang pagsulod sang Ilongga beauty queen nga si Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo sa showbiz.
english: Ilongga beauty queen Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo has just entered showbiz.

text: Siya ang ginkuha bilang leading lady ni Senator Bong Revilla Jr..
english: She was hired as leading lady by Senator Bong Revilla Jr..

text: Maga-umpisa ang taping sang Ilongga beauty queen sa masunod nga semana.
english: The taping of the Ilongga beauty queen will start next week.

text: Excited naman ang nasambit nga senador nga si Rabiya ang bag-o niya nga maka-partner.
english: The senator is excited that Rabiya is his new partner.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Rabiya nga excited man siya nga makita ang iya kaugalingon bilang isa ka actress pagkatapos mangin isa ka beauty queen.
english: Rabiya had earlier said that she is also excited to see herself as an actress after becoming a beauty queen.

text: Nag-sorry ang sexy actress nga si AJ Raval kay Kylie Padilla matapos gin-repost sini ang cheating allegation ni Aljur Abrenica batuk sa estranged wife.
english: Sexy actress AJ Raval apologized to Kylie Padilla after she reposted Aljur Abrenica's cheating allegation against his estranged wife.

text: Apisar wala may ginbutang nga caption si AJ, nag-angkon ini sang pagpakamalaot halin sa netizens kag gin-akusaran siya nga nagasawsaw sa isyu sang mag-asawa nga nagbulagay lima pa lang ka bulan ang nagligad.
english: Although AJ did not put any caption, he drew condemnation from netizens and accused him of diving into the issue of the couple who broke up just five months ago.

text: Apang sa subong, deleted na ang gin-repost ni AJ nga statement ni Aljur sa iya facebook account.
english: But now, AJ has deleted Aljur's statement on his facebook account.

text: Suno kay AJ, indi niya intensyon nga maghilabot sa away nanday Aljur kag Kylie.
english: AJ says it wasn’t his intention to interfere in Aljur and Kylie’s fight.

text: Liwat man niya nga ginpanginwala nga kerida siya ni Aljur kag wala siya sang may ginaguba nga pamilya.
english: She also denied that she was Aljur's girlfriend and that she was not destroying any family.

text: Ginpahayag man ni AJ nga plano niya nga magpahuway anay sa social media agud nga maprotektahan ang iya nga kaugalingon gikan sa mga bashers.
english: AJ also said that he plans to take a break from social media to protect himself from the bashers.
