text: Preparado na ang Iloilo City Police Office ukon ICPO sa ti-on sang State of the Nation Address ukon SONA ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) is ready for the State of the Nation Address or SONA of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: subong nga Lunes, Hulyo 28.
english: this Monday, July 28.

text: Suno kay ICPO Director Police Colonel Kim Legada, nagahimo na sila sang final inspection sa mga police personnel nga i-deploy para masiguro ang kalinong kag katawhay sa syudad, labi na sa ti-on sang mga rally.
english: ICPO Director Police Colonel Kim Legada said they are already conducting a final inspection of the police personnel to be deployed to ensure peace and order in the city, especially during rallies.

text: Ginpa-athag pa ni Col.
english: He explained that Col.

text: Legada nga may mga grupo nga may rally permit na, kag handa ang ICPO nga magresponde kun may kinahanglanon.
english: Legada said there are groups that already have rally permits, and the ICPO is ready to respond if necessary.

text: Ang preparasyon indi lang limitado sa Iloilo City kundi kabahin sang koordinado nga pagbantay sa bug-os nga Western Visayas region.
english: The preparation is not limited to Iloilo City but is part of the coordinated surveillance throughout the Western Visayas region.

text: Nagpasalig siya nga padayon nila pagaprotektahan ang seguridad sang publiko.
english: He assured that they will continue to protect public safety.

text: Nagsaka pa ang numero sang mga Pinoy nga wala sang trabaho sa bulan sang Hunyo ipaanggid sa numero sa bulan sang Mayo subong nga tuig.
english: The number of unemployed Filipinos in June increased compared to the number in May this year.

text: Sa data nga ginpaguwa sang Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), may yara sang 2.99 million unemployed Filipinos sa Hunyo nga 62,000 nga mas mataas sa 2.93 million nga rekord sang Mayo.
english: According to data released by the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), there were 2.99 million unemployed Filipinos in June, 62,000 higher than the 2.93 million record in May.

text: Ini nga figure ang katumbas sang unemployment rate nga 6.0% nga amo man ang rekord sang Mayo.
english: This figure is equivalent to the unemployment rate of 6.0% which was also the record in May.

text: Apang ini nga numero ang mas manubo na ipaanggid sa Hunyo 2021 kun sa diin 7.7% ang unemployment rate.
english: However, this figure is lower compared to June 2021 where the unemployment rate was 7.7%.

text: Ang mga Pinoy naman nga may trabaho sa bulan sang Hunyo ang yara sa 46.59 million ukon 508,000 nga mas mataas sa 46.08 million sa Mayo, kag 1.52 million nga mas mataas sa 45.08 million nga rekord sa Hunyo 2021.
english: The number of Filipinos employed in June was 46.59 million or 508,000 higher than the 46.08 million in May, and 1.52 million higher than the 45.08 million record in June 2021.

text: Sang Mayo subong nga tuig, 94.0% man ang employment rate.
english: In May this year, the employment rate was also 94.0%.

text: Wala ini sang pagbag-o sa Hunyo suno sa PSA.
english: This remains unchanged in June, according to the PSA.

text: Mas mataas naman ipaanggid sa 92.3% sa amo man nga bulan sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: This is higher than 92.3% in the same month last year.

text: Nagbalik na kay Novak Djokovic ang trono bilang world number one sa tennis matapos naangkon ang iya ika-napulo nga Australian Open title paagi sa pagdominar sa final sa Melbourne Park subong nga tuig.
english: Novak Djokovic has regained the throne as world number one in tennis after winning his tenth Australian Open title by dominating the final at Melbourne Park this year.

text: Ginbalabagan sang 35-anyos nga Serbian tennis superstar ang Grand Slam nga handum sang iya Greek nga kasumpong nga si Stefanos Tsitsipas paagi sa pag-secure sang 6-3 7-6(4) 7-6(5) victory.
english: The 35-year-old Serbian tennis superstar thwarted the Grand Slam dreams of his Greek opponent Stefanos Tsitsipas by securing a 6-3 7-6(4) 7-6(5) victory.

text: Ini man ang ika-22 nga Grand Slam men’s singles title ni Djokovic nga subong tupong na sa rekord ni Rafael Nadal sang Spain, kag abanse naman sang duha sa 20 nga natipon sang Swiss great nga si Roger Federer.
english: It is also Djokovic's 22nd Grand Slam men's singles title, which is now equal to the record of Rafael Nadal of Spain, and two ahead of the 20 collected by Swiss great Roger Federer.

text: Makabig man ini sang Djokovic fans nga ‘ultimate redemption’ kag ‘remarkable comeback’ bangud kun matandaan, sang nagligad nga tuig, wala siya nakahampang sa tournament kag gin-deport pa sa Australia bangud sa kontrobersiya sa iya nga Covid-19 vaccination status.
english: Djokovic fans will also consider this an 'ultimate redemption' and a 'remarkable comeback' because last year, he did not play in the tournament and was deported to Australia due to controversy over his Covid-19 vaccination status.

text: Mangin ang ten-time Australian Open champion ang nagakabig sini nga kadalag-an bilang “biggest victory” sa iya nga kabuhi.
english: Even the ten-time Australian Open champion considers this victory as the “biggest victory” of his life.

text: “I have to say this has been one of the most challenging tournaments I have ever played in my life considering the circumstances, not playing last year, coming back this year,” suno kay Djokovic, isa sa ginakabig greatest of all time sa tennis.
english: “I have to say this has been one of the most challenging tournaments I have ever played in my life considering the circumstances, not playing last year, coming back this year,” said Djokovic, one of the greatest of all time in tennis.

text: Kaangay sa natabo sa semi-final match, wala man ang amay sini nga si Srdjan sa players’ box sa final matapos nga nadalahig ini sa kontrobersiya kasunod sang picture kun sa diin kaupod sini ang isa ka fan nga nagadala sang Russian flag nga naga-feature sang nawong ni Russian President Vladimir Putin.
english: As in the semi-final match, his father Srdjan was not in the players' box in the final after he was involved in controversy following a picture where he was accompanied by a fan carrying a Russian flag featuring the face of Russian President Vladimir Putin.

text: Magluwas diri, nagsuprer man si Djokovic sang injuries sa sini nga edisyon sang Australian Open.
english: In addition, Djokovic also suffered injuries in this edition of the Australian Open.

text: Ang ika-napulo nga tropeo ni Djokovic sa Australia ang nagdugang pa sa iya decorated career.
english: Djokovic's tenth trophy in Australia added to his decorated career.

text: Sa iya 22 ka major championships (kaangay sa rekord ni Nadal) ang ginakilala subong nga pinakamataas nga nahimo sa maragtas sang tennis.
english: With his 22 major championships (similar to Nadal's record) is now recognized as the highest achievement in the history of tennis.

text: Lakip diri ang pito halin sa Wimbledon, tatlo sa U.S. Open, kag duha sa French Open.
english: That includes seven from Wimbledon, three at the U.S. Open, and two at the French Open.

text: Ang Australian Open ginahiwat kada tuig sa Melbourne Park sa Melbourne, Victoria, Australia.
english: The Australian Open is held annually at Melbourne Park in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia.

text: Ini nga tournament ang una sa apat ka Grand Slam tennis events nga ginapatigayon kada tuig nga ginasundan sang French Open, Wimbledon, kag US Open.
english: This tournament is the first of four Grand Slam tennis events held annually followed by the French Open, Wimbledon, and US Open.

text: Yara na sa advanced state of decomposition ang bangkay sang isa ka overseas Filipino worker (OFW) sang nasapwan sa ugsaran mismo sang iya amo sa Saad Al-Abdullah, Jahra sa Kuwait.
english: The body of an overseas Filipino worker (OFW) was found in the yard of his employer in Saad Al-Abdullah, Jahra in Kuwait.

text: Ang biktima amo si Dafnie Nacalaban nga duha ka bulan man nga na-missing antes nabalahuba ang natabo sa iya.
english: The victim was identified as Dafnie Nacalaban who was also missing for two months before her incident was revealed.

text: Suno sa iya utod nga si Michael Nacalaban Lensahan, natalana kuntani nga magpauli si Dafnie sa Disyembre apang wala sang ginhatag nga eksakto nga petsa agud nga sorpresahon ang iya pamilya.
english: According to her brother Michael Nacalaban Lensahan, Dafnie was scheduled to return home in December but no exact date was given to surprise her family.

text: Ginpahayag man nga sang nag-istoryahanay sila sang Mayo 2024, wala man ini sang ginpakigbahin nga problema.
english: It was also reported that when they spoke in May 2024, he did not share any problems.

text: Ginahingyo sang pamilya nga madala pauli ang bangkay sang Pinay domestic worker kag mahatagan sang hustisya ang iya kamatayon.
english: The family is demanding that the body of the Filipina domestic worker be brought home and justice be done to her death.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nag-report naman si Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) Undersecretary Eduardo de Vega nga may suspek na sa insidente kag subong na-detain na sang otoridad.
english: Meanwhile, Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) Undersecretary Eduardo de Vega reported that there is a suspect in the incident and is now detained by the authorities.

text: May yara na sang nauna nga criminal record ang suspek kag mismo ang utod sini amo ang nagpanugid sa mga pulis rason nga may ginhimo nga imbestigasyon.
english: The suspect has a previous criminal record and his brother himself informed the police, which led to an investigation.

text: Gin-alegar man nga mabudlay ini kuhaan sang impormasyon nga possible bangud man sa paggamit sini sang iligal nga droga.
english: It was also alleged that he was difficult to get information from, possibly because of his use of illegal drugs.

text: Nagpasalig man ang DFA nga himuon sang gobyerno ang obligasyon sini agud mahatag ang hustisya.
english: The DFA also assured that the government will fulfill its obligation to provide justice.

text: Nagalaom ang Social Action Center sang Archdiocese of Jaro nga malakip sa State of the Nation Address (SONA) ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: The Social Action Center of the Archdiocese of Jaro hopes to be included in the State of the Nation Address (SONA) of President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: ang isyu sa flood control ilabi na subong nga madamo nga areas ang nalubog sa tubig-baha bangud sang habagat kag sunod-sunod nga mga bagyo.
english: the issue of flood control especially now that many areas are submerged in flood waters due to the south and successive typhoons.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Msgr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Msgr.

text: Meliton Oso, director sang Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center (JASAC), ginpahayag sini nga makatilingala kun sa diin nagkadto ang tuman ka dako nga pundo nga para ma-kontrol ang pagbaha.
english: Meliton Oso, director of the Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center (JASAC), said it is surprising where the huge funds went to control the flooding.

text: Kun masobra sa P1-trillion ang budget suno kay Oso apang padayon gihapon ang flash floods, nagaguwa ang mga pamangkot kun may nagkurakot sang pondo.
english: If the budget exceeds P1-trillion but the flash floods continue, questions arise if someone corrupted the funds.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa sulod sang 15 ka tuig ukon halin sang 2011 tubtub sang 2025, nag-alokar ang gobyerno sang P1.47 trillion para sa flood control kag mitigation programs.
english: It is known that for 15 years or from 2011 to 2025, the government has allocated P1.47 trillion for flood control and mitigation programs.

text: Subong nga 2025, nagbaton ang Department of Public Works and Highways sang ikaduha sa pinakadako nga budget allocation nga lab-ot sa P1.007 trillion.
english: In 2025, the Department of Public Works and Highways received the second largest budget allocation of P1.007 trillion.

text: Sang 2021 report naman, nagpahayag anay ang Department of Justice nga ang DPWH kag local government units amo ang may pinakamataas nga corruption complaints sa tanan nga government agencies.
english: In its 2021 report, the Department of Justice said that the DPWH and local government units had the highest number of corruption complaints among all government agencies.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang nagligad nga semana, halos nag-anaw ang Metro Manila kag madamo nga mga rehiyon sa pungsod bangud sang pag-ulan dala sang enhanced southwest monsoon kag Bagyo Crising, Bagyo Dante, kag Bagyo Emong.
english: Last week, Metro Manila and many regions in the country were almost flooded due to rains caused by the enhanced southwest monsoon and Typhoon Crising, Typhoon Dante, and Typhoon Emong.

text: Ginmanduan sang Mandaluyong Regional Trial Court (RTC) ang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) nga kanselahon ang passports ni retired police colonel Royina Garma kag anay National Police Commission commissioner Edilberto Leonardo.
english: The Mandaluyong Regional Trial Court (RTC) has ordered the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) to cancel the passports of retired police colonel Royina Garma and former National Police Commission commissioner Edilberto Leonardo.

text: May kaangtanan ini sa kaso nga pagpatay kay Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) Board Secretary Wesley Barayuga.
english: This is in connection with the murder case of Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) Board Secretary Wesley Barayuga.

text: Ang Mandaluyong Regional Trial Court (RTC) branch 279 nagpaguwa man sang hold departure order batok kanday Garma, Leonardo kag tatlo pa ka iban nga responsable sa kamatayon ni Barayuga.
english: The Mandaluyong Regional Trial Court (RTC) branch 279 also issued a hold departure order against Garma, Leonardo and three others responsible for Barayuga’s death.

text: Kadungan sini, ginmanduan man sang korte nga magpabilin sa kustodiya sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) si anay Lieutenant Santi Mendoza kag anay pulis Nelson Mariano nga una nga nadakpan sang nagligad nga bulan.
english: Meanwhile, the court also ordered former Lieutenant Santi Mendoza and former policeman Nelson Mariano, who were first arrested last month, to remain in the custody of the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI).

text: Natalanan naman ang pre-trial conference sang kaso sa Nobyembre 12.
english: The pre-trial conference of the case is scheduled for November 12.

text: Madumduman nga sanday Garma kag Leonardo ang gintudlo sa hearing sang Senado nga sila ang masterminds sa likod sang pagpatay kay Barayoga sadtong tuig 2020.
english: Garma and Leonardo were identified in the Senate hearing as the masterminds behind the assassination of Barayoga in 2020.

text: AUSTRALIA – Ginakulang subong ang supply sang itlog sa Australia.
english: AUSTRALIA – There is a shortage of eggs in Australia.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Denmark Suede, iya ginpahayag nga nagtaas sang 40% ang presyo sang itlog sa mga supermarkets.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Denmark Suede, he said the price of eggs in supermarkets has increased by 40%.

text: Ginpahayag ni Suede nga ang mga poultry farms sa Australia ang nagabatyag subong sang kabudlay nga isustinir ang demand sang mga consumers.
english: Suede said Australian poultry farms are currently experiencing difficulties sustaining consumer demand.

text: Ginatudlo suno sa natungdan ang rason sang egg shortage sa pag-shift sa free-range eggs, pagtaas sang production costs, indi maayo nga klima, kag pandemya.
english: He said the reason for the egg shortage is the shift to free-range eggs, increased production costs, poor climate, and the pandemic.

text: Sa subong, suno kay Suede, gin-limit na lang ang itlog sa two-carton per customer.
english: Currently, Suede said, eggs are limited to two-cartons per customer.

text: Nahibaluan nga kinahanglan sang 15 tubtub 16 ka oras sang daylight kada adlaw antes makapangitlog ang manok.
english: It is known that it takes 15 to 16 hours of daylight per day for a chicken to lay eggs.

text: Ang mga Battery farms ang nagagamit naman sang artificial lighting, apang ang mga free-range farms ang wala nagagamit sini nga nagaresulta sa paggamay sang supply sang itlog sa tion sang winter.
english: Battery farms use artificial lighting, but free-range farms do not use it, resulting in a reduced supply of eggs during the winter.

text: Kinumpirma ng Department of Education (DepEd) Region 6 na umabot na sa 88 paaralan sa Western Visayas ang naapektuhan ng pagbaha na dulot ng Habagat at magkakasunod na bagyo.
english: The Department of Education (DepEd) Region 6 confirmed that 88 schools in Western Visayas have been affected by flooding caused by the Habagat and subsequent typhoons.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay DepEd-6 spokesperson Hernani Escullar Jr., sinabi niyang base sa kanilang monitoring, kabilang sa mga naapektuhan ang 2 paaralan sa Aklan, 13 sa Antique, 1 sa Guimaras, 56 sa Iloilo Province, at 16 sa Iloilo City.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, DepEd-6 spokesperson Hernani Escullar Jr. said that based on their monitoring, among the affected schools are 2 schools in Aklan, 13 in Antique, 1 in Guimaras, 56 in Iloilo Province, and 16 in Iloilo City.

text: Naitala rin na may 659 silid-aralan ang naapektuhan ng pagbaha; 7 sa Aklan, 346 sa Antique, 7 sa Guimaras, 201 sa Iloilo Province, at 98 sa Iloilo City.
english: It was also recorded that 659 classrooms were affected by the flooding; 7 in Aklan, 346 in Antique, 7 in Guimaras, 201 in Iloilo Province, and 98 in Iloilo City.

text: Ayon kay Escullar, karamihan sa mga silid-aralan ay nagtamo lamang ng minor damage at posible pang maisaayos at maaaring humingi ng karagdagang pondo ang mga paaralan kung kinakailangan para sa pag-aayos.
english: According to Escullar, most of the classrooms sustained minor damage and it is possible that the schools will be able to repair and receive additional funds if needed for repairs.

text: Tiniyak naman ng DepEd na ligtas na mabalikan ang mga paaralan sa mga lugar na naapektuhan, kaya’t inaasahang makakabalik na sa klase ang mga estudyante sa mga susunod na araw.
english: The DepEd assured that schools in the affected areas will be safe to resume, so students are expected to return to classes in the coming days.

text: Naaresto sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) ang regional top-listed drug personality lakip ang isa ka security guard kasunod sang ginpatuman nga drug buy-bust operation sa Barangay Calumpang, Molo.
english: The Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) arrested a regional top-listed drug personality and a security guard following a drug buy-bust operation in Barangay Calumpang, Molo.

text: Ang mga subject amo sanday Alias “Ariane”, 48-anyos, residente sang Zone 2, Barangay Bakhaw, Mandurriao, Iloilo City; ginakabig bilang regional top-listed drug personality; kag si Alias “Toto”, 32-anyos, security guard kag residente sang Barangay Dacuton, Capiz.
english: The subjects were identified as Alias ​​“Ariane”, 48 years old, resident of Zone 2, Barangay Bakhaw, Mandurriao, Iloilo City; regarded as regional top-listed drug personality; and Alias ​​“Toto”, 32, security guard and resident of Barangay Dacuton, Capiz.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, Head sang City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU), iya ginpahayag nga nakumpiskar ang 1,100 grams sang suspected shabu nga nagabalor sang ginabanta P7.5 million.
english: Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, head of the City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU), said 1,100 grams of suspected shabu worth P7.5 million were seized.

text: Suno kay Inot, ang mga nakumpiskar sa mga operasyon amo ang 39 ka heat-sealed plastic sachets nga may unod sang suspected shabu (lakip na ang buy-bust item),4 ka knot-tied nga plastic packs, buy-bust money kag non-drug-related items.
english: According to Inot, the items seized during the operations were 39 heat-sealed plastic sachets containing suspected shabu (including the buy-bust item), 4 knot-tied plastic packs, buy-bust money and non-drug-related items.

text: Samtang, gindayaw naman ni Mayor Jerry P. Treñas ang ICPO, sa pagpamuno ni PCol Kim Legada, kag ang Police Regional Office 6 (PRO6), sa pagpanguna ni PBGen Jack Wanky, sa pinakadaku nga drug recovery sang syudad subong nga tuig.
english: Meanwhile, Mayor Jerry P. Treñas commended the ICPO, led by PCol Kim Legada, and the Police Regional Office 6 (PRO6), led by PBGen Jack Wanky, for the city's biggest drug recovery this year.

text: Hiniling ni Senator Robinhood Padilla kay Senate Secretary Renato Bantug Jr, na isapubliko ang kaniyang Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN).
english: Senator Robinhood Padilla asked Senate Secretary Renato Bantug Jr., to make public his Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN).

text: Kasunod ito sa tuluyang pagbasura ng Office of the Ombudsman ang paghihigpit sa publiko para makita ang SALN ng mga opisyal ng gobyerno.
english: This follows the Office of the Ombudsman's outright rejection of the public's right to see the SALN of government officials.

text: Sa sulat ng Senador kay Bantug, sinabi nito na kusang loob siya na nagbibigay pahintulot na ilathala ang kaniyang SALN.
english: In the Senator's letter to Bantug, he said that he voluntarily gave permission to publish his SALN.

text: Nakikiisa rin si Padilla sa ganap na pagpapahayag at katapatan na naaayon sa prinsipyo ng “Public Office is a public trust”.
english: Padilla also stands for full disclosure and honesty in line with the principle of “Public Office is a public trust”.

text: Naglab-ot sa 71 ang napatay sa southern Ethiopia matapos naglapaw ang ila ginasakyan nga truck kag nahulog sa suba.
english: At least 71 people have been killed in southern Ethiopia after a truck they were traveling in overturned and fell into a river.

text: Nagabyahe ang amo nga salakyan sa Sidama state sang natabo ang insidente.
english: The vehicle was traveling in Sidama state when the incident occurred.

text: Ginpahayag man nga halin ang mga pasahero sa isa ka wedding party.
english: The passengers were also reportedly coming from a wedding party.

text: Base sa traffic police, overloaded ang truck nga amo ang ginalantaw nga rason sang paglukso sini sa suba.
english: According to the traffic police, the truck was overloaded which is believed to have caused it to jump into the river.

text: Nahibaluan nga linibo ka mga tawo ang nagakapatay sa Ethiopia kada tuig bangud sa mga aksidente sa dalan kun sa diin ginatumod nga rason ang overspeeding kag indi pagsunod sa mga layi sa trapiko.
english: It is known that thousands of people die in Ethiopia every year due to road accidents where overspeeding and non-compliance with traffic laws are cited as reasons.

text: Gindugangan pa sang China ang trade suspensions sa Taiwan kasunod sang pagbisita ni US House Speaker Nancy Pelosi sa amo nga self-ruled island.
english: China has increased trade suspensions with Taiwan following US House Speaker Nancy Pelosi's visit to the self-ruled island.

text: Epektibo kahapon, Myerkules nga adlaw, suspendido naman ang natural sand exports sa Taiwan matapos ang mandu sang Ministry of Commerce .
english: Effective yesterday, Wednesday, natural sand exports to Taiwan were suspended following the order of the Ministry of Commerce.

text: Ginsuspinde man sang General Administration of Customs ang imports sang citrus fruits, chilled white scallops, kag frozen mackerel halin sa Taiwan.
english: The General Administration of Customs also suspended imports of citrus fruits, chilled white scallops, and frozen mackerel from Taiwan.

text: Ginhimo nga rason ang pagka-detect sang pila ka peste sa fruit shipments kag positive coronavirus tests sa cold supply chain.
english: The reason was the detection of several pests in fruit shipments and positive coronavirus tests in the cold supply chain.

text: Antes sini nga tikang, gin-ban na nga daan sang China ang imports sang Taiwanese confectionery, biscuits, tinapay, kag aquatic products.
english: Prior to this move, China had already banned imports of Taiwanese confectionery, biscuits, bread, and aquatic products.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang China amo ang largest trading partner sang Taiwan.
english: China is Taiwan's largest trading partner.

text: Sang nagligad lang nga tuig, yara sa $273 billion ukon P15.21 trillion ang bilateral trade nga katumbas sang 33% sang total trade sang Taiwan sa nabilin nga bahin sang kalibutan.
english: Last year alone, bilateral trade was $273 billion or P15.21 trillion, equivalent to 33% of Taiwan's total trade with the rest of the world.

text: Sa subong, ginakalabalak-an man sang mga eksperto ang posible mangin impact sini nga tensyon sa semiconductor industry sang Taiwan.
english: Meanwhile, experts are also concerned about the possible impact of this tension on Taiwan's semiconductor industry.

text: Ini bangud ang Taiwan amo ang ginakabig global leader sa supply sang semiconductor chips nga amo ang importante nga component para sa modern electronics — halin sa mga salakyan, padulong sa refrigerators, padulong sa mobile phones.
english: This is because Taiwan is considered the global leader in the supply of semiconductor chips that are the crucial component for modern electronics — from cars, to refrigerators, to mobile phones.

text: Posible nga madugangan pa ang mga banwa sa Iloilo nga magadeklarar sang state of calamity kasunod sang daku nga halit sang habagat nga ginpabaskog pa sang sunod-sunod nga mga bagyo sa Pilipinas.
english: It is possible that more towns in Iloilo will declare a state of calamity following the severe damage caused by the south wind that was exacerbated by a series of typhoons in the Philippines.

text: Suno sa Iloilo Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO), mahimo nga mag-deklarar ang Leganes kag Zarraga bangud pareho nga sobra sa 15% ang apektado nga populasyon.
english: According to the Iloilo Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO), Leganes and Zarraga may declare because both have more than 15% of the affected population.

text: Una na nga nagpaidalom sa amo nga status ang Pototan bangud sa halit sang enhanced southwest monsoon kag mga Bagyo Dante kag Emong sa sektor sang ila agrikultura.
english: Pototan was previously placed under such status due to the damage caused by the enhanced southwest monsoon and Typhoons Dante and Emong to its agricultural sector.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Retired Police Colonel Cornelio Salinas, head sang opisina, iya ginpahayag nga paagi sa sini nga deklarasyon, ma-mobilize ang kinahanglanon nga resources para sa emergency response, relief operations, kag recovery measures.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Retired Police Colonel Cornelio Salinas, head of the office, said that through this declaration, the necessary resources will be mobilized for emergency response, relief operations, and recovery measures.

text: Ginlaragway man ni Salinas nga “intense” gid ang epekto sang habagat sa probinsya bangud nahalitan sini ang 22 ka mga banwa kun sa diin may 210 barangays.
english: Salinas also described the impact of the habagat in the province as “intense” as it damaged 22 towns with 210 barangays.

text: Nakarekord ang opisina sang 355 ka mga balay nga nagkalaguba kun sa diin 322 diri ang partially damaged kag 33 naman ang totally damaged.
english: The office recorded 355 houses destroyed of which 322 were partially damaged and 33 were totally damaged.

text: Nauna naman nga ginpahayag ni Governor Arthur Defensor, Jr.
english: Earlier, Governor Arthur Defensor, Jr.

text: nga nagdangat na sa masobra P2.2 million ang balor sang kahalitan sa agrikultura sa probinsya ilabi na ang mga talamnan sa Lambunao, Leganes, Oton, Pototan, San Joaquin, San Miguel, kag Tubungan.
english: that the damage to agriculture in the province has reached more than P2.2 million especially the crops in Lambunao, Leganes, Oton, Pototan, San Joaquin, San Miguel, and Tubungan.

text: Ginahitso pa subong sang Philippine national women’s football team ang listahan sang pinal nga players nga ipadala sa FIFA Women’s World Cup nga matabo na sa bulan sang Hulyo.
english: The Philippine national women's football team is still finalizing the list of final players to be sent to the FIFA Women's World Cup in July.

text: Halin sa masobra 30 ka players sa national team, 23 gid lamang ka stars kag veterans ang dapat dal-on sa official line-up nga dapat na isumite sa Hunyo.
english: Out of more than 30 players in the national team, only 23 stars and veterans should be included in the official line-up that should be submitted in June.

text: Suno sa Australian head coach nga si Alen Stajcic, ginapilian pa subong ang players nga halin pa sa ila tagsa ka club duties sa Europa, Australia kag kaiping nga mga pungsod sa Asya.
english: According to Australian head coach Alen Stajcic, players are still being selected from their respective club duties in Europe, Australia and neighboring Asian countries.

text: Nalakip ang Pilipinas sa Group A sa una sini nga pagpartisipar sa Women’s World Cup kun sa diin makasumpong sini ang co-host nga New Zealand, Norway kag Switzerland.
english: The Philippines is in Group A in its first participation in the Women's World Cup where it will face co-hosts New Zealand, Norway and Switzerland.

text: Para sa Filipinas, daku nga lyabe sa ila preparasyon pag-abot sa estilo sang hampang ang patigayunon nga Pinatar Cup sa masunod nga bulan kun sa diin ila makaatubang ang Iceland, Wales kag Scotland.
english: For the Philippines, a big key to their preparation in terms of style of play is the Pinatar Cup next month where they will face Iceland, Wales and Scotland.

text: Magapatuman sang psychological debriefing ang Iloilo Police Provincial Office – Women and Children Protection Desk sa mga lamharon nga na-link sa ginaalegar attempted abduction.
english: The Iloilo Police Provincial Office – Women and Children Protection Desk will conduct a psychological debriefing on the youths linked to the alleged attempted abduction.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Liza Nofuente, Chief sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office – Women and Children Protection Desk, iya ginpahayag nga nagapakig-angot na sila sa mga kabataan agud magpatuman sang imbestigasyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Liza Nofuente, chief of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office – Women and Children Protection Desk, said they are already contacting the children to conduct an investigation.

text: Nagpanugyan man ini sa mga menor-de-edad nga naka-eksperyensya sang amo nga sitwasyon nga gilayon i-report sa ila talatapan agud mahatagan sang proper intervention.
english: He also advised minors who experience such situations to immediately report to their office for proper intervention.

text: Suno kay Nofuente, isa ang social media sa mga nagatuga sang fabrications sa kaisipan sang mga lamharon kon sa diin, nagahimo-himo sang istorya ukon scenario nga indi matuod.
english: According to Nofuente, social media is one of the factors that create fabrications in the minds of young people where, they make up stories or scenarios that are not true.

text: Nahibaluan nga lakip sa mga alleged attempted abduction ang natabo sa Igbaras kon sa diin, ginahatagan sang iloy ang iya anak sang P1500 agud ibayad sa eskwelahan, apang nagasto ini sang bata kag naghimo-himo sang istorya nga ginhold-up sya kag gin-abduct.
english: It is known that among the alleged attempted abductions that happened in Igbaras where, a mother gave her son P1500 to pay for school, but she spent the child and made up a story that she was hold-up and abducted.

text: Lakip man diri ang kaso nga alleged kidnapping sa Pototan, samtang sa Janiuay nga naglisensya nga maghimo sang school project apang wala na nakapauli kag natukiban sang WCP nga nag-upod sa iya ex-boyfriend kag nag-inom-inom sang makahulubog nga ilimnon.
english: This includes the case of alleged kidnapping in Pototan, while in Janiuay who took permission to do a school project but did not return home and was discovered by the WCP to be with her ex-boyfriend and drinking alcohol.

text: Nabalhag man sang talatapan ang kaso sa Dumangas kon sa diin, ginapahayag nga ginsundan ini sang motorsiklo apang mas ginpakamaayo nga ipaidalom ini sa psychological tests.
english: The office also recorded a case in Dumangas where he was allegedly followed by a motorcycle but preferred to undergo psychological tests.

text: Samtang, kapareho man ini sa kaso sa Barotac Nuevo nga gintanyagan sang dulsi sang duha ka lalaki apang ginkumpirma sang barangay official sa amo nga lugar nga wala sang naga-eksister nga amo nga report.
english: Meanwhile, this is similar to the case in Barotac Nuevo where two men offered sweets but the barangay official in the area confirmed that there is no such report.

text: Pinakaulihi naman ang natabo sa Igtambo, San Miguel, kon sa diin, gindulogan sang van ang tatlo ka mga bata apang ulihi natukiban nga nagapangita lang sang kalan-an nga batchoyan ang driver sang van.
english: The latest incident occurred in Igtambo, San Miguel, where a van hit three children but it was later discovered that the driver of the van was just looking for a restaurant to batchoyan.

text: Agud ma-address ang krisis sa kalamay sa Pilipinas, naghingyo ang major producers kay President Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos nga itigana na lang para sa local ukon domestic sale ang kalamay nga amo pa ang gina-allocate agud i-export sa Estados Unidos.
english: To address the sugarcane crisis in the Philippines, major producers have asked President Ferdinand 'Bongbong' Marcos to reserve for local or domestic sale the sugarcane that is still allocated for export to the United States.

text: Ang Central Azucarera de Bais Inc.
english: Central Azucarera de Bais Inc.

text: (CAB) kag Central Azucarera de San Antonio Inc.
english: (CAB) and Central Azucarera de San Antonio Inc.

text: (Casa) sa Negros Island ang may yara sang combined volume nga 9,679 metric tons (MT) nga outstanding class A raw sugar.
english: (Casa) in Negros Island has a combined volume of 9,679 metric tons (MT) of outstanding class A raw sugar.

text: Ini ang gina-request nila sa Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) agud ma-reclassify kag matuon sa class B stocks agud mahimo nga mabaligya sa local market.
english: They are requesting the Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) to be reclassified and classified as class B stocks so that they can be sold in the local market.

text: Sa ila sulat kay President Marcos nga amo man ang Agriculture Secretary, nag-apelar ang CAB kag Casa agud nga mabaliskad ang ginapahayag “unreasonable, arbitrary and discriminatory” denial sang SRA sa ila aplikasyon para sa sugar reclassification.
english: In a letter to President Marcos, who is also the Agriculture Secretary, the CAB and Casa appealed to overturn the SRA's alleged “unreasonable, arbitrary and discriminatory” denial of their application for sugar reclassification.

text: Ginsaad man sang major producers nga ang SRA gani mismo ang naghambal nga may yara sang “severe” shortage sang kalamay kag posible nga maubusan gid sang suplay ang pungsod subong nga bulan sang Agosto.
english: The major producers also promised that the SRA itself has said that there is a “severe” shortage of sugarcane and the country is likely to run out of supply this August.

text: Ginhingyo man sang Negros-based companies nga tun-an liwat ang mandatory sugar export system sa Pilipinas.
english: Negros-based companies also called for a review of the mandatory sugar export system in the Philippines.

text: Ginsaad man ang 2021 policy discussion paper sang National Economic and Development Authority (Neda) kun sa diin ginpahayag nga: “the allocation of quedans for sugar exports to the US has outlived its usefulness and introduces unwanted distortions in the market.” ##
english: Also promised was the 2021 policy discussion paper of the National Economic and Development Authority (Neda) which stated that: “the allocation of quedans for sugar exports to the US has outlived its usefulness and introduces unwanted distortions in the market.” ##

text: Nagasinggitan sang suporta ang pamilya sang 179 ka mga napatay kasunod sang pag-crash ang South Korean passenger airplane sa Muan International Airport sa South Jeolla Province sa South Korea.
english: Families of 179 people killed after a South Korean passenger plane crashed at Muan International Airport in South Jeolla Province in South Korea are shouting for support.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joseph Vermont Bandoy, Bombo International Correspondent sa South Korea, iya ginpahayag nga padayon ang pagpatuman sang identification sang South Korean government paagi sa finger printing kag DNA testing.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joseph Vermont Bandoy, Bombo International Correspondent in South Korea, said the South Korean government continues to implement identification through finger printing and DNA testing.

text: Suno kay Bandoy, ang duha ka mga naka-survived ang yara subong sa Seoul, South Korea kag padayon nga ginalapatan sang pagbulong.
english: Bandoy said the two survivors are currently in Seoul, South Korea and are undergoing treatment.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga halos tanan sa mga biktima ang na-identify kon sa diin, duha sa kabug-usan nga 181 nga pasahero, duha ang Thai kag lunsay South Korean ang nabilin.
english: He also explained that almost all of the victims were identified where, two of the total 181 passengers, two Thais and all South Koreans remained.

text: Nagtipon naman ang pila sa mga pamilya sang mga nagtaliwan sa Muan airport agud maghulat nga maguwa ang ‘official’ nga identity sang ila mga himata.
english: Some of the families of the deceased gathered at Muan airport to wait for the official identity of their relatives to be released.

text: Una na nga nagaguwa ang impormasyon nga ‘bird strike’ ang rason sa pagkaguba sang landing gear sang eroplano tubtob nga naghugpa sa runway apisar nga wala na sang landing gear.
english: Earlier, it was reported that a bird strike was the cause of the damage to the plane's landing gear until it landed on the runway despite the fact that there was no landing gear.

text: Naham-ot nga ginklaro ni Vice President Sara Duterte nga wala siya sang kontrol sa kontrobersyal nga kongresista nga si Kiko Barzaga.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte has made it clear that she has no control over controversial congressman Kiko Barzaga.

text: Pahayag sang bise-presidente, may kaugalingon nga prinsipyo si Barzaga kag ini ang sahi sang tawo nga mabudlay kontrolon.
english: The vice-president said Barzaga has his own principles and is the kind of person who is difficult to control.

text: Ginbalikan sini ang UniTeam rally sa Cavite sang 2022.
english: He recalled the UniTeam rally in Cavite in 2022.

text: Pahayag sini, Sara Duterte supporters ang mga ginikanan ni Kiko, apang si Kiko, pareho nga si Sara kag si President Bongbong Marcos ang ginsuportahan.
english: He said Kiko's parents were Sara Duterte supporters, but Kiko, both Sara and President Bongbong Marcos were supported.

text: “Ang magulang nya ay hindi Uniteam, for Sara only sila.
english: “Her parents are not Uniteam, they are for Sara only.

text: Si Kiko was for Uniteam,” suno sa vice president.
english: Kiko was for Uniteam,” the vice president said.

text: “Di ko pakawala si Kiko.
english: “I can’t lose Kiko.

text: Isa syang tao na mahirap kontrolin kahit sinuman.
english: He is a person who is difficult to control anyone.

text: I do not control Kiko Barzaga.
english: I do not control Kiko Barzaga.

text: He is his own person, he has his own principles and own free will,” dugang niya.
english: He is his own person, he has his own principles and own free will,” he added.

text: Matandaan nga sa isa ka protesta sa guwa sang Forbes Park sang Domingo, nagpanawagan si Barzaga nga mag-resign si President Marcos.
english: It can be recalled that in a protest outside Forbes Park on Sunday, Barzaga called for the resignation of President Marcos.

text: Nagpahibalo ang More Electric and Power Corporation nga may matabo nga scheduled power interruption buwas, Hulyo 27.
english: More Electric and Power Corporation announced that there will be a scheduled power interruption tomorrow, July 27.

text: Ini kaangot sa patigayunon nga mga trabaho para sa pagkay-o sang mga hotspot, reconductoring sang 13.2kV primary line, paglimpyo sang mga linya pinaagi sang vegetation, pag-ilis sang mga guba nga insulator, kag pagbutang sang mga rubber insolation.
english: This is in connection with the works to be carried out for the repair of hotspots, reconductoring of 13.2kV ​​primary line, cleaning of lines through vegetation, replacement of damaged insulators, and installation of rubber insolation.

text: “Ini nga tikang ang ginahimu agud malikawan ang mas dalagko nga problema nga mahimu matabo kun indi matigayon ang ini nga mga aktibidades,” suno sa MORE Power.
english: “This step is being taken to avoid bigger problems that could occur if these activities are not carried out,” according to MORE Power.

text: Matapos gindelete sang actress nga si Nadine Lustre ang mga pictures nila ni James Reid sa Instagram, padayon naman ang pagguwa sang mga litrato sini kaupod ang ginpahayag bag-o niya nga boyfriend.
english: After actress Nadine Luster deleted her pictures with James Reid on Instagram, photos of her with her alleged new boyfriend continue to appear.

text: Nakit-an sanday Nadine kag lalaki nga si Christophe Bariou nga nagaholding hands samtang nagalakat sa Makati City.
english: Nadine and Christophe Bariou were seen holding hands while walking in Makati City.

text: Samtang spotted man si Nadine nga yara sa Commission on Elections (Comelec) office sa Siargao sa diin siya nagparehistro.
english: Meanwhile, Nadine was also spotted at the Commission on Elections (Comelec) office in Siargao where she registered.

text: Masako ang actress sa pagtuon sang surfing sa Siargao kag kaupod man niya diri si Christophe.
english: The actress is busy learning surfing in Siargao and she is also accompanied by Christophe.

text: Ang ginapahayag nobyo ni Nadine amo ang tag-iya sang isa ka boutique resort sa Siargao Island.
english: Nadine’s alleged boyfriend is the owner of a boutique resort on Siargao Island.

text: Makig-istorya si Iloilo City Representative Julienne “Jamjam” Baronda kay City Director PCol.
english: Iloilo City Representative Julienne “Jamjam” Baronda will meet with City Director PCol.

text: Wilbert Parilla sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) agud maathagan kun ano ang buot silingon nga indi alarming ang illegal nga droga sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: Wilbert Parilla of the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) to clarify what it means that illegal drugs in Iloilo City are not alarming.

text: Ini may kaangtanan sa nagluntad nga stabbing incident sa Zone 5 San Isidro, La Paz gab-i sang Marso 21,2026 nga nagresulta sa apat tanan ka indibidwal nga ginbawian sang kabuhi kun sa diin palpak nga transakyon sa illegal nga droga ang ginhalinan.
english: This is in connection with the stabbing incident that occurred in Zone 5 San Isidro, La Paz on the night of March 21, 2026 which resulted in the death of four individuals where the cause was a failed illegal drug transaction.

text: Suno kay Lone District Representative Julliene ”Jam-Jam” Baronda, iya ginpahayag nga tuman ka alarming ini sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: Lone District Representative Julliene "Jam-Jam" Baronda said it is very alarming in Iloilo City.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga sa pagpakighinun-anon sini sa mga pumuluyo nagahambal ang mga ini nga tuman ka makalarma ang illegal nga droga sa syudad kag indi na safe ang seguridad sang pumuluyo.
english: He said that in his discussions with the residents, they say that illegal drugs in the city are very alarming and the security of the residents is not safe.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga kaangay nga wala sang kahadlok ang mga tawo nga nagagamit sang illegal nga droga kun sa diin may nagakatabo nga pagpinatyanay kag pagbinun-anay.
english: He also said that people who use illegal drugs seem to have no fear where there are killings and beatings.

text: Gindugang man sini nga magapatigayon ini sang privilege speech kun indi pa ini ma-address nga problema.
english: He added that he will hold a privilege speech if the problem is not addressed.

text: Nagpasalig ang Filipino weightlifter nga si Hidilyn Diaz-Naranjo nga iya himuon ang tanan agud mangin madinalag-on sa iya pagbalik sa Southeast Asian (SEA) Games sini nga tuig.
english: Filipino weightlifter Hidilyn Diaz-Naranjo has pledged that she will do everything to be successful in her return to the Southeast Asian (SEA) Games this year.

text: Sang nagligad, ginkumpirmar ni Naranjo nga magabalik siya sa kompetisyon, kun sa diin iya nakuha ang back-to-back gold medals sang 2019 kag 2022.
english: In the past, Naranjo confirmed that he will return to the competition, where he won back-to-back gold medals in 2019 and 2022.

text: Suno sa iya, determinado siya nga magahatag liwat sang kadungganan sa Pilipinas pinaagi sa pagpauli sang medalya.
english: He said he is determined to bring honor to the Philippines again by bringing home the medal.

text: Ginpakita man ni Naranjo ang iya suporta sa iban pa nga Filipino athletes.
english: Naranjo also showed his support to other Filipino athletes.

text: Hiwaton ang 2025 SEA Games sa Disyembre 9 tubtob 20 sa Thailand.
english: The 2025 SEA Games will be held from December 9 to 20 in Thailand.

text: Kaupod ni Naranjo nga magatiglawas sang Pilipinas sa weightlifting sanday Rosegie Ramos, Jhodie Peralta, Elreen Ando, Kristel Macrohon, kag iban pa.
english: Naranjo will be joined by Rosegie Ramos, Jhodie Peralta, Elreen Ando, ​​Kristel Macrohon, and others who will represent the Philippines in weightlifting.

text: Nagpa-andam ang pungsod Iran nga mangin lehitimo sini nga target ang US bases, mga pasilidad kag assets kun maga-atake na ang America.
english: Iran has warned that US bases, facilities and assets will become legitimate targets if America launches an attack.

text: Ini sa tunga sa ginhatag nga pagpalawig ni US President Donald Trump sa Iran nga 10 tubtob 15 nga adlaw para maka-angkon sang nuclear deal.
english: This comes amid US President Donald Trump's extension of 10 to 15 days to Iran to reach a nuclear deal.

text: Ginpasapubliko ni Iranian Ambassador to the United Nations Amir Saeid ang ini nga pahayag paagi sa isa ka sulat nga ginpadala kay UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres kag Security Council president.
english: Iranian Ambassador to the United Nations Amir Saeid made this statement public in a letter sent to UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres and Security Council president.

text: Nahibaluan nga gin-mensyonar ni Trump sa iya social media nga may posibilidad nga kinahanglan sang US ang mga base militar sang UK, dala na ang isa sa Indian Ocean Island kun indi magpasugot ang Iran.
english: Trump mentioned on his social media that there is a possibility that the US will need UK military bases, including one on an Indian Ocean island if Iran does not agree.

text: Suno sa Iran Ambassador, ang ini nga pahayag nagapakita sang matuod nga katalagman sang military aggression nga ang resulta pwede makaguba sa rehiyon kag posible magdala sang tuman nga peligro sa international peace and security.
english: According to the Iranian Ambassador, this statement shows the real danger of military aggression whose results could destroy the region and possibly pose a serious threat to international peace and security.

text: Nauna na nga gin-report nga nagahanda na ang Amerika sa paglunsyar sang strike sa Iran, samtang nagapadala si Trump sang warships, fighter jets, kag iban pa nga pwersa militar sa Middle East agud mapunggan ang Iran sa paghimo sang nuclear bomb, nga ginapanginwala naman sang Tehran.
english: It was previously reported that the United States is preparing to launch a strike on Iran, as Trump sends warships, fighter jets, and other military forces to the Middle East to prevent Iran from developing a nuclear bomb, which Tehran denies.

text: LUYAG ko iangot ining panaysayon naton diri sa ginaplano ni Gov.
english: I would like to link this conversation here to the plans of Gov.

text: Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: nga tagaan sing daku nga papel ang tourism sa uma (farm) sa Iloilo.
english: to give a greater role to farm tourism in Iloilo.

text: Madamo nga paagi ma-enjoy ang pagbisita ukon pag-bakasyon sang bisan pila lang ka semana sa farm sang isa ka turista nga taga-siyudad, labi na ang halin sa iban nga pungsod nga luyag maghibalo kag mag-enjoy sa bag-o nga palibut, exciting adventure, oportunidad sa negosyo, pagpasanyog sang physical kag spiritual life, kag ang madala pauli nga handumanan.
english: There are many ways to enjoy a visit or vacation for even a few weeks on the farm of a city tourist, especially those from other countries who want to learn and enjoy the new environment, exciting adventure, business opportunities, improve physical and spiritual life, and take home memories.

text: Ini tanan, I am sure, ma-enjoy kag ma-experience sang turista sa farm sa klase sang ila rural life, pag-producir kag pagdala sang ila produkto sa merkado, kahiwatan kalingawan kag relihiyosa, kag ang pinasahe nila nga pag-amoma (hospitality) sa bisita nga duna sa mga Filipino.
english: All this, I am sure, can be enjoyed and experienced by tourists on the farm in the form of their rural life, production and transportation of their products to the market, entertainment and religious activities, and the unique hospitality of the Filipinos.

text: In fact, may bastante sila nga oportunidad agud mahibal-an ini tanan sa isa ka farm tourism (agritourism) site sa pagtener sing pila ka adlaw sa mga guest house nga madayunan nila.
english: In fact, they have enough opportunity to learn all this on a farm tourism (agritourism) site by staying for a few days in the guest houses where they can stay.

text:
***

Sugiran ko anay kamo sang akon personal nga nahibal-an kag experyensya sa amon farm, nga isa man ka fishing village, pagkatapos nagdugay sa siyudad nga liwan ang kahimtangan sa baho semento, magahod kag magamo nga siyudad.
english:
***

Let me tell you about my personal knowledge and experience on our farm, which is also a fishing village, after a long time in the city to change the situation to the smell of cement, noisy and chaotic city.

text: Setyembre 21, 1972 ato sang gin-deklarar ni anay Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Sr.
english: On September 21, 1972, former President Ferdinand Marcos Sr.

text: ang martial law agud kuno matapna ang “revolutionary storm” nga nagaluntad na sa pungsod.
english: the martial law to supposedly stop the “revolutionary storm” that is already existing in the country.

text: Luyag ini tapnaon ni anay Presidente Marcos Sr.
english: Former President Marcos Sr. wants to stop this.

text: paagi sa kamot nga salsalon.
english: with an iron hand.

text: Ang temporaryo nga kalinong nagluntad gid man anay, ugaling amat-amat nagpadaba-daba ini sang balatyagon sang madamo sa sige na pagpanglagas sa political opposition, sang bisan sin-o man lang gani nga maisug manindugan, lakip na ang mga estudyante sa kolehiyo sa ila magahod nga kabalaka sa marikot na mga hitabo sa sosyedad.
english: The temporary peace did exist, but it gradually inflamed the feelings of many in the constant pursuit of the political opposition, of anyone who dared to stand up, including college students in their noisy concern about the current events in society.

text: Ining hitabo nagtulod sa akon iloy nga bedridden agud itapok ako didto sa amon farm sa daku nga bahin sang kaumhan nanday anhing lolo kag lola sa Brgy.

Adventure sa Pagpanagat

Unahon lo ang akon experyensya sa pagpanagat.

Fishing Adventure

First lo my fishing experience.

text: Sa matuod wala ako namag-uhan sa uma kay sa masami kami nga mag-ululutod mag-bakasyon dira s amon farm tubtub elementarya bag-o nagtutok na sa siyudad sang gatuon na sa hayskul.

english: But because I was used to the city and was used to joining the student movement, it was very difficult for me to adjust to living in the countryside again.

text: Sa isang Instagram post, ibinahagi ni Jessica ang ilang larawan at alaala mula sa kanyang naging paglalakbay simula nang una siyang sumali sa kompetisyon sa edad na 10.
english: In an Instagram post, Jessica shared some pictures and memories from her journey since she first entered the competition at the age of 10.

text: Ayon sa kanya, ang kanyang tagumpay ay hindi lamang bunga ng isang gabi o isang performance, kundi ng mahigit dalawang dekadang pagsisikap na kinapalooban ng auditions, rejections, at mga sandaling pinanghinaan ng loob.
english: According to him, his success is not just the result of one night or one performance, but of more than two decades of effort that included auditions, rejections, and moments of discouragement.

text: Aniya, patunay ang kanyang karanasan na “dreams delayed are not dreams denied,” at na ang lahat ay nakabatay sa tamang oras ng Diyos.
english: Here, his experience proves that “dreams delayed are not dreams denied,” and that everything is based on God's timing.

text: Nagpasalamat si Jessica sa kanyang pamilya, mga kaibigan, at lahat ng sumuporta sa kanya, sabay bigyang-diin na ang kanyang panalo ay hindi lamang para sa kanya kundi para sa lahat ng patuloy na lumalaban sa kabila ng mga pagsubok.
english: Jessica thanked her family, friends, and everyone who supported her, while saying that her victory is not only for her but for all those who continue to fight despite the trials.

text: Bago niya tinapos ang kanyang mensahe, nagbigay din siya ng espesyal na pagbati para sa anak na si Eliana Mae: “Mama did it.

english: He became more famous as the runner-up on “American Idol” Season 11.

text: Bumalik siya sa “AGT” noong Hulyo kung saan kinanta niya ang “Beautiful Things” ni Benson Boone at nakakuha ng golden buzzer mula kay Sofia Vergara.
english: She returned to “AGT” in July where she sang Benson Boone’s “Beautiful Things” and got a golden buzzer from Sofia Vergara.

text: Sa finale episode, tinanghal niya ang makapangyarihang bersyon ng kantang “Golden Hour” ni JVKE na nagbigay-daan sa kanyang kampeonato.
english: In the finale episode, he performed a powerful version of JVKE's song “Golden Hour” that won his championship.

text: Kinaandan kun may yara kita sang flight, indi gid kita mahim-os kun isa ka oras na lang ang nabilin kag wala pa kita sa airport.
english: Usually when we have a flight, we are not ready when there is only an hour left and we are not at the airport.

text: Ang iban gani, hapon pa ang schedule pero aga pa nagakadto sa paluparan.
english: Others are scheduled for the afternoon but arrive at the airport early in the morning.

text: Sa amo sini nga sitwasyon, may ginasunod nga airline policies para sa pag-rebook ukon maghimo sang alternative travel arrangements.
english: In such a situation, there are airline policies for rebooking or making alternative travel arrangements.

text: May airlines nga nagahatag sang brief grace period ukon “flat-tire rule”, apang kun wala sang polisa, may airlines naman nga nagamarka sang ticket nga no-show nga maga- cancel sang connecting ukon return flights.
english: Some airlines give a brief grace period or “flat-tire rule”, but if there is no policy, there are airlines that mark tickets as no-show that will cancel connecting or return flights.

text: Sa isa ka hitabo sa Chile, naatrasar gid ang isa ka flight sang na-late sang abot ang isa ka pasahero kag sa sobra sini ka desperado nga indi siya mabayaan, ginbanggaan sini ang eroplano.
english: In one incident in Chile, a flight was delayed when a passenger arrived late and in his desperation not to be left behind, he collided with the plane.

text: Nagpatunga gid ang lalaki sa alagyan sang eroplano rason nga indi makahalin ang aircraft bisan nga ginmaniobra na sang pilots kag ready na gid kuntani sa flight.
english: The man got in the middle of the runway and the plane could not take off even though the pilots had maneuvered it and it was ready for flight.

text: Ginkadtuan sang staff sang airport ang lalaki kaupod ang security patrol, ginpaguwa sa runway, kag gintugyan sa pulisya.
english: Airport staff approached the man along with security patrol, escorted him off the runway, and handed him over to the police.

text: Ang imbes gamay lang kuntani sini nga late, labi pa gid nga naglawig bangud sa proseso bangud kasuhan pa ini.
english: What was supposed to be a little late, has become even longer because of the process because it is still being prosecuted.

text: Base sa reports, pakadto kuntani ang 29-anyos nga pasahero sa Concepcion, Chile sakay sang Latam Airlines, apang bangud na-late siya, naglusot siya sa security, nagdalagan sa runway, kag nagtindog didto sang isa ka minuto.
english: According to reports, the 29-year-old passenger was supposed to fly to Concepcion, Chile on Latam Airlines, but because he was late, he slipped through security, ran to the runway, and stood there for a minute.

text: 10 minutes man ang delay sang flight nga sang ulihi naglupad gid nga wala ang amo nga pasahero.
english: 10 minutes was also the delay of the flight which later took off without the passenger.

english: The resolution proposed by Councilor Lyndon Acap appealing to ICPO Director Col.

english: Kim Legada to build a satellite office of ICPS 6 in Arevalo Plaza.

text: Masobra duha ka oras nga ginpaidalom sa Yellow Alert ang Visayas Grid.
english: The Visayas Grid was placed under Yellow Alert for more than two hours.

text:
Sa ginpaguwa nga abiso, nag-umpisa ini alas singko sa hapon tubtub alas syete sa gab-i, kag ginkumpirma sang National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) nga ginbawi ini sang 7:45 sang gab-i.

Ini ang una nga yellow alert nga gin-isyu sang subong nga tuig.
english:
According to the notice issued, the outage lasted from 5 pm to 7 pm, and the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) confirmed that it was lifted at 7:45 pm.

This is the first yellow alert issued this year.

text: Gina-isyu ang yellow alert kon kulang ang operating margin agud malab-ut ang contingency requirement sang transmission grid.
english: A yellow alert is issued if the operating margin is insufficient to meet the contingency requirement of the transmission grid.

text: Suno sa grid operator, ginpasaka ang alert kasunod sang forced outage sa TVI Unit 1 nga may yara sang kapasidad nga 169 megawatts, kag PEDC Unit 2 nga may kapasidad nga 83.7 megawatts.
english: According to the grid operator, the alert was raised following the forced outage in TVI Unit 1 with a capacity of 169 megawatts, and PEDC Unit 2 with a capacity of 83.7 megawatts.

text: Ang TVI Unit 1 ang parte sang Therma Visayas Inc.
english: TVI Unit 1 is part of Therma Visayas Inc.

text: coal-fired power plant sa Barangay Bato, Toledo City, Cebu sa Central Visayas.
english: coal-fired power plant in Barangay Bato, Toledo City, Cebu in Central Visayas.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ang PEDC Unit 2 ang iya naman sang Panay Energy Development Corporation coal plant sa Iloilo City diri sa Western Visayas.
english: Meanwhile, PEDC Unit 2 belongs to the Panay Energy Development Corporation coal plant in Iloilo City here in Western Visayas.

text: Magluwas sa sini, may 10 na nga daan ka power plants nga naka-forced outage subong nga Enero, apat halin sang 2025, tatlo halin sang 2024, duha halin sang 2023, kag isa halin sang 2021.
english: In addition, there are already 10 older power plants that have been in forced outages this January, four from 2025, three from 2024, two from 2023, and one from 2021.

text: Dugang pa diri, may 21 ka mga planta nga naga-opera sa ginpanubo nga kapasidad nga nag-resulta sa kabug-usan nga 681.1 megawatts nga indi available sa grid.
english: In addition to this, there were 21 plants operating at reduced capacity resulting in a total of 681.1 megawatts not being available to the grid.

text: Una na nga nagpaandam ang Department of Energy (DOE) nga posible maapektuhan sang tyempo ang Visayas kag Mindanao grids.
english: Earlier, the Department of Energy (DOE) warned that the Visayas and Mindanao grids may be affected by the weather.

text: Indi pabor si Department of Finance (DOF) Secretary Ralph Recto nga panubuon ang Value-Added Tax (VAT) sa 10% halin sa 12 porsyento.
english: Department of Finance (DOF) Secretary Ralph Recto is not in favor of increasing the Value-Added Tax (VAT) to 10% from 12 percent.

text: Pahayag sang tiglikom, kun himuon ini, magaresulta ini sa revenue losses kag mapwersa ang gobyerno nga mangutang para sa regular nga mga galastuhan.
english: The secretary said that if this is done, it will result in revenue losses and force the government to borrow for regular expenses.

text: “I’m sure that those who have filed a bill all have well intentions.
english: “I’m sure that those who have filed a bill all have well intentions.

text: Having said that, at this point in time, if you do, I leave it to Congress — if you pass a bill, my warning will be that there will be a possible credit rating downgrade.
english: Having said that, at this point in time, if you do, I leave it to Congress — if you pass a bill, my warning will be that there will be a possible credit rating downgrade.

text: And why is that?
english: And why is that?

text: Because today, tignan lang ninyo ah, next year, what we will collect from VAT, BIR, and BOC will roughly be ₱1.5 trillion.
english: Because today, just look at it, next year, what we will collect from VAT, BIR, and BOC will roughly be ₱1.5 trillion.

text: The salaries alone of our employees amount to ₱1.7 trillion.
english: The salaries alone of our employees amount to ₱1.7 trillion.

text: So, the total VAT collection is not even enough to pay for the salaries of all our employees,” pahayag sini kadungan sang hearing sang Senate Finance Committee.
english: So, the total VAT collection is not even enough to pay for the salaries of all our employees,” he said during the hearing of the Senate Finance Committee.

text: “Lahat ng capital outlay natin — ibig sabihin, lahat ng tulay, kalsada, school building, hospital — inuutang natin.
english: “All of our capital outlay — that is, all of the bridges, roads, school buildings, hospitals — we borrow.

text:
So kung magbabawas po tayo ng revenue, baka pati ang current operating expenses natin, uutangin na rin natin.”

Si Recto amo ang author sang Expanded VAT law sang 2005 sang siya pa ang senador.
english:
So if we reduce revenue, maybe even our current operating expenses, we will have to borrow.”

Recto was the author of the Expanded VAT law in 2005 when he was a senator.

text: Nagpahayag siya nga gina-respeto man sini ang desisyon sang Kongreso kun repasuhon ukon amyendaran ang VAT system, apang nagpaandam siya nga ang pagpanubo sa rate ang mahimo makaapekto sa fiscal stability sang pungsod.
english: He said he also respects the decision of Congress whether to review or amend the VAT system, but he warned that the reduction in the rate could affect the fiscal stability of the country.

text: Nahibaluan nga lakip sa pending mga proposal sa Kamara kag Seado amo nga panubuon ang VAT rate sa 10% samtang nga pasangkaron ang tax base.
english: It is known that among the pending proposals in the House and Seado is to reduce the VAT rate to 10% while expanding the tax base.

text: May yara man sang ginaduso nga i-grant ang targeted VAT exemptions para sa kinahanglanon gid nga mga balaklon kag serbisyo kaangay sang electricity, fuel, kag food items.
english: There is also a proposal to grant targeted VAT exemptions for essential goods and services such as electricity, fuel, and food items.

text: Patigayunon sa Passi City arena ang pagbalik sang All-Star Weekend sang Philippine Basketball Association sa bulan sang Marso.
english: The Philippine Basketball Association's All-Star Weekend will be held at the Passi City arena in March.

text: Ini ang una nga tion halin sang 2019 nga ginbalik All-Star festivities.
english: This is the first time since 2019 that All-Star festivities have been reinstated.

text: Katapusan ini nga ginhiwat sa Calasiao, Pangasinan sang Marso sang amo nga tuig kun sa diin nagpangibabaw ang North All-Stars samtang sanday Japeth Aguilar sang Barangay Ginebra kag Arwind Santos naman sang San Miguel ang ginkilala nga Most Valuable Players.
english: It was last held in Calasiao, Pangasinan in March of that year where North All-Stars won while Japeth Aguilar of Barangay Ginebra and Arwind Santos of San Miguel were recognized as Most Valuable Players.

text: Suno kay PBA commissioner Willie Marcial, sa pagbalik sang event sa Marso 9-12, sa baylo nga traditional North vs.

english: South All-Stars format, the league will follow the set-up of the NBA where the leading vote-getters will draft their teammates for the game.

text: Ang fans man mismo ang makapili sang coaches para sa duha ka All-Star teams.
english: The fans also get to pick the coaches for both All-Star teams themselves.

text: Enero 25 natalana nga buksan ang fan balloting system pareho para sa online kag in game venues.
english: January 25 is scheduled to open the fan voting system both for online and in game venues.

english: Fans can vote until February 15 through the PBA website and their official social media platforms.

text: Suno pa kay Marcial, may yara man sang rookies-sophomores-juniors game kun sa diin ang kada team ang maga-feature sang duha ka first-year players.
english: Marcial said there will also be a rookies-sophomores-juniors game where each team will feature two first-year players.

text: Mahimo man i-feature sa hampang ang celebrities suno sa commissioner.

english: There will also be a blitz challenge, three-point shootout, and slam dunk contest.

english: The league is also planning a 3×3 competition that will feature local basketball stars of Passi City.

english: It can be recalled that in 2020, the PBA gave Passi City the PBA All-Star hosting rights.

english: The city hosted the PBA Governors Cup showdown in 2018 where Talk N Text KaTropa won against Rain or Shine Elasto Painters.

text: ILOILO CITY- Naplastar na sang More Electric and Power Corporation (MORE Power), ang mga plano sa pagsugod sang expansion sang ila nga franchise area.
english: ILOILO CITY- More Electric and Power Corporation (MORE Power) has laid out plans to start the expansion of its franchise area.

text: Ini matapos nga nag-lapse into law ang bill nga nagaduso sang pagpasangkad sang franchise area sang MORE Power sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: This is after the bill proposing the expansion of the franchise area of ​​MORE Power in Iloilo province was lapsed into law.

text: Sa idalom sang Republic Act 11918 ukon ang modified MORE Power franchise, nakasaad nga mahimo ini nga mag-provide sang electricity services sa Passi City, banwa sang Alimodian, Leganes, Leon, New Lucena, Pavia, San Miguel, Santa Barbara, Zarraga, Anilao, Banate, Barotac Nuevo, Dingle, Duenas, Dumangas kag San Enrique kag magalawig ini sang 25 ka tuig.
english: Under Republic Act 11918 or the modified MORE Power franchise, it is stated that it can provide electricity services in Passi City, Alimodian town, Leganes, Leon, New Lucena, Pavia, San Miguel, Santa Barbara, Zarraga, Anilao, Banate, Barotac Nuevo, Dingle, Duman, Enrique and Enrique and Enrique. of 25 years.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr Roel Castro, presidente sang MORE Power, iya ginpahayag nga una sila nga magatukod sang pasilidad sa banwa sang Pavia nga pinaka-adjacent sa Iloilo City.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mr. Roel Castro, president of MORE Power, said they will first build the facility in Pavia town, which is the most adjacent to Iloilo City.

text: Suno kay Castro, may yara na sila sang napatindog nga mga primary posts nga kabahin na nga daan sang ila pagpanghanda sa tion nga maaprubahan ang hagna kag masuguran ang proseso sang expansion.
english: According to Castro, they have already established primary posts that are already part of their preparations once the bill is approved and the expansion process begins.

text: Gin-athag naman ni Castro nga wala pa nila nabaton ang formal communication halin sa Malacanang tuhoy sa hagna nga nag-lapse agud mangin layi.
english: Castro explained that they have not yet received the formal communication from Malacanang regarding the bill that lapsed to become law.

text: Duha ka adlaw matapos ang koronasyon sang Miss World Philippines 2021, nag-resign na ang 2nd Princess nga si Ganiel Krishnan.
english: Two days after the coronation of Miss World Philippines 2021, 2nd Princess Ganiel Krishnan has resigned.

text: Suno kay Krishnan, nag-desisyon siya nga pilion ang iya propesyon bilang isa ka entertainment and lifestyle editor bangud mas daku ang iya nga platform agud nga maka-serbisyo sa Filipinos.
english: According to Krishnan, he decided to choose his profession as an entertainment and lifestyle editor because he has a bigger platform to serve Filipinos.

text: Ginpasalamatan man sini ang Miss World Philippines Organization kag nag-good luck sa kaupod niya nga mga beauty queens para sa ila masunod nga mga kumpetisyon.
english: She also thanked the Miss World Philippines Organization and wished her fellow beauty queens good luck for their upcoming competitions.

text: Ginrespeto naman sang organisasyon ang desisyon ni Krishnan.
english: The organization, however, respected Krishnan's decision.

text: Gin-appoint si Janelle Lewis sang Angeles City, Pampanga nga amo ang magabulos sa ginbilin nga korona bilang second princess.
english: Janelle Lewis of Angeles City, Pampanga was appointed to take over the crown as second princess.

text: Nag-lapse na bilang layi ang hagna nga nagaduso sa 25-year power utility franchise sang MORE Electric and Power Corporation (MORE Power).
english: The bill proposing the 25-year power utility franchise of MORE Electric and Power Corporation (MORE Power) has lapsed into law.

text: Ini ang epektibo sang July 30.
english: It is effective July 30.

text: Sa idalom sang Republic Act 11918 ukon modified MORE Power franchise, nasaad nga mahimo na maghatag ang MORE Power sang electricity services sa Syudad sang Iloilo kag Passi; kag mangin sa banwa sang Alimodian, Leganes, Leon, New Lucena, Pavia, San Miguel, Santa Barbara, Zarraga, Anilao, Banate, Barotac Nuevo, Dingle, Duenas, Dumangas kag San Enrique.
english: Under Republic Act 11918 or modified MORE Power franchise, it is promised that MORE Power can now provide electricity services in Iloilo City and Passi; and will be in the towns of Alimodian, Leganes, Leon, New Lucena, Pavia, San Miguel, Santa Barbara, Zarraga, Anilao, Banate, Barotac Nuevo, Dingle, Duenas, Dumangas and San Enrique.

text: Ang mga service areas nga ginhatag sa MORE Power ang ginalakipan sang mga lugar nga naserbisyuhan man sang Iloilo Electric Cooperatives (ILECO) I kag III – ang power utilities nga naghatag sang kuryente sa mga consumers sa sulod na sang pila ka dekada.
english: The service areas given to MORE Power include areas also served by Iloilo Electric Cooperatives (ILECO) I and III – the power utilities that have been providing electricity to consumers for decades.

text: Matandaan nga nangin kontrobersyal ang pag-take over sang MORE Power sa power distribution assets sang private firm nga Panay Electric Company (PECO) santo man sa ruling sang Supreme Court.
english: It can be recalled that MORE Power's takeover of the power distribution assets of private firm Panay Electric Company (PECO) has become controversial based on the ruling of the Supreme Court.

text: Ang RA 11918 ang isa lang sa mga hagna nga wala na-veto ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: RA 11918 is the only bill that was not vetoed by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: matapos nabilin nga pending sang Duterte administration.
english: after being left pending by the Duterte administration.

text: Nasaad sa layi nga ang MORE Power “shall not sell, lease, transfer, grant the usufruct of, nor assign this franchise or the rights and privileges acquired thereunder to any person, firm, company, corporation or other commercial or legal entity, nor merge with any other corporation or entity, nor shall transfer the controlling interest of the grantee – whether as a whole or in part.”
english: The law states that MORE Power “shall not sell, lease, transfer, grant the usufruct of, nor assign this franchise or the rights and privileges acquired thereunder to any person, firm, company, corporation or other commercial or legal entity, nor merge with any other corporation or entity, nor shall transfer the grant of control of whole part.”

text: Dalayon na nga gin-disqualify sang International Criminal Court (ICC) si chief prosecutor Karim Khan sa pag-uyat sang kaso nga war crimes batok kay former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The International Criminal Court (ICC) has immediately disqualified chief prosecutor Karim Khan from handling the war crimes case against former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Ginbasehan sang appeals judges sa desisyon ang ila gin-cite nga conflict of interest.
english: The appeals judges based the decision on what they cited as a conflict of interest.

text: Matandaan nga sang Agusto, nagpetisyon ang kampo ni Duterte nga i-disqualify si Khan.
english: In August, Duterte's camp petitioned to disqualify Khan.
